Motivation: 经典LM算法收敛快、鲁棒性强，但计算和内存成本随神经网络参数规模增大而显著上升。为解决这一限制，已有研究者提出子空间方法（如KSLM和HSLM）来提高二阶算法的效率，但需要对这些方法进行系统评估。

Method: 在神经网络上系统评估子空间LM算法变体（包括Krylov子空间LM和混合子空间LM等），并将其与经典LM方法以及其他流行的一阶算法（如SGD和Adam）进行性能比较，涵盖回归和分类两类任务。

Result: 给出了子空间LM变体在回归和分类任务上的性能评估结果，并与经典LM及一阶优化算法进行了对比分析。

Conclusion: 通过实验评估展示了子空间LM算法在保持二阶优化优势的同时提升效率的可行性，为在大规模神经网络中选择合适的优化算法提供了参考依据。

Abstract: The Levenberg-Marquardt (LM) algorithm is a well-known second-order method for rapid convergence and strong robustness when training small- to medium-sized neural networks (NNs). However, its computational and memory costs increase significantly as the number of parameters in an NN grows. To address this limitation, subspace methods have been proposed, such as the Krylov subspace LM (KSLM) and the hybrid subspace LM (HSLM), making second-order algorithms more efficient. In this work, we evaluate the subspace Levenberg-Marquardt algorithms for regression and classification tasks in neural networks. We compare the performance of subspace LM variants with the classical LM method, as well as other popular first-order algorithms, such as stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and Adam.

</details>


### [197] [CRAD: Class-wise Reliability-Aware Distillation for Decentralized Heterogeneous Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00446)
*Baraa Bilbeisi,Mengchen Fan,Baocheng Geng,Qing Tian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种去中心化的知识蒸馏框架CRAD（Class-wise Reliability-Aware Distillation），解决了传统联邦学习对客户端同构架构和IID数据的双重要求。每个客户端在其本地数据上评估同伴模型并从中蒸馏，通过按类别感知的可靠性加权聚合同伴教师预测，在异构架构与严重非IID数据下超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统联邦学习依赖参数平均，要求客户端架构一致且数据同分布，但真实部署中两者均难以满足。作者转向去中心化知识蒸馏框架，使客户端可自由使用不同架构且无需暴露原始数据，但面临关键问题：如何有效组合多个同伴教师的预测。现有均匀平均方法忽略了不同教师在不同类别上知识可靠性的差异。

Method: CRAD方法包含两个步骤：1）按类别过滤掉与同伴共识相悖的教师；2）对保留下来的教师按每类可靠性（精确率或方差的倒数）进行加权平均。由于n个样本的精度方差与1/n成正比，样本支持度被自然纳入权重——幸存教师在某类别上越准确且证据越充分，其信任度越高。

Result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和PathMNIST三个图像分类基准上，跨异构架构和严重non-IID数据分布下，CRAD在全局准确率上一致优于对比方法。

Conclusion: CRAD通过类别级可靠性感知的教师聚合策略，有效解决了去中心化联邦知识蒸馏中教师预测组合的核心挑战，在异构架构与高度非IID环境下显著提升模型性能。

Abstract: Conventional federated learning (FL) relies on parameter averaging, which forces clients to be doubly homogeneous: it demands an identical architecture and degrades under non-IID data. Real-world deployments usually break both assumptions. We sidestep both by building a decentralized knowledge distillation framework in which each client evaluates its peers' model snapshots on its own local data and distills from the resulting soft predictions. Because knowledge is transferred through the shared class posterior, clients are free to run different architectures; and because every teacher is evaluated on the student's own device, raw data never leaves the client, with no central server or public dataset required. Within this setting, we identify and address an under-examined problem: how to combine the peer teacher predictions. Existing methods, like uniform averaging, ignore how knowledge reliability varies across teachers and classes. We propose Class-wise Reliability-Aware Distillation (CRAD), which, per class, first discards teachers that disagree with the peer consensus and then takes a weighted average of the rest, weighting each teacher by its per-class reliability (precision, or inverse variance). Since the variance of an accuracy from $n$ samples scales as $1/n$, support enters automatically: among the teachers that survive filtering, a teacher is trusted for a class to the degree that it is both accurate and well-evidenced for it. On three image-classification benchmarks (CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and PathMNIST colon pathology), across heterogeneous architectures under severe non-IID skew, CRAD consistently outperforms competing methods in global accuracy.

</details>


### [198] [HBQ: Hierarchical Scaling Block Quantization with Hardware-Efficiency-Aware Design for Accurate LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00450)
*Chun-Ting Chen,Dongmin Han,Hangyeol Mun,Jake Hyun,Arnab Raha,Amit Agarwal,Mark Anders,Mohamed Abdelfattah,Jae-sun Seo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出层级块量化（HBQ）方法，通过在大块基础上引入低开销的有效数字（SIG）二级缩放，解决了传统块量化（BQ）在硬件效率与精度之间的权衡问题，在28nm ASIC上实现了优于现有方法的面积/能效比和精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 块量化（BQ）相比标量仅权重量化（WoQ）能同时量化权重和激活，提供更高的硬件效率和统一的端到端推理路径，但其设计空间（位宽、块大小、缩放、数值格式）尚未被充分探索。研究发现增大块大小可提升硬件效率但会降低精度，这一固有权衡限制了传统BQ方法的性能。

Method: HBQ采用大块以最大化硬件效率，并引入低开销的significand（SIG）缩放作为第二级量化来补偿大块带来的精度损失。与传统Power-of-Two（PoT）或整数缩放不同，SIG缩放通过有效分配量化级别并考虑激活和权重的不同分布来更好地补偿误差。论文还实现了HBQ-A（高精度）和HBQ-E（高效率）两个变体，并在28nm ASIC上实现，同时提出部分和BQ方案以降低EMA能耗。

Result: HBQ-A在仅使用W4A5的情况下达到W4A16级别的精度，且所需硅面积小于NVFP4；HBQ-E在保持高于所有现有BQ方法精度的同时降低17%硬件成本。相比最先进的WoQ方法，HBQ在相同精度下提供2.3倍面积效率和4.6倍能效；相比现有BQ方法，实现1.6-3.3倍系统能耗降低和1.5-3.0倍加速，同时保持最佳精度。

Conclusion: HBQ通过层级化的量化设计有效地解决了BQ中硬件效率与精度之间的权衡问题，SIG缩放策略为大规模LLM的高效低精度推理提供了一种新的可行方案，在准确性和硬件效率方面均优于现有方法。

Abstract: Block Quantization (BQ) is a promising approach for efficient deployment of large language models (LLMs), enabling low-precision computation with controlled accuracy degradation. Compared to scalar weight-only quantization (WoQ), BQ quantizes both weight and activation, offering higher hardware efficiency and end-to-end inference on a unified datapath, but its design space, spanning bit-width, block size, scaling, and numeric formats, remains underexplored.
  We provide hardware/benchmark results through design space exploration (DSE). We find that increasing block size improves hardware efficiency by amortizing dequantization and accumulation costs, but degrades accuracy. This trade-off limits conventional BQ methods.
  Motivated by this insight, we propose Hierarchical Block Quantization (HBQ). Unlike prior methods [1], [2], which use small blocks and conventional Power-of-Two (PoT) or integer-based scaling, HBQ uses large blocks to maximize efficiency and introduces low-overhead significand (SIG) scaling for second-level quantization. By allocating quantization levels effectively and accounting for distinct activation and weight distributions, SIG scaling compensates for large-block errors more effectively than prior PoT and INT schemes. HBQ-A (accurate) achieves W4A16-level accuracy using only W4A5 while requiring less silicon area than NVFP4. HBQ-E (efficient) further reduces hardware cost by 17% while maintaining higher accuracy than all existing BQ methods.
  We implemented a 28nm ASIC accelerator applying HBQ to weights, activations, and KV cache, and integrated a novel partial-sum BQ scheme to further reduce EMA energy.
  Compared to state-of-the-art WoQ, HBQ delivers $2.3\times$/$4.6\times$ higher area/energy efficiency at the same accuracy level; $1.6$--$3.3\times$ system energy reduction and $1.5$--$3.0\times$ speedup over prior BQ methods while providing best accuracy.

</details>


### [199] [Can LLMs Use Relational Transformer Embeddings?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00457)
*Francisco Galuppo Azevedo,Clarissa Lima Loures*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过将冻结的关系编码器（Relational Transformer）嵌入以软标记形式注入LLM（Qwen3.5-4B），尝试融合结构化关系推理与语言能力，但在RelBench的10个二分类任务上系统性地报告了负面结果：混合模型并未稳定超越独立的关系编码器，甚至经常低于随机水平，且对序列化格式和关系标记预算高度敏感，在RL训练下不稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软标记融合策略在概念上具有吸引力——让关系编码器处理多表结构、LLM处理语言与推理，避免了有损的文本序列化。作者希望实证检验这一假设的可行性，为多表关系预测提供一种无需将结构化数据转为文本的融合路径。

Method: 将冻结的Relational Transformer嵌入通过学习的MLP投影注入Qwen3.5-4B，并配合LoRA适配。训练分两阶段：先用SFT在思维链推理轨迹上微调，再用基于组的强化学习（GSPO）训练。评估覆盖RelBench中6个关系数据库的10个二分类任务，在四种监督模式下（单任务、数据集内、跨数据集、全任务）检验模型表现。

Result: 混合模型未能在一致性上超越独立的关系编码器：性能经常低于随机基线，对序列化格式和关系标记预算高度敏感，且在RL训练下表现出不稳定性。论文提供了系统性负面结果和失败模式分析。

Conclusion: 软标记融合策略在当前设计下尚不可靠，需要更强的对齐目标和模式感知设计才能成为关系预测的可行路径。该研究的价值在于如实报告负面结果并剖析失败原因，为后续研究提供重要参考。

Abstract: Injecting frozen relational-encoder embeddings as soft tokens into a large language model (LLM) is a conceptually appealing fusion strategy: the encoder handles multi-table structure, the LLM handles language and reasoning, and no lossy text serialization is required. We test this hypothesis concretely by injecting embeddings from a frozen Relational Transformer (RT) into Qwen3.5-4B via a learned MLP projection and LoRA adaptation, trained first with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on chain-of-thought reasoning traces and then with group-based reinforcement learning (GSPO). We evaluate across 10 binary classification tasks on 6 relational databases from RelBench, under four supervision regimes: single-task (ST), within-dataset (WD), cross-dataset (CD), and all-task (ALL). The hybrid model does not consistently outperform standalone RT: it is frequently below random, highly sensitive to serialization format and relational-token budget, and unstable under RL training. We report these negative results and analyze the failure modes, arguing that soft-token fusion requires stronger alignment objectives and schema-aware design before it can serve as a reliable route to relational prediction.

</details>


### [200] [Context Window Failures in Relational Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00460)
*Denis Oliveira Correa,Francisco Galuppo Azevedo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文引入Animus——一个合成金融数据集，其预测客户收入需要聚合数万条交易记录。在此数据集上，三种近期提出的关系深度学习方法（RT、Griffin、RelGT）因受限于邻域预算（迫于截断高基数关系记录），R²仅≤0.18；而一个简单的时序预聚合步骤即可将R²提升至0.65，质疑了当前关系基础模型对高基数真实世界数据的适用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期提出的关系深度学习架构（如RT、Griffin、RelGT）被宣传为多表关系数据的基础模型，但它们的架构设计中强加了受限的邻域预算，当一个实体拥有大量相关记录时只能被迫进行行截断。作者旨在探究这些模型在处理高基数（high-cardinality）真实场景数据时的实际能力是否足够。

Method: 作者构建了一个合成金融数据集Animus，其中预测客户收入这一任务本质上要求聚合多达数万条交易记录。他们在此原始数据表示上评估了三种已提出的关系模型（RT、Griffin、RelGT），并将其与执行单一的常规时序预聚合步骤后的表现进行对比。

Result: 在原始数据表示上，三种模型（RT、Griffin、RelGT）的R²均不超过0.18，表现糟糕；而仅执行一次常规的时序预聚合步骤后，R²可恢复至最高0.65，性能大幅提升。

Conclusion: 当前的关系基础模型在面对高基数的现实世界数据时尚未做好准备。它们对邻域预算的硬性限制导致在处理大量关联记录时信息严重丢失，而简单的预聚合操作反而能获得远超这些先进模型的性能，这暴露了现有架构的重大局限。

Abstract: Recent Relational Deep Learning architectures have been proposed as foundation models for multi-table relational data, yet they impose constrained neighborhood budgets that force row truncation when an entity has many related records. We introduce Animus, a synthetic financial dataset in which predicting customer income requires aggregating up to tens of thousands of transactions. On the raw representation, three recently proposed models (RT, Griffin, RelGT) achieve $R^2 \le 0.18$; a single, routine, temporal pre-aggregation step recovers $R^2$ up to $0.65$. This questions whether current relational foundation models are ready for high-cardinality real-world data.

</details>


### [201] [Higher Structures in Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00472)
*Michael L. Roberts,Carlos Zapata Carratalá. Nicholas J. Cooper,Lijun Chen,François G. Meyer,Danna Gurari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首先就高元张量运算对深度学习的重要性进行说明性介绍，随后对训练后神经网络中的高元现象进行了新颖的实证研究，引入了多层感知机的超图泛化版本，并探讨了与进化算法的联系，最后讨论了未来有前景的研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习中的大多数运算都是二元（成对）的，而现实中许多复杂关系本质上是高元的（涉及多个实体之间的交互）。作者希望探索高元（higher-arity）张量运算在深度学习中是否具有重要性和潜力，以突破传统二元运算的局限性。

Method: 论文采用多种方法：（1）对高元张量运算在深度学习中的重要性进行说明性（expository）综述；（2）对训练后的神经网络进行新颖的实证研究，考察其中的高元现象；（3）提出多层感知机（MLP）的超图（hypergraphical）泛化形式；（4）探索与进化算法（evolutionary algorithms）之间的联系。

Result: 论文提供了关于高元运算重要性的介绍性分析，通过实证研究揭示了训练神经网络中的高元现象，并成功提出了超图泛化的多层感知机架构，同时建立了其与进化算法的理论联系。不过，文中未给出具体的定量实验结果。

Conclusion: 高元张量运算是一个值得深入探索的方向，本文所提出的超图MLP和与进化算法的联系为未来研究提供了新的切入点，作者认为该方向具有广阔的研究前景。

Abstract: We provide an expository introduction on the importance of higher-arity tensor operations to deep learning. Then, we conduct a novel empirical investigation of higher-arity phenomenon in trained neural networks, introduce a hypergraphical generalization of the multilayer perceptron, and explore connections to evolutionary algorithms. We conclude with a discussion of promising directions for future research.

</details>


### [202] [AdaptNTK: Adaptive Uncertainty Quantification and Active Learning for Neural Network Potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00488)
*Prajwal Ananth,Shuwen Yue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AdaptNTK，一种基于经验神经正切核（NTK）特征空间中正则化马氏距离来度量不确定性的单模型框架，用于机器学习原子间势的主动学习。由于NTK特征在采集过程中固定，不确定性可随每次选择递归更新而无需重训练，从而减少批内冗余。在rMD17和Transition-1X数据集上取得了最优的力误差和最高相关性，比集成方法快2.6倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有不确定性量化方法常在计算成本与可靠性之间权衡，且当批量采集配置时通常无法考虑冗余性，导致主动学习效率受限。

Method: AdaptNTK采用单模型架构，在经验NTK特征空间中用正则化马氏距离度量不确定性。由于NTK特征在采集过程中固定不变，不确定性仅依赖于已采集的配置而非参考标签，因此可在每次选择后递归更新不确定性，实现批内去冗余而无需重新训练模型。

Result: 在rMD17留出数据上，AdaptNTK取得最高的力误差相关性（Spearman 0.68，Pearson 0.71），与三成员集成的误差保留能力相当。在rMD17和Transition-1X的主动学习实验中取得最低力误差，尤其在Transition-1X的过渡态构型上表现突出，且每轮比集成方法快2.6倍。

Conclusion: AdaptNTK提供了高效的单模型不确定性估计与顺序更新机制，能够实现数据高效的主动学习，在精度和计算效率上均优于现有方法。

Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials bridge the gap between quantum chemical precision and classical computational speed, enabling molecular dynamics simulations with first-principles accuracy. Their reliability is often improved through active learning, which iteratively expands the training set by identifying uncertain, out-of-distribution configurations. Existing uncertainty-quantification methods often involve a trade-off between computational cost and reliability, and generally cannot account for redundancy as an acquisition batch is assembled. Here, we introduce AdaptNTK, a single-model framework that measures uncertainty as a regularized Mahalanobis distance in empirical neural tangent kernel (NTK) feature space. With the NTK features fixed during acquisition, the uncertainty depends on the acquired configurations but not their reference labels. This allows the uncertainty to be updated recursively after each selection without retraining, reducing redundancy within an acquisition batch. On held-out rMD17 data, AdaptNTK achieves the highest mean correlations with force errors (Spearman 0.68, Pearson 0.71) and matches a three-member ensemble in error retention. In active learning experiments, AdaptNTK achieves the lowest force errors across rMD17 and Transition-1X, with particularly strong performance on transition-state configurations in Transition-1X. AdaptNTK provides a 2.6-fold speedup per Transition-1X cycle relative to the ensemble, providing efficient single-model uncertainty estimation with sequential updates for data-efficient active learning.

</details>


### [203] [A hybrid quantum-classical neural network for learning to route](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00489)
*Marcus Rolf Peter Ritt,Alexsandro Santos da Rosa Júnior,Marcos Vinicius Reballo,Cesar Augusto do Amaral,Fernando Augusto Caletti de Barros*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究混合量子-经典神经网络用于学习路由启发式算法，探讨小型量子神经网络能否替代竞争性注意力路由模型中的参数密集模块。针对容量车辆路径问题（CVRP），编码器前馈替换是最有前景的设计，可将模型参数减少56.6%，同时在小规模和中规模实例上保持接近经典神经基线的求解质量，但大规模实例上差距增大。与经典路由算法相比，混合模型并无优势。结果表明不存在量子优势，但编码器前馈替换是神经组合优化中可行的混合模块压缩策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索量子神经网络在神经组合优化中的实际价值，特别是能否用小型量子模块压缩大规模经典注意力路由模型中的参数密集部分，同时保持求解质量。

Method: 在注意力路由模型框架内，用小型量子神经网络替换不同的参数密集模块（重点考察编码器前馈替换），构建混合量子-经典模型，并在CVRP上评估参数缩减比例与求解质量的权衡。

Result: 编码器前馈替换将模型参数减少56.6%，在小中型实例上保持接近经典基线性能，但大型实例性能差距扩大；与经典路由算法相比，混合模型不具优势。

Conclusion: 研究未发现量子优势或求解器主导性，但表明编码器前馈替换可作为神经组合优化中有效的混合模块压缩策略，为量子-经典混合神经网络提供了务实的应用定位。

Abstract: This work studies hybrid quantum-classical neural networks for learning routing heuristics. Specifically, this paper asks whether small quantum neural networks can replace parameter-heavy modules inside a competitive attention-based routing model while maintaining solution quality. For the capacitated vehicle routing problem, encoder feed-forward replacement emerges as the most promising design: it reduces the number of model parameters by 56.6% while keeping the hybrid model close to the classical neural baseline at small and medium instance sizes, although the gap grows for larger instances. This work also compares to classical routing algorithms, which remain highly competitive and often superior on the fixed Euclidean test sets. Our results therefore do not indicate quantum advantage or solver dominance, but identify encoder feed-forward replacement as a viable hybrid-module compression strategy for neural combinatorial optimization.

</details>


### [204] [VATO: A Vortex-Force-Aware Transformer Operator for Unsteady Separated Aerofoil Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00507)
*Xingxin Yang,Zhan Zhang,Yichen Li,Juan Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出VATO（涡力感知Transformer算子），通过将涡力地图（VFM）方法耦合到几何感知的神经网络算子中，用于提高非定常分离流的预测精度和空气动力学功能准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非定常分离流的准确预测具有挑战性，因为气动载荷依赖于非线性分离和涡脱落动力学。高保真CFD虽能解析这些机制，但计算成本限制了其在设计和控制中的重复使用。而标准的场级代理模型训练不能区分对气动载荷贡献最大的流场区域。

Method: 提出VATO框架，包含两个机制：VATO-S在训练阶段附加VFM局部力贡献场的监督（不增加模型规模或推理成本）；VATO-A使用VFM贡献场和敏感度场来优先选择与力相关的源位置用于残差交叉注意力。

Result: 在双刃板翼型54条轨迹、9种几何外形的非定常CFD数据上评估：在1-20ms前导时间内，VATO-S将速度、压力和涡量误差分别降低10.4%、1.0%和15.6%；VATO-A分别降低15.8%、7.5%和31.2%。VATO-S在VFM导出的阻力误差上最优，VATO-A在压力导出的升力和阻力误差上最优。在训练范围外延伸50%的前导时间内，VATO-A保持涡量误差降低26.9%。

Conclusion: 力感知算子学习能够同时改善非定常分离流中的流场预测和空气动力学功能准确性，展示了将物理力信息融入算子学习的有效性和泛化能力。

Abstract: Accurate prediction of unsteady separated flows is challenging because the aerodynamic loads depend on nonlinear separation and vortex-shedding dynamics. Although high-fidelity CFD resolves these mechanisms, its cost limits repeated use in design and control. Standard field-level surrogate training, however, does not distinguish the flow regions that contribute most strongly to the aerodynamic loads. We introduce VATO (Vortex-Force-Aware Transformer Operator), which couples the Vortex Force Map (VFM) method to a geometry-aware neural operator through two complementary mechanisms. VATO-S adds training-only supervision of the local VFM force-contribution field, with no increase in model size or inference cost. VATO-A uses VFM contribution and sensitivity fields to prioritise force-relevant source locations for residual cross attention. The methods are evaluated on unsteady CFD data for double-edged-plate aerofoils over 54 trajectories from nine geometries. Over lead times of 1-20~ms, VATO-S reduces velocity, pressure, and vorticity errors by 10.4\%, 1.0\%, and 15.6\%, respectively, while VATO-A achieves reductions of 15.8\%, 7.5\%, and 31.2\%. VATO-S gives the lowest VFM-derived drag error, whereas VATO-A gives the lowest pressure-derived lift and drag errors. Over lead times extending 50\% beyond the training range, VATO-A retains a 26.9\% reduction in vorticity error and larger improvements in all four force readouts, despite reduced gains in velocity and pressure. These results show that force-aware operator learning can improve both flow-field prediction and aerodynamic functional accuracy in unsteady separated flows.

</details>


### [205] [Learning Task-Specific Antibody Representations via Function-Aware Masking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00518)
*Ayan Goel,Thomas A. Walton,Amirali Aghazadeh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"功能感知掩码"（function-aware masking）预训练算法族，通过将掩码位置与特定的功能先验（如IMGT注释或结构预测）对齐来塑造抗体的表示空间，显著提升了结构相关任务和CDR相关任务的性能，并开发了混合掩码策略以在多功能轴上取得平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的抗体语言模型通过掩码语言建模（MLM）预训练学习表征，但很少利用掩码过程本身作为先验知识来源。虽然优先掩码CDR区域可以改善结合相关预测，但抗体具有多样的生物学功能先验，现有方法未能充分利用这些不同功能域的先验信息。

Method: 提出功能感知掩码算法族，将掩码位置与特定的功能先验（来自IMGT注释或结构预测）对齐来塑造学习到的表示空间。进一步开发了混合掩码策略，集成多个先验以平衡重建过程中结合、结构和生物物理等多重目标。

Result: 专家化掩码策略在各自目标上显著提升性能：结构相关任务提升高达14%，CDR相关任务提升高达5.9倍。混合掩码策略在多个功能轴上进一步改善整体性能。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，有信息的掩码放置提供了一种无参数的机制，可以在抗体语言模型训练中施加功能性归纳偏置，而无需增加模型参数或修改模型架构。

Abstract: Antibody-specific language models pretrained via masked language modeling (MLM) learn representations that are critical for downstream sequence design and property prediction tasks. Yet, the corruption process itself is rarely leveraged as a source of inductive bias during pretraining. While preferentially masking complementarity-determining regions (CDRs) improves binding-related predictions, antibodies possess diverse biological priors over a variety of functions. Herein, we introduce function-aware masking, a family of pretraining algorithms that align mask placement with specific functional priors (e.g., from IMGT annotations or structure predictions) to shape the learned representation space. We show that these specialist masking strategies significantly improve performance on their respective objectives, yielding up to a 14% gain on structure-related tasks and up to a 5.9x improvement on CDR-related tasks. To further improve performance across multiple functional axes, we develop hybrid masking strategies that integrate multiple priors, balancing reconstruction over binding, structural, and biophysical objectives. Our results demonstrate that informed mask placement provides a parameter-free mechanism for imposing functional inductive biases in antibody language model training.

</details>


### [206] [Why Multi-Layer Message Passing Works: Completeness Theory for Graph Neural Network Interatomic Potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00528)
*Pingbing Ming,Han Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了超图神经网络（具有3体消息传递的不变架构）是势能面的通用逼近器。主要贡献是提出了多层完备性理论，证明在稀疏、基于截断的图上进行L层消息传递，可以等价于拥有完整L跳邻域的表达能力（在通用配置、重叠条件和连通性条件下），为多层消息传递配合小于物理相互作用范围的逐层截断这一普遍做法提供了首个严格的理论证明。作为推论，DPA3和CHGNet架构也继承了通用逼近性质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际应用中几乎所有基于图神经网络的经验势能模型都采用多层消息传递，且每层截断半径小于物理相互作用范围，但此前缺乏严格的理论证明来说明这种做法的有效性。作者希望填补这一理论空白，为常见实践提供严谨的数学依据。

Method: 作者证明了多层完备性理论：在配置满足通用性（generic）、重叠条件（overlap condition）和连通性条件（connectivity condition）的情况下，在稀疏截断图上进行L层消息传递，可获得与完整L跳邻域相同的表达能力。核心在于证明超图神经网络（3体消息传递）是势能面的通用逼近器，并通过该理论框架推导出DPA3和CHGNet的通用逼近性质。

Result: 首次为多层消息传递配合逐层短截断的常见实践提供了严格的理论基础证明；证明了超图神经网络对势能面的通用逼近性；并直接将DPA3和CHGNet两个实际模型纳入通用逼近的理论保证范围内。

Conclusion: 本文从理论上验证了实际图神经网络势能模型中广泛采用的设计范式（多层短截断消息传递）的可行性，为该领域的模型设计提供了坚实的理论支撑，并推广至多个实际使用的架构。

Abstract: We prove that the Hypergraph Neural Network, an invariant architecture with 3-body message passing, is a universal approximator for potential energy surfaces. Our main contribution is a multi-layer completeness theory. We show that $L$ layers of message passing on sparse, cutoff-based graphs achieve the same representational power as having access to the full $L$-hop neighborhood, provided the configurations are generic, satisfy an overlap condition and a connectivity condition. This provides the first rigorous justification for the common practice of using multi-layer message passing with a per-layer cutoff smaller than the physical interaction range, the setting used by virtually all practical graph neural network based machine-learned interatomic potentials. As immediate consequences, we show that both DPA3 and CHGNet architectures inherit universal approximation.

</details>


### [207] [DeSyR: A Decoupled Symbolic Recovery Framework with PINN-Guided Structure Search and Physics-Informed Coefficient Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00530)
*Pancheng Niu,Jun Guo,Qiaolin He,Jingcai Guo,Yanchao Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DeSyR框架，将符号回归过程解耦为"拓扑搜索"与"系数精炼"两个阶段。先用物理信息神经网络指导候选拓扑构造（含临时常数），拓扑固定后仅基于控制方程和约束精炼系数，再进行门控选择与验证。理论分析表明，在特定条件下纯物理精炼能条件性恢复精确系数；在15个微分方程问题（18种配置）上，配置级中位相对L2误差低至2.31×10⁻¹⁴或更低，同拓扑下精炼将误差降低8至14个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从不完美的教师数据中恢复紧凑的显式微分方程符号解具有挑战性：不完美的教师数据会同时误导符号拓扑搜索和系数估计，导致最终恢复的系数继承教师误差尺度。

Method: DeSyR采用解耦策略：(1) PINN引导重复搜索构造候选拓扑（含暂定常数）；(2) 拓扑确定后，系数仅从控制方程和规定约束精炼（不依赖教师数据）；(3) 门控选择与验证。理论部分对线性固定拓扑参数化刻画了教师误差继承，并给出纯物理精炼恢复精确系数的充分条件（适定性、可表示性、零残差可达性、离散确定性）；非线性参数化仅提供局部保证。

Result: 在15个微分方程问题（18种配置）上评估，涵盖高阶、时空、多维、非线性和耦合系统。候选级审计显示自由参数重拟合的收敛率达99.23%；所有选中的自由系数精炼均收敛。配置级中位精炼相对L2误差为2.31×10⁻¹⁴或更低；同拓扑比较中，精炼将误差降低8至14个数量级。

Conclusion: 结果表明：只要保留目标能力的拓扑且纯物理精炼收敛，近似的神经教师可以引导拓扑发现而不将其误差尺度强加于最终恢复的系数上。这证明了将拓扑搜索与系数估计解耦是有效的符号恢复范式。

Abstract: Recovering compact explicit solutions from neural approximations is challenging when imperfect teacher data guide symbolic topology search and coefficient estimation. We present DeSyR, a decoupled symbolic recovery framework for differential equations. A physics-informed neural network guides repeated searches to construct candidate topologies with provisional constants. Once a topology is fixed, its coefficients are refined solely from the governing equation and prescribed constraints, followed by gated selection and verification. For linear fixed-topology parameterizations, we characterize teacher-error inheritance and show that finite-weight mixed data--physics fitting retains an $O(β^{-1})$ teacher-dependent contribution when the teacher error projects onto the model space. Under well-posedness, representability, zero-residual attainment, and discrete determinacy, physics-only refinement conditionally recovers exact coefficients; for nonlinear parameterizations, the corresponding guarantees are local. DeSyR is evaluated on 15 differential-equation problems across 18 configurations covering high-order, space--time, multidimensional, nonlinear, and coupled systems. A candidate-level audit yields a 99.23% convergence rate among free-parameter refits, while every selected refinement involving free coefficients converges. Configuration-level median refined relative $L_2$ errors are $2.31\times10^{-14}$ or lower. In same-topology comparisons, refinement reduces error by eight to fourteen orders of magnitude. These results show that an approximate neural teacher can guide topology discovery without imposing its error scale on final recovered coefficients, provided a target-capable topology is retained and physics-only refinement converges.

</details>


### [208] [GenONet: A Generative operator Network for High-Resolution Precipitation Nowcasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00544)
*Mohammad Kian Golkar,Luciano Alves de Oliveira,Mohammad Khanjani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GenONet（Spatio-Temporal U-DeepONet），一种结合Deep Operator Network（DeepONet）生成器和生成对抗网络（GAN）框架的新型架构，用于长达3小时的高分辨率降水临近预报。通过对抗训练生成清晰的预报，并利用基于水分守恒方程的物理信息损失提高物理一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率降水临近预报对减轻恶劣天气影响至关重要，但快速风暴演变使其具有挑战性。现有深度学习模型在较长预报时效内预测技能退化，产生模糊预报，无法捕捉风暴系统的复杂非线性演变。

Method: GenONet架构创新性地将DeepONet作为GAN框架中的生成器，用于学习降水的连续时间动力学以确保长时间预报稳定性；通过时空判别器对抗训练产生清晰连贯的预报；并引入基于水分守恒方程的物理信息损失正则化器增强物理合理性。通过消融实验验证物理损失的有效性。

Result: 定量评估表明模型在大多数指标上持续获得更高分数，特别是在高强度事件和较长提前时间方面。定性上，GenONet生成结构连贯且保持完整性的预报，而基线模型退化为模糊模式。消融研究证实了物理信息损失的益处。

Conclusion: 将算子学习与对抗训练相结合能够有效提升长时间降水预报的清晰度和物理一致性，物理信息损失进一步增强了模型性能。

Abstract: High-resolution precipitation nowcasting is critical for reducing the impacts of severe weather but remains difficult because of rapid storm evolution. Deep learning models have shown great promise for this task, but their predictive skill often deteriorates over longer forecast horizons. This leads to increasingly blurry forecasts that fail to capture the complex, non-linear evolution of storm systems. In order to address these limitations, we introduce Spatio-Temporal U-DeepONet (GenONet), a novel architecture for long-range precipitation forecasting up to 3 hours, specifically designed to produce sharp and physically consistent results. GenONet's architecture pioneers the use of a Deep Operator Network (DeepONet) as a generator within a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) framework for this task. The DeepONet learns the continuous-time dynamics of precipitation, ensuring stability over long forecast horizons. Adversial training against a spatio-temporal discriminator compels the model to produce sharp, coherent forecasts, while a physics-informed loss regularizer, derived from the Moisture Conservation Equation, improves physical plausibility in our ablation setting. Quantitative evaluations show that our model achieves consistently higher scores on most of the metrics, especially for highintensity events and at longer lead times. Qualitatively, GenONet produces structurally coherent forecasts that maintain their integrity, whereas baseline models degrade into indistinct patterns. Finally, an ablation study confirms the benefit of this physics-informed loss, highlighting the strength of combining operator learning with adversarial training.

</details>


### [209] [Manifold-Aware General Coded Computing for Straggler-Resilient Distributed Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00552)
*Parsa Moradi,Mohammad Ali Maddah-Ali*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种流形感知的编码策略（manifold-aware encoding），用于通用编码计算（GCC）。与现有编码计算设计忽略数据结构不同，该方法利用高维数据自然集中在低维流形附近的几何特性，设计沿数据自然流形分布的编码样本。实验表明，在神经网络推理和高维多项式评估任务中，相比标准GCC，该方法在存在掉队节点的情况下显著降低了均方恢复误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有编码计算设计没有显式利用输入数据的内在结构。在通信系统中，数据结构冗余在信道编码前通过源编码被去除，但这一原理不能直接迁移到编码计算中，因为机器学习等计算任务恰恰需要利用数据结构来推断输出或学习模式。因此编码计算方案应保留并利用结构，而非忽视或消除它。此外，许多高维数据集自然集中分布在低维流形附近，现有方法却强加与数据分布无关的人工低维结构。

Method: 受图基流形学习的启发，提出流形感知的编码策略：不是对数据施加与分布无关的人工代数结构（如Reed-Solomon码中在选定点评估低维代数表示），而是设计遵循数据自然流形的编码样本，并应用于通用编码计算（GCC）框架中。

Result: 在神经网络推理和高维多项式评估两个任务上的实验表明，该流形感知编码策略在掉队（straggling）情况下，与标准GCC相比，一致且显著地降低了均方恢复误差。

Conclusion: 通过利用数据的内在几何结构（低维流形），可以在编码计算中获得更好的恢复性能。这启示编码设计应尊重并利用数据分布的先验结构，而非忽视它们。

Abstract: Existing coded-computing designs do not explicitly exploit the intrinsic structure of the input data. In communication systems, statistical structure and redundancy are often removed through source coding (or compression) before channel coding is applied. This principle, however, does not transfer directly to coded computation. In many computational tasks, particularly in machine learning, the structure of the data is precisely what the computation seeks to exploit to infer outputs or learn meaningful patterns. Consequently, coded-computing schemes should preserve and leverage this structure in their code design, rather than ignoring or eliminating it through source coding.
  This observation motivates a different perspective on code construction. In many channel-coding schemes, such as Reed-Solomon codes, coded symbols are generated by evaluating a low-dimensional algebraic representation at selected points. In contrast, many high-dimensional datasets naturally concentrate near low-dimensional manifolds. In this paper, we exploit this intrinsic geometry by designing coded samples that follow the natural manifold of the data, rather than imposing an artificial low-dimensional structure unrelated to the data distribution. Inspired by graph-based manifold learning, we propose a manifold-aware encoding strategy for general coded computing (GCC). Experiments on neural network inference and high-dimensional polynomial evaluation demonstrate that the proposed strategy consistently and significantly reduces the mean squared recovery error under straggling compared with standard GCC.

</details>


### [210] [EEG-VID: Task-Guided Latent Predictive Pretraining for EEG Decoding and Assistive Target Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00566)
*Guanzhong Sun,Junyi Ma,Yuxuan Wu,Yanzi Miao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出EEG-VID，一种任务引导的潜在预测预训练框架，用于跨会话和跨被试的EEG解码。该框架通过指数移动平均目标编码器和弱任务引导，从近期历史预测未来潜在EEG状态，随后进行监督微调，在多个基准数据集上显著提升解码性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG解码在会话间和被试间存在显著的分布偏移，导致模型泛化能力差，传统方法难以有效应对这些shift带来的性能下降。

Method: EEG-VID采用任务引导的潜在预测预训练框架：使用指数移动平均(EMA)目标编码器从历史EEG数据预测未来的潜在状态，并引入弱任务引导信号，之后进行监督微调以适应具体任务。

Result: 在VIG-48和BCI Competition IV-2a/IV-2b上，Stage 1在42个匹配对比中改善41个平均准确率（包含全部12个留一被试设置），最大提升16.22个百分点。在VIG-48跨天任务上达到6.52% Top-1和30.50% Top-5准确率。在六人离线机器人场景研究中，候选约束目标选择达到40.24%（随机水平为25%）。

Conclusion: 实验结果支持任务引导的潜在预测作为EEG解码和场景约束辅助目标选择的可迁移预训练策略。

Abstract: We propose EEG-VID, a task-guided latent predictive pretraining framework for EEG decoding under session and subject shifts. EEG-VID predicts future latent EEG states from recent history using an exponential-moving-average target encoder and weak task guidance, followed by supervised fine-tuning. Across VIG-48 and BCI Competition IV-2a/IV-2b, Stage 1 improves mean accuracy in 41 of 42 matched backbone-dataset-protocol comparisons, including all 12 leave-one-subject-out settings, with a maximum gain of 16.22 percentage points. On the 48-region cross-day VIG-48 task, EEG-VID achieves 6.52% Top-1 and 30.50% Top-5 accuracy. In a separate six-participant offline robot-scene study, candidate-constrained target selection reaches 40.24% versus a 25% chance level after subject-specific calibration. These results support task-guided latent prediction as a transferable pretraining strategy for EEG decoding and scene-constrained assistive target selection.

</details>


### [211] [GeoPAR: Large-Scale Multi-Agent Combinatorial Optimization with Geometry-Guided Parallel Autoregressive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00577)
*Wenjian Wu,Zesheng Jia,Jiaying Tang,Benyuan Yang,Jin Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GeoPAR是一个几何引导的并行自回归强化学习框架，用于可扩展的多智能体组合优化。它通过投影窗口稀疏几何机制、稀疏边偏置注意力和缓存引导的冲突感知分配三个组件，解决了并行神经求解器在大规模实例中性能退化的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体组合优化问题因NP-hard特性极具挑战。现有的并行自回归神经求解器虽提升了推理效率，但在大规模实例上性能退化，主要原因是局部几何结构建模薄弱，且冲突的任务选择仅在动作生成后才被处理。

Method: GeoPAR包含三个关键组件：(1) 投影窗口稀疏几何机制，通过多方向投影构建轻量局部候选邻域；(2) 稀疏边偏置注意力，将几何关系注入节点表示；(3) 缓存引导的冲突感知分配，在解码过程中复用几何缓存以抑制对独占任务的重复选择。

Result: 在异构车辆路径规划和开放多车场取送货问题上的实验表明，GeoPAR提升了大规模零样本泛化能力，同时大幅减少rollout步数并保持高效的推理性能。

Conclusion: 通过将几何先验信息融入并行自回归解码过程并在解码中主动处理冲突，GeoPAR有效解决了大规模多智能体组合优化中性能退化的问题，实现了可扩展性和推理效率的兼顾。

Abstract: Multi-agent combinatorial optimization problems are notoriously challenging due to their NP-hard nature. Recent parallel autoregressive neural solvers improve inference efficiency by allowing agents to make decisions simultaneously, but their performance often degrades on large-scale instances. This is largely attributable to weak modeling of local geometric structures and the fact that conflicting task selections are handled only after action generation. To address these limitations, we propose GeoPAR, a geometry-guided parallel autoregressive reinforcement learning framework for scalable multi-agent combinatorial optimization. GeoPAR integrates three key components: (1) a projection-window sparse geometry mechanism that builds lightweight local candidate neighborhoods through multi-directional projections, (2) sparse edge-biased attention that injects these geometric relations into node representations, and (3) cache-guided conflict-aware assignment that reuses the geometric cache during decoding to suppress duplicate selections of exclusive tasks. Experiments on heterogeneous vehicle routing and open multi-depot pickup-and-delivery problems show that GeoPAR improves large-scale zero-shot generalization while substantially reducing rollout steps and maintaining efficient inference.

</details>


### [212] [CRAFT: Fine-Tuning Pre-hoc Explainability in AI-native 6G RAN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00590)
*Pranshav Gajjar,Vijay K Shah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CRAFT方法，用于在电信AI-RAN场景中为小型语言模型（SLM）实现预验证推理（pre-hoc reasoning）。CRAFT通过数据驱动的方式自动生成验证过的（输入、推理轨迹、标签）三元组数据集，并利用LoRA微调SLM，解决了将GRPO强化学习方法直接移植到电信领域时的冷启动问题。在TRACTOR和IC xApp数据集上，CRAFT达到86.5%和94.6%的准确率与F1分数，且无解析失败，同时比GRPO基线节省59%的能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有电信LLM训练范式（如基于SFT的RANSTRUCT风格方法）仅能进行事后合理化（post hoc rationalization），即解释在决策之后或独立于决策生成，导致决策过程不可审计。虽然预验证推理（pre-hoc reasoning）可通过GRPO等RL方法实现，但直接将此方法移植到电信场景面临冷启动障碍：SLM要么学会输出期望格式，要么学会预测标签，但很少能同时做到两者。

Method: CRAFT（Cold-start Reasoning Alignment via Fine-Tuning）采用数据驱动的策略：(1) 自动生成经过验证的（输入、推理轨迹、标签）三元组数据集；(2) 使用LoRA（低秩适配）对SLM在该验证数据上进行微调。该方法所需的计算量和墙钟时间远少于基于GRPO的方法，且可通过CRAFT初始化的策略作为后续GRPO微调的稳健基础。

Result: 在TRACTOR和IC xApp电信数据集上，CRAFT达到86.5%和94.6%的准确率与F1分数，且无解析失败。相比之下，直接GRPO和SFT+GRPO方法的F1最高仅达28%和53.5%，并伴随多次解析失败。CRAFT初始化的策略在不同奖励函数下保持一致的性能且无解析失败。此外，CRAFT比GRPO基线节省59%的能量消耗。

Conclusion: CRAFT提供了一条可持续且可部署的路径，使6G RAN中的AI具备可审计性。通过数据驱动的方式解决SLM在电信领域的冷启动推理对齐问题，兼具高性能、高可靠性与低能耗优势，为后续强化学习优化奠定了稳健基础。

Abstract: The next generation of mobile networks is envisioned as fully AI-native, with AI-RAN architectures embedding small language models (SLMs) to perform reasoning over real-time telemetry. The state-of-the-art training paradigms for telecom LLMs, exemplified by RANSTRUCT-style supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on curated instruction data, are limited to post hoc rationalization. Here, the explanations, when produced at all, are generated after or independently of the decision, leaving the decision process unauditable. Pre-hoc reasoning, where a causal reasoning trace is produced before the output label, is preferable, and the broader LLM reasoning literature has made real progress toward it via RL methods such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Here we observe that transplanting this recipe into the telecom setting runs into a cold-start barrier: SLMs either learn to output the desired format or learn to predict the label, but rarely both. We identify this barrier and propose CRAFT, which stands for Cold-start Reasoning Alignment via Fine-Tuning, a data-centric method to autonomously generate a verified dataset of (input, trace, label) triplets. CRAFT fine-tunes SLMs on this verified data using low-rank adaptation (LoRA), requiring substantially less compute and wall-clock time than GRPO-based methods. On the TRACTOR and IC xApp telecom datasets, CRAFT achieves up to 86.5% and 94.6% for accuracy and F1 with no parse failures, while direct GRPO and SFT+GRPO fail to exceed 28% and 53.5% F1 with multiple parse failures. We further show that CRAFT-initialized policies serve as a robust foundation for subsequent GRPO fine-tuning, as under diverse reward functions the performance remains consistent with no parse failures. Finally, we demonstrate that CRAFT consumes 59% less energy than GRPO-based baselines, making it a sustainable path to deployable, auditable AI in 6G RAN.

</details>


### [213] [Topological Steering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00597)
*Benoît Guérand,Tan Minh Nguyen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于拓扑数据分析（TDA）的LLM行为控制框架"Topological Steering"，通过持久性图对激活空间进行拓扑表示，实现对模型行为的鲁棒控制，并在多个模型系列和规模上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM行为控制方法通常在激活或特征空间中直接干预，但这些方法对异常值、分布偏移、噪声等局部扰动较为敏感，缺乏对全局结构的把握。

Method: 受拓扑数据分析（TDA）的启发，利用持久性图（persistence diagrams）对激活空间进行拓扑表示，将激活空间的全局结构信息与行为控制相结合，提出Topological Steering框架进行模型行为引导。

Result: Topological Steering在多个模型系列和不同模型规模上均能一致地改变LLM行为，验证了该方法的行为控制效果。

Conclusion: 通过引入拓扑视角，Topological Steering为LLM行为控制提供了比传统局部空间干预方法更稳健的替代方案，有望成为控制模型行为的新范式。

Abstract: With the rapid rise of large language models (LLMs), controlling undesirable model behaviors has become increasingly important. Existing behavioral control methods typically intervene directly in activation or feature space, but such approaches can be sensitive to outliers, distributional shifts, noise, and other local perturbations. Motivated by Topological Data Analysis (TDA), which captures global rather than purely local structure, we propose Topological Steering, a new framework for steering LLM behavior through the topological representation of activation spaces. Using persistence diagrams, our method connects activation-based steering with TDA and enables more robust behavioral control. We show that Topological Steering consistently modifies LLM behavior across multiple model families and model sizes.

</details>


### [214] [Confess What You Know: Forget-Set Misalignment with Model Knowledge in LLM Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00605)
*Miso Kim,Georu Lee,Seungwon Jeong,Woojin Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文指出现有LLM机器遗忘方法普遍假设预定义的遗忘集与模型实际记忆内容一致，但在真实隐私场景中（原始训练数据不可获取）这一假设常被打破，作者将其称为"遗忘集错位"，并提出了数据盲框架CONFS，通过引导并形式化模型自身记忆的知识来构建与模型对齐的遗忘集，在合成、多模态及真实基准上取得接近金标准的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM机器遗忘研究通常预设一个遗忘集，但实际隐私场景中原始训练数据不可获取，遗忘集与模型实际记忆内容之间存在错位（forget-set misalignment），导致两类问题：欠遗忘（Under Unlearning，遗漏已记忆信息导致泄漏）和超出知识遗忘（Out-of-Knowledge Unlearning，强迫遗忘模型从未学过的知识，扰动参数降低性能）。作者希望通过梯度级分析揭示其根源并解决该问题。

Method: 提出CONFS（CONfession-to-Forget-Set）框架，这是一种数据盲（data-blind）方法，通过引导模型"坦白"（eliciting）其已记忆的知识并进行形式化，从而构建与模型实际记忆对齐的遗忘集。作者还通过梯度级分析证明欠遗忘和超出知识遗忘源于错位的遗忘目标，而非特定的优化选择。

Result: 在合成、多模态和真实世界基准测试中，CONFS在多项指标上接近金标准（Gold-standard）的表现，实现了具有竞争力的遗忘-效用平衡，并且在保留模型效用方面优于其他数据盲遗忘集构建方法。

Conclusion: 遗忘集错位是阻碍LLM机器遗忘在现实隐私场景中落地的关键问题，CONFS通过从模型内部提取记忆知识来构建对齐的遗忘集，为数据不可获取条件下的机器遗忘提供了有效且保持模型效用的解决方案。

Abstract: Machine unlearning for large language models (LLMs) often assumes that a pre-defined forget set matches what the model has memorized, but this frequently breaks in realistic privacy settings where the original training data is inaccessible. We term this gap forget-set misalignment and identify two cases. In Under Unlearning, the forget set omits memorized information and leakage persists. In Out-of-Knowledge Unlearning, the algorithm is driven to "forget" knowledge the model never learned, perturbing parameters and degrading utility. Using gradient-level analysis, we show these behaviors arise from misaligned unlearning targets rather than specific optimization choices. We then propose CONfession-to-Forget-Set (CONFS), a data-blind framework that constructs model-aligned forget sets by eliciting and formalizing the model's memorized knowledge. Across synthetic, multimodal, and real-world benchmarks, CONFS approaches Gold-standard performance on several metrics and achieves a competitive forgetting-utility balance, while preserving utility better than other data-blind forget-set constructions.

</details>


### [215] [Breaking the Structural Identity: Personalized Federated LoRA Fine-tuning under Rank Heterogeneity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00632)
*Lei Wang,Jieming Bian,Letian Zhang,Jie Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FedRoRA框架，针对异构联邦学习中的LoRA微调问题，通过将适应过程解耦为共享全局方向与个性化rank-wise幅度，实现了异构联邦中的细粒度个性化，并在NLU和NLG基准上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管FL结合LoRA提供了资源高效的协作微调范式，但实际部署面临资源异构和数据异构的双重挑战。现有rank异构方法主要聚焦于维度不匹配的聚合，但通常为所有客户端提供统一的全局模型，无法在非IID场景中捕获客户端特定特征。

Method: FedRoRA将适应解耦为共享的全局方向和由可学习对角缩放系数控制的个性化rank-wise幅度。在服务器端，通过奇异值分解（SVD）提取全局子空间，并通过个性化投影和top-k选择机制重新分配客户端特定的初始化。

Result: 在NLU（自然语言理解）和NLG（自然语言生成）基准上的大量实验表明，FedRoRA始终优于最先进的方法。

Conclusion: FedRoRA通过在rank异构联邦中实现细粒度个性化，有效解决了资源异构与数据异构并存下的模型个性化与聚合难题，为隐私敏感场景下的LLM协作微调提供了新的解决思路。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, but their adaptation to privacy-sensitive, distributed datasets remains a challenge. While Federated Learning (FL) combined with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) provides a resource-efficient paradigm for collaborative fine-tuning, practical deployments are hindered by the dual challenges of resource heterogeneity and data heterogeneity. Existing rank-heterogeneous methods primarily focus on bridging dimension mismatches for aggregation but typically provide a unified global model for all clients sharing the same rank, failing to capture client-specific features in non-IID scenarios. In this paper, we propose FedRoRA (Federated Rank-wise Personalized LoRA), a novel framework that enables fine-grained personalization within rank-heterogeneous federations. FedRoRA decouples adaptation into shared global directions and personalized rank-wise magnitudes governed by learnable diagonal scales. On the server side, it extracts a global subspace via singular value decomposition (SVD) and redistributes client-specific initializations through a personalized projection and top-$k$ selection mechanism. Extensive experiments on NLU and NLG benchmarks demonstrate that FedRoRA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [216] [DK-GBMKKM: Dynamic Kernel-Space Granular-Ball Multiple Kernel $k$-Means Clustering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00647)
*Xiaoyu Lian,Yuchao Zhang,Shuyin Xia,Siqi Zhong,Xuzhao Xiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出动态核空间粒度球多核k-means方法（DK-GBMKKM），在融合核空间中动态生成粒度球，并交替优化核权重与粒度球隶属度，使表示适应融合核几何的变化，提升聚类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多核k-means的点级优化对噪声和边界样本敏感，且反复操作于样本规模核矩阵上。现有粒度球方法虽能以介观单元组织局部样本组，但在输入空间中一次性生成的粒度球无法适应多核学习过程中不断演变的融合核几何。

Method: 根据当前融合核空间生成粒度球，交替执行核权重学习与粒度球隶属度更新，使粒度表示随融合核几何变化自适应；构建样本大小加权的粒度球核矩阵以保留不同大小粒度球的贡献，并证明其半正定性与相关等价性质。

Result: 在12个公开数据集上的实验表明DK-GBMKKM具有优异的整体聚类性能，代码已开源。

Conclusion: 动态调整粒度球表示以适应融合核空间变化是一种可行且有效的多核聚类策略。

Abstract: Multiple kernel $k$-means integrates complementary nonlinear similarities by learning a combination of base kernels. Its pointwise optimization, however, is sensitive to noisy and boundary samples and repeatedly operates on sample-scale kernel matrices. Granular-ball representations organize local sample groups into mesoscopic units, but granular balls generated once in the input space may be inconsistent with the fused-kernel geometry that evolves during multiple kernel learning. We propose dynamic kernel-space granular-ball multiple kernel $k$-means (DK-GBMKKM). The method generates granular balls in the current fused kernel space and alternates kernel-weight learning with granular-ball membership updates, allowing the representation to adapt to changes in the fused-kernel geometry. A sample-size-weighted granular-ball kernel is further constructed to preserve the contributions of balls of different sizes, and its positive semidefiniteness and related equivalence properties are established. Experiments on 12 public datasets demonstrate the strong overall clustering performance of DK-GBMKKM. The code has been open-sourced for reproducibility: https://github.com/lianxiaoyu724/DK-GBMKKM.

</details>


### [217] [EEG-AS: Instance-Level Foundation Model Selection for EEG Foundation Models via Behavior Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00653)
*Yunzhen Zhang,Ruoxi Piao,Hasan Onur Keles,Mustafa Misir*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出EEG-AS框架，将脑电（EEG）基础模型选择形式化为实例级算法选择（AS）问题。该框架利用推理可得的潜在EEG嵌入、手工神经生理学特征和锚定基础模型来刻画每个EEG实例，通过从特权预测token中学习重建不可得的基础模型行为，实现在不执行全部模型组合的情况下从七个EEG基础模型中进行高效选择。在七个公共EEG基准上的实验表明，EEG-AS显著缩小了单最佳求解器与实例级预言机上界之间的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管EEG基础模型在多种神经解码任务上表现出色，但没有单一基础模型能在所有数据集或个体EEG实例上始终表现最佳，而实例级模型选择问题尚未被充分探索。这促使作者将EEG基础模型选择形式化为实例级算法选择问题。

Method: 提出EEG-AS框架：(1) 每个EEG实例通过推理可得的潜在EEG嵌入、手工神经生理学特征和锚定基础模型来表征；(2) 训练阶段学习从特权预测token重建不可得的基础模型行为（以锚定基础模型为条件）；(3) 推理阶段无需执行整个模型组合即可估计这些行为，从而实现从七个EEG基础模型中进行高效选择。

Result: 在七个公共EEG基准数据集上的实验表明，EEG-AS能够显著缩小单最佳求解器（SBS）与每个实例的预言机上界之间的差距，验证了实例级算法选择对EEG基础模型自适应部署的有效性。

Conclusion: 实例级算法选择是一种有效的EEG基础模型自适应部署策略，EEG-AS框架通过无需全部模型执行的高效选择机制，显著提升了跨数据集和跨实例的选择性能。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is a non-invasive technique for measuring neural activity and has been widely used in neuroscience applications. Recent advances in EEG foundation models have enabled strong performance across diverse neural decoding tasks. However, no single foundation model consistently performs best across datasets or individual EEG instances, while instance-level model selection remains largely unexplored. To address this limitation, we formulate EEG foundation model selection as an instance-level Algorithm Selection (AS) problem. We propose \textbf{EEG-AS}, an instance-level algorithm selection framework that characterizes each EEG instance using inference-available latent EEG embeddings, handcrafted neurophysiological features, and an anchor foundation model. During training, EEG-AS learns to reconstruct unavailable foundation-model behaviors from privileged prediction tokens conditioned on an anchor foundation model, while during inference it estimates these behaviors without executing the entire model portfolio, enabling efficient selection from seven EEG foundation models. Experiments on seven public EEG benchmarks demonstrate that EEG-AS substantially narrows the gap between the Single Best Solver (SBS) and the oracle upper bound for each instance. These results highlight the effectiveness of instance-level AS for adaptive deployment of EEG foundation models.

</details>


### [218] [HarmoCore: Functional Latent Diffusion for Sparse Reconstruction of Oscillatory Wave Fields](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00679)
*Lihao Chen,Xinyu Zhang,Panqi Chen,Lei Cheng,Ting Zhang,Jianlong Li,Shikai Fang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HarmoCore，一种用于从稀疏传感器重建振荡波场的方法。它将生成先验置于紧凑、连续且结构化的波场潜空间中，利用Functional Tucker核表示联合实虚通道，学习频率条件的核扩散先验，并在核空间中直接执行扩散后验采样，从而避免密集像素空间的低效修正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从稀疏传感器重建振荡波场是严重欠定的逆问题。现有方法（低秩、算子、扩散方法）多针对实值、平滑场设计；密集像素空间扩散对振荡复值场效率低下且难以扩展到3D。此外波场响应是复值、频率敏感且高度振荡的，而昂贵的仿真和传感通常只留下极度稀疏的观测。

Method: HarmoCore将生成先验置于紧凑、连续、结构化的波场潜空间中。具体而言：(1) 用Functional Tucker核在共享连续空间基上表示联合实-虚通道；(2) 学习频率条件化的核扩散先验；(3) 直接在核空间执行Diffusion Posterior Sampling；(4) 在固定传感器坐标下，多线性解码器诱导显式似然引导算子，避免密集像素空间修正；(5) 可选的靶方程残差引导进一步促进物理一致性。

Result: 在2D Helmholtz、2D合成波场和3D Helmholtz实验上，在1%-2%的传感率下取得显著性能提升，同时在三维场景中保持实用性。

Conclusion: HarmoCore通过在结构化的低维潜空间中执行生成扩散和推理，有效解决了振荡复值波场从极端稀疏观测重建的难题，并成功扩展到3D，展示了显著的精度与实用性优势。

Abstract: Reconstructing oscillatory wave fields from scattered sensors is a severely underdetermined inverse problem. Beyond the challenges of general physical-field reconstruction, wave responses are complex-valued, frequency-sensitive, and highly oscillatory, while costly simulation and sensing often leave only extreme-sparse observations. Existing low-rank, operator, and diffusion approaches are largely designed for real-valued, smoother fields; dense pixel-space diffusion is particularly inefficient for oscillatory complex fields and difficult to scale to 3D. We propose HarmoCore, which places a generative prior in a compact, continuous, and structured wave-field latent. HarmoCore represents joint real--imaginary channels with Functional Tucker cores over shared continuous spatial bases, learns a frequency-conditioned core diffusion prior, and performs Diffusion Posterior Sampling directly in core space. At fixed sensor coordinates, the multilinear decoder induces an explicit likelihood guidance operator, avoiding dense pixel-space correction. Optional target-equation residual guidance further promotes physical consistency. Experiments on 2D Helmholtz, 2D synthetic wave fields, and 3D Helmholtz show substantial gains under 1%--2% sensing while remaining practical in three dimensions.

</details>


### [219] [A Study of Hidden-State Optimization Order in Predictive Coding Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00686)
*Xueyuan Li,Danilo Vasconcellos Vargas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种边界优先（boundary-first）的推理调度方法，将模型划分为多个块（chunk），先协调各块边界处的隐状态，再细化块内表征。将该调度方法实例化到预测编码网络（PCN）中，在CIFAR-10上相比标准预测编码分别提升了9.77%（标准参数化）和5.51%（μ参数化）的准确率，并通过诊断分析证明其促进了更强的特征学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 局部学习方法（local learning）可作为端到端反向传播的替代方案，但其无结构化的局部目标函数在深层网络中可能导致特征学习能力较弱。作者试图探究隐藏状态优化的顺序能否解决这一局限。

Method: 提出边界优先推理调度：将模型分区为块，首先协调块边界处的隐藏状态，再细化块内表征；并将这一调度实例化到预测编码网络（PCN）这一局部学习框架中，其中推理过程中显式暴露隐藏活动与预测误差。

Result: 在CIFAR-10上，边界优先的预测编码实例相比标准预测编码在标准参数化下准确率提升9.77%，在μ参数化下提升5.51%。诊断分析显示：早期层产生更多非平凡更新、初始到最终的CKA（中心核对齐）更低、层间梯度更多样化，均与更强的特征学习一致。

Conclusion: 实验结果支持边界优先、基于块划分的推理可作为预测编码训练的有效设计原则，并值得在更广泛的局部学习系统中进一步研究。

Abstract: Local learning methods offer an alternative to end-to-end backpropagation, but their unstructured local objectives can produce weak feature learning in deep networks. We study whether the order of hidden-state optimization can address this limitation. We propose a boundary-first inference schedule that partitions a model into chunks, first coordinates hidden states at chunk boundaries, and then refines representations within each chunk. We instantiate this schedule in predictive coding networks (PCNs), a local-learning framework in which hidden activities and prediction errors are explicitly exposed during inference. On CIFAR-10, the resulting boundary-first predictive-coding instantiation improves accuracy over standard predictive coding by $9.77\%$ under a standard parametrization and by $5.51\%$ under a $μ$-parametrization. Diagnostic analyses further show more non-trivial early-layer updates, lower initial-to-final CKA, and more diverse layerwise gradients, consistent with stronger feature learning. These results support boundary-first, chunk-based inference as a practical design principle for predictive-coding training and motivate its study in broader local-learning systems.

</details>


### [220] [MUGEN: Generating Unlearnable Graph Examples for Multiple Learning Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00696)
*Ziyan Liu,Chengshuai Zhao,Huan Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MUGEN是首个能够同时保护节点分类、图分类和链接预测等所有可用任务的不可学习图示例生成框架，通过任务对齐可分性目标和类型自适应扰动，实现对多种GNN骨干网络和任务的迁移性保护。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的不可学习图示例生成方法仅针对单一指定下游任务进行保护，导致数据所有者无法预先知道所有可能的攻击用途时，数据可能在其他任务上仍然可学习，存在严重的隐私泄露风险。

Method: MUGEN通过共享GNN编码器和任务特定头，从单个干净数据集生成特征扰动的发布版本以联合保护所有任务。提出任务对齐可分性目标(TASO)利用任务预测和类级可分性增强不可学习性及其跨骨干网络和任务的迁移；提出类型自适应扰动(TAP)针对节点属性类型定制优化：对离散属性直接搜索仅接收损失改进的硬翻转，对连续特征使用定制的梯度更新，从而在两种设置下均实现强不可学习性。

Result: 在五个基准、四个后端和三种学习范式上的实验表明，MUGEN生成的不可学习图示例能够跨GNN骨干网络和所有三种任务迁移，并且在对抗训练和数据增强下依然有效。

Conclusion: MUGEN为图数据的任务不可知保护提供了首个统一框架，显著增强了对多任务场景下图数据被未授权表示学习利用的防御能力。

Abstract: Graph data across diverse domains can expose valuable relational information to unauthorized representation learning, creating a pressing need for protection against such misuse. Unlearnable examples offer a data-level defense by perturbing a training release so that models trained on it fail to generalize to clean data. Existing methods generate unlearnable graph examples for only a specified downstream task. Consequently, a release protected against one task may remain learnable for other plausible uses, including node classification, graph classification, and link prediction, which the data owner cannot anticipate. We introduce MUGEN, to our knowledge the first framework for generating unlearnable graph examples that jointly protect all enabled tasks. From one clean dataset, MUGEN produces a single feature-perturbed release that protects every enabled task through a shared GNN encoder and task-specific heads. We devise a Task-Aligned Separability Objective (TASO), which leverages task prediction and classwise separability to strengthen unlearnability and its transfer across GNN backbones and enabled tasks. We further introduce Type-Adaptive Perturbation (TAP), which tailors perturbation optimization to node-attribute type, with direct search over feasible hard flips that accept only loss-improving updates for discrete node attributes and customized gradient-based updates for continuous node features, thereby enabling strong unlearnability across both settings. Experiments across five benchmarks, four backends and three learning paradigms demonstrate that MUGEN generates transferable unlearnable graph examples across GNN backbones and all three tasks, and remains effective under adversarial training and data augmentation.

</details>


### [221] [Patterning in Practice: Debiasing Reward Models with Susceptibilities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00699)
*George Wang,Elizabeth Donoway,Daniel Murfet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次将基于奇异学习理论的"patterning"方法应用于大型模型的奖励模型去偏。通过对Gemma 2 9B Instruct奖励模型进行偏好对重加权，在RM-Bench Hard分集上获得+14.2 pp的提升（超过SteerRM的+13.2 pp），同时保持总体准确率不变，且权重可迁移至其他尺寸的模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 奖励模型在人类偏好训练中存在长度、格式等风格性偏差，这些偏差会影响模型对齐的真实效果，需要一种系统性的方法去除这些非本质偏好信号带来的偏差。

Method: 采用patterning方法，通过测度每个偏好对在基准损失后验期望值上的影响（即其敏感性），对偏好对重新加权，以去偏奖励模型。使用Gemma 2 9B Instruct在Skywork-Reward-Preference v0.2上训练。

Result: 在RM-Bench Hard分集上获得+14.2±1.2 pp的提升（5个种子均值±标准误），总体RM-Bench准确率保持；权重可迁移至Gemma 2 2B和27B（无需重算），部分迁移至Llama 3.1 8B；通过可解释性分析将安全子集回归追踪到小类训练对，并经消融证实。

Conclusion: 这是patterning方法首次超越小模型和合成任务的成功应用，证明了其在大规模奖励模型去偏中的有效性、可解释性和可迁移性，为该领域提供了强于现有比较器（SteerRM）的去偏方案。

Abstract: Reward models trained on human preferences are known to suffer from length, formatting, and other stylistic biases. In this paper we use patterning, which reweights each preference pair according to its measured effect on posterior expectation values of benchmark losses (its susceptibility), to debias a Gemma 2 9B Instruct reward model trained on Skywork-Reward-Preference v0.2. We obtain $+14.2 \pm 1.2$ pp on RM-Bench Hard, the split where style cues point against correctness (mean $\pm$ s.e.\ over 5 seeds), with overall RM-Bench accuracy preserved, comparable to the strongest Hard-split gain reported by the closest published comparator (SteerRM, $+13.2$ pp). We demonstrate in a simple case that the reweighting is interpretable by tracing a side effect of the intervention (a regression on a safety subset of RM-Bench) to a small class of training pairs, which we confirm by ablation. The weights also transfer: those computed on Gemma 2 9B debias Gemma 2 2B and 27B with no recomputation, and transfer partially to Llama 3.1 8B. This is the first application of patterning, a program grounded in singular learning theory, beyond small models and synthetic tasks.

</details>


### [222] [Online Self-Weighted Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00734)
*Haiquan Wen,Yiwei He,Bei Peng,Guangliang Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了OSW-FT（在线自加权微调）方法，通过在线轨迹级加权增强标准SFT。对每个查询，用少量仅推理的rollout估计模型当前成功率，据此重新缩放SFT损失。优化方向锚定专家轨迹，更新幅度自适应。在Qwen3系列（0.6B-4B）多个基准上优于SFT，只需2个在线rollout即在二元可验证推理任务上取得优异计算-性能权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准SFT对每个专家示范分配相同显式损失权重，未考虑模型在训练过程中的能力变化；基于RL的方法虽然能自适应更新强度，但需要大量采样且在小模型硬任务上可能不稳定。因此需要一种既有SFT稳定性又具备自适应能力的微调方法。

Method: OSW-FT在每个查询上使用少量推断rollout（如2个）估计模型当前成功率，并据此重新缩放标准SFT损失。该方法包含：1) 轨迹级在线权重估计；2) 保留专家轨迹作为优化方向锚点；3) 从梯度层面建立与SFT和RL的联系（基于方差缩减原理）；4) 针对有限rollout数量提供无偏估计器和收敛性分析。

Result: 在Qwen3系列（0.6B到4B）上多个挑战性基准（如AIME）的评估显示，OSW-FT在中小规模模型上一致优于SFT。仅需2个在线rollout即可实现性能提升，提供了良好的计算-性能权衡。

Conclusion: OSW-FT是微调中小规模LLM执行二元可验证推理任务的实用有效方案，兼具SFT的稳定性和自适应更新能力，为模型训练效率与性能之间提供了有利的折中。

Abstract: Standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) assigns the same explicit loss weight to every expert demonstration, regardless of the model's changing competence over training queries. Reinforcement learning (RL) based methods adapt update strength using model-generated rollouts, but often require substantially more sampling and can be unstable on hard tasks. We propose \textbf{Online Self-Weighted Fine-Tuning (OSW-FT)}, a simple method that augments SFT with online, trajectory-level weighting. For each query, OSW-FT estimates the model's current success rate using a small number of inference-only rollouts and rescales the standard SFT loss accordingly. The optimization direction remains anchored to the expert trajectory, while the update magnitude adapts online. For binary-verifiable reasoning, we connect this weighting to SFT and RL at the gradient level, inspired by variance-reduction principles. The resulting estimator is unbiased for the exact OSW-FT surrogate update for any finite rollout count, and we analyze convergence with respect to the corresponding surrogate objective. Evaluated across Qwen3 series ranging from 0.6B to 4B on multiple challenging benchmarks (e.g., AIME), OSW-FT consistently improves over SFT on small-to-medium scale models. OSW-FT offers a favorable compute-performance trade-off as a practical approach for fine-tuning small-to-medium LLMs on binary-verifiable reasoning tasks with only \textbf{2 online rollouts}.

</details>


### [223] [Text Capability Loss in Vision-Language Adaptation: An Attention-Sink Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00746)
*Minsik Choi,Geewook Kim,Young Geun Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现将预训练LLM微调为视觉语言模型(VLM)会侵蚀骨干模型的文本能力，特别是需要严格遵循输出格式的任务（如指令跟随、受严格解析评分的思维链推理）。作者将这一退化归因于"注意力汇损坏"（attention-sink corruption）：视觉微调扰乱了锚定大量注意力概率的早期汇位置，且基础LLM保留其汇的程度与能力存留相关。基于此提出Sink Strength——在基础LLM上几秒即可在单GPU计算的单一标量，可在无需任何视觉训练的情况下预测视觉语言适配后的退化程度，并在六组VLM-LLM配对及多种格式敏感任务上一致跟踪相对退化。此外还发现后训练QK-RMSNorm注入无法复现原生QK-RMSNorm的保护作用，多种现成权重合并设置也无法在VL训练后恢复丢失能力，这些负向结果凸显了在VL训练前用Sink Strength筛选骨干模型的价值，并将干预空间收窄至头选择性（head-selective）训练时保护。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将LLM微调成VLM会损害骨干模型的文本能力，尤其在需要严格遵循输出规则的任务上退化严重。作者希望理解这种能力退化背后的机制，并提出一种无需昂贵VL训练即可预测退化程度的诊断指标，以指导骨干模型的选择。

Method: 作者追踪退化到注意力汇损坏机制——视觉微调扰乱了早期注意力汇位置。基于此定义Sink Strength（汇强度），即一个基于基础LLM计算、几秒内即可在单GPU上得到的单一标量，用于在无VL训练的情况下预测微调后的能力退化。同时通过实验检验了QK-RMSNorm注入和多种权重合并策略能否保护或恢复能力。

Result: Sink Strength在六组VLM-LLM配对和多种格式敏感任务上一致地跟踪相对退化程度。负向结果显示：后训练的QK-RMSNorm注入无法复现原生QK-RMSNorm的保护效果，现成的权重合并设置也无法在VL训练后恢复丢失的文本能力。

Conclusion: 注意力汇损坏是VL微调侵蚀文本能力的关键机制；Sink Strength可作为低成本、高效率的骨干筛选诊断工具。由于事后干预手段（如QK-RMSNorm注入、权重合并）效果有限，应优先在VL训练前进行骨干筛选，并聚焦于头选择性（head-selective）的训练时保护策略。

Abstract: Fine-tuning a pretrained LLM into a vision-language model (VLM) can erode the backbone's text capability, with the damage concentrated on tasks that require following exact output rules, such as instruction following, chain-of-thought reasoning graded on a strictly parsed final answer, and similar evaluations with strict graders. We trace this gap to attention-sink corruption: VL fine-tuning perturbs the early sink position that anchors a large fraction of attention probability, and how well the base LLM preserves its sink tracks how much of the affected capability survives adaptation. Building on this view, we introduce Sink Strength, a single scalar computed on the base LLM in a few seconds on a single GPU that predicts post-VL degradation without any VL training. It consistently tracks relative degradation across the six VLM-LLM pairs and multiple format-sensitive tasks. Complementing this diagnostic, we find that post-pretraining QK-RMSNorm injection fails to reproduce the protection of native QK-RMSNorm, while several off-the-shelf weight-merging settings fail to recover the lost capability after VL training. These negative results underscore the value of screening backbones with Sink Strength before VL training and narrow the intervention space toward head-selective training-time protection.

</details>


### [224] [How Do Language Models Choose Between Context and Memory?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00753)
*Benjamin Shih,John Winnicki,Arianna Cao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过反事实实验研究模型如何在不同信息源（上下文vs参数知识）之间做出选择。研究发现特定"权威方向"（activation directions）能部分复现模型在冲突信息中的源选择行为（30-68%），但跨任务的可迁移性很差（仅9%），表明权威计算可能是任务依赖的而非跨任务可复用的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前研究认为可以用activation directions来解码和引导模型在上下文与参数知识冲突时选择哪个信息源，但现有方法缺乏因果性验证——无法确认未编辑模型是否自然使用该方向，也无法确认该方向能否跨任务复用。

Method: 1) 从一致提示（上下文与参数知识支持同一答案）中估计权威方向；2) 在匹配提示（分别引导模型优先上下文或参数知识）之间交换自然出现的坐标；3) 在Qwen、Llama和OLMo三个模型上进行干预实验；4) 分别学习两个任务上的权威方向以测试跨任务可迁移性。

Result: 干预能复现30-68%的权威诱导的源选择转变，而对照组几乎没有复现效果。跨任务迁移仅能覆盖9%的权威差距，而本地方向（当前任务上学习到的）能覆盖57%。

Conclusion: 研究区分了权威表征、因果使用和跨任务因果复用三个层面，表明权威计算可能是任务依赖的，而非跨任务可复用的机制。

Abstract: When contextual information conflicts with the knowledge stored in model parameters, activation directions can be used to decode and steer which source the model follows. However, steering along a direction does not establish causality: whether the unedited model would naturally use that direction or whether the direction is reusable across tasks. We test these distinctions through counterfactual experiments in unambiguous settings. First, we estimate authority directions from agreement prompts, in which the context and parametric knowledge support the same answer. We then interchange naturally occurring coordinates along these directions between matched prompts that direct the model to prioritize either the supplied context or its parametric knowledge. Across Qwen, Llama, and OLMo models, this intervention reproduces 30-68% of the authority-induced shift in source choice, whereas matched controls reproduce almost none. To test cross-task reuse, we learn authority directions on two tasks separately and see that cross-task transferability closes only 9% of the authority gap while the local direction learned on the given task closes 57%. These results distinguish authority representation, causal use, and cross-task causal reuse, and suggest that authority computations may be task-dependent, rather than reusable across tasks.

</details>


### [225] [Frozen Cores Need Task Signal: Fisher-Whitened Cross-Covariance for Low-Resource LLM Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00762)
*Wentao Ye,Zhanming Shen,Zhiqing Xiao,Yao Ding,Haobo Wang,Gang Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FCCA方法，通过冻结核心适配（frozen-core adaptation）在极低可训练参数预算下进行高效微调。该方法先用校准过程固定权重矩阵的左右基，仅优化r×r的核心矩阵。FCCA估计带符号输入-误差交叉协方差，用对角Fisher矩白化后在局部度量中截断，映射回选定方向并施加薄QR分解获得稳定的核心坐标。在匹配的r²预算下，FCCA在11个任务、4种模型设置、3个种子上对比8种基构造方法，在Qwen2.5-3B上达到83.0宏平均分，比次优方法高2.3分，且在所有11个任务上超过未白化的RawGrad对照。它在三个Qwen规模上都排名第一，在Llama-3.2-1B上与最佳方法差距仅0.13分。可控消融显示白化带来2.7-17.2分增益，QR对稳定核心优化至关重要。FCCA与LoRA和DoRA的平均差距仅0.32和0.23分，但仅优化36.9K参数而非约740万参数，以极小的可训练和优化器状态代价恢复可移动低秩因子的大部分收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参数高效微调通常被框定为"更新多少参数"的问题，但在极严格的可训练状态预算下，"参数作用在哪里"同样关键。现有方法中可训练的因子能够修复初始跨度较差的子空间，这使得子空间质量难以被直接观察。作者希望通过冻结核心适配使子空间质量可观测化，从而研究如何选择固定的子空间以最大化微调收益。

Method: FCCA方法包含以下步骤：1) 校准阶段固定每个权重矩阵的左右基（left and right bases）；2) 仅优化r×r的核心矩阵；3) 估计带符号的输入-误差交叉协方差（signed input-error cross-covariance）；4) 使用对角Fisher矩进行白化（whitening）；5) 在得到的局部度量中截断（truncate）；6) 将选定方向映射回原始空间；7) 应用薄QR分解获得稳定的核心坐标。论文在匹配的r²参数预算下对比8种基构造方法。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-3B上FCCA达到83.0宏平均分，比次优匹配预算构造方法高2.3分，且在全部11个任务上超过未白化的RawGrad对照。FCCA在三个Qwen规模下均排名第一，在Llama-3.2-1B上与最佳方法差距仅0.13分。消融实验显示白化带来2.7-17.2分的增益，QR对于稳定核心优化是必要的。FCCA与LoRA和DoRA的平均差距仅为0.32和0.23分，但优化的参数仅为36.9K，远小于LoRA/DoRA的约740万参数。

Conclusion: 精心选择的固定跨度（fixed span）可以在远小于可移动低秩因子（如LoRA/DoRA）的参数预算下，恢复其大部分微调收益。子空间的选择质量（而非仅参数数量）在严格预算下至关重要，通过白化和QR分解等技巧可以显著提升固定子空间的优化效果。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning is usually framed as a question of how many parameters to update. Under a severe trainable-state budget, however, where those coefficients act is equally consequential. We study this choice through frozen-core adaptation: a calibration pass fixes left and right bases for each weight matrix, and fine-tuning optimizes only an $r\times r$ core. This removes the ability of trainable factors to repair a poor initial span and makes subspace quality directly observable. We introduce FCCA, which estimates the signed input--error cross-covariance, whitens it with diagonal Fisher moments, truncates it in the resulting local metric, maps the selected directions back, and applies thin QR to obtain stable core coordinates. Under a matched $r^2$ budget, we compare eight basis constructors on 11 tasks, four model settings, and three seeds. On Qwen2.5-3B, FCCA reaches an 83.0 macro-average, 2.3 points above the next-best matched-budget constructor, and exceeds its unwhitened RawGrad control on all 11 tasks. It ranks first at all three Qwen scales and finishes within 0.13 points of the best method on Llama-3.2-1B. Controlled ablations show gains of 2.7--17.2 points from whitening and identify QR as necessary for stable core optimization in the tested regime. Finally, FCCA comes within 0.32 and 0.23 average points of LoRA and DoRA while optimizing 36.9K rather than roughly 7.4M parameters. These results show that a carefully selected fixed span can recover most of the benefit of movable low-rank factors at a much smaller trainable and optimizer-state cost.

</details>


### [226] [Are You Thinking What I am Thinking? : Examining Conceptual Separation in Neural Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00764)
*Jaee Ponde,Roshni Agarwal,Subhashis Banerjee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究通过几何和分布分析，探讨CNN和LLM内部激活是否表现出"概念分离"——即同一概念示例是否形成连贯表征，相关概念是否在表征空间中更接近。结果显示CNN中熟悉的ImageNet概念形成连贯且有语义排序的表征，但未见概念和域偏移会削弱连贯性；LLM中清晰域良好分离，相关子域更接近，模糊主题间的区别在均值和协方差层面均崩溃。概念分离可作为输出精度无法揭示的结构诊断指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估主要依赖输出层面指标，无法揭示概念在模型内部表征空间中的组织方式。作者希望探究网络是否形成概念化组织（同一概念表征连贯、相关概念彼此邻近），从而弥补输出精度指标的盲区。

Method: 对CNN和LLM的内部激活执行几何与分布分析：考察CNN中ImageNet概念（含熟悉/未见概念及类内域偏移）以及LLM中清晰域、相关子域和模糊主题的表征连贯性与邻近性。

Result: CNN中熟悉的ImageNet概念形成连贯且语义有序的表征，但未见概念和类内域偏移会削弱该连贯性。LLM中清晰域保持良好分离，相关子域靠得更近，模糊主题之间的区分在均值和协方差层面均瓦解。

Conclusion: 概念分离能揭示输出精度无法反映的内部结构，可作为衡量模型对其识别概念表征稳健性的有效诊断工具。

Abstract: Neural networks are increasingly employed to identify both well-defined and ambiguous concepts, yet output-level metrics reveal little about how those concepts are represented internally. Our study asks if these networks exhibit \textit{conceptual separation}: if examples of the same concept form coherent representations, and whether related concepts lie closer together in the representation space. We examine this conceptual organisation in Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Large Language Models (LLMs) through geometric and distributional analysis of their internal activations. In CNNs, familiar ImageNet concepts form coherent and semantically ordered representations, while this coherence weakens for unseen concepts and suffers within-class domain shift. In LLMs, clearly distinct domains remain well separated, related subdomains move closer together, and the distinction between ambiguous topics collapses at both the mean and covariance level. These results suggest that conceptual separation can reveal structure that output accuracy alone cannot, and may serve as a useful diagnostic of how robustly a model represents the concepts it is asked to identify. Code and data available on \href{https://github.com/JaeeRoshniCapstoneProject/Are-You-Thinking-What-I-m-Thinking-Examining-Conceptual-Separation-in-Neural-Architectures}{GitHub}.

</details>


### [227] [HarnessEvolve: Learning from Reference Trajectories for Reliable Agent Self-Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00829)
*Wen Jiang,Mingmin Chu,Yimeng Tian,Qianxin Zhang,Haofei Yang,Rui Yang,Yang Liu,Tao Lv,Fangming Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HarnessEvolve，一个通过参考轨迹学习来实现可靠智能体自我进化的框架。它将执行与进化流程解耦，将执行、评估、优化和门控分配给独立模块，通过生成参考轨迹对齐失败执行来提取错误信号，并设置质量门和性能门防止捷径学习与灾难性遗忘。实验表明其在多个基准上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自进化智能体虽然前景广阔，但面临三大挑战：信用分配失败（终端反馈难以定位错误步骤）、捷径学习（记忆任务特定模式而非获得泛化能力）、以及灾难性遗忘（无保护的更新破坏已有能力），这些问题阻碍了智能体实现可靠的自主进化。

Method: HarnessEvolve将执行智能体与进化管线解耦，由四个独立模块分别负责执行、评估、优化和门控。为克服信用分配失败，它在给定真实答案时生成参考轨迹，并将失败执行与参考轨迹对齐以提取错误信号，再对错误信号聚类以发现系统性失败模式。为防止捷径学习和灾难性遗忘，候选更新需通过两道门：质量门过滤数据泄漏和提示膨胀问题，性能门要求更新在当前批次上提升且不降低近期批次表现，并在epoch结束时通过保留集验证选出最佳智能体快照。

Result: 在覆盖开放域和企业场景的多个基准上，使用不同模型和智能体框架进行了大量实验，结果显示HarnessEvolve在所有基准和设置下均一致优于最先进基线，验证了其跨任务领域的可靠性。

Conclusion: HarnessEvolve通过解耦进化管线、参考轨迹对齐和双重门控机制，有效解决了自进化智能体中的信用分配失败、捷径学习和灾难性遗忘问题，实现了可靠且泛化的智能体自我进化。

Abstract: Self-evolving agents advance toward autonomy by optimizing their harness---prompts, skills, tools, and execution logic---based on environmental feedback. This paradigm, however, is hampered by three challenges: \textit{credit assignment failure}, where terminal success/failure feedback makes it ambiguous which step caused the error; \textit{shortcut learning}, where agents memorize task-specific patterns rather than acquire generalizable capabilities; and \textit{catastrophic forgetting}, where unguarded updates degrade previously acquired competence. In this paper, we introduce HarnessEvolve, a self-evolving framework that learns from reference trajectories to achieve reliable agent self-evolution. HarnessEvolve decouples the execution agent from the evolutionary pipeline, assigning execution, evaluation, optimization, and gating to independent agent modules, enabling generalizable and stable harness improvements. Specifically, HarnessEvolve overcomes credit assignment failure by generating reference trajectories (execution paths produced when given the ground-truth answers) and aligning failed executions against them to extract error signals, which are clustered to reveal systematic failure patterns. To prevent shortcut learning and catastrophic forgetting, candidate harness updates must pass two gates: a quality gate that filters data leakage and prompt bloat, and a performance gate that accepts each update if it improves on the current batch without degrading recent batches, with epoch-end validation on a held-out set selecting the best-performing accepted agent snapshot. We conduct extensive experiments on several benchmarks spanning open-domain and enterprise scenarios, using different models and agent frameworks. Results demonstrate that HarnessEvolve consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across all benchmarks and settings, confirming reliability across task domains.

</details>


### [228] [Conditional Flow Matching for ML-Based Inverse Design Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00863)
*Juliana Felder,Milad Habibi,Soheyl Massoudi,Mark Fuge*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在EngiOpt框架中引入条件流匹配（CFM）模型，并与条件扩散模型和条件GAN在结构（beams2d）和热传导（heatconduction2d）两个工程逆向设计基准上进行比较。实验表明CFM在COG、FOG、MMD和体积分数偏差等指标上均优于两种基线，且推理速度远快于扩散模型（约66倍吞吐量）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工程逆向设计受限于PDE约束迭代求解器的高计算成本和初始化的敏感性。深度生成模型可以在推理时无需重跑模拟器即可生成候选设计，但GAN单次前向采样质量有限，扩散模型需要迭代反向时间积分计算缓慢。因此需要一种兼具生成质量与采样效率的生成模型。

Method: 在EngiOpt框架中添加条件流匹配（CFM）模型，与条件扩散模型和条件GAN进行对比。使用相同的下游优化协议（将生成设计作为梯度精炼的热启动），在EngiBench的两个基准任务（beams2d结构优化和heatconduction2d热传导优化）上评估。主要指标包括累积最优性差距（COG）、最终最优性差距（FOG）、最大均值差异（MMD）和体积分数偏差。CFM采用Euler采样步数s=16和s=32进行对比实验。

Result: CFM在两个任务上均取得最低的COG、FOG、MMD和体积分数偏差。CFM平均体积分数偏差在beams2d和heatconduction2d上分别为0.4%和1.0%，远低于扩散模型的3.8%和11.2%。在Euler s=16时，CFM在beams2d上的吞吐量为53.2样本/秒，约为采用1000次网络评估的扩散基线吞吐量的66倍。CFM的COG在s=16和s=32时分别为1.182±3.126和1.173±3.100。

Conclusion: 条件流匹配（CFM）在两个工程基准任务上生成的暖启动方案COG低于两种基线方法，且比扩散模型使用更少的网络评估次数，在生成质量和采样效率之间取得了更好的平衡，是工程逆向设计中一种有前景的生成建模方法。

Abstract: Engineering inverse design is often limited by the high computational cost of iterative solvers for optimization problems constrained by partial differential equations (PDEs) and by their sensitivity to initialization. Deep generative models can produce candidate designs without rerunning the simulator at inference time. Generative adversarial networks (GANs) sample in one forward pass, whereas diffusion models require iterative reverse-time integration.
  In this work, we add conditional flow matching (CFM) to EngiOpt and compare it with a conditional diffusion model and a conditional generative adversarial network (cGAN) on structural (beams2d) and thermal (heatconduction2d) benchmarks from EngiBench using the same downstream optimization protocol. We use cumulative optimality gap (COG) and final optimality gap (FOG) as the primary metrics for evaluating the generated designs as warm starts for gradient-based refinement. On the evaluated EngiOpt implementations and two EngiBench tasks, CFM achieves the lowest measured COG, FOG, maximum mean discrepancy (MMD), and volume-fraction deviation on both tasks. CFM has mean volume-fraction deviations of 0.4% and 1.0% on beams2d and heatconduction2d, respectively, compared with 3.8% and 11.2% for diffusion. At Euler s = 16, CFM achieves 53.2 samples/s on beams2d, about 66 times the measured throughput of the evaluated diffusion baseline using 1000 network evaluations under the same timing protocol, with COG 1.182 +/- 3.126, compared with 1.173 +/- 3.100 for Euler s = 32.
  Across the two tasks, CFM produces warm starts with lower measured COG than both baselines and uses fewer network evaluations than diffusion.

</details>


### [229] [MemoryWalker: Stop Training Agents on Contexts They Never Saw](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00865)
*Zinco J,Xunjie Zhu,Shen Huang,Zhenyi Wang,Pengjun Xie,Jieping Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究生产级智能体框架（如Claude Code、Qwen-Agent）在压缩rollout下的训练问题。由于每次上下文驱逐（eviction）都会使有效历史产生分支，学习目标从序列变为树状结构。现有线性化方法要么保留最右侧路径（导致时间旅行泄漏），要么重放深度优先遍历（导致训练-推理不匹配）。作者提出两种精确的、梯度等价修正方法：LogitTree（分段K前向遍历）和打包的4D注意力掩码，并提出SDCC（自蒸馏一致性），一种单反向传播变分松弛方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生产级智能体工具在部署时通过上下文压缩降低成本，但在压缩条件下训练会产生条件化问题：每次驱逐都会分支有效历史，使学习目标成为树而非序列，现有方法无法同时满足训练效率、梯度准确性和训练-部署一致性。

Method: 1) LogitTree：分段K前向遍历，需要K+1次反向传播，精确处理树结构目标；2) 4D注意力掩码：需要自定义内核和自盒驱逐记录，打包处理树分支；3) SDCC（自蒸馏一致性）：单反向传播变分松弛，在每次驱逐时最小化压缩学生与stop-gradient教师在重建前驱逐前缀上的前向KL散度，适用于黑盒框架。

Result: 在七个网络搜索基准上（配合TC-RAG、AgentFold、MemexRL、Claude Code和OpenCode），朴素训练显著夸大训练rollout对数概率差距，尤其在驱逐密集批次上。精确方法保持在无压缩下限水平，SDCC大幅缩小差距，具有更低的logit漂移和更高的rollout奖励。

Conclusion: SDCC通过残差每节点KL为epsilon_KL，给出关于训练-部署总变差差距的O(sqrt(epsilon_KL))界，提供理论保障且适用于黑盒框架，为压缩条件下的智能体训练提供了实用且理论健壮的解决方案。

Abstract: Production agent harnesses such as Claude Code and Qwen-Agent compress context during rollout, but training under compression creates a conditioning problem: every eviction branches the effective history, so the learning object is a tree rather than a sequence. Existing linearizations either retain the rightmost path, causing time-travel leakage, or replay a depth-first traversal, causing train-inference mismatch. We introduce two exact, gradient-equivalent corrections: LogitTree, a segmented K-forward traversal, and a packed 4D attention mask. LogitTree requires K+1 backward passes; the 4D mask requires a custom kernel and white-box eviction records. We also propose SDCC (Self-Distillation for Conditioning Consistency), a single-backward-pass variational relaxation. At each eviction, it minimizes forward KL between the compressed student and a stop-gradient teacher on the reconstructed pre-eviction prefix. A residual per-junction KL of epsilon_KL gives an O(sqrt(epsilon_KL)) bound on the train-deployment total-variation gap. SDCC also applies to black-box harnesses. On seven web-search benchmarks with TC-RAG, AgentFold, MemexRL, Claude Code, and OpenCode, naive training inflates the train-rollout log-probability gap, especially on eviction-heavy batches. The exact methods stay at the no-compression floor, and SDCC substantially closes the gap, with lower logit drift and higher rollout rewards.

</details>


### [230] [iPINN for Broadband CARS Phase Retrieval: A Framework for Function Approximation and Inverse Modeling Problems in Nonlinear Spectroscopy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00883)
*Ravi Teja Vulchi,Carl Messerschmidt,Mohammadsadegh Vafaeinezhad,Rajendhar Junjuri,Tobias Meyer-Zedler,Juergen Popp,Thomas Bocklitz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于逆向物理信息神经网络(iPINN)的宽带相干反斯托克斯拉曼光谱(BCARS)相位恢复方法。iPINN通过Transformer编码器将光谱特征分配至24个可学习的洛伦兹峰槽位，并利用可微分的解析正向模型重建共振磁化率。多视图一致性损失强制模型在不同非共振背景(NRB)模式、强度和噪声下保持不变性。在公开基准上达到最低误差(MAE 0.016 vs 次优0.046)，并在28个零样本测试光谱上展现深度不变性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BCARS中的相位恢复是一个病态逆问题，Raman类信号编码在共振磁化率的虚部中，并与随采集条件变化的非共振背景(NRB)相干混合。传统直接光谱回归方法在采集条件变化时精度下降，因此需要在不同测量条件下保持鲁棒的相位恢复方法。

Method: 1) 构建逆向物理信息神经网络(iPINN)，直接预测洛伦兹峰参数而非原始光谱；2) 使用Transformer编码器将光谱特征分配到24个可学习的峰槽位；3) 通过可微分的解析正向模型重建共振磁化率；4) 设计多视图一致性损失，强制预测在不同NRB模式、NRB强度和噪声条件下保持不变。

Result: 在公开基准上达到最低误差(MAE 0.016，优于次优基线0.046)。在28个跨7种溶剂和4种焦平面位置的零样本测试光谱中，7种溶剂中有5种在深度上保持精度不变。

Conclusion: 逆向参数预测结合可微分物理解码器能够支持跨测量条件的鲁棒相位恢复，为BCARS光谱分析提供了有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Phase retrieval in broadband coherent anti-Stokes Raman spectroscopy (BCARS) is an ill-posed inverse problem. The Raman-like signal is encoded in the imaginary part of the resonant susceptibility, which mixes coherently with a non-resonant background (NRB) that varies across acquisitions. We introduce an inverse physics-informed neural network (iPINN) that predicts Lorentzian peak parameters from raw BCARS spectra and reconstructs the resonant susceptibility through a differentiable analytical forward model. A transformer encoder assigns spectral features to 24 learnable peak slots, and a multi-view consistency loss enforces invariance across NRB pattern, NRB strength, and noise. Unlike direct spectral regression approaches, the method retains accuracy under varying acquisition conditions. On a public benchmark, iPINN achieves the lowest error among the tested baselines (MAE 0.016 vs. next-best 0.046). On 28 zero-shot test spectra acquired across seven solvents and four focal positions, accuracy is depth-invariant in five of seven solvents. These results show that inverse parametric prediction with a differentiable physical decoder supports robust phase retrieval across measurement conditions.

</details>


### [231] [Poisson-Gamma Dynamical Systems with Time-varying Transition Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00896)
*Jiahao Wang,Yijun Wang,Nan Fang,Sikun Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种具有时变转移核的Poisson-Gamma动态系统（TV-PGDS），通过三种专门设计的Dirichlet马尔可夫链来建模转移矩阵随时间的演化，并利用Dirichlet-Multinomial-Beta数据增强技术开发了全共轭的高效Gibbs采样器进行后验推断。实验表明该模型在预测性能上优于相关模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的Poisson-Gamma动态系统（PGDS）在处理实世界计数时间序列时，无法捕捉随时间演化的转移动力学，即底层转移矩阵通常被假设为静态的，这与实际数据中普遍存在的异构结构突变不符。

Method: 提出时变转移核的PGDS（TV-PGDS），允许底层转移矩阵随时间演化。具体构建了三种Dirichlet马尔可夫链（Dir-Dir、Dir-Gam-Dir、PR-Gam-Dir）来建模依赖关系中的异构结构突变，并利用Dirichlet-Multinomial-Beta数据增强技术设计全共轭的Gibbs采样器进行后验模拟。

Result: 与相关模型相比，TV-PGDS能够学习时变依赖结构（通过随时间演化的转移矩阵体现），从而取得了更优的预测性能。

Conclusion: 通过让转移矩阵随时间演化，PGDS能够更好地捕捉真实计数时间序列中常见的动态转移模式，从而提升模型的表达能力和预测准确性。

Abstract: Bayesian methodologies for handling count-valued time series have gained prominence due to their ability to infer interpretable latent structures and to estimate uncertainties.
