Among these Bayesian models, Poisson-Gamma Dynamical Systems (PGDSs) are proven to be effective in capturing the evolving dynamics underlying observed count sequences. However, the state-of-the-art PGDS still falls short in capturing the transition dynamics that are commonly observed in real-world count time series. To mitigate this limitation, a PGDS with time-varying transition kernel (TV-PGDS), is proposed to allow the underlying transition matrices to evolve over time. Three specifically-designed Dirichlet Markov chains (Dir-Dir, Dir-Gam-Dir, PR-Gam-Dir) are constructed to accommodate heterogeneous structural mutations within these dependencies. Leveraging Dirichlet-Multinomial-Beta data augmentation techniques, a fully-conjugate and efficient Gibbs sampler is developed to perform posterior simulation. Experiments show that, in comparison with related models, the proposed PGDS achieves improved predictive performance due to its capacity to learn time-varying dependency structure captured by the time-evolving transition matrices.

</details>


### [232] [SAGE: Subpopulation-Aware Generative Enhancement for Mitigating Spurious Correlations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01051)
*Yiming Luo,Rongqiang Zhao,Jie Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SAGE框架，一种无需组标签的两阶段生成式增强方法，通过聚类派生子标签和类别标签微调条件生成模型，生成合成数据填补少数群体区域并构建平衡验证集进行最后一层重加权，在Waterbirds、CelebA和MetaShift上分别达到89.5%、85.7%和79.1%的最差组准确率，超越最佳无组标签基线最多7.7个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虚假相关性（spurious correlations）严重威胁现代机器学习的鲁棒性。数据集分布的内在失衡导致传统ERM模型依赖多数类的虚假属性进行分类，使少数群体表现不佳。当虚假属性不可用时尤为困难，现有无组标签方法通过上采样少数群体或误分类的真实训练样本来缓解，但重复相同实例会降低有效多样性并导致过拟合。

Method: 提出SAGE（Subpopulation-Aware Generative Enhancement）两阶段生成式增强框架。第一阶段利用聚类派生子标签（cluster-derived sub-labels）和类别标签，微调条件生成模型和文本编码器；第二阶段生成定向合成数据以填补训练集中代表性不足的区域，并构建一个平衡的验证集用于最后一层重加权（last-layer reweighting）。

Result: 在Waterbirds、CelebA和MetaShift数据集上分别达到89.5%、85.7%和79.1%的最差组准确率，相比最佳的无组标签基线方法提升了最多7.7个百分点。

Conclusion: SAGE从数据中心的视角有效缓解了无先验知识条件下的虚假相关性偏差，通过生成式增强而非简单重复样本来提升少数群体的多样性，验证了生成合成数据在提升最差组鲁棒性方面的有效性。

Abstract: Spurious correlations pose a significant challenge to the robustness of modern machine learning. The inherent imbalance in dataset distributions often leads traditional Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM) models to rely on majority spurious attributes for classification, resulting in poor performance on minority groups. This problem becomes particularly challenging when the spurious attributes are unavailable. Existing group-label-free methods often upsample minority groups or misclassified real training examples; repeating the same instances can reduce effective diversity and encourage overfitting. To mitigate these spurious correlations from a data-centric perspective in the absence of prior knowledge, we introduce Subpopulation-Aware Generative Enhancement (SAGE), a two-stage generative augmentation framework. Using cluster-derived sub-labels and class labels, we fine-tune a conditional generative model and text encoder, generating targeted synthetic data to fill underrepresented regions in the training set and construct a balanced validation set for last-layer reweighting. We experimentally show that SAGE achieves 89.5%, 85.7%, and 79.1% worst-group accuracy on Waterbirds, CelebA, and MetaShift, respectively, outperforming the best group-label-free baselines by up to 7.7 percentage points.

</details>


### [233] [Let Confidence Change, Not the Prediction: Prediction-Preserving Repair for Post-hoc Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01072)
*Daehwan Kim,Haejun Chung,Ikbeom Jang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CORD（Calibrator-Output Repair for Top-1 Decision Preservation），一种后拟合适配器，通过修复校准后的完整概率向量，在不改变原始顶级预测的情况下保持校准精度，实现零TPCR（预测变化率）并降低ECE/NLL/Brier指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多类别校准器在改善置信度时可能改变模型的top-1预测，而精确率只反映这些变化的净效应，没有反映预测频繁改变的程度。TPCR可以衡量预测变化频率，但缺少一种不影响校准效果的同时保持原始决策的方法。

Method: CORD作为后拟合适配器，仅利用原始输出和校准输出，确定分配给原始top-1的质量，然后通过校准的条件分布将剩余质量分配给其他类别，生成经过修复的概率向量，使其argmax恢复原始预测。CORD在校准集上协调修复后的质量，尽可能保留校准输出对原始预测的平均质量，不改变校准器本身或其直接输出。

Result: 在CIFAR-10/100和ImageNet-1K数据集上，CORD通过构造实现零TPCR，并在所有数据集中相对于直接输出降低了平均ECE、NLL和Brier分数。配对收益在分布偏移和不同校准集大小下仍保持。

Conclusion: CORD将决策保持约束从校准器拟合中移除，将原始决策的精确恢复分配给后续的输出修复步骤，有效解决了校准与决策保持之间的冲突。

Abstract: Post-hoc calibration corrects reported confidence, yet a multiclass calibrator can also change the associated top-1 prediction. Accuracy captures only the net effect of these changes on correctness, not how often predictions change; the Top-1 Prediction Change Rate (TPCR) instead measures this frequency. We propose Calibrator-Output Repair for Top-1 Decision Preservation (CORD), the first post-fit adapter to impose exact prediction preservation by repairing the full calibrated probability vector. From the original and calibrated outputs alone, CORD determines the mass assigned to the original top-1. The calibrated conditional distribution allocates the remaining mass over the other classes, yielding a repaired vector whose own argmax recovers the original prediction. On the calibration split, CORD coordinates the repaired masses to retain the calibrated outputs' mean mass on original predictions whenever attainable. The adapter alters neither the fitted calibrator nor its direct output, fits no additional supervised map, and requires no user- or validation-tuned hyperparameter. Across CIFAR-10/100 and ImageNet-1K, CORD attains zero TPCR by construction and lowers mean ECE, NLL, and Brier relative to the corresponding direct outputs in every dataset; paired gains persist under distribution shift and across calibration-set sizes. CORD thus removes the preservation constraint from calibrator fitting and assigns exact recovery of the original decision to subsequent output repair. Our code is available at https://github.com/labhai/ORCU.

</details>


### [234] [Modelpedia: A Catalog of Model Findings for the Meta-Science of AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01090)
*Franciszek Bernat,Dawid Płudowski,Michał Jan Włodarczyk,Luca Longo,Jianlong Zhou,Andreas Holzinger,Riccardo Guidotti,Wojciech Samek,Przemysław Biecek*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Modelpedia是一个自动化、由LLM辅助的框架，用于从已发表的论文中提取关于AI模型的发现，并将其链接到相关模型、数据集、方法和概念，最终聚合为一个可搜索的公共目录。原型系统已应用于ICLR 2024和2025论文，提取了超过一千条发现，并对社区如何研究模型进行了元分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI模型知识产生的速度远超社区整理能力，导致关于模型行为或失败的发现分散各处且无法被有效检索，形成了巨大的知识鸿沟。

Method: 构建自动化、LLM辅助的框架：从已发表论文中提取模型相关发现，将发现与涉及的模型、数据集、方法和概念建立关联，并聚合为可搜索的公共目录。

Result: 在ICLR 2024和2025论文上提取了超过一千条模型发现，并对目录本身进行元分析，揭示了社区研究模型的模式。

Conclusion: 作者邀请社区探索、贡献和构建开放目录，旨在将模型发现确立为AI元科学的共享基础。

Abstract: Scientific knowledge about AI models is produced faster than the community can organize it. Every few months a new foundation model reshapes the field and hundreds of papers, blogs, and technical reports document how each behaves or fails. Yet, these findings remain scattered and effectively unretrievable. To address this gap we present Modelpedia, an automated, LLM-assisted framework that extracts findings about models from published papers, links it to the model, dataset, method, and concept it concerns, and aggregates the result into a searchable public catalog. Applying the prototype to accepted ICLR 2024 and 2025 papers, we extract over a thousand findings and, treating the catalog itself as an object of study, run a meta-analysis of how the community investigates models. Now, we invite the community to explore, contribute to, and build on the open catalog, and to help establish model findings as a shared foundation for the meta-science of AI.

</details>


### [235] [Subliminal Learning as Trait-Direction Drift: A Mechanism and Targeted Control under SFT Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01091)
*Zhixuan Liu,Zhichen Dong,Yuyu Fan,Xiangtian Li,Chao Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"特质方向漂移"（trait-direction drift）作为潜意识学习（subliminal learning）的机制解释，并据此提出"探针空间走廊正则化"（probe-space corridor regularization）作为蒸馏过程中的针对性防御方法，有效抑制隐藏特质从教师模型向学生模型的传递，同时保持任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型蒸馏不仅传递预期能力，还可能将教师模型的隐藏特质（如受系统提示词诱导的偏好）转移给学生。此前的相关工作只识别了该过程的碎片，但信号如何在训练中累积并产生行为迁移的机制尚不明确，导致难以进行针对性的缓解。

Method: 1) 提出并验证"特质方向漂移"机制：有偏生成在教师数据中产生可测量的偏好差距，学生可识别的差距在监督微调期间诱导特质对齐的更新，并累积为行为迁移。2) 基于该机制提出"探针空间走廊正则化"防御方法，在蒸馏过程中沿校准的特质方向约束漂移。

Result: 该方法显著降低了隐藏特质的迁移，同时保持任务性能：例如将恶意响应迁移率从29.55%降至6.45%（且主任务准确率代价低），并在Qwen主设定下持续抑制动物偏好迁移。

Conclusion: 偏好差距、训练轨迹和干预证据将潜意识学习与特质方向漂移联系起来，验证了走廊正则化可作为蒸馏过程中针对性的控制手段。

Abstract: Beyond intended capabilities, model distillation can transfer hidden traits from a teacher. A teacher biased by a system prompt can generate semantically clean training data, such as numeric sequences, that still causes a downstream student to inherit the hidden preference, a phenomenon known as subliminal learning. Prior work has identified several parts of this process. How the signal builds up during training and produces behavioral transfer remains unclear, making targeted mitigation difficult. We propose and validate trait-direction drift as a mechanism for subliminal learning: biased generation creates measurable preference gaps in teacher data, and student-recognizable gaps induce trait-aligned updates during supervised fine-tuning that accumulate into behavioral transfer. Guided by this mechanism, we propose probe-space corridor regularization, a targeted defense that constrains drift along a calibrated trait direction during distillation. The method substantially reduces hidden-trait transfer, preserving task performance: for example, it lowers malicious-response transfer from 29.55% to 6.45% with low main-task accuracy cost, and consistently suppresses animal-preference transfer across the main Qwen setting. The preference-gap, training-trajectory, and intervention evidence links subliminal learning to trait-direction drift and motivates corridor regularization as a targeted control during distillation.

</details>


### [236] [Neural Symbollic Regression Using Deep Learning and Sparse Modelling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01102)
*Ravi Kumar U,Sumitra S*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个神经符号回归（NSR）框架，将神经网络作为功能预处理器，通过解耦流程（先神经网络学习平滑鲁棒的近似，再用LASSO提取稀疏闭式表达式）结合Ray Tune与ASHA分布式超参数优化，在Nguyen基准上优于SINDy和非调优神经基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统符号回归方法（如遗传编程）面临可扩展性差和对噪声敏感的挑战，而稀疏回归方法（如SINDy）过度依赖预定义的特征库。需要一种既能保持可解释性又能应对噪声和规模的符号发现方法。

Method: 采用解耦流水线：1) 神经网络在交互感知的非线性特征空间中先学习目标函数的平滑、抗噪声近似；2) 使用LASSO从中提取稀疏、可解释的闭式表达式；3) 通过Ray Tune和ASHA调度集成分布式超参数优化以提升预测精度和符号保真度。

Result: 在Nguyen基准测试套件上，该方法在RMSE、噪声鲁棒性和分布外泛化方面一致优于SINDy和非调优的神经基线。消融研究证实了特征交互、神经网络深度和调优策略的重要性。

Conclusion: 该研究提供了一个可扩展且可解释的神经符号框架，在神经逼近与稀疏方程发现之间建立了坚实的桥梁，适用于科学机器学习。

Abstract: Symbolic Regression (SR) seeks to find succinct mathematical expressions that represent the fundamental relationships within data, providing interpretability and scientific understanding that exceeds that of black-box models. Nevertheless, traditional methods like Genetic Programming face challenges with scalability and are highly sensitive to noise, while sparse regression techniques such as SINDy rely significantly on predetermined feature libraries. In this work, we present a Neural Symbolic Regression (NSR) framework that treats neural networks as functional preconditioners for symbolic discovery. Our approach uses a decoupled pipeline: a neural network first learns a smooth, noise-robust approximation of the target function in an interaction- aware nonlinear feature space. LASSO is then applied to extract sparse, interpretable closed-form expressions. To improve predictive accuracy and symbolic fidelity by integrating distributed hyperparameter optimization with Ray Tune and ASHA scheduling. Experiments on the Nguyen benchmark suite show that our approach consistently outperforms SINDy and non-tuned neural baselines in RMSE, noise robustness, and out-of-distribution generalization. Ablation studies confirm the significance of feature interactions, neural depth, and tuning strategies. In general, this study presents a scalable and understandable neural-symbolic framework, creating a solid link between neural approximation and the discovery of sparse equations for scientific machine learning.

</details>


### [237] [Replicating TRACE: A Practitioner's Guide to Its Threshold and Particle Budget](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01108)
*Alex Chadyuk,Alicia Zhang,Roy Kucukates*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文独立复现了TRACE方法（从预训练自回归模型中提取因果图）的核心合成实验结果，发现其最佳阈值并非固定常数而是依赖于真实因果边缘的margin（delta/2附近），单阈值主要恢复lag-1直接边而严重低估lag≥2的边，且论文基准实验的lag衰减设计将约85%的干预真值集中在lag-1，导致头号F1结果只证明了lag-1恢复能力。作者提出逐lag阈值族可恢复部分lag-2真值，并总结出五条实践规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TRACE声称能从预训练模型中读出事件类型间的因果图，但其阈值选择机制、不同因果lag的恢复能力以及基准设计的公平性尚未被独立验证。作者旨在通过精确复现、阈值敏感性分析和更公平的基准对比，揭示该方法的真实能力边界与潜在偏倚。

Method: 作者独立复现TRACE的合成实验设置，在验证集上选取阈值tau*并报告F1分数；系统分析最优阈值与真值margin（delta=0.05）的关系，外推到5000词汇量；对比单全局阈值与逐lag阈值族的表现；通过调节合成基准的lag衰减分布（从默认陡峭衰减改为平坦衰减）来分离基准偏斜与算法自身限制；并从N=2粒子起考察F1饱和行为及估计器的N^(-1/2)收敛特性。

Result: 复现得到F1在0.86-0.91范围，与原论文一致；发现最优阈值始终对应真值margin（delta/2），而非固定常数；单阈值下lag-1真边召回率0.97-0.99而lag≥2的召回率低数量级；逐lag阈值族恢复到1/3至1/2的lag-2真边；在lag均匀数据上每lag召回率0.40-0.87，比原子干预对照组在lag 3-6低8-26个百分点；F1在N=2即饱和，但估计器本身遵循N^(-1/2)收敛。

Conclusion: TRACE的头部合成F1实为lag-1恢复能力的表征，其效果在很大程度上依赖阈值恰好落在真值margin上及基准中lag-1主导的偏斜设计。为在实践中正确使用，需采用适配的阈值选择策略、明确区分直接与非直接因果影响、并设计更公平的lag分布基准，作者据此给出五条操作规则。

Abstract: TRACE (Math & Lienhart, arXiv:2602.01135) reads causal graphs over event types out of a pretrained autoregressive sequence model by thresholding a per-position conditional-mutual-information estimate at a fixed tau. We independently replicate its headline synthetic result: with tau selected on a validation split, mean per-sequence F1 against exact interventional truth reaches 0.90-0.91 at vocabulary size 1000 (paper: 0.91) and 0.86-0.91 from 100 to 2000. First, the optimal threshold is pinned to the truth margin, not to any constant: at every size the errors at tau* straddle the delta = 0.05 margin defining ground truth (missed true edges lie just above it, accepted false ones just below), and the blind optimum lands near delta/2 times the estimator's calibration, confirmed out of sample at 5000. Second, at a single global threshold TRACE mostly recovers a direct, adjacent-influence graph: lag-1 true edges are recalled at 0.97-0.99, while true edges at lag 2 or more read orders of magnitude lower---the reading-scale price of randomizing mediating positions, which an exact test of direct causal effect requires when the truth is unknown. A per-lag threshold family recovers a third to a half of lag-2 truth; on lag-uniform data one validated threshold recalls every lag at 0.40-0.87, 8-26 pp below an atomic-intervention control at lags 3-6. Third, the default lag decay of the paper's synthetic benchmark concentrates about 85% of interventional truth at lag 1 and pushes the rest below the estimator's noise floor, so headline F1 there certifies lag-1 recovery only and conflates the benchmark's skew with the algorithm's own limit; a flatter decay separates the two. Fourth, F1 saturates from N = 2 particles at the selected threshold---a property of the threshold's margin over the noise floor, not of the estimator, which converges as N^(-1/2). We distill five practitioner rules.

</details>


### [238] [When Does Online Adaptation Pay on the Edge? A Leakage-Free Evaluation of Warmup, Learning-Rate Selection, and Resource Trade-offs for Time-Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01126)
*Takumi Fujimoto,Hiroaki Nishi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了边缘时间序列预测中在线自适应的评估偏差问题，在六个公开多元数据集上采用无泄漏流式协议，识别出除已知偏差外两种新的比较偏差来源：静态基线的预热预算呈两面性效应（不足会欠训练，过度会损害漂移前泛化），以及共享默认学习率会混淆优化器质量与学习率敏感性。通过仅使用保留的漂移前验证切片选取预热预算和在线学习率，研究发现Adam在360个评估单元中的310个优于SGD+动量，并进一步刻画了不同自适应方案的准确率-内存-延迟权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘时间序列预测在分布漂移下可通过在线自适应获得收益，但已有研究衡量的自适应收益对评估选择高度敏感。作者希望识别并解决比较方法学上的偏差来源，从而为边缘部署提供可靠的自适应收益评估。

Method: 在六个公开多元数据流（建筑传感器、智能电表等）上采用无泄漏流式协议分析；将静态基线预热预算和优化器配置从1000到20000步范围内系统变化以量化影响；提出仅用保留的漂移前验证切片（不接触测试数据）选取预热预算和在线学习率的验证仅程序；从准确率、自适应状态内存、A100实测每更新时延三个维度对比全量、仅头部和基于校准的自适应方案。

Result: 估算的自适应收益在不同设置间随预热范围变化3.0到18.8个百分点；验证仅程序下Adam在360单元中310个优于SGD+m，4个Adam单元仍低于静态基线；在PatchTST前沿设置中多个参数高效变体在自适应状态内存轴上无支配关系；智能电表分析显示报告收益依赖于电表选择规则。

Conclusion: 提出验证仅调试程序的结论，即应在不接触测试数据的情况下选取预热预算和在线学习率，以公平评估在线自适应收益；同时指出目标设备的时延和能耗仍是待测量项，为未来边缘自适应评估标准提供了方法学基础。

Abstract: Online adaptation can help edge time-series forecasting under distribution drift, but its measured benefit is sensitive to evaluation choices. We study six public multivariate streams, including building-sensor and smart-meter data, under a leakage-free streaming protocol. We identify two additional sources of comparison bias. First, the warmup budget of the static baseline has a two-sided effect: insufficient warmup undertrains the baseline, whereas excessive warmup can degrade its pre-drift generalization. Across six dataset-backbone settings, the estimated adaptation benefit changes by 3.0 to 18.8 percentage points (pp) over the 1,000-20,000-step warmup range. Second, comparing SGD with momentum (SGD+m) and Adam at a shared default learning rate conflates optimizer quality with rate sensitivity. We select both the warmup budget and each optimizer's online rate using a held-out pre-drift validation slice without accessing test data. Under this validation-only procedure, Adam outperforms SGD+m in 310 of 360 evaluated cells, while 4 Adam cells remain below the static baseline. We further characterize accuracy against adaptation-state memory and A100-measured per-update latency for full, head-only, and calibration-based adaptation. In the evaluated PatchTST frontier settings, several parameter-efficient variants are nondominated on the adaptation-state-memory axis. Smart-meter analyses also show that reported gains depend on meter-selection rules. These findings support a validation-only commissioning procedure, while target-device latency and energy remain to be measured. Code, data, and all reported numbers: https://github.com/keiotakmin/tsf-edge-adaptation.

</details>


### [239] [Scaled Idempotence in Transformer Attention: Paired OV Geometry and Shared-Value Algebras](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01129)
*Jiming Feng,Junliang Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现Transformer注意力中存在一种递归代数规律：有效OV算子T=OV^⊤的稀疏子集在合成下近似封闭，即T²≈αT（近似幂等性）。研究覆盖2.8B至235B参数的多个预训练模型，发现少数头满足平方封闭对齐，且这种性质源于K的特定方向而非特征值结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解Transformer注意力中OV子空间的代数结构，探究为何某些头表现出递归的代数规律（近似幂等），以及这种规律是来自模型容量还是训练获得的特定方向。

Method: 1) 识别OV算子T=OV^⊤在合成下近似封闭（T²≈αT）；2) 使用精确主坐标分解T=Q_OKQ_V^⊤将支撑内传输与读写返回几何分离；3) 在9个MHA/GQA模型的7,304个头中进行消融实验，仅打乱K的方向而保留奇异值、范数、因子跨度和主角度；4) 通过构造性搜索显示高封闭性在每层都可行但通常未达到；5) 在值共享条件下研究头级闭包扩展为右作用代数（T_iT_j=α_jT_i）的性质。

Result: 在六个2.8B-235B规模的预训练端点中，3.98%-8.00%的头达到平方封闭对齐P≥0.9，而匹配的层内O/V不匹配均不满足。打乱K方向后中层数封闭性从0.336降至1.04×10^-4，98.64%的头和每一层中训练方向获胜。七模型实验验证了近似定律并揭示具有共享值定义核的独特斜投影。

Conclusion: 缩放幂等性（近似幂等）是广泛几何容量中稀疏的训练方向选择，值共享将头级关系扩展为局部算子代数。这揭示了注意力头在实现具体功能时如何从可行的几何空间中选择特定的代数方向。

Abstract: We identify a recurrent algebraic regularity in Transformer attention: a sparse subset of effective OV operators $T=OV^\top$ nearly closes under composition, $T^2\approxαT$. Across six pretrained endpoints spanning 2.8B--235B parameters, 3.98--8.00% of heads reach squared closure alignment $\mathcal{P}\geq0.9$, while no matched within-layer O/V mismatch does. An exact principal-coordinate factorization, $T=Q_OKQ_V^\top$ and $T^2=Q_O(KDK)Q_V^\top$, separates within-support transport from read--write return geometry. Across all 7,304 heads in nine MHA/GQA models, scrambling only the orientation of $K$ while preserving singular values, norms, factor spans, and principal angles reduces median closure from 0.336 to $1.04\times10^{-4}$; trained orientation wins for 98.64% of heads and in every layer. Constructive searches show that high closure is feasible in every surveyed layer, but usually not attained. Retrospective trajectories in three independently trained lineages further separate broadly available capacity from the orientations attained by final strong heads. Under exact value sharing, headwise closure extends to a right-action algebra, $T_iT_j=α_jT_i$. Seven-model experiments verify the approximate law and reveal distinct oblique projections with a shared value-defined kernel. These results characterize scaled idempotence as a sparse trained orientation within broadly available geometric capacity and show how value sharing extends a headwise relation into a local operator algebra.

</details>


### [240] [Superposed Latent Autoencoder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01158)
*Quanling Zhao,Jiaying Yang,Tianqi Zhang,Ziyang Hao,Fatemeh Asgarinejad,Flavio Ponzina,Tajana Rosing*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出超位置潜变量自编码器（SLAE），通过可学习的叠加方式将多个高容量潜变量共享存储，替代传统不可逆的维度瓶颈压缩，在相同存储预算下显著改善重建-存储权衡，并提升下游分类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统自编码器受限于紧凑的潜空间内存预算，通常通过压缩每个潜表示（即维度瓶颈）来降低存储，这牺牲了表征容量。作者提出不同的思路：既然单个窄表示容量有限，是否可以用多个更宽的潜变量并通过叠加方式共享存储？

Method: SLAE将潜变量转换为便于存储的编码，使用随机化密钥（randomized keys）进行绑定，将多个编码叠加（superpose）为单一记忆张量，并通过学习恢复每个潜变量后再解码。在相同存储预算下，用可抑制的结构化干扰（structured interference）替代不可逆的维度瓶颈。

Result: 在CIFAR-10/100、SVHN、STL-10、Tiny ImageNet及多种存储预算设置下，SLAE相比传统自编码器在匹配存储下最多降低56%重建误差；下游分类准确率在相同内存预算下最多提升16.79个百分点。分析表明优势源于使更宽的表示在相同存储预算下可用。

Conclusion: 提出表示压缩的新原则：与其把所有潜变量做得更小，不如保持表示"宽"（高容量），让它们通过叠加共享内存，从而在有限存储下保留更多信息。

Abstract: Autoencoders typically meet tight latent-memory budgets by making each latent representation smaller, sacrificing representational capacity. We ask a different question: can multiple wider latents be stored together instead? We introduce the Superposed Latent Autoencoder (SLAE), which preserves high-capacity latent representations while sharing storage through learned superposition. SLAE transforms latents into storage-friendly codes, binds them with randomized keys, superposes multiple codes into a single memory tensor, and learns to recover each latent before decoding. Under the same storage budget, SLAE replaces irreversible dimensional bottlenecks with structured interference that can be suppressed. Across CIFAR-10/100, SVHN, STL-10, Tiny ImageNet, and a wide range of memory budgets, SLAE substantially improves the reconstruction--memory tradeoff, reducing reconstruction error by up to 56% over conventional autoencoders at matched storage. Further analysis shows that SLAE's advantage comes from making wider representations usable under the same storage budget. These gains also extend beyond reconstruction: the information preserved by SLAE improves downstream classification by up to 16.79 percentage points under the same memory budget. Our results suggest a new principle for representation compression: instead of making every latent smaller, keep representations wide and let them share memory.

</details>


### [241] [CopyShield: A Cross-Level Benchmark of Copyright Defenses in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01161)
*Maryam Alshehyari,Dushyant Singh Chauhan,Samuele Poppi,Martin Takac,Salem Lahlou,Nils Lukas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CopyShield是一个受控基准测试框架，系统比较了三种不同干预层面的版权防御方法：对比解码（输出层面）、直接偏好优化DPO（行为层面）和激活干预（表征层面），在LLaMA-3.1-8B和Mistral-7B-v0.3两个模型家族上评估其合规性-效用权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型能够逐字复现记忆化文本，但现有的版权防御评估通常采用不兼容的协议，缺乏统一的、跨层面的标准化基准来公平比较不同干预水平的防御方法。

Method: 提出CopyShield受控基准，使用五本公有领域书籍在两种模型上构建受控记忆场景，以共享协议评估四类指标：字面泄漏（literal leakage）、校准的非字面泄漏、效用（utility）和退化（degeneracy），并对三种代表性防御方法进行对比。

Result: 在LLaMA-3.1-8B上：对比解码近乎无退化（0-2%）但字面抑制有下限（NV-Recall 0.192-0.203）；DPO几乎消除字面泄漏（0.263降至0.002）但在58%的QA输出中引发改写循环退化；激活干预通过提前阻断84%的非字面查询实现最低非字面标记率（1/200）。在Mistral-7B-v0.3上，输出与表征层面模式保持，而DPO退化降至10-14%，表明其严重程度依赖模型。

Conclusion: CopyShield提供了跨层面的参考基线，并识别出针对性非字面抑制仍是一个未解决的开放挑战；人类评估表明DPO连贯性低，而激活干预通过广泛拒答降低感知版权风险，但各方法的效用与合规权衡各异。

Abstract: Large language models can reproduce memorized text verbatim, yet copyright defenses are usually evaluated under incompatible protocols. We introduce CopyShield, a controlled benchmark comparing three representative defenses at distinct intervention levels: contrastive decoding (output), Direct Preference Optimization (behavioral), and activation intervention (representation). We evaluate CopyShield on two model families, LLaMA-3.1-8B and Mistral-7B-v0.3, using controlled memorization over five public-domain books and a shared protocol measuring literal leakage, calibrated non-literal leakage, utility, and degeneracy. Across these methods, intervention level is associated with distinct compliance-utility trade-offs. On LLaMA-3.1-8B, contrastive decoding remains near-degeneracy-free (0-2%) but reaches a literal-suppression floor at NV-Recall 0.192-0.203. DPO nearly eliminates literal leakage (0.263 to 0.002) but induces paraphrase-loop degeneracy in 58% of QA outputs, with no utility gain over the SFT baseline. Activation intervention attains the lowest non-literal flagging rate (1/200) by blocking 84% of non-literal queries before generation. Human evaluation confirms that DPO has low coherence, whereas activation lowers perceived copyright risk through broad refusal. On Mistral-7B-v0.3, the output- and representation-level patterns persist, while DPO degeneracy falls to 10-14%, showing that its severity is model-dependent. Together, CopyShield provides cross-level reference baselines and identifies targeted non-literal suppression as an open challenge. The code is available at https://github.com/spotai-mbzuai/CopyShield.git.

</details>


### [242] [Pre-carved Niches: The Formation Dynamics of Modular Task Partitions in Early LLM Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01170)
*Guangqi Li,Yongxin Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过逐步追踪Pythia-410M模型从头训练的全过程（两个轨迹：bf16和fp32），在每一步进行归因修补（attribution patching），并结合梯度范数、有效更新、权重范数和一阶损失分解等探针，跨14个任务、4个认知域，揭示了LLM模块化内部组织的形成过程。研究发现三个关键结论：模块化图谱在训练前就已预刻（dominant task pair重叠度为基础线的3.6倍）；分区通过两次陡峭跳跃锁定（幅度不跟随学习率调度，第二次达20.4 sigma）；底物（substrate）偏离仅出现在正在学习的域中，支持模块化跟踪学习的假说。最后区分了可辩护的特征级解释与无法回答的机制性问题，并预注册了2.8B实验的规模阈值假说。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前工作仅刻画了训练完成后的最终模型，揭示了LLM具有与人类大脑功能网络相呼应的模块化内部组织，但这一组织在训练过程中如何形成仍然未知。作者旨在填补这一空白，系统追踪模块化结构形成的每一步过程。

Method: 训练Pythia-410M模型（两条轨迹：bf16和fp32），在训练的每一步执行归因修补（attribution patching），同时采集梯度范数、有效更新、权重范数、一阶损失分解等多维度探针，覆盖14个任务和4个认知域，进行逐步追踪分析。

Result: 三点发现：(1) 模块化图谱在训练前已预刻，主导任务对的重叠度达到任务无关基线的3.6倍，层0浓度是该模型家族的架构级常数；(2) 分区通过两次陡峭跳跃锁定，第二次跳跃达到20.4 sigma安静窗口/6.2 sigma全局显著性，且幅度不跟随学习率调度，伴随梯度层面的相对剥夺现象（赢家获得输家2.25-2.73倍的梯度供给，偏离随机控制9.5-11.5个标准差），但该效应未传播到更新或权重层面；(3) 底物的偏离仅出现在正在学习的域中，支持模块化跟踪学习的假说。

Conclusion: 模块化组织在训练开始前已通过架构先验预刻，训练过程中通过两次突变式跳跃完成锁定，且该过程在梯度层面存在"相对剥夺"但未传导至权重。作者诚实地区分了可辩护的特征级解释与尚无法回答的机制性问题，并预注册了针对2.8B模型的规模阈值假说，为后续更大规模实验提供可检验的理论框架。

Abstract: Large language models exhibit a modular internal organization that mirrors well-studied functional networks of the human brain, but how this organization forms during training is unknown: prior work has characterized finished models, not the formation process. We track formation step by step: we train a Pythia-410M model from scratch (two trajectories, bf16 and fp32) and run attribution patching at every step, alongside probes for gradient norms, effective updates, weight norms, and first-order loss decomposition across 14 tasks in four cognitive domains. Three findings. First, the modular map is pre-carved: before any learning, the dominant task pair already overlaps at ~3.6x the attribution substrate (a task-independent baseline), and its layer-0 concentration is an architecture-level constant on this model family. Second, the partition locks in through two sharp jumps whose amplitudes do not track the learning-rate schedule (the second reaching 20.4 sigma quiet-window / 6.2 sigma global), accompanied by gradient-level relative deprivation--winners receive 2.25->2.73x the loser's gradient supply, 9.5-11.5 standard deviations below a random control--that does not propagate to updates or weights. Third, deviation from the substrate appears only in the domain being learned, consistent with the hypothesis that modularity tracks learning. We close by separating the feature-level account we can defend from the mechanistic questions we cannot, and we pre-register the scale-threshold hypothesis behind our ongoing 2.8B experiments.

</details>


### [243] [Births are difficult to predict even with rich survey and full-population register data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01194)
*Elizaveta Sivak,Emily M. Cantrell,Thomas Emery,Javier Garcia-Bernardo,Flavio Hafner,Kasia Karpinska,Malte Lüken,Adrienne Mendrik,Joris Mulder,Hanzhang Ren,Varun Satish,Mark Verhagen,Angelica M. Maineri,Paulina Pankowska,Jasmin Abdel Ghany,Bruno Arpino,Giovanni Cassani,Julia Hellstrand,Katya Ivanova,Sanni Kuikka,Ana Macanovic,Charles Rahal,Felix C. Tropf,Roland J. Veen,Nicole Walasek,Daniël van Wijk,Kelsey Q. Wright,Emilio Zagheni,Henry Abbink,Emanuele Aliverti,Matteo Amestoy,Tilbe Atav,Nicola Barban,Sunnee Billingsley,Goan J. Booij,Louis Boucherie,Yael Broos,Li Ya Chang,Jamie C. Chiu,Chiara Ludovica Comolli,Boris Cule,Qixiang Fang,Dennis M. Feehan,Rachel Ganly,Erwin Gielens,Rolando M. Gonzales Martinez,Andrea Gradassi,Rosember Guerra-Urzola,Mario Guerra-Urzola,Stéphane Guerrier,Enamul Hassan,Vincent A. Haverhoek,Andrew T. Hendrickson,Amber Howard,Yuxuan Jin,Sayash Kapoor,Erik-Jan van Kesteren,Iris ten Klooster,Marie Labussiere,Lydia T. Liu,Tiffany Liu,Adam Maghout,Simone Meneghello,Lasse Mohr,Clara H. Mulder,Saul J. Newman,Jessica Nisén,Janis Norden,Mikkel Odgaard,Riccardo Omenti,Ozancan Ozdemir,Christina Pao,Paige Park,Gaia Penta,Juan C. Perdomo,Tanzir Pial,Alessio Piraccini,Federica Querin,Ziwei Rao,Christian Rellama,Adrien Remund,Frederieke Richert,Arnout van de Rijt,Mojtaba Rostami Kandroodi,Stijn J. Rotman,Lucas Sage,Germans Savcisens,Katrin Schwanitz,Steven Skiena,Alessandro Spata,Yannick Stadtfeld,Benedikt Stroebl,Gaetano Tedesco,Mathilde Theelen,Gianluca Tori,Abigail Tun-Mendicuti,Rishabh Tyagi,Keyon Vafa,Luiz Felipe Vecchietti,Linda Vecgaile,Willem R. J. Vermeulen,Maria-Pia Victoria Feser,Lionel A. Voirol,Thom B. Volker,Xinran Wang,Jiani Yan,Xinyi Zhao,Flora Zhou,Zuzana Zilincikova,Malvina Nissim,Matthew J. Salganik,Gert Stulp*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究通过一项由147名研究人员参与的数据挑战赛，预测荷兰18-45岁居民三年内是否生育。结果发现预测准确率中等（F1最高：注册数据0.59，调查数据0.76），先进模型未超越传统模型，大规模注册数据也未优于调查数据。通过模拟受孕和怀孕的随机生物学过程，估算了预测上限（调查F1约0.86-0.94，注册数据0.88-0.96），实际表现低于该上限，说明数据不完善、方法不足及未建模的随机因素共同限制了个体生活事件的预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重大生活事件一直难以预测，作者想要探究这种困难究竟源于理论、数据或算法的局限，还是本质上由随机性主导。生育这一事件提供了一个近乎理想的预测场景来回答该问题。

Method: 组织数据挑战赛，147名研究者使用调查数据和全人口注册数据预测荷兰18-45岁居民三年内是否生育，方法涵盖逻辑回归到大语言模型和Transformer；同时通过随机生物学模型（模拟受孕与怀孕的随机过程）估算预测理论上限。

Result: 预测准确率中等（最佳F1：注册数据0.59，调查数据0.76）；先进模型没有超越经典方法；大样本注册数据未优于调查数据。模拟估计的预测上限为调查F1约0.86-0.94、注册数据0.88-0.96，实际表现低于该上限。

Conclusion: 实际预测低于理论上限，说明数据质量与建模方法仍存在改进空间；但即使数据、方法理想，生育本身蕴含的随机性也会对个体生命事件预测设置一个不可忽视的根本性上限，研究者应正视随机性对预测的根本制约。

Abstract: Major life events have proven difficult to predict. Does this reflect limits of theory, data, and algorithms, or the large role of chance? We examine one outcome - having a child within three years - through a near-ideal setting for prediction: a data challenge where 147 researchers predicted births for Dutch residents aged 18-45, using survey data and full-population registers. Methods ranged from logistic regression to a large language model and transformers. Predictions were moderately accurate (best F1: register 0.59, survey 0.76); advanced models did not outperform classical ones; and the larger registers did not beat the survey. Simulating the stochastic biology of conception and pregnancy, we estimated a predictive ceiling (survey F1 ~ 0.86-0.94, register 0.88-0.96). Observed performance falls short of this ceiling, implicating imperfect data, methods, and unmodelled chance, while the ceiling itself shows that chance in reproduction alone sets a non-trivial limit on predicting individual lives.

</details>


### [244] [Recent Developments in Transformer Inference Deployment on FPGA Platforms: A Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01212)
*Arjan Blankestijn,Uraz Odyurt,Amirreza Yousefzadeh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对Transformer模型在FPGA平台上的推理加速研究进行了系统性文献综述，探讨了最新的进展、趋势和设计选择，并提供了一个主题分类体系，可作为学术界和工业界研究人员的指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着基于Transformer架构的机器学习模型快速增长并被广泛采用，对其部署能力（包括吞吐量、延迟等运行性能以及能耗等效率方面）提出了很高需求。相比CPU和GPU等常见部署选择，FPGA平台作为专用硬件加速器提供了实现灵活性、能源效率和适合现场部署等优势，因此值得系统性地研究Transformer推理在FPGA上的最新进展。

Method: 采用系统性文献综述（Systematic Literature Review）方法，对Transformer推理在FPGA平台上的研究进行提取和分析，深入研究实现和优化的首选技术，并构建主题分类体系（taxonomy）。

Result: 论文提供了关于Transformer推理在FPGA平台上最新进展、趋势和设计选择的系统性综述结果，识别出关键的实施和优化技术，并建立了涵盖相关主题的分类体系。

Conclusion: 该综述及其提供的主题分类可同时作为学术界研究人员和工业界从业者在FPGA上部署Transformer推理模型时的实用指南。

Abstract: With the rapid and continuous growth in the incorporation of machine learning models based on the Transformer architecture, capable deployment is in high demand. In this context, capable deployment refers to operational performance aspects, e.g., throughput and latency, as well as efficiency aspects, e.g., energy consumption. When it comes to the task of inference using such models, purpose-built hardware accelerators provide a lucrative alternative to common deployment choices, such as Central Processing Units (CPUs) and Graphics Processing Units (GPUs). The Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) platforms category is an example of such alternative accelerators, promising implementation flexibility, energy efficiency, improved latency and suitability for on-site deployment. We investigate the most recent advances, trends, and design choices for Transformer inference on FPGA platforms. We perform a systematic literature review, extracting and delving into preferred techniques for implementation and optimisation. This study and the provided taxonomy of topics could act as a guide for researchers from the academia and industry alike.

</details>


### [245] [REFACTOR-VLA: Unsupervised Library Learning of Typed Motor Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01215)
*Riyaaz Shaik,Chandru Venkataraman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: REFACTOR-VLA 提出了一种 wake/sleep 两阶段系统用于机器人技能学习。sleep 阶段通过行为等价核（BEK）在潜在世界模型 rollout 中聚类运动程序片段，wake 阶段基于 Hindley-Milner 启发的词汇表生成类型化 lambda 项，由库条件化的 rectified-flow 动作解码器消费。在 LIBERO 上发现世界模型规模增大反而有害，而训练目标（辅助 InfoNCE 对比损失）对 sleep 阶段聚类质量影响更大，NMI 指标全面超越最强基线（平均 Δ=+0.184）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型（如 OpenVLA、π₀、RT-2、RDT-1B）都是单体架构，直接输出原始电机指令或短动作块，没有将行为组织成语义抽象，导致在长程任务中性能退化且难以解释。现有技能发现方法回避了"两个动作序列何时行为等价"这一核心问题，要么对对比嵌入聚类，要么委托给与机器人动力学不校准的 LLM 判断。

Method: 引入 REFACTOR-VLA wake/sleep 系统：(1) sleep 阶段：利用学习到的潜在世界模型 M_φ 的 rollout 计算行为等价核（BEK），对运动程序片段聚类；(2) wake 阶段：在 Hindley-Milner 启发的词汇表上生成类型化 lambda 项，由库条件化的 rectified-flow 动作解码器使用；(3) 抽象仅在通过最小描述长度（MDL）和返回保持门控后才被接纳。

Result: LIBERO 上的关键发现：世界模型从 188M 扩大到 430M 参数反而使全部 4 个套件性能下降，容量本身无帮助；训练目标更关键——在世界模型预热阶段添加辅助监督对比（InfoNCE）损失显著改善 sleep 阶段聚类，n=3 种子下 NMI 达 0.462（object）、0.867（spatial）、0.915（goal）、0.754（LIBERO-10），超出最强基线平均 Δ=+0.184。n=12 providers 下 95% bootstrap CI 为 [0.683, 0.729]（均值 0.705）。sleep 阶段还产出首个真实 LIBERO 任务语言库：解码器使用 3 个抽象中的 2 个，重写了全部 256 个采样演示。

Conclusion: 论文的核心结论是：在技能发现/抽象学习中，训练目标的设计（如对比损失）远比模型容量重要；行为等价性的自动化判断可以通过世界模型 rollout 的核方法实现，而非单纯依赖嵌入聚类或 LLM 判断。REFACTOR-VLA 展示了可解释、可复用的技能抽象能从真实机器人数据中自动涌现。

Abstract: Most vision-language-action (VLA) models -- OpenVLA, $π_0$, RT-2, RDT-1B -- are monolithic: they emit raw motor commands or short action chunks without organizing behavior into reusable abstractions, so they degrade on long-horizon tasks and resist interpretation. Existing skill-discovery methods sidestep the core question of when two action sequences are behaviorally equivalent, either clustering contrastive embeddings or delegating the judgment to a language model uncalibrated to the robot's dynamics. We introduce REFACTOR-VLA, a wake/sleep system for learning reusable skills. Its sleep phase clusters motor-program fragments under a Behavioral-Equivalence Kernel (BEK) computed from rollouts of a learned latent world model $M_φ$; its wake phase emits typed lambda terms over a Hindley--Milner-inspired vocabulary, consumed by a library-conditioned rectified-flow action decoder. Abstractions are admitted only if they pass Minimum Description Length and return-preservation gates. On LIBERO we report two findings. First, enlarging the world model from 188M to 430M parameters worsened performance on 4 of 4 suites, so capacity alone does not help. Second, the training objective matters far more: adding an auxiliary supervised contrastive (InfoNCE) loss during world-model warmup substantially improves sleep-phase clustering, giving Normalized Mutual Information at $n=3$ seeds of $0.462 \pm 0.021$ (object), $0.867 \pm 0.025$ (spatial), $0.915 \pm 0.013$ (goal) and $0.754 \pm 0.010$ (LIBERO-10), and beating the strongest published baseline on all 4 suites by a mean $Δ= +0.184$. Across providers ($n=12$) the 95% bootstrap confidence interval for mean pairwise NMI is $[0.683, 0.729]$ (mean $0.705$). The sleep phase also yields the first real-LIBERO task-language library: the decoder uses 2 of 3 admitted abstractions and rewrites all 256 sampled demonstrations.

</details>


### [246] [Post-Training Science for Supervised Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01244)
*Charles O'Neill,Mudith Jayasekara,Harry Partridge*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过统一的单变量扫描实验框架，系统测量了监督微调（SFT）中的关键超参数决策（学习率、批大小、LoRA/全参微调、轮数、优化器等），覆盖Qwen3与Llama两个模型家族的稠密与MoE架构，在四个真实客户SFT数据集上进行对比，并提供每个建议的不确定性度量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 每次监督微调都要重新摸索同样的决策链（学习率、批大小、LoRA或全参微调、轮数、优化器等），这些决策通常针对每个新模型和数据集从头重复探索，缺乏系统性的跨模型、跨数据的可比度量。

Method: 设计一个每次只改变一个杠杆的扫描实验仪器，覆盖Qwen3和Llama两个模型家族（含稠密和MoE架构），在四个真实客户SFT数据集上同时进行LoRA和全参微调。数据集训练数据由迭代式SFT生成，基于客户共建的评估标准，确保监督目标内部一致。实验中系统探究学习率与批大小随模型规模、家族和数据的移动规律及迁移性；LoRA与全参微调间的权衡及rank/alpha的设置；验证损失等指标对下游质量的排序保真度；从稠密到MoE直至235B参数的模型阶梯上的收益缩放；通用指令遵循退化前的轮数上限；以及几何感知优化器与AdamW的对比。

Result: 针对上述每个问题给出了对应的实证推荐，并且每个推荐都配有其不确定性度量，报告的评价标准即为构建训练数据时依据的同一判据。

Conclusion: 本文提供了一个可复现的系统化SFT超参数测量框架，将原本分散的经验决策整合为带不确定性的实证建议，有望减少未来微调研究中重复试错的成本，同时揭示了跨模型规模、家族与数据类型的超参数迁移规律。

Abstract: Every supervised fine-tuning run forces the same chain of decisions, such as learning rate, batch size, LoRA or full fine-tuning, how many epochs, which optimiser, and what data to feed the model. Each of these is typically rediscovered from scratch for every new model and dataset. Here we measure them under one instrument: a sweep that varies one lever at a time, and spans dense and mixture-of-experts models in two families (Qwen3 and Llama), on four real-world customer SFT datasets, for both LoRA and full fine-tuning. These datasets give a controlled testbed: each task carries an evaluation built with the customer, and its training data is produced by iterative supervised fine-tuning that refines model outputs until they pass that evaluation, so the supervised target is internally consistent and the task judge we report against is the criterion the data was built to satisfy. We ask how the optimal learning rate and batch size move with model scale, family, and data, and whether one selection rule transfers across them; what LoRA trades against full fine-tuning, and how its rank and alpha set what the adapter can learn; whether validation loss (or other metrics, such as loss landscape flatness) faithfully ranks downstream quality; whether post-training gains scale with model size and data volume, on a model ladder extended through mixtures-of-experts to 235B parameters; how many epochs to train before general instruction-following erodes; and whether a geometry-aware optimiser improves on AdamW. Each recommendation is paired with a measure of its uncertainty.

</details>


### [247] [Explore More, Drift Less: Outcome-Only Reinforcement Learning Can Suffice for Long-Horizon Interactive Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01245)
*Liming Pu,Xiaoxia Li,Yifu Liu,Teng Cao,Bin Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CANOPY(覆盖度锚定在线策略RL)协议，解决小规模开放模型上基于结果奖励RL的性能瓶颈问题。该方法通过扩大同任务探索范围恢复稀疏奖励信号，并保持更新在线、KL锚定且限制在agent自身动作token内，无需任务特定监督或辅助信号。在AppWorld基准上，Qwen3-14B通过纯环境交互训练在公开排行榜上登顶；相同设计原则使Qwen3.5-9B在SWE-bench Verified上提升16.6分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有共识认为仅基于结果奖励的RL在小规模开放模型上很快触及天花板，因此大量工作通过密集奖励、SFT先验、技能库等复杂机制来补偿。作者论证这一天花板实际上是两种常见实践缺陷的产物：信号饥饿(稀疏结果奖励仅在成功失败混合时产生梯度，扩展不足使最难任务被忽略)和政策漂移(小任务池上多次更新使采样分布坍缩)。

Method: CANOPY协议包含三个核心策略：(1)扩展同任务探索直到自然信号重新出现，解决信号饥饿问题；(2)保持每次更新严格在线(on-policy)；(3)KL锚定并将更新限制在agent自身动作token上，防止政策漂移。该方法完全依赖环境交互和最终结果验证，不借助任务特定监督、辅助信用信号或复杂agent脚手架。

Result: 在AppWorld长时程交互编码基准上，经过CANOPY训练的Qwen3-14B达到Test-Normal TGC 86.9和Test-Challenge 67.6，登顶2026年2月公开排行榜。相同设计原则使Qwen3.5-9B在SWE-bench Verified上提升16.6点。证明了纯agentic RL能将长时程能力直接内化到小规模开放模型中。

Conclusion: 结果奖励RL的性能天花板并非固有，而是训练实践缺陷所致。CANOPY的极简方案表明，正确设计的纯RL可以在小模型上实现顶尖长时程交互能力，为后续研究提供了简化范式。完整训练栈将在GitHub开源。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning is a natural way to post-train LLM agents for long-horizon interactive tasks judged only by end-of-task verification, yet a shared belief holds that outcome-only RL soon hits a ceiling on small open models. Recent work therefore compensates around the training with denser rewards, SFT priors, skill libraries, curated memory, or multi-agent orchestration. We argue the ceiling is an artifact of two failures of common practice. Signal starvation: group-relative RL with sparse outcome-only rewards yields a gradient only when a task's rollout group mixes successes and failures, so under-scaled exploration silences exactly the hardest, most instructive tasks. Policy drift: squeezing many updates out of a small task pool degrades the policy itself, as an unanchored objective lets the sampling distribution collapse exactly when saturation has already made informative groups rare. We present CANOPY (Coverage-ANchored On-PolicY RL), a minimalist protocol attacking both directly: scale same-task exploration until the natural signal reappears, keep every update on-policy, KL-anchored, and confined to the agent's own action tokens, then cash in an enlarged interaction budget at test time. On AppWorld, a long-horizon interactive coding benchmark, a Qwen3-14B policy trained with CANOPY through environment interaction alone--without task-specific supervision, auxiliary credit signals, or elaborate agent scaffolding--topped the public leaderboard (Feb. 2026; Test-Normal TGC 86.9, Test-Challenge 67.6), and the same design principles lift Qwen3.5-9B on SWE-bench Verified by 16.6 points. Agentic RL alone thus internalizes long-horizon capability directly into a small open model; we plan to release the complete training stack at https://github.com/AlibabaResearch/SignalCoverageRL.

</details>


### [248] [Solving In-Table Prediction Problems by Deep Neural Networks with Performance Evaluation Using Synthetic Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01262)
*Xiao Zhao,Daniela Oelke*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"表内预测"(In-Table Prediction, ITP)问题，即利用深度神经网络基于表中已知列预测任意选定列的值。采用自监督学习方式随机掩码列作为学习目标，提出一种新神经层同时嵌入数值和缺失值，并在合成数据上比较了MLP、ResNet和Transformer三种架构的性能。结果表明在训练样本充足且嵌入长度较大时，基于注意力机制的Transformer表现最佳，但作者强调该结论仅在受控的合成条件下获得，范围有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的表格深度学习方法遵循监督学习范式，需要显式给定目标特征。作者希望探索一种不同的途径：利用深度神经网络学习表格中列与列之间的关系，实现对任意选定列的预测，这一方向在现有文献中研究不足。

Method: 采用自监督学习方式，随机选择列进行掩码作为学习目标。提出一种新型神经层同时嵌入数值和空值以处理连续特征中的缺失值。基于预定义列关系生成合成数据，通过两种机制插入空值，并采用适配的掩码策略创建测试数据。在MLP、ResNet和Transformer三种NN架构上评估性能。

Result: 在训练样本充足且嵌入长度较大时，基于注意力机制的Transformer结构优于MLP和ResNet。然而这些发现是在受控、合成条件下获得的，且列数较少。

Conclusion: 本文是一项初步的、范围有限的探索性研究。自监督的ITP方法在合成数据上展示了注意力架构的优势，但结论尚不能推广到真实世界表格数据，需要进一步在更广泛和复杂的真实场景中验证。

Abstract: Tabular deep learning (TDL) leverages neural networks (NN) to extract patterns from tabular data. Traditional TDL methods follow a supervised learning paradigm, where a target feature is explicitly given. In this work, however, we explore a different approach by employing deep NNs to learn relationships among individual columns within a given table. We investigate whether NNs can predict the values of arbitrarily selected columns in a given table based on the remaining known columns. We call this problem In-Table Prediction (ITB), which is slightly different from table imputation methods and the pretraining task of TDL. Three potential usage scenarios are identified, which, to our best knowledge, have not been extensively studied in the literature. A self-supervised learning approach is applied to address this problem by randomly selecting columns to be masked out and used as learning targets. This work focuses on tabular datasets containing only continuous features. To handle missing values in continuous features, a novel neural layer is proposed to embed both numerical and empty values. Synthetic data is generated based on predefined column relationships, with empty values inserted using two distinct mechanisms. Additionally, an adapted masking strategy is employed to create test data. Performances of three NN architectures, namely MLP, Resnet and Transformer, are evaluated using the generated synthetic data. We conclude that, the attention-based structure outperforms the other two networks, when a sufficiently large number of training examples is available and a relatively large embedding length is chosen. We stress that these findings are obtained under controlled, synthetic conditions with a small number of columns and it should therefore be regarded as an initial, narrowly-scoped investigation rather than a general characterization of ITP on real-world tabular data.

</details>


### [249] [Position: Privacy Is a Claim, Not a Property of Synthetic Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01273)
*Jiachen Zhao,Antonia Januszewicz,Taeho Jung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，指出合成数据在隐私敏感场景中的使用已悄然从"基于假设的残余推断风险"转变为"基于生成过程的外观属性"。通过实证分析发现，许多ML顶会论文在隐私敏感场景中使用合成数据，却未明确阐述威胁模型、推断风险或可证伪的隐私声明，导致隐私保障隐式化、难以验证且分布不均（稀有和少数记录风险更高）。作者主张将隐私视为明确的、基于证据的科学声明，并建议ML期刊采用要求隐私断言清晰界定、可测试和可争议的规范。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者观察到合成数据在隐私敏感场景中的使用存在一种隐含的社区标准转变：隐私风险评估从明确声称的推断风险演变为由数据生成过程本身推断出的"表面属性"。作者指出这不是对既有隐私原则的误解，而是社区对"何为充分隐私证据"的默示标准发生了变化。这种变化可能导致隐私保障隐式化、难以验证，并对稀有和少数记录产生不成比例的风险暴露。

Method: 作者对各主要ML期刊的近期出版物进行了实证分析，检验合成数据在隐私敏感场景中的使用情况，特别是检查论文是否明确阐述了威胁模型、推断风险或可证伪的隐私声明。文章采用立场论文（position paper）形式，结合经验证据来支撑其论证。

Result: 实证分析表明，合成数据经常在隐私敏感场景中用于研究，但很少对威胁模型、推断风险或可证伪的隐私声明进行明确阐述。这导致隐私保障常常是隐式的、难以验证的，并且分布不均——稀有和少数群体的记录面临更高的暴露风险。

Conclusion: 作者主张将隐私视为一种明确的、基于证据的科学主张，而非隐式的属性。他们建议ML期刊和会议采纳规范，要求与隐私相关的断言必须范围清晰、可测试且可争辩，从而推动社区标准向更严格、更可验证的隐私实践转变。

Abstract: Synthetic data has become a common component of machine learning research. While widely adopted, its use in privacy-sensitive contexts has quietly shifted from a claim of residual inference risk under stated assumptions to an appearance-based property inferred from data generation itself. In this position paper, we argue that this shift reflects an implicit change in community standards for what counts as sufficient privacy evidence, rather than a misunderstanding of well-established privacy principles. Drawing on an empirical analysis of recent publications across major ML venues, we show that synthetic data is frequently used in privacy-sensitive settings without explicit articulation of threat models, inference risks, or falsifiable privacy claims. As a result, privacy assurance often remains implicit, difficult to verify, and unevenly distributed, with heightened exposure for rare and minority records. We argue for treating privacy as an explicit, evidence-based scientific claim and recommend that ML venues adopt norms requiring privacy-relevant assertions to be clearly scoped, testable, and contestable.

</details>


### [250] [The Constitutional Coverage Trilemma in AI Governance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01275)
*Natalija Mitic,Soona Sedahmed A. O.,Mamadou Selly Ly,Moustapha Cisse*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究将前沿AI系统视为"宪法性机构"，每个部署模型都隐式编码了安全、有用性、诚实、自主性和公平性之间的价值排序。通过对23个前沿LLM原型默认宪法进行审计，并调查1,649名美国参与者，作者发现：需求广泛但供应狭窄且发生漂移。23个原型仅覆盖需求凸包的约2%，没有任何原型将有用性或自主性放在首位（37%用户"宪法性无家可归"）。修复方案很稀疏：仅需2个顶点菜单即可比完整23原型前沿在平均遗憾上提升47%。作者将该发现形式化为"预算化多元主义三难困境"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核心动机是检验前沿AI系统所编码的价值观（供应端）是否覆盖了人类对不同价值观的偏好（需求端）。如果供应与需求之间存在系统性错配，可能导致AI系统在价值权衡上偏离用户需求，尤其对最少数群体的福利产生系统性损害。

Method: 采用双管齐下的方法：(1) 对23个前沿LLM原型的"开箱"默认宪法进行释义控制的审计，以刻画其价值排序；(2) 在相同工具上对1,649名美国参与者进行两两权衡研究，刻画人类需求端的价值偏好分布。结合两者构建需求/供应的凸包，并测试在噪声匹配与全审计精度下的覆盖情况。通过顶点数量和后悔值衡量不同修复方案的效率。

Result: 三个主要发现：(1) 需求广泛——跨五个价值观分布，最大群体不足三分之一；(2) 供应狭窄且漂移——23原型凸包仅占需求凸包的2%（全精度下0.10%），无原型将有用性或自主性优先，37%用户"宪法性无家可归"，且模型版本更新趋势为自主性下降（5/6家族）、公平性上升（5/6）、安全性上升（4/6），方向性漂移远离已覆盖不足的价值；3) 修复稀疏——2顶点菜单优于完整23原型前沿47%（CI [43%,52%]），三个顶点添加可将平均/最差群体遗憾降低至多81%/64%。结论对基于距离的福利与降级路由均稳健。

Conclusion: AI系统的价值供应与人类需求存在显著的、方向性的错配，而这种结构性缺陷可以通过极稀疏的"价值顶点菜单"修复。作者将其形式化为预算化多元主义三难困境，并证明该约束在经验上是真实存在的，而非理论假设。这为AI治理中如何设计多元化的模型价值配置提供了经验基础和政策启示。

Abstract: Frontier AI systems function as \emph{constitutional institutions}: each deployed model encodes an implicit ranking among safety, helpfulness, honesty, autonomy, and equity. We ask whether the supply of frontier constitutional types covers human demand. Combining a paraphrase-controlled audit of the as-shipped default constitutions of $23$ frontier LLM archetypes with a pairwise-tradeoff study of $1{,}649$ US participants on the same instrument, we report three facts. \emph{Demand is broad}: it spans all five values, with the largest constituency under one-third. \emph{Supply is narrow and drifting}: the $23$-archetype hull occupies ${\sim}2\%$ of the demand hull under conservative noise-matched estimation ($0.10\%$ at full audit precision), no archetype puts helpfulness or autonomy first ($37\%$ of users are constitutionally homeless), and across six model families autonomy decreases in $5/6$, equity increases in $5/6$, and safety increases in $4/6$, with monotone within-family version trends (order-permutation $p = 0.013$) and the autonomy decline concentrated in scenarios where safety is not at stake. The drift's importance is directional: \emph{away} from a value already undercovered, mechanically worsening the welfare floor for the least-served users. \emph{The fix is sparse}: a $2$-vertex menu $\{e_{\mathrm{HON}}, e_{\mathrm{AUT}}\}$ beats the full $23$-archetype frontier by $47\%$ on mean regret (CI $[43\%, 52\%]$); three vertex additions cut mean/worst-group regret by up to $81\%$/$64\%$. We formalize these findings as a budgeted-pluralism trilemma, show the binding regime is empirically realized, and verify the conclusions are robust to distance-based welfare and to degraded routing. The instrument and audit harness are described in full in the appendices.

</details>


### [251] [Bandits in Prod: Hyperparameter Optimization at Inference Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01335)
*Louis Abraham,Tuan-Anh Nguyen,Nicolas Devatine*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了在线超参数优化（OHPO）这一形式化框架，用于处理只能通过线上请求和噪声反馈评估配置的生产系统（如agentic系统）。作者引入IMABO框架，将任意bandit策略与任意提议oracle结合，并实例化IMOSS策略，证明了期望累积分位数遗憾界。结合三种实用oracle（TPE、基于逐维度bandit的变异oracle、预训练表格基础模型），IMABO在多种OHPO场景中取得最低累积遗憾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多生产系统只能通过线上实时请求评估配置并观察噪声反馈，尤其是现代agentic系统（涉及模型选择、检索深度、提示策略、解码温度等推理时选择），且往往没有代表性验证数据。现有超参数优化方法依赖离线验证集，无法适用于这种缺乏验证数据的在线场景，因此需要形式化该问题并提出专门框架。

Method: 将OHPO形式化为混合与条件搜索空间上的无限多臂老虎机问题。提出IMABO通用框架，该框架将任意bandit策略（选择已采样配置）与任意oracle（提议新配置）解耦组合。实例化为IMOSS，一种无重启的任意时间策略，其活跃集以t^β速率增长，β∈(0,1)。构建三种实际oracle：树结构Parzen估计器（TPE）、由逐坐标bandit驱动的现有最优解变异oracle，以及预训练表格基础模型。

Result: 证明了IMOSS的期望累积分位数遗憾界为O(p_ρ^{-1/β} + T^{(1+β)/2})，其中p_ρ是提议配置落入搜索空间前ρ分位数的概率下界。三种oracle均优于均匀随机oracle基线。IMABO在多种OHPO设置中（从经典机器学习模型调参到LLM-based agent配置）获得最低累积遗憾。

Conclusion: IMABO提供了一个通用且理论有保障的OHPO框架，成功将bandit策略与配置提议oracle解耦，证明了在无验证数据的在线噪声反馈场景下进行高效超参数优化的可行性，并为agentic系统等生产环境的自适应配置优化提供了实用解决方案。

Abstract: Many production systems can assess a configuration only by using it on live requests and observing noisy feedback. Modern agentic systems are a prominent example, with inference-time choices such as model selection, retrieval depth, prompting strategy, and decoding temperature, yet often with no representative validation data. We formalize this setting as Online Hyperparameter Optimization (OHPO) and cast it as an infinitely many-armed bandit over mixed and conditional search spaces. We introduce IMABO, a general framework that combines any bandit policy for choosing among already sampled configurations with any oracle for proposing new ones. We instantiate it with IMOSS, a restart-free anytime policy whose active set grows as $t^β$, and prove an expected cumulative quantile-regret bound of $O(p_ρ^{-1/β} + T^{(1+β)/2})$, where $β\in(0,1)$ controls active-set growth and $p_ρ$ lower-bounds the probability that a proposed configuration falls in the top-$ρ$ fraction of the search space. We combine IMOSS with three practical oracles: a Tree-structured Parzen Estimator, an incumbent-mutation oracle driven by a per-coordinate bandit, and a pretrained tabular foundation model, all three improving over the uniform random oracle baseline. IMABO obtains the lowest cumulative regret across diverse OHPO settings, from tuning classical machine-learning models to configuring LLM-based agents.

</details>


### [252] [SMELT: Scaling Laws for Compute-Matched MoE Looped Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01343)
*Shaowen Wang,Ge Zhang,Kairong Luo,Yuhao Wu,Shaofan Liu,Jiaheng Liu,Wenhao Huang,Shen Yan,Jian Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了SMELT（Sparse MoE Transformer, middle layers Loop Twice）方法，在MoE Transformer中循环中间一半的层两次，同时严格匹配非循环基线的每token FLOPs、总非嵌入参数和KV cache预算。在高达54B非嵌入参数的规模上，SMELT比基线节省6.8-18.0%的训练FLOPs，且优势能迁移到下游基准任务，尤其在代码任务上效果显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环Transformer通过迭代共享层块来增加有效深度，但以往评估多在固定模型大小下比较，混淆了架构优势与额外FLOPs带来的收益。作者希望在严格匹配计算预算的前提下，公平评估循环架构是否真正优于非循环架构。

Method: 通过一系列消融实验确定最佳方案：在中MoE Transformer的中间一半层上循环两次（SMELT），同时严格匹配三个预算指标：per-token FLOPs、总非嵌入参数和KV cache。在四个规模（最高54B非嵌入参数）上训练，并为每种架构分别拟合Chinchilla风格的缩放定律，结合机制分析（注意力汇/attention sink）解释性能来源。

Result: SMELT的损失随计算量下降更快，在计算最优前沿上节省6.8-18.0%的训练FLOPs。该优势可迁移到下游基准（超出验证损失的预测），在代码任务上最大，且随样本长度和上下文示例数量增长而增强。机制分析表明第二次访问减少了注意力汇，并将注意力质量导向内容相关token。

Conclusion: 即使在严格的预算匹配下，循环仍能提升Transformer性能。深度复用（depth reuse）是一种实用的策略，可在不增加预算的情况下带来可衡量的收益。注意力从sink token向内容token的重新分配可能是收益背后的归纳偏置。

Abstract: Looped Transformers increase effective depth by iterating a shared block of layers, but most evaluations compare at fixed model size, conflating architectural advantage with extra FLOPs. We study looping on Mixture-of-Experts Transformers while closely matching per-token FLOPs, total non-embedding parameters, and KV cache. Through a series of ablations, we arrive at a recipe we call SMELT (Sparse MoE Transformer, middle layers Loop Twice), which loops the middle half of layers twice while matching the unlooped Baseline on all three budgets. We scale SMELT across four sizes up to 54B non-embedding parameters and fit a separate Chinchilla-style scaling law for each architecture. SMELT's loss drops faster with compute, saving 6.8--18.0\% of training FLOPs on the compute-optimal frontier. The advantage transfers to downstream benchmarks beyond what validation loss predicts, is largest on Code, and grows with sample length and the number of in-context examples. Mechanistic analysis shows that the second visit reduces the attention sink and redirects mass toward content-relevant tokens, an inductive bias that may underlie the observed performance gains. These results show that looping can improve Transformers even under budget matching, offering a practical recipe that turns depth reuse into measurable gains.

</details>


### [253] [Contribution-Aware Bandwidth Allocation for Multimodal Split Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01406)
*Iason Ofeidis,Leandros Tassiulas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ModalShare，一种跨模态分配机制，在分割学习中根据各模态对融合预测的贡献（基于Shapley值）动态分配上行压缩预算，替代传统等比例分配方式。在固定传输预算下，ModalShare在5倍压缩时相较等量压缩比在CREMA-D和MVSA上分别提升15.4和12.4个百分点准确率，且无需额外上行流量或客户端计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态模型越来越多地部署在网络边缘，但训练几乎全在数据中心进行。分割学习允许客户端仅保留模型首层进行训练，但代价是每个模态的smashed activations每步都需要上行传输。现有压缩方案给每个模态相同的保留率，导致共享预算按激活维度比例分配，而这个比例与各模态对融合预测的实际贡献无关，造成预算浪费。因此需要显式地根据模态贡献进行跨模态分配。

Method: ModalShare的核心是跨模态预算分配器：在固定上行链路预算下，服务器基于已接收的激活coalitions计算每个模态的Shapley贡献分数，据此设定每个模态的keep-ratio。该分数计算不增加上行流量、不需要客户端计算，也不需事先知道哪个流的语义。每个策略在相同预算下传输相同期望负载，仅在不同模态间的分配方式上有差异。

Result: 在5倍压缩下的匹配负载设置中，ModalShare相较等量保留率在CREMA-D上提升15.4个百分点、在MVSA上提升12.4个百分点准确率。在三个压缩器、三个数据集和四个预算设置下均表现强劲。实验还表明现有压缩器在多模态场景下表现不佳，ModalShare能够恢复这些被浪费的增益。

Conclusion: 跨模态分配是多模态分割学习中一个重要的且被忽视的维度。通过将各模态的keep-ratio作为显式决策，并基于Shapley贡献进行分配，ModalShare在零额外开销的前提下显著超越了传统的等比例分配方案，展示了此类分配决策对多模态边缘训练效率的关键作用。

Abstract: Multimodal models are increasingly the default option for perception at the network edge, yet they are trained almost entirely in the datacenter, because a client holding several sensor streams cannot host an encoder per modality. Split Learning makes such training feasible by keeping only the first layers on the device, at the cost of an uplink that must carry smashed activations for every modality at every step. Existing compression schemes give each modality the same keep-ratio, so the shared budget is divided in proportion to smashed-activation dimension, a quantity unrelated to how much each modality contributes to the fused prediction. We make that division an explicit decision and call it inter-modality allocation: under a fixed uplink budget, every policy transmits the same expected payload and differs only in how that payload is split across modalities. Our allocator, ModalShare, sets each modality's keep-ratio from a Shapley contribution score that the server computes over coalitions of activations it has already received. Measuring this score adds no uplink traffic and no client-side computation, and needs no prior knowledge of which stream is which. ModalShare improves accuracy over equal keep-ratios by 15.4 and 12.4 percentage points on CREMA-D and MVSA at matched payload in 5x compression, with strong performance across three compressors, three datasets, and four budgets. We show that existing compressors underperform in multimodal settings, with ModalShare recovering what gains are left behind.

</details>


### [254] [Predicting Subsurface Abnormalities Growth using Physics-Informed Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01417)
*Mehrdad Shafiei Dizaji,Hoda Azari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种融合物理信息神经网络（PINNs）的探地雷达（GPR）数据预测框架，通过将电磁波传播的物理规律嵌入深度学习架构中，实现高精度的GPR数据预测，从而提升桥梁桥面状况评估等土木基础设施无损检测的准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的GPR数据预测方法缺乏对地下结构物理规律的深入建模，导致预测精度有限。作者借鉴医学成像中预测肿瘤行为的方式，希望通过将物理定律与深度学习结合，增强基础设施劣化预测的准确性，并深入理解劣化的基本机制。

Method: 提出一个由三个组件构成的深度学习架构：1) CNN用于视觉特征提取；2) 空间特征通道注意力（SFCA）机制，通过自适应的通道注意力权重计算来微调视觉特征响应；3) ConvLSTM配合时间特征帧注意力（TFFA）模块，通过自适应的时序注意力权重提取最相关的时间特征。模型将电磁波传播的物理规律直接嵌入网络结构中，确保预测结果符合基本物理原理。

Result: 实验表明，将物理规律直接集成到神经网络中后，模型在预测GPR数据方面展现出更高的准确性，该改进对于桥梁桥面状况评估及其他土木基础设施评价至关重要。

Conclusion: PINNs在无损评估（NDE）领域具有变革潜力，不仅提升了基础设施劣化预测的精度，还通过物理模型的视角提供了对劣化基本机制的更深入理解。

Abstract: The research explores the pioneering integration of Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) into the domain of Ground-Penetrating Radar (GPR) data prediction. This research presents a detailed development framework for a specialized PINN model, proficient at interpreting and forecasting GPR data, much like how medical imaging models predict tumor behavior. By harnessing the synergy between deep learning algorithms and the physical laws governing subsurface structures or in medical terms, human tissues the model effectively embeds the physics of electromagnetic wave propagation into its architecture. This ensures that predictions not only align with fundamental physical principles but also mirror the precision needed in medical diagnostics for detecting and monitoring tumors. The suggested deep learning structure comprises three components: a CNN, a spatial feature channel attention (SFCA) mechanism, and ConvLSTM, along with temporal feature frame attention (TFFA) modules. The attention mechanism computes channel attention and temporal attention weights using self-adaptation, thereby fine tuning the visual and temporal feature responses to extract the most pertinent and significant visual and temporal features. By integrating physics directly into the neural network, our model has shown enhanced accuracy in forecasting GPR data. This improvement is vital for conducting effective assessments of bridge deck conditions and other evaluations related to civil infrastructure. The use of Physics Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) has demonstrated the potential to transform the field of Non-Destructive Evaluation (NDE) by enhancing the precision of infrastructure deterioration predictions. Moreover, it offers a deeper insight into the fundamental mechanisms of deterioration, viewed through the prism of physics-based models.

</details>


### [255] [Provably Safe Sim-to-Real Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01418)
*Tingting Ni,Maryam Kamgarpour*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究安全模拟器到现实（sim-to-real）迁移问题，在奖励无关安全强化学习框架下设计了一种计算高效的算法，利用不完美的模拟器信息来减少真实世界的交互次数，同时保证安全探索并能为任意潜在奖励函数计算近似最优的可行策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接进行sim-to-real迁移可能因模拟器与现实环境不匹配而失败，而纠正这种不匹配需要从真实系统收集数据，但该过程本身受安全约束（如机器人、医疗领域）。因此需要在利用不完美模拟器的同时，确保真实世界数据收集的安全性，并学习近似最优可行策略。

Method: 将安全sim-to-real迁移问题形式化为奖励无关安全强化学习（reward-free safe RL）框架，设计了一个计算高效的算法，该算法能够利用模拟器信息来显著减少真实世界的交互次数，同时保证安全探索，并能针对任意潜在奖励函数计算出近似最优可行策略。

Result: 文中给出了真实世界样本复杂度界，该界以sim-to-real不匹配程度来刻画使用模拟器带来的收益。证明了该算法能通过模拟器信息减少真实环境交互需求，同时保持安全性与近似最优性。

Conclusion: 该工作为安全sim-to-real迁移提供了理论保障，明确了模拟器在减少真实世界样本需求方面的价值取决于模拟器与现实环境之间的不匹配程度，为存在安全约束的实际应用（如机器人和医疗）提供了可行的解决方案。

Abstract: To mitigate the sample complexity of real-world reinforcement learning (RL), a common practice is to first train a policy in a simulator, where samples are cheap, and then deploy the learned policy in the real world with the hope that it generalizes effectively. Such direct sim-to-real transfer is not guaranteed to succeed: simulator-trained policies can be suboptimal in the real world due to sim-to-real mismatch. Correcting this mismatch requires collecting data from the real system, but in many applications, such as robotics and healthcare, this data-collection process is itself subject to safety constraints. This gives rise to the problem of safe sim-to-real transfer: how can an agent exploit an imperfect simulator while ensuring safe real-world data collection and learning a near-optimal feasible policy for the target system? We address this problem by formulating safe sim-to-real transfer within the framework of reward-free safe RL. We design a computationally efficient algorithm that exploits simulator information to provably reduce real-world interaction while ensuring safe exploration and enabling the computation of a near-optimal feasible policy for any potential reward function. Our real-world sample complexity bound characterizes the benefit of using the simulator in terms of the sim-to-real mismatch.

</details>


### [256] [CATeye: Coupled Attribute-Topology Invariance Learning for Voucher Abuse Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01425)
*Tian Tian,Shuaicheng Niu,Hao Kuang,Yuanhang Hu,Dong Li,Zhiqi Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CATeye框架，用于解决电商促销券滥用检测中由属性-拓扑耦合分布偏移导致模型退化的问题。通过属性不变性选择器(AIS)和边不变性选择器(EIS)分别过滤非不变属性和非不变边，构建多个视图进行域不变表示学习，在Lazada私有数据集和公开基准上相比九个强基线实现最高8.61%的F1提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电商优惠券滥用检测面临两大挑战：欺诈模式随时间与地域快速演变导致分布偏移；属性偏移会通过属性近邻构建的边传播放大到图拓扑结构中，形成耦合的属性-拓扑偏移，使现有检测模型性能快速退化。

Method: 提出CATeye框架，包含两个可学习选择器：(1)属性不变性选择器(AIS)学习节点自适应掩码以过滤非不变属性；(2)边不变性选择器(EIS)基于保留的不变属性采样不变子图并隔离非不变边。利用得到的不变与非不变组件构建多视图，采用视图特定目标函数以强化域不变表示并抑制域特定变化。

Result: 在Lazala（东南亚主要电商平台）私有数据集和公开基准上，CATeye一致优于九个强领域泛化和图异常检测基线，相比最强基线平均F1分数提升最高达8.61%。

Conclusion: CATeye通过解耦属性偏移与拓扑偏移的耦合效应来有效缓解分布偏移，为电商风控场景下的图神经网络检测提供了更具鲁棒性的解决方案，且源代码已公开。

Abstract: Voucher abuse poses a major challenge in e-commerce, where malicious users exploit promotional vouchers for profit. Unfortunately, fraud patterns evolve rapidly over time and across regions, causing distribution shifts that degrade existing detection models unless retrained frequently. To tackle this, we propose the Coupled Attribute-Topology Invariance Learning framework (CATeye). The key challenge arises from coupled attribute-topology shift, where edges built from attribute proximity cause environment-driven attribute shift to induce shifted topology, thereby amplifying variant signals through GNN message passing. CATeye sees through such coupled shifts with two learnable selectors. First, an Attribute Invariance Selector (AIS) learns node-adaptive masks to filter out non-invariant attributes. Then, conditioned on retained invariant attributes, an Edge Invariance Selector (EIS) samples an invariant subgraph and isolates non-invariant edges. Using the resulting invariant and non-invariant components, CATeye constructs multiple views and applies view-specific objectives to emphasize domain-invariant representations while suppressing domain-specific variations. Experiments on both a proprietary dataset from Lazada, a major Southeast Asian e-commerce platform, and a public benchmark show that CATeye consistently outperforms nine strong domain generalization and graph anomaly detection baselines, achieving up to an 8.61% improvement in average F1 score over the strongest baseline. Source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Tian0426/CATeye.

</details>


### [257] [TRIAGE: Three-level Routing and Intelligent Agent Guidance for Efficient Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01428)
*Ruocan Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TRIAGE三级路由框架，通过将历史执行轨迹抽象为可复用技能（TaaS），在查询层面实现0 token直接复用、技能替换和完整ReAct三级分流，在安全监控和工具基准上分别节省62.3%和76.3%的token消耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ReAct范式的LLM智能体存在根本性效率问题：每次查询都从零开始完整推理循环，相似查询重复执行相同步骤，无法利用历史经验，导致token消耗巨大。

Method: 提出TRIAGE三级路由框架：(1) Direct Reuse层——完全相同查询直接复用历史轨迹，0 token；(2) Skill Substitution层——相似查询通过确定性参数替换复用技能，0 token；(3) Full ReAct层——全新查询完整推理并自动存储供未来复用。核心创新TaaS将历史轨迹抽象为可复用技能，并有自动技能提取机制将高频轨迹模式蒸馏为确定性技能。

Result: 在1007条安全监控查询上节省62.3% token，其中56.0%为L2、5.5%为L1零成本执行；在ToolBench 15个领域345条查询上实现76.3% token削减。在线学习实验显示L2命中率从0%提升到前100次查询的57%，平均token成本从198降至74.7。

Conclusion: 通过TRIAGE框架验证了基于语义路由的历史轨迹复用机制能显著降低LLM智能体的token消耗，"越用越高效"的正反馈循环逻辑成立，且具备跨领域泛化能力。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents based on the ReAct paradigm have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in tool use and task execution. However, ReAct suffers from a fundamental efficiency problem: every query triggers a complete reasoning loop from scratch, and similar queries repeat identical steps without leveraging historical experience. We propose TRIAGE,a three-level routing framework that reduces token consumption by reusing historical execution trajectories. Its core innovation is TaaS (Trajectory-as-a-Skill), which abstracts historical execution trajectories into reusable skills, realizing 'experience as a service'. TRIAGE classifies queries into three levels: (1) Direct Reuse-identical queries, 0 tokens; (2) Skill Substitution-similar queries, 0 tokens via deterministic parameter substitution; (3) Full ReAct-novel queries, automatically stored for future reuse. In large-scale experiments on 1,007 security monitoring queries, TRIAGE achieves 62.3% token savings, with 56.0% of queries at Level 2 and 5.5% at Level 1, both executing at zero cost. Cross-domain validation on ToolBench (15 domains, 345 queries) achieves 76.3% token reduction, confirming the generalizability of semantic routing. An online learning experiment demonstrates cold-start-to-mature evolution: the L2 hit rate rises from 0% to 57% within the first 100 queries, and the average token cost drops from 198 to 74.7. We also propose an automatic Skill extraction mechanism that distills high-frequency trajectory patterns into deterministic Skills, creating a positive feedback loop of 'the more you use it, the more efficient it becomes'.

</details>


### [258] [Learning Sparse Decision Trees via Transformer Variational Auto-Encoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01430)
*Giacomo Fidone,Alessio Cascione,Riccardo Guidotti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TREVIS是一种基于Tree Transformer变分自编码器（TTVAE）潜在空间探索的决策树学习方法，通过将离散的决策树搜索空间映射为连续空间，利用可微代理模型进行梯度优化，从而同时优化预测性能和结构稀疏性等多个目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有决策树学习算法主要关注预测性能，忽视了结构稀疏性等其他理想属性的联合优化，而这些属性在高风险决策场景中同样重要。

Method: 提出TTVAE将决策树映射到潜在连续表示，将原本离散的树搜索空间替换为连续空间，通过可微分的代理模型实现基于梯度的优化。

Result: TREVIS能够发现与现有近最优算法预测性能相当的决策树，同时改善了树的结构稀疏性。

Conclusion: 通过将决策树学习转化为连续潜在空间的优化问题，TREVIS有效实现了预测性能与结构稀疏性的联合优化。

Abstract: Decision trees are among the most widely used models in machine learning, largely due to their transparent decision logic, making them well-suited for high-stakes decision-making contexts. However, most existing learning algorithms focus on predictive performance, overlooking the joint optimization of other desirable properties, such as structural sparsity. In this work we propose TREVIS, an approach for learning decision trees with respect to complex objectives, based on the exploration of the latent space of a Tree Transformer Variational Auto-Encoder (TTVAE). By mapping decision trees onto latent representations, TREVIS replaces the discrete search space with a continuous one, enabling gradient-based optimization via a differentiable surrogate model. We experiment with TREVIS for learning decision trees that jointly optimize predictive performance and sparsity. Results show that TREVIS discovers decision trees matching the predictive performance of existing near-optimal algorithms while improving their structural sparsity.

</details>


### [259] [Efficiently Estimating Optimal Hyperparameter Scaling Laws through Power-Law Entropy Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01431)
*Zhiliang Chen,Sebastian Ament,David Eriksson,Maximilian Balandat,Eytan Bakshy,Jihao Andreas Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Power-Law Entropy Search (PLES)，一种基于多保真贝叶斯优化的计算成本感知采集函数，通过自适应实验高效估计大语言模型训练的最优超参数缩放定律，在不到传统网格搜索十分之一的计算预算下即可收敛到准确的缩放定律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 估计最优超参数缩放定律传统上需要对数千次训练运行进行穷举网格搜索，消耗巨大的计算资源。缺乏一种高效方法能够在可负担的计算成本下准确预测大规模生产配置下的最优超参数。

Method: PLES构建在多保真贝叶斯优化框架之上，核心创新在于其采集函数不是优化单一目标函数，而是搜索能最大程度降低缩放定律估计整体不确定性的候选配置。每一轮迭代中，PLES选择每单位计算成本下能最大程度减少缩放定律估计不确定性的候选配置，从而自然偏向信息量大的小规模实验。

Result: 在合成基准、拟合真实LLM训练数据的代理模型以及实际LLM预训练运行的三类设置中，PLES均以不到传统网格搜索和其他基线方法十分之一的计算预算收敛到准确的最优超参数缩放定律。

Conclusion: PLES证明了通过不确定性驱动的自适应实验设计，可以大幅降低估计超参数缩放定律的计算成本，使得在无大量昂贵大规模调优的情况下预测生产规模的超参数配置成为可能。

Abstract: Optimal hyperparameter scaling laws describe how the best hyperparameters for large language model (LLM) training change with model and data scale, enabling practitioners to predict optimal configurations at production scales without expensive large-scale tuning. However, estimating these scaling laws conventionally requires exhaustive grid searches over thousands of training runs, consuming enormous computational resources. We introduce Power-Law Entropy Search (PLES), a computational cost-aware acquisition function built on multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization that efficiently estimates optimal hyperparameter scaling laws through adaptive experimentation. A key innovation in PLES is that it searches for candidates that reduce the overall uncertainty of a scaling law estimate, instead of optimizing a single objective function. At each iteration, PLES selects the candidate configuration that maximally reduces the uncertainty of the scaling law estimates per unit computational cost, naturally favoring informative small-scale experiments. We evaluate PLES on synthetic benchmarks, surrogate models fitted to real LLM training data, and actual LLM pre-training runs. Across all settings, PLES converges to accurate optimal hyperparameter scaling laws using less than one-tenth of the computational budget required by conventional grid search and other baselines.

</details>


### [260] [Edge-Girth as a Structural Edge Feature for Graph Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01441)
*Lilian Marey,Charlotte Laclau*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于边-girth（经过某条边的最短环长度及数量）的图结构描述符，将其注入门控消息传递架构(EGAGNN)中，在ZINC-12k基准上测试MAE比最强门控对比模型低三倍，但存在理论局限：当图中所有边具有相同girth信息时，模型能力会退化回1-WL界限，BREC基准中90个此类图对均无法区分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统GNN受限于1-WL测试的区分能力，常见解决方法是预计算固定大小子图计数作为结构描述符，但这些方法需要预先承诺子图大小，且这种选择通常对数据是盲目的。作者希望找到一种无需预先设定大小、能报告任意长度环的描述符。

Method: 提出边-girth描述符：每条边的最短环长度及其多重性（最短环的数量），可通过每条边一次BFS精确计算。将其注入门控消息传递架构EGAGNN中，并与有界环计数描述符（字典计数至长度8或4）在相同架构下对比。

Result: 在ZINC-12k回归基准上，EGAGNN在104k参数下测试MAE比最强门控对比模型低三倍；与有界环计数描述符相比，仅匹配计数至长度8且通道数翻倍的字典性能，而长度4的字典计数效果不比无结构信息好。在BREC图区分基准上，90个所有边具有相同girth信息的图对全部无法区分。

Conclusion: 边-girth描述符是一种无需预设大小、精确可算的有效结构信息，在回归任务上表现优异；但在结构对称性高的图中（所有边girth信息一致），该描述符退化为常数，模型能力坍缩回1-WL界限，证明此方法的局限性与理论边界。

Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNN) based on message passing are provably no more powerful than the one-dimensional Weisfeiler--Leman colour-refinement test (1-WL): two graphs it cannot tell apart receive identical representations, however deep or wide the network. A common remedy augments node or edge features with precomputed structural descriptors, most often counts of a fixed small subgraph such as triangles or longer cycles, but such counts require committing in advance to the size of the substructure counted, a choice usually made blind to the data. We study a descriptor that avoids this choice. The edge-girth of an edge is the length of a shortest cycle through it, and its multiplicity is the number of such shortest cycles; together they form a per-edge invariant that reports cycles of arbitrary length, computable exactly by a single breadth-first search per edge. Injected into a gated message-passing architecture, EGAGNN, it reaches a test MAE a factor three below the closest gated comparator on the ZINC-12k regression benchmark at 104k parameters; against bounded cycle-counting descriptors under the same architecture, it matches only a dictionary counting cycles up to length eight, using twice as many channels, while a dictionary capped at length four performs no better than no structural information at all. On graph discrimination we prove a matching limitation: on graphs where every edge sees the same number of shortest cycles of the same length, the descriptor becomes constant and any model built on it collapses back to the 1-WL bound. This holds without exception across all 400 pairs of the BREC benchmark: not one of the 90 such pairs is distinguished.

</details>


### [261] [Diffusion as a Training Curriculum for Timestep-Free Iterative Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01449)
*Mariia Drozdova,Aidan Sirbu,Pietro Miotti,Robert Obryk,Mayalen Etcheverry,Eyvind Niklasson,Blake Richards*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种将扩散模型与递归推理结合的任意时间求解器：在扩散去噪器中加入持久隐藏状态并移除时间步条件，共享更新可任意深度运行。即使推理时保持最大噪声并以新鲜高斯噪声替代非线索变量，仍能在Sudoku-Extreme达到99.90%精确求解率、Maze-Unique达到98.93%求解率，表明扩散的主要贡献是去噪训练课程而非推理采样过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型与递归推理器都是迭代过程，但二者在迭代间传递信息的方式不同。作者希望探究如何将扩散模型的迭代特性转化为可任意深度推理的求解器，并理解扩散过程在其中的真正作用。

Method: 在扩散去噪器中加入持久隐藏状态，并移除时间步条件，形成一个单一的共享更新，可运行至任意深度。训练时保持有序退火损坏（annealed corruption），推理时则可在最大噪声条件下通过新鲜高斯噪声注入进行迭代求解。

Result: Sudoku-Extreme达到99.90%精确求解率，Maze-Unique达到98.93%求解率。推理深度远超训练时的展开长度和反向传播窗口仍能持续提升精度。推理时保持最大噪声并注入新噪声仍保持近完美求解并收敛到稳定解，无需并行rollout、候选选择或外部验证器。

Conclusion: 扩散模型在此任意时间求解器中的主要贡献并非推理时的采样过程，而是其去噪训练课程。这种简单的噪声注入机制使单个轨迹就能高效探索解空间并收敛到正确答案，绕过了先前推理模型所需的复杂机制。

Abstract: Diffusion models and recursive reasoners are both iterative, but they carry information across iterations differently. We add a persistent hidden state to a diffusion denoiser and remove its timestep conditioning, leaving a single shared update that can be run to arbitrary depth. The result is an anytime solver: accuracy keeps improving with inference depth far beyond the rollout lengths and backpropagation window used in training, reaching 99.90% exact solve on Sudoku-Extreme. We also obtain 98.93% solve rate on Maze-Unique. Surprisingly, progressive denoising is unnecessary at inference: holding corruption at its maximum by replacing every non-clue variable with fresh Gaussian noise at each step retains near-perfect solving and converges to stable solutions. This simple noise-injection mechanism enables a single trajectory to efficiently explore the solution space and settle on the correct answer without parallel rollouts, candidate selection, or external verifiers required by prior reasoning models. Nonetheless, ordered annealed corruption remains critical during training, which suggests that diffusion's primary contribution to our anytime solver is not a sampling procedure at inference, but a denoising training curriculum.

</details>


### [262] [Rethinking Learnability in Offline Data-driven Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01493)
*Chao Qian,Chen-Guang Wang,Rong-Xi Tan,Ke Xue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对离线黑箱优化提出算法相关的可学习性概念，并据此提出UGTL方法，在五个Design-Bench任务上取得了最优的聚合平均排名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线数据驱动优化仅依赖固定历史数据寻找高质量解，但此前理论上表明PAC可学习性不足（最优区域可能未被充分学习）。作者希望探究离线优化所需的最小可学习性条件，并据此指导设计更有效的方法。

Method: 提出算法依赖的可学习性概念：只需在优化器轨迹上保证准确性。证明了值查询形式足以支撑子模最大化的贪心与局部搜索；一阶导数形式足以支撑凸最小化的投影梯度下降。据此形式化轨迹学习框架（轨迹构建、轨迹建模、候选生成），并提出UGTL方法：用不确定性感知的梯度引导构建局部一致的改进轨迹，以条件扩散建模，再选择多样化候选集。

Result: 在五个Design-Bench任务上，UGTL在25种方法中取得了最佳聚合平均排名3.1/25。受控轨迹分析与跨架构替换实验证实轨迹构建对性能提升有显著贡献。

Conclusion: 算法依赖的轨迹级可学习性是离线优化的充分条件，这为理解离线数据驱动优化的理论特性提供了新视角，同时UGTL作为该理论驱动的方法在实验中取得了领先性能。

Abstract: Black-Box Optimization (BBO) has found broad applications, but evolutionary algorithms and Bayesian optimization face efficiency challenges as real-world BBO problems grow increasingly complex. Data-driven optimization improves the efficiency of BBO algorithms by learning from data. Offline data-driven optimization seeks high-quality solutions using only a fixed set of previous evaluations, attracting substantial attention because it requires no additional online evaluations. Many offline optimization methods have been proposed, but a fundamental question remains unanswered: what learnability is sufficient for offline optimization? Prior theoretical studies show that Probably Approximately Correct (PAC) learnability is insufficient, as the optimal region may remain poorly learned even when most regions are well learned. In this paper, we propose algorithm-dependent learnability, which requires accuracy only on the optimizer's trajectory. We prove that its value-query form is sufficient for representative discrete settings, including greedy and local search for submodular maximization, while its first-order analogue is sufficient for projected gradient descent on convex minimization. Motivated by this notion, we formalize a trajectory-learning framework comprising trajectory construction, trajectory modeling, and candidate generation, and analyze existing trajectory-based methods under it. We further propose Uncertainty-aware Gradient-guided Trajectory Learning (UGTL), which constructs locally coherent improvement trajectories reflecting plausible search paths, models them with conditional diffusion, and selects a diverse candidate set. On five Design-Bench tasks, UGTL achieves the best aggregate mean rank, $3.1/25$, among 25 methods. Controlled trajectory analyses and cross-architecture replacements confirm that our trajectory construction plays a significant role in the improvement.

</details>


### [263] [Optimizing Byzantine Node Placement in Decentralized Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01495)
*Edoardo Gabrielli,Gabriele Tolomei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究去中心化联邦学习（DFL）中拜占庭节点的放置问题。作者提出将拜占庭节点放置视为攻击者的显式对抗决策，并引入拜占庭放置影响力（BPI）这一基于实际八卦传播动力学的集合级度量，量化拜占庭源对诚实节点的累积暴露。通过高效优化算法，在六类异质图、无目标模型投毒和后门攻击下验证，BPI指导的放置策略能持续识别高破坏性配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有DFL安全评估主要关注拜占庭参与者如何行为（如投毒策略），却忽略了哪些参与者被攻击者攻陷。由于聚合分布在通信图上，拜占庭节点的位置决定了恶意影响如何在网络中传播，这是一个被严重低估的关键维度。

Method: 1) 将拜占庭放置形式化为攻击者在固定预算下的节点集合选择优化问题；2) 提出BPI度量，基于八卦动力学推导诚实节点对拜占庭源的累积暴露；3) 开发高效优化BPI的算法；4) 在多种图结构和攻击场景下进行系统性评估。

Result: BPI指导的放置策略在不同网络结构下始终能识别高破坏性配置，且在放宽线性八卦假设（使用拜占庭鲁棒聚合）时仍然有效。表明基于中心性启发式的放置准则不够充分，BPI能更好捕获加权多跳传播和节点间交互效应。

Conclusion: 拜占庭节点放置是DFL威胁模型与鲁棒性评估中被低估但至关重要的维度，BPI为系统化评估该维度提供了有效工具。
