Abstract: Security evaluations of decentralized federated learning (DFL) typically focus on how Byzantine participants behave, while largely overlooking which participants are compromised. Yet, because aggregation is distributed over a communication graph, the placement of Byzantine nodes determines how malicious influence propagates through the network. We therefore treat Byzantine placement as an explicit adversarial decision and formulate the attacker's objective as selecting, under a fixed compromise budget, the set of participants that maximizes its finite-time impact on honest nodes. To approximate this objective without executing the learning process for every candidate placement, we introduce Byzantine Placement Influence (BPI), a set-level measure derived from the actual gossip dynamics that quantifies the cumulative exposure of honest nodes to Byzantine sources over the training horizon. Unlike placement criteria based on node centrality heuristics, BPI directly accounts for weighted multi-hop propagation and interactions among compromised nodes. We develop efficient algorithms for optimizing BPI and evaluate them across six heterogeneous graph families, untargeted model poisoning, and backdoor attacks. BPI-guided placements consistently identify highly damaging configurations across different network structures and remain effective when the linear gossip assumption is relaxed through Byzantine-robust aggregation. Our results show that Byzantine placement is a critical but under-modeled dimension of DFL threat models and robustness evaluations.

</details>


### [264] [LatentPress: Context Compression Beyond Text and Vision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01507)
*Zhengze Zhou,Hejian Sang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出LatentPress，将对话历史和长文档压缩为连续记忆token（soft tokens），使冻结的decoder可直接通过输入嵌入接口读取，无需在推理时重建文本。小型writer以4-16倍压缩率训练适配器（约占decoder参数的0.1%），在LongMemEval上达到0.504准确率（7.70倍压缩），超越未压缩证据（0.490）、文本摘要（0.184）和OCR压缩；在LongBench-QA上4-8倍压缩可匹敌或超越原始上下文阅读。写入速度快约一个数量级，读取速度提升5-9倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统压缩上下文采用人类可读文本或渲染图像形式，即使消费方是语言模型也需要解码（文本重建或OCR）。这引入了不必要的计算开销和性能瓶颈。作者希望探索一种面向语言模型本身的第三种表示——连续记忆token，使解码器能直接读取压缩信息，无需中间重建过程。

Method: LatentPress采用一个与解码器匹配的小型writer网络，将对话历史或长文档压缩为连续的记忆token（memory tokens）。该writer通过解码器的输入嵌入接口直接训练，仅训练适配器参数（4.2M-26.2M，约为decoder的0.1%），decoder本身保持冻结。推理时无文本重建，读取通过输入嵌入接口直接进行。在训练/推理过程中实现了4-16倍的上下文压缩。

Result: 在LongMemEval上，LatentPress在7.70倍压缩下达到0.504准确率，优于未压缩证据（0.490）、文本摘要（0.184）和OCR压缩（0.426-0.312）。在LongBench-QA上，4-8倍压缩时域内writer匹敌或超越原始上下文阅读，16倍压缩略逊。写入每条对话耗时43ms（比文本摘要或OCR快约一个数量级），读取速度比原始上下文或缓存OCR快5-9倍。在两个迁移设置（UltraChat零样本到LongMemEval，LongMemEval派生QA到未见LongBench域）中验证了接口的有效性。

Conclusion: LatentPress证明了直接软token（continuous soft tokens）可以作为一种实用的机器面向上下文接口，超越文本和视觉表示，是压缩上下文的第三种可行路径。该方法的压缩质量在中等压缩率下能匹敌甚至超越原始上下文，同时显著提升读写效率，为面向LLM的高效上下文管理提供了新方向。

Abstract: Compressed context is usually carried as human-readable text or as rendered images that must be decoded, even when its consumer is a language model. We introduce LatentPress, which writes conversational histories and long documents into a third representation: continuous memory tokens that a frozen decoder reads directly through its input-embedding interface, with no text reconstruction at inference. A small reader-matched writer compresses $4$-$16\times$ while training only an adapter (4.2M-26.2M parameters, $\sim\!0.1\%$ of the decoder). On LongMemEval, LatentPress reaches $0.504$ accuracy at $7.70\times$ compression versus $0.490$ for uncompressed evidence, outperforming text summaries (0.184) and OCR-based compression (0.426 to 0.312). On LongBench-QA, in-domain writers match or exceed raw-context reading at $4$-$8\times$ compression, while $16\times$ trails raw. Writing takes 43ms per conversation, roughly an order of magnitude faster than text summarization or OCR reconstruction, and reading is $5$-$9\times$ faster than raw context or cached OCR. We validate the interface under two transfer settings, zero-shot from UltraChat to LongMemEval memory QA and from LongMemEval-derived QA to unseen LongBench document domains, establishing direct soft tokens as a practical machine-facing context interface beyond text and vision. The implementation of the experiments could be found at: https://github.com/xuyd16ai/context_softtoken_compress .

</details>


### [265] [Quantum Sparse Autoencoders for Q-Matrix Estimation in Cognitive Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01537)
*Arif Hassan Zidan,Yi Pan,Bowen Guo,Xiang Li,Yu Bao,Yingfeng Wang,Tianming Liu,Wei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次将量子机器学习应用于认知诊断中的Q矩阵估计，提出量子稀疏自编码器（QSAE）。实验表明QSAE虽在部分模拟条件下平均准确率略低于经典自编码器（CAE），但在60种条件下的49种中方差更低、稳定性更强，且在9个真实数据集的6个中表现更优，凸显了QML在此场景的主要价值在于鲁棒性和对真实数据潜在结构的探索能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Q矩阵在教育数据挖掘的认知诊断中至关重要，但数据驱动的Q矩阵估计在技能高度相关、真实响应模式偏离理想生成假设时仍具挑战性，需要更稳健的方法。

Method: 提出量子稀疏自编码器（QSAE），将学生的二值响应向量通过编码器嵌入量子电路，压缩为稀疏潜在表示后映射到Q矩阵，并与经典自编码器（CAE）进行对比基准测试。

Result: 在60个模拟数据集和9个真实数据集上，CAE在部分模拟条件下平均准确率略高，但QSAE在60种条件中的49种方差更低；真实数据上QSAE在9个数据集的6个中优于CAE。

Conclusion: 量子机器学习在此场景的主要进步并非普遍性的准确率提升，而是增强的鲁棒性以及对真实数据集潜在结构复杂性的探索能力。

Abstract: Q-matrices play a central role in cognitive diagnosis within educational data mining (EDM), specifying which latent skills each assessment item requires. Data-driven Q-matrix estimation remains challenging when assessments involve many correlated skills and when real response patterns depart from idealized generative assumptions. We introduce a novel quantum sparse autoencoder (QSAE) for Q-matrix estimation, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first application of quantum machine learning (QML) to cognitive diagnosis. Overall, the QSAE embeds each student's binary response vector into a quantum circuit using an encoder, compresses it into a sparse latent representation, and maps that representation to the Q-matrix. We benchmark the QSAE against a classical autoencoder (CAE) across 60 simulated datasets and 9 real-world assessment datasets. The results reveal complementary strengths. Although the CAE partially achieves higher average accuracy under several simulation conditions, the QSAE is substantially more stable across replications, exhibiting lower variance in 49 of the 60 conditions. Moreover, on real assessment data, the QSAE outperforms the CAE on 6 of the 9 datasets. These findings suggest that the principal advancement of QML in this setting is not universal accuracy improvement, but enhanced robustness and capability to explore latent-structure complexity in real datasets.

</details>


### [266] [NashDreamer: Model-Based Reinforcement Learning for Zero-Sum Imperfect-Information Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01549)
*Tomáš Holeček,Viliam Lisý*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出NashDreamer，一个用于两人零和博弈不完备信息游戏（IIGs）的基于模型强化学习（MBRL）框架，通过集中式多智能体循环状态空间模型（MARSSM）解耦环境动力学与对手策略的影响，在四种基准游戏中显著提升早期训练样本效率，并揭示Dreamer算法家族在随机环境中后验坍缩的脆弱性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管MBRL在单智能体领域成果显著，但在竞争性不完备信息游戏中的扩展仍未被充分探索。多智能体环境下对手引发的不平稳性使学习过程复杂化，而分散式模型学习面临严重的可识别性障碍，因此作者论证集中式模型学习在数学上是必要的。

Method: 提出NashDreamer框架：(1) 集中式Multi-Agent Recurrent State-Space Model (MARSSM)，将环境动力学与智能体策略对个体观测的影响解耦；(2) 设计上可与任意策略梯度算法兼容，并继承其在理想模型下的纳什均衡收敛保证。

Result: 在四个基准游戏中的实证评估表明，NashDreamer在训练早期相比无模型基线大幅提升了样本效率。理论分析还揭示了Dreamer家族算法在随机环境中对后验坍缩（posterior collapse）的脆弱性。

Conclusion: NashDreamer为竞争性不完备信息游戏中的MBRL提供了原则性框架，验证了集中式模型学习的必要性并展示了样本效率优势；同时指出后验坍缩问题仍是一个开放挑战。

Abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) has achieved remarkable results in single-agent domains, yet its extension to competitive imperfect information games (IIGs) remains underexplored. In multi-agent settings, opponent-induced non-stationarity complicates the learning process, and decentralized model learning faces severe identifiability barriers, which we argue make centralized model learning a mathematical necessity. Building on this analysis, we propose NashDreamer, a principled MBRL framework for two-player zero-sum IIGs. It introduces a centralized Multi-Agent Recurrent State-Space Model (MARSSM) that decouples environment dynamics from the effect of players' strategies on their individual observations. NashDreamer is designed to use arbitrary policy gradient algorithms and inherits their convergence guarantees towards Nash equilibria under an idealized model. Empirical evaluations across four benchmark games demonstrate that NashDreamer substantially improves sample efficiency over model-free baselines early in the training. Finally, we theoretically analyze the architecture's optimization landscape, identifying the vulnerability of the Dreamer family of algorithms to posterior collapse in stochastic environments. We leave it as an open challenge.

</details>


### [267] [A Mathematical Theory of Reusable Neural Bases for Network Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01550)
*Binshuai Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出线性可复用神经基座架构（LRNBA），通过将网络块表示为共享神经基座的线性组合，在相同参数预算下构建更宽更深的网络，从而大幅压缩参数并降低内存开销，同时保持稳定训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型AI模型在训练和推理中的内存成本已成为关键瓶颈，亟需提高参数效率并降低内存开销的方法。

Method: 受RNN设计启发，将每个网络块表示为共享神经基座集合的线性组合，实现高网络压缩率，同时维持训练稳定性，从而在相同参数预算下构建更宽更深的网络。

Result: 实验表明该模型相比经典架构能达到相当甚至更快的收敛速度和更低的loss，同时保持稳定的训练动态。

Conclusion: LRNBA作为一种新颖的参数高效架构，能够在不牺牲性能的前提下显著降低内存成本，为大规模AI模型提供了可行的压缩方案。

Abstract: As large AI models become increasingly prevalent across a wide range of applications, memory cost has become a critical bottleneck in both training and inference. To mitigate this issue, we introduce the Linear Reusable Neural Bases Architecture (LRNBA), a novel framework aimed at improving parameter efficiency and reducing memory cost. Inspired by recurrent neural network (RNN) designs, the core idea of our approach is to represent each network block as a linear combination of a shared set of neural bases, thereby enjoying highly network compression rate while maintaining stable training. The proposed architecture allows for the construction of significantly wider and deeper networks under the same parameter budget. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our model achieves comparable or even faster convergence and lower loss than classical architectures, while maintaining stable training dynamics.

</details>


### [268] [Retrieved but not ranked: surface-form bias in structural retrieval, from mathematics to agent trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01556)
*Nabira Rashid,Manolis Kellis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了嵌入检索在"表面形式与语义被刻意分离"场景下的表现，涵盖数学竞赛(117K语料)和具身智能体轨迹(336条)两个无关领域。结果显示：在对抗性表面变化(数学)中检索完全失败(Hit@1=0%)；在偶然性表面变化(轨迹)中检索低于随机水平。词法重排器的符号可判别表面变化是"对抗性"还是"偶然性"，LLM重排器可恢复部分差距但部分源于记忆。下游实验表明检索质量对求解器精度几乎无影响，其准确率主要是"截断代理"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有嵌入检索评估通常在表面形式与语义一致的前提下进行，未测试当两者被刻意分离时的鲁棒性。作者旨在揭示生产级嵌入模型是否真正理解任务底层结构，而非仅匹配字面词元，并通过两个无关领域的统一协议提供可复现的基准。

Method: 设计统一评估协议：(1) 数学领域用MathNet-Retrieve(117,088项语料，500查询)涵盖多种"伪装"层级；(2) 轨迹领域用ALFWorld派生的118查询/336轨迹，要求金标准包含不同物体或容器。对比三种嵌入器、词法重排器、LLM重排器，并进行210查询的下游配对实验。

Result: 数学领域最重伪装层级下Hit@1=0.0%，但正确项几乎总在top10；95.2-99.8%的失败中胜出项词法相似度更高。轨迹领域中当金标准需不同物体时接近超几何随机水平，需物体+容器均不同时低于随机。词法重排在数学中有害、在轨迹中有益(恢复26-36%差距)；LLM重排在数学恢复5-63%、轨迹恢复43-76%。数学恢复集中在知名竞赛(+19.8分，6个单元之一)，部分源于记忆。下游实验oracle与对抗性差检索无显著差异(McNemar p=0.678)。

Conclusion: 生产级嵌入检索本质上是词法匹配而非真正的语义结构理解：(1) 在数学对抗性伪装下完全失效，但在轨迹偶然变化中仅略优于随机，说明模型锚定字面token；(2) 词法重排器的表现符号可作为基准表面变化性质的判别指标；(3) LLM重排的部分恢复来自记忆而非通用推理；(4) 在配对下游实验中，检索质量对零样本求解器无影响——69.5%的准确率主要是截断代理，范式本身缺乏可提升空间。

Abstract: We evaluate embedding retrieval where surface form and meaning are pulled apart on purpose: retrieving items that share underlying structure but not wording, in two unrelated domains under one protocol, competition mathematics (MathNet-Retrieve; 500 queries, 117,088-item corpus) and embodied-agent trajectories (ALFWorld-derived; 118 queries, 336 trajectories). In mathematics the failure is complete: strict Hit@1 at the heaviest disguise tier is 0.0% for both production embedders (bootstrap 95% CI [0.0, 0.0]) while the correct item sits in the top 10 nearly always, and in 95.2 to 99.8% of misses the winner is more lexically similar to the query than the correct answer. In trajectories, where surface variation is incidental, the same models land at or near hypergeometric chance when gold must involve a different object, and below chance for all three embedders once gold must differ in object and receptacle: retrieval anchors on literal tokens, not task structure. A lexical reranker control hurts in mathematics and helps in trajectories (closing 26 to 36% of the gap, CIs excluding zero); its sign reveals whether a benchmark's surface variation is adversarial or incidental. An LLM reranker recovers 5 to 63% of the gap in mathematics and 43 to 76% in trajectories; direction replicates across three judges (all 21 cells positive), but effect sizes, tier profiles, and the outlier judge change with domain (paired differences excluding zero everywhere). Mathematics gains concentrate on well-known competitions (+19.8 points, CI [+6.7, +33.2], one of six cells), so part of the recovery is memorization. In a paired downstream experiment (210 queries, graders at 96 to 99% agreement), oracle retrieval was indistinguishable from adversarially bad retrieval (McNemar p = 0.678); the solver's 69.5% zero-shot accuracy is largely a truncation proxy (97 to 100% on finished answers), leaving no headroom.

</details>


### [269] [Gradient-Update Mismatch: Rethinking Conflict-Free Training of Physics-Informed Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01558)
*Jing Xiao,Xinhai Chen,Qinglin Wang,Menghan Jia,Zhiquan Lai,Dongsheng Li,Jie Liu,Tiejun Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对PINN训练中梯度冲突问题，发现梯度手术方法构造的无冲突方向在经优化器变换后可能重新产生冲突（称为GUM现象），并提出Gradient-Update Alignment (GUA)方法，将优化器更新投影回无冲突锥内并对内部状态进行调整，实验表明GUM现象在各类优化器中普遍存在（冲突率最高达86.3%），GUA能显著提升各种梯度手术方法的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PINN训练需要联合优化物理残差和初边值条件的损失项，这些损失项的梯度经常发生冲突。现有梯度手术方法仅保证手术构造的方向无冲突，但忽略了优化器变换（如动量历史、自适应缩放、预条件化、解耦权重衰减）会破坏这种无冲突性质，导致最终施加到参数上的更新仍然存在冲突。

Method: 论文首先理论分析证明优化器变换后a_t ∈ C_t 不一定推出 u_t ∈ C_t，将此不一致定义为梯度-更新失配（GUM）。随后提出梯度-更新对齐（GUA）方法：将优化器提议更新u_t投影到无冲突锥C_t上获得对齐更新p_t并施加到参数；当优化器维护内部状态时，进一步基于施加的更新反向调整内部状态，使状态与实际更新保持一致。

Result: 实验发现GUM在动量型、自适应型和曲率型优化器中广泛存在，冲突率最高达86.3%；在所有PINN设置下GUA能够实现应用的更新完全无冲突，一致地提升各类梯度手术方法的性能，在个别设置中相对L2误差最多降低98.2%。

Conclusion: 论文揭示了梯度手术与优化器之间被忽视的交互失配问题，并提出GUA作为一种通用且有效的解决方案，能够确保无冲突的最终参数更新，为PINN训练中多损失梯度冲突治理提供了更完整的框架。

Abstract: Training Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) requires jointly optimizing physics residual and initial/boundary condition loss terms, which often induce conflicting gradients. Gradient surgery methods mitigate this issue by constructing directions from loss-specific gradients to reduce conflict before optimizer transformation. However, even when the constructed direction is conflict-free, this property may not be preserved after optimizer transformation. Let $a_t$ denote the direction constructed by gradient surgery, $u_t$ the optimizer proposal, and $\mathcal{C}_t$ the conflict-free cone induced by the loss-specific gradients. We show that modern optimizers can transform $a_t$ through mechanisms such as historical state, adaptive scaling, preconditioning, or decoupled weight decay, so $a_t \in \mathcal{C}_t$ does not generally imply $u_t \in \mathcal{C}_t$. We refer to this optimizer-induced discrepancy in conflict-freeness between $a_t$ and $u_t$ as Gradient-Update Mismatch (GUM). Accordingly, we propose Gradient-Update Alignment (GUA), which projects $u_t$ onto $\mathcal{C}_t$ to obtain the aligned update $p_t$ and applies $p_t$ to the parameters. When the optimizer maintains internal state, GUA further adjusts this state toward targets reconstructed from the applied update. We conduct extensive experiments and find that GUM is widespread across momentum, adaptive, and curvature-based optimizers, with conflict rates reaching up to 86.3%. Across all PINN settings, GUA achieves conflict-free applied updates and consistently improves various gradient surgery methods, reducing the relative $L_2$ error by up to 98.2% in individual settings. Data and code are available at https://github.com/JingXiao10/GUA.

</details>


### [270] [The Structure of Quantization Damage in LLMs: Why the Next Bit Should Be Spent Globally](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01587)
*Jundong Hu,Shekar Ramachandran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了LLM后训练量化（PTQ）中精度损失的位置与修复预算分配问题。通过对9个开源模型、4个架构家族的因果混合精度干预实验，发现量化损伤的恢复是"弥散"的——多数模型需要约一半层数才能恢复75%的精度差距。三个直观假设（任务回路、计算位置、权重统计）均无法预测哪些层受益于精度恢复。在匹配的精度预算下，全局细化量化粒度比局部修复最可恢复的层更有效（提升21-52点）。这挑战了"选择性保护关键层"的常见做法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PTQ虽然广泛用于降低LLM推理成本，但其精度损失在不同模型中不均匀，且通常需要逐模型调优。作者希望理解量化损伤发生在哪里，以及如何以小量额外精度预算最有效地修复损伤。

Method: 以因果混合精度干预为ground truth（逐一将每层提升至8-bit并测量恢复的精度），对9个开源模型、4个架构家族进行实验。测试三个假设：损伤位于任务回路、模型计算位置、或权重统计中。另在匹配精度预算下比较全局粒度细化与局部逐层修复两种策略。

Result: 三个直觉假设均无法预测哪些层受益于精度恢复。恢复是弥散的：8/9模型恢复75%精度差距需约一半层数（Qwen3-8B例外，高度集中）。在匹配预算下，全局细化量化粒度优于局部修复，8个group-128兼容模型提升21-52点。次要发现：残差受预算限制（8-bit近无损），峰值恢复位置与架构族内部相关但跨族不相关。

Conclusion: 在有限精度预算设定下，全局粒度细化优于选择性保护关键层。更一般地，与量化损伤相关的廉价信号不一定能识别精度恢复的有效位置，需通过因果干预检验。

Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is widely used to reduce the cost of serving large language models (LLMs), but its accuracy cost is uneven and is often tuned per model. We study where quantization damage occurs and how to allocate a small additional precision budget. Using causal mixed-precision intervention as ground truth (raise each layer to 8-bit in turn and measure the accuracy it recovers) across 9 open-weight models in 4 architecture families, we test 3 intuitive hypotheses: that quantization damage lives in task circuits, where the model computes, or in weight statistics. None of them predicts which layers benefit from restored precision. Recovery is instead diffuse: for 8 of 9 models, recovering 75% of the gap takes roughly half the layers; the lone exception, Qwen3-8B, is sharply concentrated. At a matched precision budget, spending it globally on finer quantization granularity beats locally repairing the most recoverable layers for all 8 group-128-compatible models (all but OpenLLaMA, whose width rules out group-128), by 21-52 points, including the concentrated Qwen3-8B. We report 2 secondary findings: the residual is budget-limited (8-bit is near-lossless in our evaluation across RTN, GPTQ, and AWQ), and the location of peak recovery correlates with architecture within a family, though not across families. Within this budget setting, global granularity is a better default than selectively protecting critical layers. More broadly, cheap signals that correlate with quantization damage do not necessarily identify where restoring precision improves accuracy; this must be tested with causal intervention.

</details>


<div id='eess.SY'></div>

# eess.SY [[Back]](#toc)

### [271] [The Space-Time Transform: Memory-Augmented Control Barrier Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00079)
*Avinash Malik*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文针对控制障碍函数（CBF）及其变体在数学上等价于受零记忆核限制的连续时间卷积这一结构性缺陷，提出了一种时空变换（STT-CBF），将动态时间滤波直接嵌入安全约束合成中，通过设计适当的时空核来衰减高频噪声同时保持仿射控制权威，并证明了所设计STT-CBF的鲁棒前向不变性。在三次系统的蒙特卡洛仿真中，该方法实现了100%的安全率，同时相比传统参数化障碍方法将控制总变差降低了99%以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统CBF、HOCBF和ECBF虽然在非线性安全约束方面提供了优雅的几何框架，但它们在数学上等价于受零记忆核限制的连续时间卷积。在存在高频测量噪声时，这些无记忆算子充当不适当的滤波器，导致显著的控制震颤，并因二次规划（QP）不可行性而可能丧失主动控制权威。这一结构性限制阻碍了其在物理机器人平台上的可靠部署。

Method: 本文引入一种时空变换（Space-Time Transform），将动态时间滤波直接嵌入到安全约束合成过程中。通过设计适当的时空核（spatio-temporal kernel），该方法在固有地衰减高频噪声的同时保持仿射控制权威，并在此基础上构建时空变换CBF（STT-CBF），同时证明了其鲁棒前向不变性。

Result: 在三次系统的蒙特卡洛仿真中，所提出的STT-CBF框架实现了100%的安全率，同时与传统参数化障碍方法相比，将控制总变差降低了超过99%，有效缓解了硬件危害并支持在物理机器人平台上的可靠部署。

Conclusion: 通过时空变换将动态滤波嵌入安全约束合成，能够从根本上解决传统CBF框架因零记忆核导致的噪声放大和控制震颤问题，在保持安全保证（鲁棒前向不变性）的同时显著提升控制平滑性，为实现物理机器人平台上的可靠安全部署提供了新的理论框架。

Abstract: Control Barrier Functions (CBFs), their High-Order variants (HOCBFs) and Exponential CBFs (ECBFs) are standard geometric tools for enforcing nonlinear safety constraints. CBFs, and their variants, offer an elegant geometric framework for nonlinear safety, yet mathematically, they reduce to continuous-time convolutions restricted by zero-memory kernels. In the presence of high-frequency measurement noise, these memoryless operators act as improper filters, leading to significant control chattering and the potential loss of active control authority due to Quadratic Program (QP) infeasibility. To address this structural limitation, this paper introduces a space-time transform that embeds dynamic temporal filtering directly into the safety constraint synthesis. By designing a proper spatio-temporal kernel, this approach inherently attenuates high-frequency noise while preserving affine control authority. Crucially, we prove the robust forward invariance of the designed STT-CBF. Monte Carlo simulations of a third-order system demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves a 100% safety rate while reducing control total variation by over 99% compared to conventional parameterized barrier methods, mitigating hardware hazards and enabling reliable deployment on physical robotic platforms.

</details>


### [272] [Exploiting the Benefits of V2B Application on Peak Shaving of Data Center Loads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00204)
*Arya Joshi,Hamed Haggi,Chinmay Morankar*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文探讨了车辆到建筑（V2B）应用在数据中心冷却负荷削峰中的潜力。通过对弗吉尼亚州劳登县10 MW数据中心的案例研究，模拟了40辆商业和乘用电动车的V2B参与，结果表明在中午12点至下午5点之间策略性调度V2B资产，可根据季节变化抵消13-36%的总冷却负荷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据中心项目的加速增长给电网带来了需求驱动的瓶颈，并导致碳排放大幅增加。这些担忧推动了利用现有能源资产提升运营效率的讨论，因此需要探索V2B应用来支持数据中心冷却负荷的削峰。

Method: 首先进行了文献综述，考虑V2B约束和优化方法（包括SoC限制、EV参与、电价和建筑负荷）。随后基于此分析，通过模拟温度依赖性负荷曲线并调整40辆商业和乘用EV的V2B参与，开发了位于弗吉尼亚州劳登县的10 MW数据中心概念案例研究。

Result: 仿真结果表明，根据冷却负荷需求的季节性变化，在下午12点至5点之间策略性部署V2B资产，可以抵消总冷却负荷的13-36%。

Conclusion: V2B应用能够有效利用现有电动车资产为数据中心冷却系统提供削峰支持，其削峰效果受季节性冷却负荷需求的影响显著。

Abstract: The accelerated growth in data center projects has introduced a demand-driven bottleneck throughout power grids and contributed to a substantial increase in carbon emissions. These concerns are fueling discussions on methods to use existing energy assets to drive operational efficiency. To this end, this paper explores the benefits of Vehicle-to-Building (V2B) applications to support peak shaving of data center cooling loads. Initially, a literature review was conducted considering V2B constraints and optimization methods including SoC limitations, EV participation, tariffs, and building loads. This analysis was then used to develop a conceptual case study of a 10 MW data center in Loudoun County, VA by simulating a temperature-dependent load profile and adjusting the V2B participation of 40 commercial and passenger EVs. Simulation results indicate that, depending on seasonal variations in cooling load demands, strategic deployment of V2B assets between 12-5pm can offset gross cooling loads by 13-36%.

</details>


### [273] [Uncertainty-Aware Parameter Estimation for Condition Monitoring of Power Converters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00218)
*Tomas Monopoli,Jiahong Liu,Shuai Zhao*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于贝叶斯最大后验优化和可微分变换器模型的不确定性感知参数估计框架，用于功率变换器的状态监测，能够量化参数估计的不确定性并进行统计显著性检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有功率变换器参数估计方法大多只提供点估计，无法判断观测到的参数变化是否具有统计显著性，缺乏不确定性量化能力。

Method: 采用贝叶斯最大后验优化结合可微分变换器模型进行参数估计；利用拉普拉斯近似获得局部高斯后验分布，从而实现不确定性量化、一致性检验、估计器分辨率分析和跨数据窗口的精度加权池化。

Result: 在合成数据和硬件Buck变换器上进行了验证，能够准确估计良好可辨识的参数，同时揭示了在现有传感配置下如MOSFET导通电阻等参数的实际可辨识性较弱。

Conclusion: 该框架不仅提供了参数点估计，还能量化不确定性并评估参数的可辨识性，为功率变换器状态监测提供了更可靠的统计依据。

Abstract: Parameter estimation is widely used for condition monitoring of power converters, but most existing methods provide only point estimates and therefore cannot quantify whether an observed parameter change is statistically significant. This paper proposes an uncertainty-aware parameter estimation framework based on Bayesian maximum a posteriori optimization and a differentiable converter model. A Laplace approximation is used to obtain a local Gaussian posterior, enabling uncertainty quantification, consistency testing, estimator-resolution analysis, and precision-weighted pooling across data windows. The method is validated on synthetic and hardware Buck converter. It demonstrates accurate estimation of well-identified parameters and reveal the weak practical identifiability of parameters such as MOSFET on-resistance under the available sensing configuration.

</details>


### [274] [Non-Blocking Fault Current Limiting Control of Half-Bridge MMCs for MTDC Transmission](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00286)
*Pengxiang Huang,Shahil Shah*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于半桥模块化多电平换流器（HB-MMC）的有源故障电流限制（AFCL）控制策略，以减轻多端高压直流（MTDC）输电系统中的直流故障电流，避免换流器闭锁并降低直流断路器（DCCB）的遮断能力要求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在MTDC系统中，使用HB-MMC缺乏固有故障电流抑制能力，直流故障时可能在DCCB清除故障之前就导致换流器闭锁，影响系统的选择性故障隔离和持续运行。

Method: 提出AFCL控制策略用于HB-MMC以抑制直流故障电流，并采用系统性设计方法，在换流器约束和网络稳定性约束下对AFCL控制策略进行参数设计。

Result: 通过PSCAD仿真在两个典型MTDC系统中验证了该策略在直流故障期间的有效性。

Conclusion: 所提出的AFCL控制策略能够有效避免HB-MMC在直流故障期间的换流器闭锁，并降低对DCCB遮断能力的要求，从而提升MTDC系统的故障隔离可靠性。

Abstract: A key protection requirement in multiterminal HVDC (MTDC) transmission systems is to selectively isolate faulted areas using DC circuit breakers (DCCBs) during DC faults while keeping the rest of the systems in operation. However, in MTDC systems using half-bridge modular multilevel converters (HB-MMCs), the lack of inherent fault current suppression capability in HB-MMCs can cause converter blocking before fault clearance by DCCBs. This work presents an active fault current limiting (AFCL) control strategy for HB-MMCs to mitigate DC fault currents, thus avoiding converter blocking and reducing the breaking capability required of DCCBs. In addition, a systematic approach is proposed to design the AFCL control strategy under converter and network stability constraints. The effectiveness of the proposed strategy is demonstrated through PSCAD on two typical MTDC systems during DC faults.

</details>


### [275] [Counterfactual Closing-Acceleration Risk: An Anticipatory Surrogate Safety Measure for the Blind Region of Car-Following](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00370)
*Eni Solomon Laughter*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出反事实接近加速度风险（CCAR），一种前瞻性的替代安全度量，用于评估当前方车辆刹车时后车暴露于追尾冲突的风险程度。该度量基于后车当前的接近加速度（closing acceleration）进行条件化。在SQM-W-1轨迹数据集的745,540个高速公路跟车帧上评估，传统度量因后车未更快而留下51%的帧无法打分，而CCAR在98.8%的盲区内给出分级、非平凡的风险值。CCAR与现有度量不冗余，并在模拟中验证其风险机制与实际碰撞率一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的替代安全度量（如TTC及其变体）假设运动不变，且当前方车辆尚未比前车更快时无法定义，导致大量跟车场景没有任何风险读数。需要一种能够覆盖这些"盲区"并具有预测能力的度量。

Method: 提出CCAR度量：通过反事实推理，评估若前车突然刹车，后车在当前接近加速度条件下的追尾冲突暴露程度。在真实高速轨迹数据（SQM-W-1，745,540帧）上评估，并与传统度量进行相关性和重叠度对比；使用反应式IDM（智能驾驶员模型）后车配合脚本化前车刹车的受控模拟验证机制。

Result: 传统度量因后车尚未更快而无法对51%的跟车帧评分；在这些盲区中CCAR能在98.8%的帧中给出分级且非平凡的风险。CCAR与传统度量非冗余（与修正TTC的Spearman相关0.54，顶十分位风险集重叠0.19）。在固定间距和速度下，风险随接近加速度单调上升。受控模拟证实实际碰撞率随接近加速度上升。

Conclusion: CCAR是一种有效的反事实式前瞻安全度量，能够覆盖传统度量的盲区并提供分级风险信号，其预测机制得到模拟支持。但存在参数敏感性等局限，该度量对前向碰撞预警系统具有潜在应用价值。

Abstract: Surrogate safety measures allow road-safety assessment from trajectory data in which crashes are absent, yet the dominant proximity measures - time-to-collision (TTC) and its variants - assume invariant motion and are undefined whenever the following vehicle is not yet faster than its leader, so a large fraction of car-following carries no risk reading at all. This paper introduces Counterfactual Closing-Acceleration Risk (CCAR), an anticipatory surrogate measure that scores how exposed a follower is to a rear-end conflict if its leader were to brake, conditioned on the follower's current gap-closing acceleration. CCAR is evaluated on 745,540 expressway car-following frames from the SQM-W-1 trajectory dataset. Conventional measures leave 51% of frames unscored because the follower is not yet faster; across this blind region CCAR returns a graded, non-trivial risk in 98.8% of frames. CCAR is not redundant with existing measures (Spearman correlation 0.54 with modified TTC; top-decile risk-set overlap 0.19), and at fixed gap and speed its risk rises monotonically with closing acceleration. A controlled simulation with a reactive Intelligent Driver Model follower and a scripted leader brake confirms that, holding gap and brake fixed, the actual collision rate rises with closing acceleration, supporting the proposed precursor mechanism. Parameter sensitivity, limitations, and implications for forward-collision-warning systems are discussed.

</details>


### [276] [An Open Synthetic Test System for the Jordanian Transmission Grid](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00388)
*Muhy Eddin Zater,Bri-Mathias Hodge*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文构建了首个开放的中东地区输电系统合成测试用例——约旦输电网合成测试系统，完全基于公开数据重建2018年实际电网拓扑、发电机组、可再生能源及负荷数据，并通过结构统计、潮流分析、N-1筛选、能耗损失分解和全年生产成本模拟等多维度验证，再现了实际年度能源结构（最大生产商误差在4%以内，系统总量误差在0.1%以内）。该测试系统可用于资源充裕度、时序机组组合、可再生能源消纳、燃料供应韧性及互联研究等基准测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的开放电力测试系统几乎都代表北美和欧洲电网，缺乏任何中东国家的开放输电测试系统。中东电网面临独特的问题（如单一走廊燃料供应韧性、小同步系统中的高比例可再生能源运行），而现有基准无法展示这些特性，因此需要开发面向中东电网的合成测试系统。

Method: 从约旦电网公布的图中重建真实拓扑，恢复至2018年带电状态；包含厂级发电机组和可再生能源机组、各厂逐时出力曲线以及按约旦电网运营商公布数据校准的负荷；通过结构统计对比真实电网标准、潮流与N-1筛选、考虑能量的损耗分解、全年生产成本模拟与公布的分厂电量对比以及跨求解器验证来校验模型。

Result: 模型在技术层面复现了年度能源结构：最大发电生产商误差在4%以内，系统总量误差在0.1%以内。发布的数据库包含母线身份密钥、所有脚本及2019年后的情景变体。

Conclusion: 该测试用例设计用于基准测试系统级资源充裕度、时序调度与机组组合、可再生能源整合、燃料供应韧性情景、互联研究及稳态研究，填补了中东电网开放测试系统的空白。

Abstract: Open synthetic test systems are essential for reproducible power system research, yet the available cases represent almost exclusively North American and European grids. No open transmission test system exists for any Middle Eastern country, whose grids raise different questions such as single corridor fuel-supply resilience and high-renewable operation within small synchronous systems, and established benchmarks cannot demonstrate. This paper presents a synthetic test system for the Jordanian transmission grid, assembled entirely from public sources, where the real topology is reconstructed from a published diagram and restored to its 2018 energized state, with plant-level generation and renewable fleets, per-site hourly profiles, and loads calibrated to the values published by Jordan's grid operators. The case is validated through structural statistics against real-grid criteria, power flow and $N\!-\!1$ screening, an energy-weighted loss decomposition, in addition to a full-year production-cost run compared against the published per-plant energy, and cross-solver verification. The model reproduces the annual energy mix at technology level (largest producers within 4\%, system total within 0.1\%), and the released dataset includes the bus-identity key, all scripts, and a post-2019 scenario variant. This test case is designed to benchmark system-level resource adequacy, time-series dispatch and unit commitment, renewable integration, fuel-supply resilience scenarios, interconnection studies and steady-state studies.

</details>


### [277] [Decentralized and Equilibrium-Set-Oriented Stability Analysis and Control for Power Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00497)
*Peng Yang,Liaoyuan Yang,Feng Liu*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种去中心化的电力系统稳定性分析与控制框架，通过引入"输入-输出微分无源"（IODP）新概念，将平衡集渐近稳定性的验证分解为对各个设备的局部要求，适用于大规模波动性可再生能源并网下的多运行点场景，并在改进的IEEE 39节点系统上验证了其可扩展性和有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统电力系统稳定性分析是集中式的，且围绕单一平衡点展开，在可再生能源大规模接入导致运行点高度波动的背景下，这种分析方式日益受限，缺乏可扩展的、面向平衡集而非单点的稳定性分析与控制框架。

Method: 提出输入-输出微分无源（IODP）概念，将互联系统的平衡集稳定性分解为各设备需满足的局部条件（无需嵌入特定运行平衡点）；每个节点需要具备由IODP指数量化的足够无源水平；对于无源不足的设备，开发了基于I/O变换的无源化控制器以重塑其局部输入-输出行为，从而使所有并网组件满足系统级稳定的去中心化条件。

Result: 在改进的IEEE 39节点系统上进行了验证，仿真结果表明该框架在高波动运行工况下能够提供可扩展且面向平衡集的稳定性认证与控制解决方案。

Conclusion: 该框架成功地将系统级稳定性问题去中心化，使稳定性验证简化为检查给定运行工况的平衡点是否位于已认证集合内，并为无源不足设备提供了可补偿的无源化控制方案，为高比例可再生能源接入下的电力系统稳定性分析提供了新范式。

Abstract: Conventional power-system stability analysis is largely centralized and centered on a single equilibrium point, which becomes increasingly restrictive in the presence of large-scale fluctuating renewable generation. This paper develops a decentralized framework for stability analysis and control that certifies the asymptotic stability of an equilibrium set rather than that of a given single operating point. To this end, we introduce a new notion termed input--output differential passivity (IODP), which decomposes equilibrium-set stability of the interconnected system into local requirements imposed on individual devices. These requirements are formulated without embedding a particular operating equilibrium into the local conditions; once the certified regions are constructed, stability verification for a given operating scenario reduces to checking whether its equilibrium lies in the certified set. The proposed conditions require each bus to possess a sufficient level of IODP, quantified by an IODP index. To compensate for an IODP shortage, we further develop an I/O-transformation-based passivation controller that reshapes the local input--output behavior of the corresponding device. In this way, all grid-connected components can be made to satisfy the decentralized conditions for system-wide stability. The proposed framework is validated on a modified IEEE 39-bus system. Simulation results demonstrate that it provides a scalable and equilibrium-set-oriented solution for stability certification and control under highly variable operating conditions.

</details>


### [278] [Optimal Uniform Pricing for Multi-Interval Dispatch without Make-Whole Uplifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00541)
*Valentina Norambuena-Guzman,Cong Chen,Lang Tong,Timothy D. Mount*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种最优统一定价规则，用于解决滚动窗口调度中因爬坡限制和预测误差导致的LMP低于发电商报价问题，该规则可消除OOM补偿、最小化需求支付、保留拥堵费用并确保收入充足，同时还能消除发电商虚报报价的激励。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在具有爬坡限制发电机组和不准确净需求预测的电网中，实际滚动窗口调度会使LMP低于发电商的投标报价，导致需要采用市场外（OOM）结算来补偿发电商。但OOM存在负面后果，包括实时价格信号不透明、歧视性补偿以及诱导不诚实投标等，因此需要设计更好的定价机制。

Method: 提出一种最优统一定价规则，采用闭式解推导该定价规则，并将其与现有定价方案建立关联。该规则旨在最小化需求支付、消除OOM make-whole支付、保留基于LMP的拥堵费用并确保收入充足。

Result: 数值比较表明，所提定价规则能够带来更有利的发电商利润和更低的电价波动性。但更高发电商利润伴随需求支付增加，反映了爬坡成本的统一市场内分配。数值结果还显示，在LMP+OOM结算下，价格接受型发电商有虚报报价的动机，而所提定价规则在测试投标范围内消除了这一激励。

Conclusion: 所提出的最优统一定价规则是一种可行的替代方案，能够在市场内统一分配爬坡成本、消除OOM结算、改善价格信号透明度并消除策略性虚报报价行为，尽管以增加需求支付为代价。

Abstract: In a network with ramp-limited generators and inaccurate net-demand forecasts, practical rolling-window dispatch can drive locational marginal prices (LMPs) below generators' bid-in offers. In such cases, out-of-market (OOM) settlements are used to compensate generators and maintain dispatch-following incentives, but OOM can have negative consequences, including nontransparent real-time price signals, discriminatory compensation, and incentives for untruthful bidding. This paper presents an optimal uniform pricing rule that minimizes demand payments, eliminates OOM make-whole payments, preserves LMP-based congestion charges, and ensures revenue adequacy. We derive the proposed pricing rule in closed form and relate it to existing pricing schemes. Numerical comparisons demonstrate favorable generator profits and reduced price volatility. However, higher generator profits are accompanied by increased demand payments, reflecting the in-market, uniform allocation of ramping costs while preserving the LMP-based congestion charges widely used in real-time market settlements. The numerical results also show that, under LMP with OOM settlement, a price-taking generator has an incentive to inflate its offer, whereas this incentive is absent under the proposed pricing rule within the tested bid range.

</details>


### [279] [A Bayesian Adaptive Spectral Surrogate Model for Efficient Probabilistic Optimal Power Flow Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00547)
*Xiaoting Wang,Xiaozhe Wang,Gregory Kish,Yunwei,Li*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种自适应随机谱嵌入（ASSE）方法，用于高效求解概率交流最优潮流（AC-OPF）问题，能够准确估计AC-OPF解的均值、方差、中位数及分位数等概率特征，并在此基础上确定基于置信区间的生产成本指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交流最优潮流（AC-OPF）是电力系统运行中的关键问题，在不确定性条件下，传统蒙特卡洛模拟方法计算成本高昂，难以满足实际工程对精度和效率的双重要求。

Method: 采用自适应域划分策略指导细化域的选择与划分，提升对强局部化响应的捕捉能力；集成基于贝叶斯压缩感知的系数计算算法，增强方法性能。整体框架能够在估计AC-OPF决策（发电机出力）的同时，确定基于置信区间的生产成本指标。

Result: 在改进的IEEE 9节点和IEEE 118节点系统上的数值研究表明：与蒙特卡洛模拟相比，所提ASSE方法提供准确且快速的评估；与稀疏多项式混沌展开、高斯过程回归和深度神经网络相比，该方法能更有效地评估具有强局部化行为和非对称分布的响应。

Conclusion: ASSE方法能够为不确定性下的发电机出力和运行成本提供实用的决策边界，是一种兼具精度和效率的概率AC-OPF求解方案。

Abstract: This paper presents an adaptive stochastic spectral embedding (ASSE) method to solve the probabilistic AC optimal power flow (AC-OPF), a critical aspect of power system operation. The proposed method can efficiently and accurately estimate the probabilistic characteristics (e.g., mean, variance, median, and quantile-based metrics) of AC-OPF solutions while minimizing power losses. Based on estimated AC-OPF decisions (i.e., generator outputs), the confidence interval (CI)-based production cost index can be determined. Specially, an adaptive domain partition strategy is adopted to guide refinement domain selection and partition. The Bayesian compressive sensing-based coefficient calculation algorithm is integrated to enhance its performance. Numerical studies on modified IEEE 9-bus and IEEE 118-bus systems demonstrate that the proposed ASSE method offers accurate and fast evaluations compared to Monte Carlo simulations. Comparisons with a sparse polynomial chaos expansion, Gaussian process regression, and deep neural networks, further illustrate its efficacy in accurately assessing the responses with strongly localized behavior and non-symmetric distributions, providing practical decision-making bounds for generator outputs and operating costs under uncertainty.

</details>


### [280] [IMU-Aided Correction of Orientation-Induced Ranging Error in Bluetooth Channel Sounding on Commercial Hardware](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00650)
*Mihir Bapat,Santosh Nagaraj*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文首次研究了商业硬件上设备朝向对蓝牙低功耗信道探测（BLE CS）测距精度的影响，并提出使用IMU特征进行机器学习修正的方法，在留一朝向评估中实现了74.6%的平均绝对误差（MAE）降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管已有研究探讨了固定朝向下BLE CS的测距精度，但尚无公开发表的工作研究设备朝向如何影响商业硬件上的测距误差，这是一个重要但被忽视的研究空白。

Method: 使用EFR32xG24 Channel Sounding开发套件（目前唯一集成六轴IMU的商业CS平台），采集不同设备朝向下的CS测距数据，利用IMU导出的朝向特征训练随机森林模型，并通过留一朝向（Leave One Orientation Out）评估方式验证模型的泛化能力。

Result: 实验表明设备朝向对CS测距精度有显著影响；基于IMU朝向特征训练的随机森林模型在留一朝向评估中实现了74.6%的平均绝对误差（MAE）降低。

Conclusion: IMU读数具有提升BLE CS测距精度的潜力，为未来在动态朝向场景下提高测距可靠性提供了可行性验证和解决思路。

Abstract: Bluetooth Low Energy Channel Sounding (BLE CS), standardized in Bluetooth Core Specification 6.0 (September 2024), enables distance estimation via phase-based ranging (PBR) and round-trip time (RTT). Although prior work has studied CS accuracy in configurations with a fixed orientation, no published work has studied how device orientation affects ranging error on commercial hardware. We present the first study of orientation-induced CS ranging error and a Machine Learning correction using IMU features. This study used the EFR32xG24 Channel Sounding Development Kit, the only commercial CS platform with an integrated six-axis Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU). Our results show that device orientation has a substantial effect on CS ranging accuracy; we found that a Random Forest model trained on the IMU derived orientation achieved a 74.6\% Mean Absolute Error (MAE) reduction under a Leave One Orientation Out Evaluation, demonstrating that IMU readings have potential to improve ranging accuracy.

</details>


### [281] [Strategic and Grid-Aware Maintenance Planning of Offshore Wind Farms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00651)
*Robert Mieth,Ahmed Aziz Ezzat*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究风电场在电网和电力市场环境下的维护调度规划问题，提出了一种战略性维护规划模型，风电场运营商通过提交降额（derated）容量参与市场出清以最大化利润，同时确保所有必需维护任务可完成。文章构建了确定性与随机两种版本模型（后者考虑环境和运行不确定性），并在IEEE RTS 96节点测试系统上结合真实海上风电场数据进行了数值实验，考察了风机/风电场规模及预测质量的影响。研究发现战略性维护规划与电网友好的维护规划具有一致性，风电场能在对系统成本影响很小的情况下改善自身收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 风力涡轮机需要定期维护，维护成本是风电场发电成本的重要组成部分。现有研究主要关注在维护成本与故障/非计划维修风险之间寻求最优平衡，但忽略了在电网约束与电力市场出清背景下进行维护调度的机会，这一空白正是本文要填补的。

Method: 作者推导了一个战略性维护规划问题的模型及其高效求解方法：风电场运营商提交降额后的风电场容量参与市场出清，使得电价和出清结果能最大化其利润，同时确保所有维护任务能够完成。研究包含确定性模型和考虑环境与运行不确定性的随机模型，并在IEEE RTS 96节点测试系统上使用真实海上风电场数据进行数值实验。

Result: 数值实验表明，战略性维护规划与电网友好的维护规划之间存在一致性；风电场可以通过战略性维护调度改善自身经济效益，同时仅对系统总成本产生很低的影响。研究还考察了风电场规模、风机尺寸以及预测质量对结果的作用。

Conclusion: 将维护规划置于电网与电力市场背景下具有实际价值，风电场的战略性维护调度既能提升自身利润又能与电网的维护需求保持协同，为风电场运营商提供了在电力市场环境下优化维护决策的新思路。

Abstract: Wind turbines require regular maintenance and the resulting costs are a substantial component of a wind farm's cost of electricity production. As a result, there has been ongoing interest in improving wind turbine maintenance scheduling to find an optimal balance between maintenance costs and the risk of failure or unplanned repairs. What remains understudied is the opportunity for wind farms to schedule maintenance in the context of grid conditions and electricity market clearing. This paper contributes to closing this gap by modeling and studying wind farm maintenance planning in a grid and electricity market context. We also review current U.S. practice of wind farm maintenance scheduling, which motivates this paper and its models. Our focus is the derivation of a strategic maintenance planning problem, alongside an efficient solution approach, in which the wind farm operator aims to submit a derated wind farm capacity such that the resulting market clearing and electricity prices maximize its profit while ensuring that all required maintenance can be performed. We derive and study both deterministic and stochastic versions of the model, with the latter considering environmental and operational uncertainties. We conduct numerical experiments using the IEEE RTS 96-bus testbed with real-world offshore wind farm data and investigate the roles of farm and turbine size, as well as forecast quality. We observe an alignment between strategic and grid-serving maintenance planning and find that wind farms can improve their bottom line with low impact on system costs.

</details>


### [282] [Order-Adaptive Distributed Integral Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00688)
*Fei Chen*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种阶次自适应分布式积分控制器（OADIC），用于在目标复杂度未知的分布式动态协调中，动态地增加积分状态以消除跟踪误差，同时保持低阶控制器的状态效率，且不依赖非线性反馈或非光滑反馈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在分布式动态协调中，当目标复杂度未知时，控制器阶次的选择存在结构性权衡：低阶控制器节省状态但可能留下持续的跟踪误差，高阶控制器改善跟踪但可能给每个智能体带来不必要的动态负担。现有解决方案（非线性反馈或非光滑反馈）计算复杂或存在抖动问题。

Method: 提出的OADIC方法：(1) 从比例反馈开始，仅当局部可测相对误差表明当前阶次不足时才添加积分状态；(2) 将候选控制器组织成嵌套形式，保留已有状态和增益，保证阶次切换期间控制输入连续；(3) 在增强的智能体-目标图上刻画规定相对位移的一致性；(4) 构造能镇定所有可行固定阶子系统的增益，并建立变维闭环系统的统一输入-状态稳定性界；(5) 证明OADIC在有限个决策区间后拒绝所有不充分阶次，并明确给出关键阶次拒绝时间的上界。

Result: 理论分析表明该控制器能保证变维闭环系统的统一输入-状态稳定性，能够在有限决策区间内识别并拒绝所有不充分的控制器阶次，且给出了关键阶次拒绝时间的显式上界。

Conclusion: 所提出的OADIC成功消除了低阶与高阶控制器之间的两难选择，在保持控制输入连续性和状态效率的同时，能够自适应地达到足以消除跟踪误差的控制器阶次，并提供严格的理论保证。

Abstract: We address a structural tradeoff in distributed dynamic coordination: when the target complexity is unknown, a low controller order saves states but may leave a persistent tracking error, whereas a high order improves tracking but may burden every agent with unnecessary dynamics. To remove this choice without resorting to computationally more involved nonlinear feedback or chattering-prone nonsmooth feedback, we develop an order-adaptive distributed integral controller (OADIC). Specifically, we start with proportional feedback and add integral states only when locally measurable relative errors show that the current order is inadequate. Meanwhile, we organize the candidate controllers in a nested form, thereby preserving the existing states and gains and maintaining continuous control inputs during order transitions. To provide a theoretical basis for this design, we first characterize the consistency of prescribed relative displacements on the augmented agent--target graph. Next, we construct gains that stabilize all admissible fixed-order subsystems and establish a uniform input-to-state stability bound for the variable-dimension closed loop. Furthermore, we prove that OADIC rejects every insufficient order after finitely many decision intervals and explicitly bound the rejection time of the critical order.

</details>


### [283] [A Modular IoT-Enabled Remote Laboratory Platform for Hybrid Energy System Research and Engineering Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00815)
*Lamine Chalal,Louis Olivier,Pierre Liennard,Allal Saadane,Ahmed Rachid*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种模块化、基于IoT的远程实验室平台，用于混合能源系统研究。该平台结合可再生能源仿真器、电池储能和可编程负载，采用基于Web HMI、TIA Portal和MATLAB/Simulink的三接口架构，通过Talk2M VPN云实现连接。工业PLC和IoT网关提供确定性本地控制和安全的远程访问。在相同风能和辐照度条件下对比本地与远程执行结果，验证了分层能源管理算法，结果显示能源平衡差异小，通信延迟约100ms，支持研究级远程实验和基于项目的学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 远程实验室系统能够提升工程教育和研究中与物理设备进行互联网交互的可访问性，本文旨在构建一个支持混合能源系统研究的远程实验平台，以解决传统实验室在物理访问和资源共享方面的局限性。

Method: 采用模块化IoT架构，包含五种核心组件：可再生能源仿真器、电池储能和可编程负载，以及三接口架构（Web HMI、TIA Portal、MATLAB/Simulink），通过Talk2M VPN云连接。工业PLC和IoT网关实现确定性本地控制与安全远程监控，并设计了分层能源管理算法进行验证。

Result: 在相同风能和辐照度剖面下，本地与远程执行结果的能源平衡（可再生能源、电池、负载）差异很小；典型通信延迟约为100ms，表明平台能够支持研究级的远程实验。

Conclusion: 该平台能够有效支持远程研究级实验和基于项目的学习，适用于控制与能源系统工程领域，兼具工业级控制可靠性和远程实验的便利性。

Abstract: Remote laboratory systems improve accessibility in engineering education and research by enabling Internet-based interaction with physical equipment. This paper presents a modular IoT-enabled remote laboratory platform for hybrid energy system studies, combining renewable energy emulators, battery storage, and programmable loads within a three-interface architecture based on a web HMI, TIA Portal, and MATLAB/Simulink, all connected through a Talk2M VPN cloud. An industrial PLC and IoT gateway provide deterministic local control as well as secure remote access and monitoring. A hierarchical energy-management algorithm is validated by comparing local and remote executions under identical wind and irradiance profiles. The results show small differences in the energy balances of the renewable sources, battery, and load, while typical communication delays are on the order of 100 ms. Consequently, the platform supports research-grade remote experimentation and project-based learning in control and energy systems engineering.

</details>


### [284] [A Three-phase and Single-phase Compatible Dual-Mode EV On-Board Charger with Integrated Active Power Decoupling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00822)
*Bitan Joydhar,Shimul K. Dam*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种适用于电动汽车的双模式车载充电器（OBC），能在三相供电和单相供电下运行。该拓扑利用额外的继电器开关和小电容实现有源功率解耦（APD），消除了单相充电时需要的大容量直流母线电容。仿真验证表明，单相运行时直流母线电容可降低一个数量级以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高性能电动汽车倾向于采用三相充电以获得更高功率等级，但同时也需要兼容单相供电。单相充电时，直流母线存在二次频率电流，这需要庞大且昂贵的直流链路电容，增加了成本和体积。

Method: 提出一种双模式OBC拓扑，在单相运行模式下，仅通过增加一个额外的继电器开关和一个小容量电容来实现有源功率解耦（APD），从而替代传统的大容量直流母线电容。

Result: 在详细仿真中，所提出的拓扑在不同条件下得到验证，单相运行期间直流母线电容可减少超过一个数量级。

Conclusion: 所提出的双模式OBC拓扑能够同时兼容三相和单相充电，并通过有源功率解耦大幅降低直流母线电容需求，是一种高效且经济的解决方案。

Abstract: Onboard charger (OBC) is essential part of Electric Vehicle (EV). High-performance EVs are preferring three phase charging to achieve higher power level. However, the ability to charge from a single phase supply is also required. A dualmode OBC for EVs is proposed, which is capable of operating from both three-phase supply and single-phase supply. The single phase charging comes with the requirement of bulky DC link capacitance due to double frequency current in DC link. The proposed topology eliminates this by achieving Active Power Decoupling (APD) using only one additional relay switch and a small capacitor. The proposed topology is verified under different conditions in a detailed simulation, which shows more than an order of magnitude reduction in DC link capacitance during single phase operation.

</details>


### [285] [Low-Complexity Control Under Input Saturation and Performance Constraints: A Bidirectional Modification Scheme](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00827)
*Jinyu Ni,Xiucai Huang,George A. Rovithakis,Yamin Yan*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文针对一类受输入饱和与性能约束的高阶不确定强耦合MIMO非线性系统，提出了一种双向修正机制及无模型、无逼近、无复杂度爆炸的控制方案，并通过新颖的稳定性分析框架保证修正约束的满足与闭环信号的有界性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高阶级联MIMO非线性系统同时面临输入饱和与输出性能约束的挑战，二者之间存在潜在冲突——当饱和发生时，严格性能约束可能难以满足甚至导致控制失效；现有方法缺乏对约束与饱和之间动态关系的灵活处理机制。

Method: 构建双向修正机制：饱和发生时放松约束以缓解冲突；饱和结束后加速恢复原始约束；稳态阶段若饱和持续未激活，则进一步收紧约束以提升控制性能。在此基础上提出不依赖模型、不依赖逼近器、无复杂度爆炸问题的控制方案，并开发新颖的Lyapunov稳定性分析框架，仅需满足两个参数选择条件即可保证系统稳定性。

Result: 仿真结果验证了所提方法的有效性与优越性，表明该方案能够在输入饱和条件下维持性能约束的满足，并通过动态双向调节约束边界获得更好的控制性能。

Conclusion: 所提出的双向修正机制与控制方案有效解决了输入饱和与性能约束之间的冲突问题，为高阶级联不确定MIMO系统的输出跟踪提供了理论保障与实践验证。

Abstract: This article addresses the output tracking control problem for a class of high-order uncertain highly-coupled MIMO nonlinear systems subject to input saturation and performance constraints. To resolve the problem, a bidirectional modification mechanism is constructed, which is able to not only relax the constraints when saturation occurs to alleviate potential conflict, but also accelerate the recovery of original constraints after saturation ceases, and further tighten the constraints to enhance control performance if saturation remains inactive at the steadystate phase. Based on the mechanism, a model-, approximationand complexity-explosion-free control scheme is proposed. To bypass the obstacle in Lyapunov analysis, a novel stability analysis framework is developed, which, given that two parameter selection conditions are met, ensures satisfaction of modified constraints and boundedness of all closed-loop signals. Simulation results validate the effectiveness and superiority of the methodology.

</details>


### [286] [Lightweight CFR-Based Modulation Adaptation in a Real-Time MIMO-OFDM SDR Testbed](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00903)
*Luca Borst,Maryam Ansarifard,Ankith Vinayachandran,Kishor C. Joshi,George Exarchakos*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究在实时MIMO-OFDM系统中，使用信道频率响应（CFR）幅度描述符替代传统标量SNR进行调制选择。基于USRP测试平台采集87,817个OTA样本，评估DT、RF和KNN三种分类器，CFR特征比SNR大幅提升精度（最高82.8% vs 42%），深度为7的决策树可集成到LabVIEW C Node用于实时推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统链路自适应依赖SNR等标量链路质量指标，信息量有限；而完整CSI虽能提升自适应效果但处理复杂度高。需要寻找一种折中方案——既能提供比标量SNR更丰富的信道信息，又能在实时SDR系统中轻量实现。

Method: 在USRP测试平台采集87,817个OTA样本，从基站端接收的上行导频中提取CFR测量值。使用决策树（DT）、随机森林（RF）和K近邻（KNN）三种分类器，分别评估基于基站端SNR、CFR特征及其组合的调制选择性能。深度为7、123个叶节点的DT进一步集成到LabVIEW C Node实现实时推理。

Result: SNR-only分类器测试精度仅35%-42%；CFR-only特征达到DT 73.6%、RF 81.4%、KNN 80.0%的精度，RF最高达82.8%。CFR性能维持在接近10% BLER可靠性阈值附近。

Conclusion: 紧凑的基站端CFR描述符比可用的标量基站端SNR提供更具判别性的信息，同时适合轻量级SDR实现，为实时MIMO-OFDM系统中的调制选择提供了有效的低成本替代方案。

Abstract: Conventional link adaptation typically relies on scalar link-quality indicators such as signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), while richer channel state information (CSI) can improve adaptation at the cost of higher processing complexity. This paper investigates a compact alternative for modulation selection in a real-time multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) system using channel frequency response (CFR) magnitude descriptors. A dataset of 87,817 over-the-air (OTA) samples is collected using a USRP-based testbed, with CFR measurements extracted at the base station (BS) from received uplink pilots. Decision tree (DT), random forest (RF), and k-nearest neighbours (KNN) classifiers are evaluated using BS-side SNR, CFR features, and their combination. SNR-only classifiers achieve 35%-42% test accuracy, whereas CFR-only features achieve 73.6%, 81.4%, and 80.0% for DT, RF, and KNN, respectively. CFR-based performance is maintained near the 10% BLER reliability thresholds, with RF reaching 82.8%. A depth-7 DT with 123 leaves is further integrated into the LabVIEW C Node for real-time inference. The results show that compact BS-side CFR descriptors provide more discriminative information than the available scalar BS-side SNR while remaining suitable for lightweight SDR implementation.

</details>


### [287] [Geometric Fixed-Time Sliding Mode Control for Constrained Attitude Tracking on $\mathrm{SO}(3)$](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01211)
*Saumitra Barman,Shashi Ranjan Kumar,Rohit Gupta*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究SO(3)流形上考虑多重姿态指向约束和外部扰动的航天器姿态跟踪问题，提出基于内在几何分析的势函数方法，结合非奇异固定时间几何滑模控制，保证状态在允许子集内演化并在固定时间内收敛到期望平衡点附近的小邻域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际航天器姿态控制中，敏感器指向约束（如防止太阳直射）与外部扰动同时存在，需要在黎曼流形SO(3)上进行约束姿态跟踪。现有方法往往难以在保证约束满足的同时实现固定时间收敛，且存在奇异性问题。

Method: 1) 在SO(3)上内在构建姿态势函数，基于内在几何分析建立其关键性质；2) 在排除禁忌区域和测度零集的可允许子集上证明势函数在期望姿态处存在唯一非退化极小值；3) 通过黎曼Hessian分析证明期望姿态开邻域内Hessian局部一致正定，建立局部强凸性；4) 利用势函数的黎曼梯度构造非奇异固定时间几何滑模面，设计固定时间滑模约束姿态控制律。

Result: 对可允许子集中的每一个初始姿态，闭环状态轨迹在SO(3)×R^3上演化，姿态始终保持在可允许子集内，并在规定的固定时间内收敛到期望平衡点的一个足够小的紧致邻域。数值仿真验证了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 该研究在几何层面解决了带约束和扰动的航天器姿态跟踪问题，通过势函数的内在构造与黎曼几何分析，兼顾了约束保持、固定时间收敛和奇异规避，为工程应用提供了理论基础与可行方案。

Abstract: This paper studies constrained spacecraft attitude tracking on the Riemannian configuration manifold $\mathrm{SO}(3)$ in the presence of multiple attitude pointing constraints and matched external disturbances. To address this, an attitude potential function is proposed intrinsically on $\mathrm{SO}(3)$, and its key properties are established using intrinsic geometric analysis. Under mild conditions, the potential function is shown to admit a unique nondegenerate minimum at the desired attitude over the admissible subset of $\mathrm{SO}(3)$, defined by excluding the forbidden attitude regions as well as a measure-zero set, thereby ensuring a well-posed constrained attitude tracking problem. A Riemannian Hessian analysis shows that the Hessian of the potential function is locally uniform positive definite in an open neighborhood of the desired attitude, thereby establishing local strong convexity. A nonsingular fixed-time geometric sliding manifold is proposed using the Riemannian gradient of the potential function, leading to a geometric fixed-time sliding-mode-based constrained attitude control law. It is shown that, for every initial attitude in the admissible subset, the closed-loop state trajectory evolves on $\mathrm{SO}(3)\times\mathbb{R}^3$, with the attitude remaining in the admissible subset throughout the maneuver, while the state converges to a sufficiently small compact neighborhood of the desired equilibrium in a prescribed fixed time. Numerical simulations validate the proposed control approach and illustrate the theoretical results.

</details>


### [288] [Constructive Port-Hamiltonian Energy Shaping Design of Dispatchable Virtual Oscillators in Grid-Forming Converters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01349)
*Lu Gao,Lihui Yang,Feng Ji,Dong Liu,Longze Kou*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于耗散Port-Hamiltonian（PH）系统的电网形成控制框架，将传统的可调度虚拟振荡器控制（dVOC）的外环动力学统一为单一能量结构，从而同时实现幅值调节、同步和功率分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统dVOC虽然是一种基于无源性的电网形成控制方法，但其幅值调节、同步和功率分配相互耦合，无法自然地转化为耗散PH系统，缺乏统一的能量解释。这一理论缺口阻碍了PH框架下对dVOC的系统性分析和设计。

Method: 1. 利用Logistic型径向调节具有内在饱和类非线性的特性，证明其与二次储能相容的精确梯度分解是可行的；2. 在此基础上构造统一的成形Hamiltonian函数，同时封装幅值恢复与功率分配；3. 从该Hamiltonian推导出径向增益匹配条件，获得显式闭式参数不等式；4. 通过调节功率误差权重系数主动塑造能量景观，消除不希望的低压功率流解，保证收敛到期望的高压平衡点；5. 利用Hessian奇异性条件确定临界权重阈值，确保高压平衡点的唯一性。

Result: 该方法实现了几乎全局渐近稳定性和局部指数收敛，数值仿真验证了所提方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过将dVOC外环动力学重构为耗散PH系统，实现了幅值调节、同步和功率分配在统一能量框架下的整合，为基于PH理论的电网形成控制提供了更系统的分析和参数设计依据。

Abstract: Port-Hamiltonian (PH) theory offers a passivity-based framework for grid-forming control, yet conventional dispatchable virtual oscillator control (dVOC) does not naturally admit a dissipative PH realization, since its amplitude egulation, synchronization, and power dispatch are inherently coupled without a unified energy interpretation. This paper formulates the outer-loop dynamics as a dissipative PH system, thereby unifying amplitude regulation, synchronization, and power dispatch within one energy structure. The formulation rests on the key property that logistic-type radial regulation, characterized by an inherent saturation-like nonlinearity, permits an exact gradient decomposition compatible with the quadratic energy storage. On this basis, a unified shaped Hamiltonian is constructed, which encapsulates both amplitude restoration and power dispatch. Radial gain matching derived from this Hamiltonian yields explicit closed-form arameter inequalities that guarantee almost-global asymptotic stability and local exponential convergence. Moreover, tuning the power-error weighting coefficient actively shapes the energy landscape, thereby eliminating the undesirable low-voltage power-flow solution from the stationary set and ensuring convergence to the desired high-voltage equilibrium point. The Hessian singularity condition further provides the critical weight threshold that guarantees uniqueness of the high-voltage equilibrium. Numerical simulations validate the proposed method.

</details>


### [289] [Exact Risk-Complexity Laws for Projective Boundaries in Scenario Optimization and Distribution-Free Certification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01355)
*Giuseppe C. Calafiore*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文识别了场景优化、保形预测等无分布认证方法中条件违规风险服从beta分布背后的确定性边界机制，并推导了当观测边界大小为随机时对应的精确分布律。核心概念是"正常射影边界方案"（proper projective boundary scheme），其条件违规风险由边界的跨样本复杂度轮廓决定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典的无分布认证方法（如场景优化、保形预测）利用有限样本构造具有违规风险保证的决策或预测集。在多个经典设定中，条件违规风险服从精确的beta分布，其尾部具有beta-二项表示，参数是支持维、校准维或压缩维。本文试图找出这些公式背后统一的确定性边界机制，并将其推广到观测边界大小为随机的情形。

Method: 作者将决策规则表示为对未观测样本的接受集，配合一个边界映射来选择导致该接受集的样本点，二者构成"正常射影边界方案"。该方案要求：留出样本被接受当且仅当全样本边界被保留，且可删除被接受的非边界样本而不改变边界。对于每个这样的方案，给定观测边界大小下违规风险的条件分布由边界的跨样本复杂度轮廓决定——稳定的轮廓产生通常的beta分布，变化的轮廓则产生精确的轮廓修正。

Result: 该框架统一覆盖了标量序统计量校准、支持重构场景规划、级联支持移除证书、坐标包围盒以及带向量分数的Pareto前沿校准。此外还产生了条件概率证书，并给出了一个"不可行"（no-go）结果，解释了为何仅观测复杂度不足以提供完整的保证。

Conclusion: 本文建立了无分布认证方法中beta分布律的统一边界机制理论，将经典结果推广到随机边界大小情形，为条件概率保证提供了更精细的工具，同时揭示了单独依赖观测复杂度时的理论局限性。

Abstract: Scenario optimization, conformal prediction, and related distribution-free certification methods use finite samples to construct decisions or prediction sets with violation-risk guarantees for fresh observations. In several classical settings, the conditional violation risk follows an exact beta law, whose tail has a beta-binomial representation and whose parameter is a support, calibration, or compression dimension. This paper identifies the deterministic boundary mechanism behind these formulas and derives the corresponding law when the observed boundary size is random. A decision rule is represented by an acceptance set for future observations, together with a boundary map selecting the sample points responsible for that set. The resulting pair is called a {\em proper projective boundary scheme} when held-out samples are accepted precisely if the full-sample boundary is retained, and accepted non-boundary samples can be deleted without changing that boundary. For every such scheme, the conditional law of the violation risk given the observed boundary size is determined by the boundary's cross-sample complexity profile. A stable profile yields the usual beta law, whereas a varying profile produces an exact profile correction. The framework covers scalar order-statistic calibration, support-reconstructive scenario programs, cascaded support-removal certificates, coordinatewise envelopes, and Pareto-frontier calibration with vector scores. It also yields conditional probabilistic certificates and a no-go result explaining why observed complexity alone is insufficient.

</details>


### [290] [Equivalent DQ Sequence-Domain Model of Unbalanced Three-Phase Passive Elements for Power Converter Controllers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01396)
*Air\án Franc\és,Luis Saz,Rafael Castillo,Dionisio Ramirez,Javier Uceda*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出了非平衡三相无源元件在dq序列域中的等效模型，该模型能够考虑零序与正序、负序之间的交互作用，并通过解析推导和图解方法呈现，实验结果验证了所提模型的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的三相无源阻抗dq0等效模型假设各相阻抗相同，但在三相阻抗不对称的场景下该假设不成立，会在dq0分量中产生二次谐波，削弱dq0变换的优势。现有文献中仅少数研究推导了非平衡三相无源元件的序列域等效模型，且均无法考虑零序与正序、负序之间的交互作用。

Method: 利用Fortescue定理将任何非平衡三相信号表示为三个对称序列的线性组合，并通过解析推导和直观图解两种方式，推导非平衡三相无源元件在dq序列域中的等效模型，特别考虑零序与正序、负序之间的耦合关系。

Result: 成功推导出能够表征非平衡三相无源元件在序列域中完整交互行为的等效模型，并通过实验结果验证了所提模型的正确性。

Conclusion: 本文填补了非平衡三相无源元件序列域等效模型中零序与正序、负序交互作用的研究空白，为三相逆变器和整流器控制器在非平衡场景下的同步坐标系设计提供了更完善的建模基础。

Abstract: Equivalent dq0 models of three-phase passive impedances are widely used for the design of three-phase inverter and rectifier controllers in the synchronous frame. However, these equivalent models assume that the impedance in each phase are the same, which is not always applicable. The fact that the impedance in each phase is different, generates second order harmonic content in the dq0 components, which hinders the advantages of the dq0 transformation. To avoid the second harmonic in these scenarios, it is possible to use the Fortescue's theorem to represent any asymmetrical set of three-phase signals as a linear combination of three symmetrical sequences. In the literature, only a few works have attempted to derive the equivalent model of unbalanced three-phase passive elements in the sequence domain, and none is able to account for the interaction between the zero sequence and the positive and negative sequences. This work presents the derivation of the equivalent dq sequence-domain model of unbalanced three-phase passive elements both analytically and with an intuitive graphical approach. Experimental results are shown to validate the proposed models.

</details>


### [291] [Blackbox Small-Signal Modeling of Grid-Connected Inverters in Asymmetrical Power Grids](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01411)
*Airan Frances,Dionisio Ramirez,Javier Uceda*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文提出一种在序域（sequence domain）中表示并网三相逆变器动态行为的黑箱建模新结构，适用于非对称条件，并通过不对称电压跌落实验验证了模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电力电子变换器在现代配电系统中至关重要，但基于电力电子的系统可能表现出动态交互并引发电能质量问题。系统级分析需要各元件的电气模型，然而商业变换器的电气模型通常不可得。现有黑箱建模策略主要针对直流变换器，扩展到三相变换器的dq框架方法仅适用于对称和平衡条件，缺乏处理非对称工况的能力。

Method: 提出一种基于序域（sequence domain）的新黑箱模型结构，用于表示非对称条件下并网商业三相逆变器的动态行为。通过对三相逆变器进行实验测试来辨识其黑箱模型。

Result: 在三相逆变器上完成了黑箱模型辨识实验，并在不对称电压跌落条件下验证了所提出模型的有效性和性能。

Conclusion: 所提出的序域黑箱建模结构能够有效表征非对称条件下并网三相逆变器的动态行为，弥补了现有dq框架方法仅适用于对称平衡条件的局限。

Abstract: Power electronic converters are envisaged to be key enablers of modern electric power distribution systems. Grid-connected three-phase inverters are widely used in Smart Grids and microgrids, but also in standard grids. They provide controllability and dynamic decoupling capabilities, which are fundamental in the integration of renewable sources and storage systems and in specialized applications such as FACTS. Nevertheless, power electronics-based systems can exhibit dynamic interactions, which may lead to power quality issues. Although the electrical model of each element of these systems is important for their system-level analysis, they are rarely available. Blackbox modeling strategies are useful for obtaining behavioral models of commercial electronic converters. Most blackbox modeling strategies are focused on dc-dc electronic converters; however, some works have extended these concepts to three-phase converters by means of the dq framework, under the assumption of symmetrical and balanced conditions. This work proposes a new structure in the sequence domain to represent the dynamic behavior of grid-connected commercial converters in asymmetrical conditions. Experimental tests have been performed on a three-phase inverter to identify its blackbox model and its performance has been validated during an asymmetric voltage sag.

</details>


### [292] [Stability of Droop-Controlled Low-Frequency Transmission Lines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01571)
*Rafael Castillo-Sierra,Giri Venkataramanan,Dionisio Ramirez*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 本文研究了采用降载控制策略的低频交流（LFAC）输电系统的小信号稳定性。通过特征值分析，考察了控制器降载增益、运行频率、输电线路参数及运行点对系统稳定性的影响。结果显示系统动态由交流/交流变换器降载增益之和主导，并提出了分析结果揭示线路长度、R/X比、运行频率和电压对临界稳定点的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LFAC输电系统凭借功率变换器被广泛应用于多种场景，但其小信号稳定性尚缺乏系统研究，特别是降载控制策略下系统参数对稳定性的影响机制需要深入理解。

Method: 采用特征值分析法，研究LFAC输电线路在降载控制策略下的小信号稳定性。考察降载增益、运行频率、线路参数和运行点等变量对系统稳定性的影响，并推导出各参数影响临界稳定点的解析结果。

Result: 系统整体动态由AC/AC变换器降载增益之和决定；线路长度、线路R/X比、运行频率和电压均会影响系统稳定性。

Conclusion: 该研究为LFAC输电系统在降载控制下的参数设计和稳定性优化提供了理论指导，明确了影响临界稳定点的关键参数及其作用规律。

Abstract: Low-Frequency AC (LFAC) transmission systems employing power converters are being considered for a varity of applications. This work studies the small-signal stability of an LFAC transmission line controlled by the Droop Control Strategy. Eigenvalue Analysis is used to determine how the controller droop gains, operating frequency, transmission line parameters, and the operating point affect system stability. The results show that the overall system's dynamic is governed by the sum of the droop gains of the AC/AC converters. Analytical results that give insights on how the different system's parameters affect the critical stability point are presented. The results indicate that system stability is affected by the line's length, the line's R/X ratio, operating frequency and voltage.

</details>


<div id='econ.EM'></div>

# econ.EM [[Back]](#toc)

### [293] [Manipulation Testing in Boundary Discontinuity Designs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00350)
*Federico A. Bugni,Federico Crippa,Daniel Restrepo*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文提出了首个适用于一般边界形状的边界不连续设计（BDD）的操纵检验方法，通过k-means聚类将边界附近的观测值分组，利用每组内处理组与控制组近似均匀分布的平衡性进行二项检验，避免了多维密度估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 回归不连续设计（RDD）在多维拓展（BDD）中，现有的操纵检验方法通常需要估计多维密度函数，这在一般情况下（尤其是复杂边界形状）极具挑战性且不稳定。当前缺乏一种能够处理一般边界形状且计算简便的操纵检验方法。

Method: 该方法基于关键洞察：在没有操纵的情况下，边界附近的观测值在任意由边界投影定义的组内应在处理组与控制组之间近似均匀分布。据此，作者利用k-means聚类对边界附近的观测值进行分组，然后在每个组内进行二项平衡检验，形成一组检验统计量。

Result: 在合适的正则条件下建立了检验的渐近有效性；通过蒙特卡洛模拟评估了有限样本表现；并在三个实证应用中展示了方法的实用性。

Conclusion: 该检验为一般边界形状的BDD提供了一种无需多维密度估计的操纵检验方法，弥补了该领域的空白，具有广泛的适用性和可操作性。

Abstract: We propose the first manipulation test designed for boundary discontinuity designs (BDDs) with general boundary shapes. A BDD is a multidimensional extension of the regression discontinuity design (RDD) in which treatment assignment is determined by whether the multidimensional running variable crosses a lower-dimensional boundary set. The test avoids multivariate density estimation and builds on the observation that, in the absence of manipulation, observations near the boundary should be approximately evenly split between treatment and control within arbitrary groups defined by their projections onto the boundary. We test this implication using a collection of binomial balance tests on observations near the boundary, with groups formed by k-means clustering. We establish the asymptotic validity of the test under suitable regularity conditions. We also evaluate finite-sample performance through Monte Carlo simulations and illustrate the test in three empirical applications.

</details>


### [294] [Residential Price Modeling using Spatially Validated Machine Learning Methods: A Comparison Across Geographic Contexts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00375)
*Usman Ahmed,Jason Hawkins*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本研究使用XGBoost和随机森林模型，对比巴基斯坦拉瓦尔品第/伊斯兰堡大都市区与加拿大多伦多两个截然不同的城市环境下，土地利用与交通基础设施对住宅价格的影响。研究发现两城市在交通设施与便利设施对房价影响上呈现相似模式：靠近城市核心区及高质量轨道交通（地铁、BRT）提升房价，而靠近常规公交站则降低房价。此外，非空间交叉验证会高估空间数据的预测精度，XGBoost表现略优于随机森林。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 土地利用与交通基础设施紧密关联，住宅价格在交通规划中起核心作用；同时交通投资也反过来影响房产价值，使得两者联动预测成为一项重要的跨学科研究挑战。作者希望探索不同城市背景下机器学习方法对住宅价格建模的适用性。

Method: 采用XGBoost和随机森林两种机器学习模型，评估土地利用与交通基础设施对住宅价格的影响；对比非空间与空间交叉验证以检验模型对空间数据的预测表现；使用SHAP值解释各特征的贡献影响。研究区域为巴基斯坦拉瓦尔品第/伊斯兰堡大都市区（发展中国家）与加拿大多伦多（发达国家）。

Result: 尽管两城市在人口统计与经济发展水平上差异显著，但交通基础设施和本地便利设施对房价的影响模式相似：靠近主要城市核心区提高售价，高质量快速公交（地铁、BRT）提升价格，而靠近常规公交站则降低价格。非空间交叉验证会高估空间数据集的预测精度，XGBoost整体略优于随机森林。

Conclusion: 作者建议在对空间依赖的土地价格数据应用机器学习方法时需谨慎，应使用空间交叉验证以获取更可靠的预测精度评估。

Abstract: Land use and transportation infrastructure are tightly linked systems, and residential property prices play a central role in transportation planning. Transportation investments also influence property values, making accurate forecasting of both systems an interconnected research challenge. This study examines these interactions and evaluates machine learning methods for modeling residential real estate prices across contrasting urban contexts. We use XGBoost and Random Forest models to assess how land use and transportation infrastructure shape dwelling prices, comparing results between the Rawalpindi and Islamabad Metropolitan Area in Pakistan and the City of Toronto in Canada. We also examine the performance of machine learning models on spatial data by comparing nonspatial and spatial cross validation, and use SHAP values to interpret feature impacts. Despite differences in demographics and economic development, both cities show similar effects of transportation infrastructure and local amenities on prices. Proximity to major urban cores increases sale price, while high quality transit such as subway and bus rapid transit raises prices and conventional bus stop proximity lowers them. Nonspatial cross validation overestimates predictive accuracy for spatial datasets. XGBoost performs slightly better than Random Forest. We recommend careful application of machine learning methods when modeling spatially dependent land price data.

</details>


### [295] [LPG Subsidy Reform, Energy Compensation, and Social Risk in Bolivia: A Machine-Learning Agent-Based Microsimulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00414)
*Ricardo Alonzo Fernández Salguero*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本研究利用机器学习驱动的智能体微观模拟框架，评估了玻利维亚液化石油气(LPG)补贴改革的多种替代设计方案，比较了无补偿取消补贴、固定能源转移、全额补偿、代金券、母婴转移、清洁能源转型工具包及混合政策包等方案，发现全额货币补偿Q1-Q2低收入LPG用户既能显著降低社会损害又能保留大量财政节省，且优于代金券设计；最具社会稳健性的方案是组合定向货币能源补偿、母婴强化支持与固体燃料家庭的清洁能源工具包。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 玻利维亚面临普遍LPG补贴改革的迫切需求，但如何在财政节省与社会保护之间取得平衡缺乏系统性评估。需要同时考虑财政、贫困、能源替代、行政成本和社会风险等多维度的量化分析框架。

Method: 构建机器学习辅助的智能体微观模拟框架：整合家庭调查数据、支出数据、人口健康数据及月度碳氢化合物生产与商业化数据；用机器学习模型学习家庭脆弱性、燃料使用模式、粮食不安全风险和行为倾向；在月度智能体模拟中评估多种LPG补贴改革场景。

Result: 无补偿的补贴取消产生最大财政节省但增加贫困、极度贫困及固态燃料替代压力；Q1-Q2 LPG用户的全面货币补偿在保留显著财政节省的同时大幅减少社会损害，并在正常市场条件下因较低的行政摩擦优于等效代金券方案；综合定向货币能源补偿、母婴强化与清洁能源工具包的混合设计最具社会稳健性。

Conclusion: 研究支持以有针对性、行政精简且行为知情的补偿机制逐步替代普遍LPG补贴，为发展中国家能源补贴改革提供了可复制的方法论与政策评估证据。

Abstract: This study evaluates alternative designs for reforming Bolivia's liquefied petroleum gas subsidy using a machine-learning agent-based microsimulation framework. The analysis harmonizes household survey data, expenditure data, demographic and health information, and monthly hydrocarbon production and commercialization series to simulate fiscal savings, poverty effects, energy substitution, administrative costs, and social risks under multiple reform scenarios. The model compares uncompensated subsidy removal, fixed energy transfers, full compensation for vulnerable LPG users, voucher-based compensation, maternal-child transfers, clean-energy transition kits, and hybrid policy packages. Machine-learning models are used to learn household vulnerability, fuel-use patterns, food insecurity risk, and behavioral propensities that feed into a monthly agent-based simulation. The results show that eliminating the subsidy without compensation generates the largest fiscal savings but increases poverty, extreme poverty, and pressure toward solid-fuel substitution. Full monetary compensation for Q1-Q2 LPG users substantially reduces social harm while preserving significant fiscal savings and dominates an equivalent voucher design under normal market conditions because of lower administrative friction. The most socially robust design combines targeted monetary energy compensation, maternal-child reinforcement, and clean-energy kits for households using solid fuels. The findings support a gradual replacement of the universal LPG subsidy with targeted, administratively lean, and behaviorally informed compensation mechanisms.

</details>


### [296] [Was Stalin Necessary? Counterfactual Evidence on Soviet Growth](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00418)
*Fernández Salguero,Ricardo Alonzo*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文评估1928年后苏联经济的超常增长是否必须用斯大林体制来解释，通过一系列越来越严格的反事实比较而非单一二元对比来回答这一历史问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统研究往往将实际增长与单一替代方案进行二元比较，无法充分检验"斯大林体制是否具有历史必然性"这一强假设。作者希望构建更严谨的方法论框架来评估该增长是否必须归因于特定的斯大林主义制度。

Method: 结合Global Macro Database和Maddison Project的长期产出数据，运用合成控制、增强合成控制、合成双重差分、交互因子模型、矩阵补全、预测基准、历史类比、时空安慰剂、供体扰动、端点敏感性检验以及独立的苏联国民账户重建等多种方法。方法贡献在于修正了新经济政策反事实：不以1922-1928年快速恢复的外推为基础，而是将恢复缺口建模为以1914年前趋势为锚的自举过程，并以战后俄罗斯产出缺口的收敛进行校准。

Result: 俄罗斯核心地区估计在所有端点上超过中位数可行前沿，并从1930年代中期起超过第90百分位前沿；而更广泛的苏联领土总体估计则更为保守。供体扰动保持了正的俄罗斯核心溢价，但有限的安慰剂样本、不完美的预处理拟合、与恢复相关的假阳性、资料来源依赖及不利上界限制了强历史必然性主张的成立。

Conclusion: 证据支持存在条件下的增长溢价，但并不能将斯大林体制识别为唯一具有制度可行性的发展路径。

Abstract: This article evaluates whether the exceptionally rapid growth of the Russian and Soviet economy after 1928 requires a specifically Stalinist explanation. The analysis treats this historical question as a sequence of increasingly demanding counterfactual comparisons rather than a binary comparison between observed growth and a single alternative. Long run output series from the Global Macro Database and the Maddison Project are combined with synthetic control, augmented synthetic control, synthetic difference in differences, interactive factor models, matrix completion, prediction benchmarks, historical analogues, spatial and temporal placebos, donor pool perturbations, endpoint sensitivity, and independent Soviet national account reconstructions. A key methodological contribution is a revised New Economic Policy counterfactual. Instead of extrapolating the rapid recovery observed from 1922 to 1928, the analysis models the recovery gap as a bootstrap process anchored to the pre 1914 trend and calibrated using the observed postwar closure of the Russian output gap. The Russian core estimates exceed the median admissible frontier at every endpoint and surpass the main 90th percentile frontier from the mid 1930s onward, whereas the broader Soviet territorial aggregate remains more conservative. Donor perturbations preserve a positive Russian core premium, but the limited placebo sample, imperfect pretreatment fit, recovery related false positives, source dependence, and hostile upper bounds prevent strong claims of historical necessity. The evidence supports a conditional growth premium but does not identify Stalin as the only institutionally feasible path.

</details>


### [297] [Which Policy Works, and Where? Estimation and Inference for State-Level Treatment Effects in Difference-in-Differences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01467)
*Nichole Austin,Sunny R. Karim,Erin Strumpf,Matthew D. Webb*

Main category: econ.EM

TL;DR: 本文探讨了在共同目标和实施日期下，不同细节或情境的政策差异。作者区分了总体平均处理效应（ATT）与按实施队列、辖区、时期或政策类型定义的子总体ATT，并提出两种DiD估计量（UN-DID和DID-INT）来构建辖区-时间效应，在匹配聚合层面的平行趋势假设下估计这些ATT。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在政策评估中，即使政策有共同目标和实施日期，其实施细节或情境背景可能不同。研究者需要对政策效应进行分解，区分总体ATT和按不同维度（队列、辖区、时期、类型）聚合的子ATT，以确保估计目标和推断方法与实际政策问题和实施情境相匹配。

Method: 提出两种双重差分（DiD）估计量：UN-DID和DID-INT，它们通过构建辖区-时间效应来估计总体ATT和子总体ATT，并在与聚合层级相匹配的平行趋势假设下进行推断。在CPS（当期人口调查）安慰剂法律模拟中，使用随机化推断来检验检验的尺寸（size）性质，并评估jackknife方法的表现。

Result: 在CPS安慰剂法律模拟中，随机化推断通常具有良好（well-sized）的检验尺寸，但某些辖区特定检验偏保守。Jackknife方法在子总体ATT中可能未定义；当可定义时，在只有少量处理或对照辖区的情况下会出现过度拒绝（over-rejection）的问题。

Conclusion: 研究强调估计目标（estimand）和推断方法应当与具体政策问题和实施情境相匹配，以避免错误推断。不同层面的ATT需要对应的估计量和恰当的推断策略。

Abstract: Policies with a common objective and implementation date may differ in details or context. We distinguish the aggregate average treatment effect on the treated (ATT) from sub-aggregate ATTs defined by implementation cohort, jurisdiction, period, or policy type. UN-DID and DID-INT, two DiD estimators that construct jurisdiction-by-time effects, estimate these ATTs under parallel-trends conditions matched to the aggregation. In CPS placebo-law simulations, randomization inference is generally well-sized, though some jurisdiction-specific tests are conservative. The jackknife can be undefined for sub-aggregate ATTs; when defined, it over-rejects with few treated or comparison jurisdictions. Estimands and inference methods should match the policy question and implementation setting.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [298] [Agentic Empirical Asset Pricing: Methodological Foundations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00731)
*Yingjian Pan,Xiaowei Ding,Kay Giesecke*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"代理式实证资产定价"(AEAP)新范式——由LLM智能体自主完成科学发现过程的资产定价系统，并聚焦因子发现，提出了参考架构、严格的因子评估标准以及发现系统的样本外回测方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有评估实践只对输出（因子或交易）进行回测，而忽略了产生这些输出的自主发现系统本身。缺乏对AI驱动因子发现系统的系统性评估标准。

Method: 提出AEAP的参考架构与多维评估标准；以SEADS为具体实例，在两组美国股票面板上与五个重新实现的基线对比；引入滚动重执行的样本外方法评估发现过程本身的可靠性。

Result: 没有单一指标能够一致地对各系统进行排名，因此需要在多个维度上同时评估；滚动重执行揭示发现过程的可靠性问题；同时报告了负面发现及暴露出的更多评估陷阱。

Conclusion: 评估发现系统本身而非仅输出结果至关重要，AEAP研究需要多轴评估与样本外流程验证，未来系统应警惕论文中揭示的评估陷阱。

Abstract: Recent advances in LLM agents enable a new paradigm for asset pricing, which we call Agentic Empirical Asset Pricing (AEAP): systems that autonomously conduct the scientific discovery process itself. We define AEAP and identify its core building blocks. Existing evaluation practices backtest only the outputs (factors or trades), not the autonomous discovery system that produced them. We focus on factor discovery, contributing a reference architecture, a rigorous evaluation standard for discovered factors, and a method for out-of-sample backtesting the discovery system. As a concrete instance of that architecture, we evaluate SEADS against five re-implemented baselines on two US equity panels using this standard: no single metric ranks the systems consistently, motivating evaluation on multiple axes at once. A separate rolling re-execution then asks the complementary question of whether the discovery process itself, not one static output, is reliable. We also report negative findings and limitations that surface further evaluation pitfalls for future AEAP systems.

</details>


### [299] [HyperWorld: Hypergraph-Structured State Serialization Improves Learned Textual World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00002)
*Yun-Jian Zhang,Chen-Wei Liang,Tian-Yi Zhang,Jian Ding,Yi-Lun Wu,Ao-Bo Li,Wei-Cong Su,Saifullah,Hong-Yu An,Mu-Jiang-Shan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出HyperWorld，一项关于状态序列化方式对文本世界模型学习影响的控制研究。比较原始观测与三种符号序列化（独立句子、成对三元组、以实体为中心的超边单元），发现在超边序列化下，中小规模模型（0.5B-1.5B）和分布外场景中效果最佳，能提升行动可行性检测与效果预测的平衡性及下游规划成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言代理智能体在文本环境中需要从序列化的状态描述中学习符号动作效果，但序列化结构对世界模型学习的影响尚未被充分探索。

Method: 设计HyperWorld控制研究，将相同的真实状态分别序列化为原始观测、独立句子、成对三元组、实体中心超边单元共四种表示。所有变体使用相同的训练目标：给定状态和动作，预测符号效果或判断动作不可行。在多个模型规模、数据预算、分布内与分布外测试世界中进行对比。

Result: 超边序列化在0.5B-1.5B规模模型和分布偏移条件下带来最明显增益；更大模型缩小了表示间的差距；成对三元组在分布内精确匹配上可匹敌或略优于超边，但超边在分布外事实F1和中小规模可行性检测与效果预测权衡上表现最佳；下游贪心规划中超边世界模型成功率最高。

Conclusion: 高阶状态组织（超边）是一种简单而有效的归纳偏置，尤其当模型容量有限或测试环境与训练分布不同时，能显著提升符号世界模型的学习效果。

Abstract: World models enable language-model agents to predict environment dynamics and plan before acting. In text environments, the model must learn symbolic action effects from serialized state descriptions, but the role of serialization structure remains underexplored. We present HyperWorld, a controlled study of state serialization for learned textual world models. We compare raw observations with three symbolic serializations of the same ground-truth state: independent sentences, pairwise triples, and entity-centered hyperedge units that group multiple related facts around entities and relations. All variants use the same training objective: given a state and an action, predict symbolic effects or judge the action infeasible. Across model scales, data budgets, and in-distribution and out-of-distribution test worlds, hyperedge serialization gives the clearest gains for 0.5B--1.5B models and under distribution shift. Larger models reduce the gap, and pairwise triples can match or slightly exceed hyperedges on in-distribution exact match, but hyperedges achieve the strongest out-of-distribution fact F1 and the best small-to-medium scale trade-off between feasibility detection and effect prediction. In downstream greedy planning, the hyperedge world model also attains the highest success rate among the tested representations.
