Moreover, QFL is non-trivially challenging because several QNN parameters are periodic angles, where Euclidean averaging often fails to capture the inherent dynamics. We develop a novel self-consistent midpoint aggregation method for stable QFL design and implementation. We combine QoS-aware client weighting, circular parameter aggregation, and bounded midpoint-based update control. We perform several angular tests and IBM real Quantum machines experiments for validation confirming our approach. Extensive evaluations and experiments on medical and financial datasets show improved stability, lower volatility, and competitive accuracy.

</details>


### [334] [Dr. Claw: An AI Scientist Workspace for Vibe Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00365)
*Dingjie Song,Hanrong Zhang,Dawei Liu,Yixin Liu,Zongxia Li,Zhengqing Yuan,Siqi Zhang,Henry Peng Zou,Zhiling Yan,Yuxuan Zhang,Yanfang Ye,Philip S. Yu,Lichao Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Dr. Claw 是一个开源工作区，它不引入新的自主智能体，而是将现有编码智能体执行器封装在可控、可审计的人机协同工作流中，通过持久化状态对象、可复用技能库和多执行器协调，将规划、执行与写作整合为可追踪、可恢复的闭环。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管命令行编码智能体已能读写文件并支持长会话，但端到端研究仍分散于聊天工具、IDE、终端和写作环境之间，且关键的决策过程很少被保留，导致研究过程难以审计和重构。

Method: 提出 Dr. Claw 开源工作区，核心设计包括：1) 包装现有编码智能体执行器，而非另造自主智能体；2) 引入持久化状态对象记录决策；3) 构建可复用的技能库；4) 支持多执行器协调。全部封装在人机协同（human-in-the-loop）工作流中，形成可追踪、可恢复的统一循环。

Result: 通过交互式三视图场景和故障恢复演示验证功能；在与共享同一后端执行器的裸命令行智能体对比实验中，固定执行器不变的情况下，Dr. Claw 在研究完整性上得分更高，同时保留了可审计、可恢复的过程轨迹。

Conclusion: Dr. Claw 证明可通过编排层（任务图、状态对象、技能库）而非替换底层执行器来增强编码智能体的可靠性、完整性与可审计性，使研究过程可追踪、可恢复。

Abstract: Command-line coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Gemini CLI) can already read and write files and sustain long sessions, yet end-to-end research still fragments across chat tools, IDEs, terminals, and writing environments, and the decisions that make it auditable are rarely preserved. We present Dr. Claw, an open-source workspace that wraps existing coding-agent executors in a controllable and auditable human-in-the-loop workflow rather than introducing another autonomous agent. Persistent state objects, a reusable skill library, and multi-executor coordination link human decisions to AI execution, turning planning, execution, and writing into one traceable, recoverable loop. We demonstrate Dr. Claw through an interactive three-view scenario and a failure-recovery walkthrough, and evaluate it against a bare command-line agent sharing the same backend executor, so the comparison contrasts the whole orchestration layer (task graph, state objects, and skill library) with the agent it wraps. Holding the executor fixed, Dr. Claw scores higher on research completeness while persisting an auditable, recoverable process trail. Demo access: repository https://github.com/OpenLAIR/dr-claw, released under AGPL-3.0 with GPL-3.0 upstream components.

</details>


### [335] [Dependency-Aware Chain-of-Thought Compression for Financial Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00413)
*Wenjun Wu,Lei Fu,Kejian Tong,Tao Ning,Sichen Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出HSDN（层次语义蒸馏网络），用于压缩金融领域的思维链推理过程，在保持答案准确性和逻辑连贯性的同时大幅降低推理成本。在AFAC2025基准上实现91.0%准确率与68.4%压缩率，优于现有压缩基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 思维链提示虽能提升复杂推理能力，但其冗长的中间推理轨迹导致高昂的推理成本，阻碍了金融场景中的实际部署。作者旨在解决这一效率与质量之间的权衡问题。

Method: 框架包含五个核心模块：语义分割、依赖图构建、双编码器重要性评分、约束段选择以及局部边界重写。使用冻结的Qwen3 4B模型仅用于特征提取和最终答案生成，压缩过程保持结构化和可解释性。

Result: 在AFAC2025基准上，HSDN达到91.0%准确率和68.4%压缩率，在总体评分和推理连贯性上均优于强压缩基线。

Conclusion: 实验结果表明，基于图引导的压缩方法对高风险金融推理任务有效，能在显著压缩推理链的同时保持答案质量。

Abstract: Chain of thought prompting improves complex reasoning, but its long intermediate traces create substantial inference cost and hinder practical deployment in financial settings. We present a Hierarchical Semantic Distillation Network, HSDN, for compressing reasoning chains while preserving answer accuracy and logical coherence. The framework combines semantic segmentation, dependency graph construction, dual encoder importance scoring, constrained segment selection, and local boundary rewriting. A frozen Qwen3 4B model is used only for feature extraction and final answer generation, while the compression process remains structured and interpretable. On the AFAC2025 benchmark, HSDN achieves 91.0% accuracy with 68.4% compression, outperforming strong compression baselines in overall score and reasoning coherence. The results show that graph guided compression is effective for high stakes financial reasoning tasks.

</details>


### [336] [SpecMind: Enabling Spectrum Intelligence via Multi-Agent Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00427)
*Songwei Dong,Bingyan Lu,Makayla Kienlen,J. Nicholas Laneman,Cong Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SpecMind，一个面向频谱智能的多智能体检索增强生成（RAG）系统，能够对政策文件、法规和许可数据库等异构数据源进行推理，并配套构建了SpecBench问答数据集。实验表明SpecMind在频谱相关任务上优于传统通用RAG系统，胜率超过80%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无线设备爆炸式增长带来前所未有的频谱需求，频谱管理需要更细粒度的空间、时间和设备约束决策。频谱政策制定者和工程师需要处理来自多种来源、多种形式（文本、表格等）的大量数据，这些数据源通常是分散的，整合、搜索和解释耗时费力，且大部分信息面向人类理解，难以被自动化系统直接访问。

Method: 提出SpecMind，一种新颖的多智能体RAG系统，使自主智能体能够协调专门子智能体在政策程序、法律法规和许可数据库中进行检索与知识综合。同时开发了基于真实许可记录和政策程序的SpecBench问答数据集，填补频谱领域RAG系统评估资源的空白。

Result: 实验表明SpecMind在频谱相关任务上优于传统通用RAG系统，对强基线实现超过80%的胜率。智能体设计实现了更准确的检索、更好的上下文推理以及更优的任务完成度。

Conclusion: 多智能体架构设计使系统在异构数据源上的频谱情报任务中展现了显著优势，验证了智能体协同在专业化RAG系统中的有效性。

Abstract: The exponential growth of wireless devices is driving unprecedented spectrum demand, pushing spectrum management toward more fine-grained decisions across space, time, and device constraints. As a result, spectrum policymakers and engineers must process large volumes of data that come from diverse sources and take many different forms, such as text and tables. These data sources are often disaggregated and require significant time and effort to integrate, search, and interpret. Furthermore, most of this information is formatted for human understanding and is not readily accessible to automated systems. To address this challenge, we propose SpecMind, a novel Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system for spectrum intelligence that performs reasoning over heterogeneous data sources. This system enables autonomous agents to coordinate specialized sub-agents that retrieve and synthesize knowledge across policy proceedings, legal regulations, and license databases. We develop SpecBench, a question and answer (Q&A) dataset based on real-world license records and policy proceedings, addressing the lack of evaluation resources for RAG systems in the spectrum domain. Experimental results demonstrate that SpecMind outperforms traditional, general-purpose RAG systems across spectrum-related tasks, achieving over 80% win rate against strong baselines. The agent-based design enables more accurate retrieval, better contextual reasoning, and improved task completion across diverse query types.

</details>


### [337] [SAGE: State-Grounded, Abstention-Aware Evaluation of Task-Oriented Dialogue Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00434)
*Rayan Khoury,Shih-Yao Lin,Pratyush Mishra*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SAGE（State-Grounded Abstention-Aware Evaluation），一种面向任务型对话智能体的状态级评估方法。它将工作流规范和每轮状态差异编译为原子化、基于模式的标准，并通过级联的符号验证器和编码器/NLI验证器进行路由，这些验证器在无法确定时选择弃权而非猜测。SAGE-Core能以零付费LLM成本处理81-91%的标准，在多个数据集切片上不逊于甚至优于所有LLM-as-judge基线，同时成本极低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统整体式LLM评判器将可用上下文作为一个整体单元评估，会遗漏轮次是否正确推进底层工作流状态这一关键区别。此外，每轮需要一次或多次完整模型调用，成本高昂。

Method: SAGE将工作流规范和每轮状态差异编译为原子化、基于模式的标准，每个标准通过编译器、符号规则、设备端编码器的级联进行路由，验证器可弃权而非猜测，最终将标准判定聚合成带证据轨迹的轮次级决策。SAGE-Core仅用编译器、符号规则和编码器（零LLM成本），SAGE-LLM增加可选的聚焦LLM回退以处理开放类别标准。

Result: 在MultiWOZ、Schema-Guided Dialogue和ABCD四个切片上，没有任何LLM-as-judge基线（包括状态感知的GPT-4.1评判器和更便宜的GPT-4.1-mini变体）在任何切片上显著超过SAGE-Core。GPT-4.1 G-Eval每千轮成本为$4.7-8.0，而SAGE-Core为$0。双标注者人工审计（n=200, κ=0.94）确认了标签保真度。

Conclusion: SAGE证明了通过符号化编译、设备端验证器与弃权机制的组合，可以在零LLM成本下达到甚至超越昂贵LLM评判器的评估质量。研究也诚实指出了构造效度的局限，包括注入失败和部分符号循环性。

Abstract: Evaluating task-oriented dialogue agents requires judging not merely whether a reply reads well but whether each turn advances the underlying workflow state correctly--a distinction conventional holistic LLM judges can miss because they evaluate the available context as a single unit and require one or more full-model calls per turn. We propose SAGE (State-Grounded Abstention-Aware Evaluation), which compiles a workflow specification and per-turn state diff into atomic, schema-grounded criteria and routes each through a cascade of symbolic and encoder/NLI verifiers that abstain rather than guess, aggregating criterion verdicts into a turn-level decision with an evidence trace. Its recommended operating point, SAGE-Core, decides 81--91% of criteria with only the compiler, symbolic rules, and on-device encoders--at zero paid LLM cost--while SAGE-LLM adds an optional focused-LLM fallback for open-class criteria. Across four slices spanning MultiWOZ, Schema-Guided Dialogue, and ABCD, no evaluated LLM-as-a-judge baseline--including a state-aware GPT-4.1 judge and cheaper GPT-4.1-mini variants--significantly exceeds SAGE-Core on any slice, even though the GPT-4.1 G-Eval judge costs $4.7--8.0 per 1,000 turns to SAGE-Core's $0. A two-annotator human audit (n=200, $κ$=0.94) confirms strong label fidelity on the transcript-visible failure classes--where, excluding the weak-salience IUV class, SAGE-Core is statistically tied with the strongest LLM judge--and honestly scopes ignored-user-value as a state-consistency signal with weak broad-human salience. We analyze construct-validity limits from injected failures and partial symbolic circularity.

</details>


### [338] [Conversation Coach: A Voice-enabled AI System that Helps Practice Difficult Workplace Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00441)
*Fanyou Wu,Suraj Maharjan,Ainur Yessenalina,Dennis Xu Chen,Rahul Srivastava,Srinivasan H. Sengamedu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Conversation Coach，一个语音优先的AI系统，帮助管理者以真实口语形式排练困难的职场对话。系统解决了低延迟交互、可配置机器人个性模拟不同员工类型、以及生成个性化反馈三个挑战。作者比较了端到端语音到语音模型与级联方法（ASR+LLM+TTS），发现端到端方法延迟低3倍、成本低8倍，但级联方法推理能力更优。级联架构已在生产中部署，超过4万名管理者使用半年。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有效的管理者-员工沟通对留住高绩效人员和培养低绩效人员至关重要，但培训管理者的成本高昂。基于文本的聊天机器人虽可扩展，却无法提供逼真的排练体验——管理者需要通过大声练习来建立在高风险对话前的信心。

Method: 提出Conversation Coach语音优先系统，通过三种方式解决挑战：(1) 实现低延迟交互与强语言理解；(2) 通过可配置的机器人个性模拟不同类型的员工，实现自适应对话；(3) 生成关于内容和政策合规性的个性化反馈。系统对比了端到端语音到语音模型与级联方法（ASR结合LLM和TTS）。

Result: 端到端方法的P50延迟比级联方法低3倍，具备原生插入（barge-in）能力，估计成本低8倍；然而级联方法提供更优的推理能力，对辅导质量至关重要。级联架构已部署至生产环境，6个月内超过4万名管理者使用，采用模式表明用户会选择性用于困难对话场景。

Conclusion: 级联架构虽然在延迟和成本上不如端到端方法，但其推理能力更佳，更适合需要高质量辅导的应用场景。实际部署验证了该系统的实用性和价值，管理者倾向于将其用于困难的对话排练。

Abstract: Effective manager-employee communication is critical for retaining high performers and developing underperformers, yet training managers in these skills remains costly. Text-based chatbots offer a scalable approach but cannot provide realistic rehearsal: managers need to practice speaking aloud to build confidence before high-stakes conversations. In this paper, we propose Conversation Coach, a voice-first AI system that enables managers to rehearse difficult workplace conversations in a realistic spoken format. The system addresses three challenges: achieving low-latency interactions with strong language understanding, enabling adaptive conversations through configurable bot personalities that simulate different employee types, and generating personalized feedback on content and policy compliance. We compare an end-to-end speech-to-speech model with a cascaded approach combining automatic speech recognition, a large language model, and text-to-speech synthesis. The end-to-end approach achieves 3$\times$ lower median (P50) latency with native barge-in capability at an estimated 8$\times$ lower cost, while the cascaded approach offers superior reasoning essential for coaching quality. We deployed the cascaded architecture in production, where 40,000+ managers used it over six months, with adoption patterns indicating selective use for difficult conversations.

</details>


### [339] [mimeo: Compiling Public Expert Corpora into Agent Skills and Testing What Transfers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00453)
*Timothy Kassis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: mimeo是一个开源工具，通过搜索某人的公开作品、提取并校验引用内容，生成代理可加载的专家档案文件。实验表明其知识接入效果最清晰（能回答全部20个晦涩问题），接地性（grounding）在防止人格化错误上有明显优势，但判断力迁移未能证实，且单一AI评委的可靠性存疑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望厘清"给代理一个关于专家名人的档案文件"能带来什么：是提供难以找到的材料（知识接入）、塑造可识别的人格特征，还是改变代理的决策（判断力迁移）。这三者是不同主张，需分别验证。

Method: 构建mimeo开源工具：查找人物公开作品、用缓存源文本校验每个提取的引用、生成可加载档案。用四种专家档案配合一个编码代理框架做测试，并对比封闭条件、BM25关键词搜索、记忆中的人格等多种基线。

Result: 知识接入最清晰：mimeo答对全部20个晦涩问题，而封闭条件最多答对10个；BM25答对15-17个（差异样本无法定论）。接地性显示明显好处：模型记忆写的人格在1-4/20的答案中错误陈述了已记录立场，而普通代理和mimeo从不犯错。人格在短开放提示上极易识别，但加入任务材料会降低18-23点识别率；mimeo不比从记忆的档案更易识别。判断力迁移无结论：两类测试都触顶（94-100%命中率）。AI评委的"像专家"评分随评委变化，两个偏模型刻板印象，两个说无差异。

Conclusion: mimeo应被视作一个人紧凑、可检查的参考资料，而非其判断力得到验证的迁移工具。同时警示不应依赖单一AI评委判断人格相似性。

Abstract: Giving an agent a file about a named expert can supply hard-to-find material, produce a recognizable persona, or change what the agent decides. These are different claims. We test each one. mimeo is an open-source tool that finds a person's public work, checks each extracted quotation against the cached source text, and writes a file an agent can load. Eight logged builds averaged 38 model calls; the check rejects 13.2% of extracted quotations. We tested four expert files with one coding-agent harness. Knowledge access was clearest: mimeo answered all 20 obscure, quotation-heavy questions; no closed-book condition answered more than 10. Keyword search (BM25) over the same pages answered 15-17, a gap this sample cannot resolve. Grounding showed one clear benefit: personas written from model memory misstated a documented position on 1-4 of 20 answers under every grader; the plain agent and mimeo never did. Every persona was easy to spot on short open prompts, and adding task material lowered identification by 18-23 points. mimeo was no more identifiable than a from-memory profile. Judgment transfer remained unresolved because both tests hit their ceiling: every condition found 94-97% of the problems planted in engineering tasks and scored 94-100% on 16 new application scenarios. An AI-judged "sounds like the expert" score changed with the judge: two of four preferred answers based on a model's stereotype, while two found no difference on the same text. That is a caution against relying on a single AI judge. The evidence supports mimeo as a compact, inspectable reference on a person, not as a demonstrated transfer of their judgment. Toolkit and expert profiles: https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/mimeo

</details>


### [340] [Towards a Belief-Based World Model for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00455)
*Shubham Kumar,Harshit Kumar,Narendra Ahuja,Saurabh Jha*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出基于信念的世界模型（Belief-Based World Models, BB-WMs），在部分可观测环境下直接向LLM智能体暴露世界模型对当前状态的不确定性估计（信念），以补充传统仅依赖仿真的世界模型方法，实验表明该方法能提升LLM在长期任务中的决策性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在部分可观测的长期任务中表现不佳。现有的世界模型仅通过模拟候选动作结果来辅助决策，但模拟无法充分捕捉当前状态的不确定性，而准确的决策恰恰需要这种不确定性信息。

Method: 提出信念基世界模型（BB-WMs），该模型建模并维护关于当前状态的信念（即对已知与未知信息的表示），LLM可以通过查询该信念获取当前状态的不确定性信息，辅助决策。

Result: 实验结果表明，让LLM代理访问世界模型的信念信息能够提升其在部分可观测条件下的任务表现，并且与现有的基于仿真的世界模型方法互补。

Conclusion: 暴露世界模型的信念给LLM策略可以显著改善部分可观测环境下的决策质量，且这一方法不与现有仿真方法冲突，二者可以结合使用。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are being used as policies for autonomous decision-making and planning in many domains. Despite their strong reasoning capabilities, LLMs struggle with long-horizon tasks, especially under partial observability. World models are a promising way to enhance policy performance, both during training and inference. During inference, agents currently use world models to simulate the consequences of candidate actions before committing to an action, which can improve decision-making. However, we argue that simulation alone is an incomplete interface for decision-making under partial observability: simulation doesn't adequately capture uncertainty about the current state, which agents may need for accurate decision-making. We address this limitation with Belief-Based World Models (BB-WMs), which model and maintain a belief that LLMs can query to access information on what is known and uncertain about the current state. Before developing methods to learn accurate BB-WMs, we first ask a more fundamental question: does exposing a world model's belief directly to an LLM policy improve decision-making? Our results show that giving LLM agents access to world model beliefs improves task performance under partial observability, while remaining complementary to existing simulation-based world models. Code is released at https://github.com/skumar-ml/belief-world-models.

</details>


### [341] [EGT-KG: Evidence-Grounded Typed KG Retrieval for Practical Scientific QA with Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00479)
*Muran Yu,Jiechao Gao,Yuandong Pan,Barney H. Miao,Andrew C. Lesh,Kincho H. Law,Jie Wang,Michael D. Lepech*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出证据对齐的类型化知识图谱（EGT-KG）检索框架，用于在小语言模型上进行科学问答。实验表明，EGT-KG显著优于vanilla RAG方法，在llama3:8b上最佳效果提升约14.67%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新兴科学研究领域中，本地小语言模型因其隐私保护和部署稳定性而更具吸引力，但实际科学问答常面临文献集合小、证据碎片化、上下文窗口与推理能力受限等约束，导致传统RAG方法效果不佳。

Method: 提出证据对齐的类型化知识图谱（EGT-KG）检索框架，包含两种变体：自动生成关系模式（AS）和专家定义关系模式（ES），并对比了vanilla RAG流程。评估采用六维度框架（S3CRF: 健全性、正确性、完整性、简洁性、相关性、流畅性）。

Result: 在生物聚合物结合土壤复合材料文献基准上，EGT-KG在大多数设置下优于vanilla RAG。最佳改进来自llama3:8b：AS/ES变体分别获得最终得分70.37（+14.67%）和68.82（+12.14%）。

Conclusion: EGT-KG通过知识图谱结构化检索有效改善了局部小语言模型在科学问答中的表现，其中自动生成关系模式在多数情况下表现更好，证明了该框架在资源受限的科学信息检索场景中的实用价值。

Abstract: For emerging scientific research domains, local Small Language Models (SLMs) are becoming more attractive, as they offer stronger privacy control and more stable deployment pipelines than Large Language Models. However, in practice, scientific question-answering on SLMs often operates under inevitable constraints: small literature collections, fragmented evidence, limited context window and reasoning abilities. We propose the Evidence-Grounded Typed Knowledge Graph (EGT-KG), a retrieval framework to improve information retrieval with local SLMs. We assessed three question-answering settings: a vanilla Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflow and two EGT-KG workflows: an automatically generated relation schema (AS) and an expert-defined relation schema (ES). Our experiments were evaluated with a six-dimensional evaluation framework (S3CRF: Soundness, Correctness, Completeness, Conciseness, Relevance, Fluency) on a Biopolymer-bound Soil Composite literature benchmark, showing that EGT-KG outperforms the vanilla RAG method in most settings, with the best improvement from llama3:8b: a Final Score of 70.37 (+14.67%) and 68.82 (+12.14%) by AS/ES EGT-KG variants.

</details>


### [342] [The Privacy-Hallucination Tradeoff in Differentially Private Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00492)
*Krithika Ramesh,Krishna Pillutla,Danish Pruthi,Anjalie Field*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文首次揭示并系统研究了差分隐私（DP）语言模型中隐私与幻觉之间的权衡关系。研究发现DP训练（预训练或微调）会导致模型产生更多幻觉，且隐私预算越严格幻觉越严重。论文进一步揭示了DP机制如何通过展平输出分布，将概率质量转移到事实错误的选择上，并探讨了训练数据中信息频率对缓解幻觉的作用，最后呼吁开发更精细的隐私保护干预措施。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在高风险领域（如医疗）中，隐私保护和事实准确性都至关重要。然而之前的研究很少关注DP语言模型在隐私保护的同时是否会损害事实生成能力，即二者之间是否存在权衡关系。作者希望系统性地揭示并理解这一潜在冲突。

Method: 1) 通过经验对比实验，考察DP预训练和DP微调模型与非DP模型在幻觉发生率上的差异；2) 通过分析模型内部属性（尤其是输出分布的展平程度），探究导致隐私-幻觉权衡的机制；3) 设计可控实验，通过调节训练数据中事实信息的出现频率，分析信息频率对DP模型幻觉风险的影响。

Result: 1) DP训练的模型比非DP模型产生明显更多幻觉，且隐私预算越严（更强的隐私保护）幻觉越严重；2) DP机制会"展平"模型的输出分布，导致概率质量被重新分配到事实上不正确的备选答案上；3) 训练数据中信息频率的提升可以有效降低DP模型的幻觉风险。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了DP语言模型中隐私与事实准确性之间存在固有权衡，现有DP方法在提供严格隐私保障的同时可能牺牲事实生成能力。作者呼吁需要设计更精细、更细致的隐私保护干预方案，使其能够在提供严格的隐私保证的同时不影响模型的事实准确性，这对高风险的医疗等应用场景尤为重要。

Abstract: Both privacy and factual accuracy are paramount in high-stakes domains like healthcare. Concerningly, we uncover and investigate a privacy-hallucination tradeoff in differentially private (DP) language models. First, we empirically show that models pre-trained or fine-tuned with DP tend to produce more hallucinations than non-DP counterparts, with increased severity as the privacy budget grows stricter. Second, we investigate model properties driving this tradeoff, demonstrating that DP mechanisms flatten output distributions, potentially redistributing probability mass toward factually incorrect alternatives. Third, through experiments where we control fact frequency in training data, we characterize how information frequency can reduce hallucination risks in DP models. Overall, our findings underscore the need for more nuanced privacy-preserving interventions that offer rigorous privacy guarantees without compromising factual accuracy.

</details>


### [343] [Validity-Aware Jailbreak Evaluation for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00498)
*Qilong Wu,Sahil Wadhwa,Pranab Mohanty,Giri Iyengar,Varun Chandrasekaran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SEAV框架，一种以验证为中心的越狱评估方法，通过将响应分解为有序步骤并同时评估有效性和正确性（结合LLM裁判与检索验证），解决了现有越狱评估过于强调语言合理性而忽视事实/程序正确性的局限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有越狱鲁棒性评估方法主要依赖拒绝行为、语义相似度和意图匹配启发式，偏向语言合理性而非正确性。许多越狱意图依赖的是指令有效性而非认识论事实性，导致看起来逼真的错误响应被错误标记为成功。

Method: SEAV框架将响应分解为有序步骤，采用LLM-as-a-judge机制进行语义解释，并结合基于外部知识源的检索接地验证，综合评估内容是否事实正确、结构一致以及操作上能否推进恶意目标。

Result: SEAV在SD-A诊断集上相比最强基线将误报率降低14.9个百分点，并在四个公开基准中的三个上将22.1%-51.0%的先前标记成功样本重新分类为无效，且在不同搜索后端和评估模型上结果稳定。

Conclusion: 强制正确性显著重塑了测得的鲁棒性：许多先前标记的越狱成功被重新分类为无效，验证了正确性验证在越狱评估中的核心价值。

Abstract: Jailbreak robustness has become central to large language model (LLM) safety evaluation, yet prevailing methodologies rely primarily on refusal behavior, semantic resemblance, and intent-matching heuristics that emphasize linguistic plausibility rather than correctness. We identify a key limitation in existing evaluations: many jailbreak intents depend on instructional validity rather than epistemic factuality, allowing realistic-looking responses to be labeled successful despite being factually or procedurally incorrect. To address this gap, we propose Sequential Epistemic and Action-Level Validation (SEAV), a verification-centric jailbreak evaluation framework that decomposes responses into ordered steps and evaluates both validity and correctness. SEAV combines LLM-as-a-judge mechanisms for semantic interpretation with retrieval-grounded verification using external knowledge sources, assessing whether generated content is factually correct, structurally consistent, and operationally capable of advancing harmful objectives. Empirically, SEAV cuts the false-positive rate on SD-A (a curated strategic-dishonesty diagnostic) by 14.9\,pp vs. the strongest baseline, and reclassifies 22.1\%--51.0\% of sampled prior-labeled successes as invalid across three of four public benchmarks. Together, these results show that enforcing correctness substantially reshapes measured robustness: many previously labeled jailbreak successes are reclassified as invalid, and results are stable across the tested search backends and evaluator models. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Ardor-Wu/SEAV.

</details>


### [344] [Wave Function Backpropagation with Explicit Temporal-Interval Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00503)
*Byunggu Yu,Justin Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出波函数反向传播（WFB），一种以可学习振幅、波数、角频率和相位参数化神经响应的学习框架，将观测状态与其时间间隔Δt通过可微时空波的相位关联起来。在轨迹预测的前馈任务中，WFB相比原始FFN基线将平均位移误差（ADE）降低了20.4%（带运动特征）；在去除时间泄漏的纯位置评估中降低10.4%，并保持与参数匹配的ReLU对照组竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统神经网络主要通过学习仿射变换加非线性激活，时间往往仅作为辅助特征或假设均匀采样，缺乏一种将时间间隔自然编码进网络内部表征的数学化学习框架。

Method: 提出WFB：神经响应由可学习振幅、波数、角频率和相位表示，通过可微时空波的相位将观测状态与时间间隔Δt关联。推导标准WFB梯度以及基于波响应拉普拉斯算子的空间曲率校正项，并在刻意前馈的轨迹预测器上实现受控概念验证。

Result: 带运动特征时，STD-WFB使用真实间隔相较于原FFN基线降低了20.4%的ADE；在消除时间泄漏的纯位置评估中，真实间隔WFB降低10.4% ADE，且比显式Δt匹配FFN低2.1%的平均ADE。打乱间隔的WFB达到最低平均ADE，表明波表示有效但增益不归于间隔对齐。

Conclusion: WFB被确立为一种可行的结构化前馈学习公式，为后续架构研究奠定基础。但其有效性的证据支持波表示的贡献，而非时间间隔对齐的因果作用，序列学习超出当前评估范围。

Abstract: Conventional neural networks learn predominantly through affine transformations followed by nonlinear activations, while elapsed time is often treated as an auxiliary feature or assumed to be uniformly sampled. This paper introduces Wave Function Backpropagation (WFB), a wave-parameterized learning formulation in which neural responses are represented by learnable amplitude, wavenumber, angular frequency, and phase. The formulation associates an observed state with its temporal interval Delta t through the phase of a differentiable spatiotemporal wave. We derive standard WFB gradients and a spatial-curvature correction based on the Laplacian of the wave response. WFB is instantiated in a deliberately feed-forward trajectory predictor to provide a controlled proof of concept; sequence learning is outside the scope of the present evaluation. With motion features, STD-WFB using real intervals reduces average displacement error (ADE) by 20.4% relative to the original FFN baseline. In a new position-only evaluation that removes temporal leakage through precomputed velocity and acceleration, real-interval WFB reduces ADE by 10.4% relative to the original FFN and remains competitive with parameter-matched ReLU controls, obtaining 2.1% lower mean ADE than the matched FFN with explicit Delta t. Shuffled-interval WFB attains the lowest mean ADE, indicating that the present evidence supports the effectiveness of the wave representation but does not attribute the gain to interval alignment. These results establish WFB as a viable structured feed-forward learning formulation and define a clear basis for subsequent architectural studies.

</details>


### [345] [CoVer: Conflict-Aware Claim Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00508)
*Shuning Zhang,Dai Shi,Bohao Chu,Hui Wang,Yuwei Chuai,Yifan Wang,Jingruo Chen,Simin Li,Xin Yi,Hewu Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ContraNote数据集（从X社区笔记构建的大规模真实事实核查数据集）及CoVer事实裁决框架，通过证据模式规范化、事实共识与支持验证三阶段流水线解决社交媒体事实核查中的证据级与聚合级冲突问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交媒体事实核查长期受证据级与聚合级冲突挑战，错误证据可能模仿权威新闻来源，现有方法难以有效区分真实与误导性证据。

Method: 提出ContraNote数据集（含33,686条帖子用于证据级冲突解决，54,474个实例用于聚合级优先级排序），并提出CoVer框架，采用证据模式规范化、事实共识与支持验证的三阶段流水线，优先处理证据而非噪声以避免影响最终裁决。

Result: CoVer在ContraNote数据集上取得强性能（冲突任务86.0%准确率、68.0%宏平均F1、64.5平衡准确率；优先级排序任务88.5%准确率、88.5宏F1、89.2平衡准确率），并在CONFACT-HumC（88.4%准确率）和CONFACT-ModC（89.4%准确率）上优于最先进基线。

Conclusion: CoVer框架有效解决社交媒体事实核查中的冲突验证问题，验证了"证据优先于噪声"的设计理念，并提供了大规模真实世界基准数据集ContraNote以推动该领域研究。

Abstract: Social media fact-checking has long been challenged by evidence-level and aggregation-level conflicts, where erroneous evidence mimics authoritative news sources. To capture this challenge and support conflict verification tasks, we present ContraNote, a large-scale real-world dataset curated from X's Community Notes system. It includes 33,686 posts for evaluating evidence-level conflict resolution, and 54,474 instances for evaluating aggregation-level prioritization. Additionally, we propose CoVer, a factual adjudication framework with three-stage pipelines: evidence schema normalization, factual consensus and support verification. This prioritizes evidence over noise to prevent it from compromising the final verdict. Technical evaluations show that CoVer achieves strong performance compared with state-of-the-art baselines across ContraNote (86.0% Acc., 68.0% mac. F1, 64.5 bal. Acc. on Conflict; and 88.5% Acc., 88.5 mac. F1 and 89.2 bal. Acc. on Prioritization), CONFACT-HumC (88.4% Acc.) and CONFACT-ModC (89.4% Acc.).

</details>


### [346] [When the Algorithm Becomes the Brand Crisis: A Sociotechnical Theory of Distributed Responsibility and Accountable Transparency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00510)
*Mohammad Saleh Torkestani,Taha Mansouri*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个社会技术过程理论，解释利益相关者在AI系统故障、组织危机和丑闻中如何分配责任，以及如何评估品牌。"负责任的透明"被提出作为响应配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统品牌危机模型无法充分解释当技术因果关系、客户控制权和治理职责分散在AI系统、开发者、部署者、供应商和用户之间时，利益相关者如何分配责任的问题。

Method: 基于结构化、联合范围的综合综述（federated scoping synthesis），对经过验证的学术和一手资料进行分析，发展概念性社会技术过程理论。

Result: 框架区分了三类事件：AI/算法事件、AI相关的组织危机和AI相关的组织丑闻。提出事件配置影响特定行动者归责，归责影响能力、诚信、公平和关系评估，公共道德化可能但不必然将事件升级为丑闻。调和了矛盾发现：算法参与可在某些情境中缓冲负面品牌反应，而机器人和聊天机器人故障可将责任转嫁到关联企业。证据更支持关于责备、信任、满意度、企业评价和沟通可信度的有条件推导性推断，而非关于持久声誉、品牌资产或市场表现的宣称。

Conclusion: 引入"负责任的透明"作为响应配置，包含及时通知、可理解的说明、角色责任承认、补救、纠正证据和追索机制六要素。研究对持久品牌损害的证据支持有限，需进一步实证检验。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence systems increasingly enact market-facing promises through chatbots, recommendation systems, automated decisions, and generative interfaces. Their failures, misuse, and misrepresentation raise a question that conventional brand-crisis models do not fully specify: how do stakeholders assign responsibility when technical causation, customer-facing control, and governance duties are distributed across an AI system, developer, deployer, vendor, and user? This conceptual paper develops a sociotechnical process theory from a structured, federated scoping synthesis of verified academic and primary sources. It distinguishes an AI/algorithmic incident from an AI-related organisational crisis and, in turn, from an AI-related organisational scandal. The framework proposes that incident configuration shapes actor-specific attribution; attribution informs capability, integrity, fairness, and relationship appraisals; and public moralisation may, but need not, escalate an incident into scandal. The theory offers a reconciliation of findings that algorithm involvement can buffer negative brand reactions in some settings while robot and chatbot failures can redirect responsibility to an associated firm in others. It introduces accountable transparency as a proposed response configuration that combines timely notice, an intelligible account, role-responsibility acknowledgement, remedy, evidence of correction, and recourse. The evidence supports conditional, proximal inferences about blame, trust, satisfaction, firm evaluation, and communication credibility more strongly than claims about durable reputation, brand equity, or market performance.

</details>


### [347] [ISO-RAG: Isoperimetric Noise Control for Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00513)
*Siyuan Zhang,Hanchen Wang,Dong Wen,Ying Zhang,Wenjie Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ISO-RAG是一个几何感知的RAG框架，通过将知识图谱投影到双曲Poincaré球中预计算节点等周曲线，在检索时剪除虚假边、限制搜索空间为严格局部子图，从而解决多跳问答中传统稠密检索和图检索存在的语义漂移与高延迟问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统稠密检索难以处理多跳问答的复杂推理路径，而基于图的RAG虽能捕捉多步关系，但因全局图遍历导致严重语义漂移和高在线延迟，亟需一种兼顾精确性与效率的检索方案。

Method: 提出ISO-RAG框架：(1) 将知识图谱投影到双曲Poincaré球中预计算节点级等周曲线（isoperimetric profiles）；(2) 利用拓扑净化在检索阶段剪除虚假边，将搜索空间限制为严格局部子图；(3) 用净化后的拓扑调节Personalized PageRank（PPR）扩散驱动检索过程，保证精确且低延迟收敛。

Result: 在多跳QA基准测试中，ISO-RAG相较最先进基线在检索召回率上平均绝对提升10.0%，在下游精确匹配中提升4.3%，实现了优越的准确率-效率权衡，从根本上消除了全局遍历的延迟瓶颈。

Conclusion: 通过将图拓扑的几何等周性质融入RAG检索，ISO-RAG有效解决了多跳QA中检索精度与在线延迟的矛盾，展示了几何感知方法在知识密集型推理任务中的潜力。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) mitigates large language models (LLMs) hallucinations, yet conventional dense retrieval struggles with the complex reasoning paths of multi-hop question answering (QA). Graph-based RAG captures multi-step relationships but suffers from severe semantic drift and high online latency due to noisy global graph traversals. Thus, we propose ISO-RAG (ISOperimetric Retrieval-Augmented Generation), a geometry-aware RAG framework. By projecting the underlying knowledge graph into a hyperbolic Poincare ball to precompute node-wise isoperimetric profiles, ISO-RAG prunes spurious edges during retrieval, restricting the search space to a strictly localized subgraph. This topological purification regulates Personalized PageRank (PPR) diffusion driving the retrieval process, ensuring exact and low-latency convergence. Experiments on multi-hop QA benchmarks demonstrate that ISO-RAG outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by average absolute gains of 10.0% in retrieval recall and 4.3% in downstream exact match, achieving a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off by fundamentally eliminating the latency bottleneck of global traversals. Our source code is available at https://github.com/ZaiizaiZHANG/ISO-RAG.

</details>


### [348] [Feedback-Assisted Trust Propagation over Document Relation Graphs for Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00543)
*Zhuoheng Li,Ying Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出TrustPropRAG，将文档关系构建为图，通过多跳传播将少量人类可靠性反馈信号扩展至整个语料库，用以提升RAG系统的检索质量与答案可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG系统依赖的外部语料库可能包含过时、矛盾、嘈杂或不可靠的文档，带来可靠性风险。先前工作虽利用文档关系提升答案可靠性，但仅能传播到直接比较的文档对，无法将信号扩展到更广范围；而人工可靠性反馈成本高昂，难以大规模收集。

Method: 将文档关系构建为图结构；以少量人工反馈作为锚点，通过多跳传播在图中估计每篇文档的可信度评分；将信任传播形式化为一个联合刻画成对文档关系与用户反馈的优化问题并求解；利用得到的信任评分改善可靠文档的选择，并支持信任感知的答案生成。

Result: 评估结果表明TrustPropRAG在检索质量和精确匹配指标上均优于基线方法，且在稀疏和嘈杂的反馈条件下仍保持鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 通过图结构化的多跳信任传播，TrustPropRAG能以极少量人工反馈有效扩展可靠性信号到整个语料库，显著提升RAG在不可靠外部语料环境下的性能与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems rely on external corpora that may contain outdated, contradictory, noisy, or unreliable documents, introducing reliability risks. Prior work has leveraged document relations to improve the answer reliability of RAG. To propagate reliability signals beyond directly compared document pairs, we propose TrustPropRAG, which structures document relations as a graph and estimates document reliability through multi-hop propagation across the graph. TrustPropRAG anchors this propagation with a limited set of human feedback on document reliability, extending these costly-to-collect feedback-based reliability signals across the whole corpus. Specifically, based on the constructed document relation graph, TrustPropRAG estimates a trust score for each document by formulating and solving an optimization problem that jointly captures pairwise document relations and user feedback. These scores are then used to improve the selection of reliable documents and support trust-aware answer generation. Evaluation results show that TrustPropRAG improves both retrieval quality and exact match over baselines, and remains robust under sparse and noisy feedback.

</details>


### [349] [VoiceLongMemEval: Do Assistants Remember How You Sounded?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00570)
*Ramit Pahwa,Parivesh Priye,Apoorva Beedu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出VoiceLongMemEval (VLME)基准，用于评估AI助手在多会话长对话历史中利用副语言元数据（情感标签、韵律描述、声音事件）进行推理的能力。该基准通过三阶段对抗性门控确保仅靠文字无法回答，揭示了现有模型普遍存在的"情感缺口"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准将对话历史评估为信息检索、时间推理或知识更新，忽略了人机交互的基本动态——即说话方式（情感、韵律、声音事件）如何影响语义。这些副语言信息仅从文字中无法恢复，现有模型和ASR流水线系统地丢弃了这些关键信号。

Method: 构建VLME基准，每个问题的答案都依赖于附加在对话轮次上的副语言元数据（情感标签、韵律描述符、声音事件）。每个条目都经过三阶段对抗性门控，确保强语言模型在仅获得文字转录时无法正确回答。评估了前沿和开放权重模型，并对比文本追踪、音频原生模型和标准ASR流水线的表现。

Result: 领先的前沿和开放权重模型存在普遍的情感缺口。提供文本追踪副语言元数据可带来0.09至0.38的准确率提升（有证据提示时提升0.61至0.69）。标准ASR流水线系统性丢弃这些信号。音频原生模型能从语音中直接提取这些线索（0.354至0.412 vs. 盲测0.325）。

Conclusion: 副语言信息对长期对话理解至关重要，当前主流AI系统在处理这类信号时存在明显不足。VLME揭示了这一差距，并表明音频原生模型和显式副语言元数据注入可以显著提升对话理解能力，为未来多模态Agent评估和设计提供了方向。

Abstract: With the growing scale of multi-agent architectures and large language models, deployed AI assistants are increasingly tasked with reasoning over long, continuous, multi-session conversation histories. Current benchmarks evaluate this dialogue history as information retrieval over long horizon, temporal reasoning, or knowledge updates, while crucially ignoring the fundamental dynamics of human-agent interaction, i.e. how they said it. To address this gap, we present VoiceLongMemEval (VLME) benchmark, where every answer depends on paralinguistic metadata (emotion labels, prosody descriptors, and voice events) attached to conversational turns, which is otherwise unrecoverable from the words alone. Every item passes a three-stage adversarial gate, ensuring that a strong language model fails when given only the transcript. Evaluating leading frontier and open-weight models reveals a pervasive affect gap; providing text-track paralinguistic metadata yields a 0.09 to 0.38 accuracy boost (0.61 to 0.69 when prompted with evidence hints), while standard ASR pipelines systematically discard this signal. Additionally, audio-native models successfully extract these cues directly from speech (0.354 to 0.412 vs. 0.325 blind). Code and dataset will be made available upon acceptance.

</details>


### [350] [Residual Sparsification via Output Importance for Compressing Mixture-of-Experts LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00575)
*Seungwoo Jung,Dohyeok Kwon,Seungmin Cha,Junseok Lee,Yeonho Yoo,Chuck Yoo,Gyeongsik Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PARSER，一种新的残差稀疏化方法，将压缩目标从最小化独立矩阵误差转变为保留专家输出误差，通过在压缩过程中引入"输出重要性"来衡量对专家输出误差的实际贡献，从而在Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）模型压缩中更好地保持模型精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有残差稀疏化方法独立压缩每个残差矩阵，最小化各投影矩阵的压缩误差。但作者分析发现该目标与压缩后保持模型精度不一致——在MoE专家中，最终输出由多个投影和隐藏表示的耦合计算产生，单个矩阵的微小误差会通过隐藏表示和投影交互传播放大，导致专家输出误差和精度下降。

Method: PARSER将压缩目标从最小化隔离矩阵误差转变为保留专家输出误差。具体做法是引入"输出重要性"（output importance），用于衡量每个矩阵压缩误差对专家输出误差的实际贡献，据此指导残差矩阵的压缩决策。

Result: 与现有方法相比，PARSER在Qwen上将与未压缩模型的精度差距缩小了1.41倍，在DeepSeek上缩小了1.44倍，同时实现了相同的峰值内存减少。

Conclusion: 通过将压缩目标与实际模型输出对齐而非仅关注单个矩阵误差，PARSER证明了在MoE模型压缩中考虑跨投影和隐藏表示的耦合效应对于保持压缩后精度至关重要，且该改进不牺牲内存缩减效果。

Abstract: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures scale large language models efficiently, but they demand massive GPU memory. To cope with such demand, models are commonly compressed to reduce their memory footprint. Residual sparsification is a representative compression technique that decomposes each projection matrix of an expert into a shared base matrix and per-expert residual matrix, and then compresses the residuals. Existing sparsification methods compress each residual matrix independently by minimizing its compression error, thereby minimizing the error of each projection matrix. However, our analysis shows that this objective is misaligned with preserving model accuracy after compression. In an expert, the final output is produced through computations coupled across multiple projections and hidden representations. Therefore, even small errors in individual matrices can propagate through hidden representations and projection interactions, leading to large expert output errors and accuracy degradation. To address this misalignment, we propose PARSER, a new residual sparsification method that shifts the compression objective from minimizing isolated matrix errors to preserving the expert output error. PARSER achieves this by introducing output importance, which measures the actual contribution to the expert output error. Our experiments show that, compared with existing methods, PARSER narrows the accuracy gap to the uncompressed model by 1.41$\times$ on Qwen and 1.44$\times$ on DeepSeek, while achieving the same peak memory reduction.

</details>


### [351] [Consistency Without Alignment: Item-Sensitive Language Models Indistinguishable From Random](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00576)
*Cris Huynh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过一个从桌游《Deception: Murder in Hong Kong》抽象出的强迫选择信号任务，证明"项敏感性"（item-sensitivity）作为任务能力的证据是必要但不充分的。在21个模型×评分规则的组合中，所有组合都表现出可靠的项敏感性，但其中8个组合在统计上无法与忽略项内容随机选择的chooser区分，5个在描述目标上比随机更差。项敏感性与随机距离的相关性仅为r=0.30。作者将此现象称为"一致但不对齐"（consistency without alignment），并论证该问题适用于任何依赖项敏感性、排列一致性或自一致性而没有独立参考量的评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前广泛使用项敏感性（模型的选择是否依赖特定输入而非其自身输出先验）作为任务能力的证据，但作者质疑这一证据是否充分。他们希望证明仅凭一致性指标无法保证模型真正理解任务，需要独立参考量来确认对齐性。

Method: 作者构建了一个可闭式计算参考点的强迫选择信号任务（适配自桌游），其中fit-maximising策略、后验最大化策略和均匀随机选择策略都有精确解。他们跨7个语言模型、2个模型家族、一个后训练消融以及3个独立评分规则进行系统评估，并纳入无语用学的字面相似度基线和加入语用层的变体，同时测试标准多选题格式。

Result: 21个模型×规则组合全部可靠地表现出项敏感性，但8个组合统计上与随机选择不可区分，5个在目标描述上劣于随机。项敏感性与随机距离仅弱相关(r=0.30)。无语用学的字面相似度基线胜过大多数测试的语言模型；在两种基线相似源上添加语用层会使chooser趋向随机而非贝叶斯参考；标准多选题格式不携带可测量的内容信号。

Conclusion: 项敏感性不能作为模型任务能力的充分证据。一致性与对齐性可以脱钩，这一"一致但不对齐"现象对依赖无独立参考的项敏感性、排列一致性或自一致性评估构成普遍挑战。该项研究是预注册仪器的模型侧结果，匹配的人类条件已设计并试点但尚未收集。

Abstract: Item-sensitivity, defined as whether a model's choice depends on the specific input rather than on its own output prior, is widely reported as evidence of task competence. We show this evidence is necessary but not sufficient using a forced-choice signalling task abstracted from the board game Deception: Murder in Hong Kong. In this environment, the reference points against which a coordinate should be judged (a fit-maximising strategy, a posterior-maximising strategy, and uniform random selection) are all computable in closed form. Across seven language models, two model families, a post-training ablation, and three independent scoring rules, every one of 21 model-by-rule cells is reliably item-sensitive. Yet 8 of those 21 cells are not statistically distinguishable from a chooser that ignores the item and selects at random, and 5 score worse than random at describing the target. Item-sensitivity and distance from random correlate at only r = 0.30. We call this consistency without alignment and argue it generalises to any evaluation that relies on item-sensitivity, permutation consistency, or self-consistency without an independent reference for the measured quantity. We further find that a literal-similarity baseline with no pragmatics outperforms most tested language models, that adding a pragmatic layer over two baseline similarity sources moves choosers toward random rather than toward the Bayesian reference, and that a standard labelled multiple-choice format carries no measurable content signal here. All results represent the model side of a pre-registered instrument; a matched human condition is designed and piloted but not yet collected.

</details>


### [352] [Same Request, Different Boundary: Evaluating Cybersecurity Assistance across Conversational Contexts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00578)
*Rui Yang,Yang Hong,Yichao Xu,Zhengyu Liu,Ziyang Li,Yinzhi Cao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出3R-Bench基准，包含150个真实网络安全请求及两种对抗性对话设置，评估8个LLM。研究发现对话历史显著改变模型对相同请求的响应：被拒绝历史后合规率升至85.1%，而对话分解后合规率从501/800降至172/800（降幅45.1个百分点），失败反馈只能恢复一小部分损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在网络安全等高风险领域存在被滥用的风险，模型提供商需要既能阻止恶意使用又不妨碍安全防御者的合法协助。现有网络安全数据集评估了这一机制，但没有考虑请求的对话上下文，导致无法真实评估模型的防护能力。

Method: 构建3R-Bench基准，包含150个真实网络安全请求，并附加两种对抗性对话设置（被拒历史、对话分解），在400组配对面板上评估8个LLM的实际响应行为。

Result: 先前的助手行为会强烈改变对相同请求的响应：合规率从被拒历史后的62.0%升至接受历史后的85.1%。对话分解下，合规率从直接响应的501/800降至对话后的172/800，降幅45.1个百分点，失败反馈仅恢复一小部分损失。

Conclusion: 对话上下文对LLM安全防护有显著影响，现有安全评估未考虑对话场景会高估模型的实际防护能力，需要新的评估方法和防护策略来应对对话分解等攻击手段。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can solve complex problems, but their misuse in high-risk domains can lead to severe consequences. Model providers therefore restrict assistance for potentially harmful requests. Refusing all cybersecurity requests would therefore harm legitimate users. Providers need a mechanism to block malicious use without denying legitimate assistance to defenders. Existing cybersecurity-specific datasets evaluate this mechanism, but none considers the conversational context of a request. We introduce 3R-Bench (Refusal, Repetition, and Revision), a benchmark of 150 real-world cybersecurity requests augmented with two adversarial conversational settings, and evaluate eight LLMs on it. Prior assistant behavior strongly changes responses to an unchanged request: among 376 available pairs from a 400-pair panel, compliance rises from 62.0% after refused history to 85.1% after accepted history. The opposite pattern appears under dialogue decomposition. In comparison, compliance falls from 501/800 direct responses to 172/800 after dialogue; among 738 pairs returning model-authored text in both conditions, the decrease is 45.1 points. Failure feedback recovers only a small fraction of this loss.

</details>


### [353] [Socrates went Nuclear: Comparing Interaction Strategies for AI systems in a Learning Context using Brain Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00584)
*Alexandre Clin Deffarges,Nataliya Kosmyna,Pattie Maes*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究比较了三种AI交互设计（无限制聊天机器人、苏格拉底式受限机器人、脑电驱动的自适应辅导系统）在学习场景中的效果。实验发现无限制聊天机器人的学习增益最高，但脑电数据显示自适应系统产生了更高的认知投入。聚类分析表明，无限制模式下多数用户采用直接检索答案策略，而苏格拉底模式用户开始尝试推理但逐渐脱离。作者指出无限制AI的成功并非深层学习的证据，而可能只是即时后测评估的产物。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探讨一个关键问题：无限制的AI访问是否绕过了学习所需的认知努力，还是仅仅简化了知识获取过程？需要实证比较不同AI交互设计对学习效果的实际影响。

Method: 50名参与者学习核安全协议（零先验知识领域），分为三种条件：（1）无限制对话机器人（类似ChatGPT）；（2）苏格拉底式受限机器人（仅给提示不给最终答案）；（3）基于脑电信号实时调整难度的自适应辅导系统。流程为教学视频→前测→AI驱动评估阶段→即时后测。使用Muse头带测量所有参与者的认知投入（EEG）。

Result: 无限制聊天机器人的学习增益显著高于两种受限模式（p < .03, d > 0.80）；自适应条件的EEG认知投入显著更高（p = .018）。聚类分析显示无限制模式参与者多采用直接答案检索策略，而苏格拉底模式用户初期尝试推理后逐渐脱离。

Conclusion: 无限制AI的成功并非深层学习的证据，而是即时后测评估的结果。高认知投入（EEG）与学习增益之间存在分离现象，提示教育AI设计需要重新审视评估方式与学习深度之间的关系。

Abstract: Does unrestricted AI access bypass the cognitive effort required for learning, or does it streamline knowledge acquisition? This paper reports on a study where we compare three designs for user-AI interaction in a learning context: (1) an unrestricted conversational bot like ChatGPT, (2) a pedagogically constrained bot that guides through hints without giving final answers, which we refer to as the Socratic mode; and (3) a non-conversational adaptive tutoring system that adjusts difficulty in real-time based on the user's cognitive engagement derived from the brain signals. Fifty study participants were tasked with learning about nuclear safety protocols, a domain chosen for its zero-prior knowledge baseline. The participants progressed through an instructional video, a pre-test, an AI-driven assessment phase, which varied in the three conditions, and an immediate post-test. The nature of the questions centered primarily on factual knowledge acquisition, but it still required participants to have a global understanding of the concepts in order to answer the questions correctly. A Muse headband was used to derive the cognitive engagement of all users in all conditions. The unrestricted chatbot produced higher learning gains (delta) than both constrained modes (p < .03, d > 0.80), while the adaptive condition generated significantly higher EEG engagement (p = .018). The cluster analysis of chatbot usage and discussion patterns by users showed that most participants in the unrestricted-mode adopted a direct answer-retrieval strategy, while participants in the Socratic-mode initially attempted to reason through the hints before progressively disengaging. Consequently, this also suggests that the success of the unrestricted AI is not an evidence of deeper learning, but rather a result of the immediate post-test evaluation after the training phase.

</details>


### [354] [Control-Data Flow Separation: Stable Prompt Optimization in Multi-Agent LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00621)
*Wentao Zhang,Syed Shariyar Murtaza,Junaid Ahmad Bhatti,Utkarsh Soni,Yifan Nie,Eugene Wen,Yuntian Deng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出控制-数据流分离（control-data flow separation）框架，将多智能体系统中"执行协议"（如消息路由、输出格式、终止信号）从可优化的提示词中解耦，以类型化、验证过的程序对象表示，而任务相关内容保留为可优化的自然语言提示。该设计使提示优化器能改进任务性能，同时不会因提示漂移破坏协议，实验在合成推理、协作审阅和保险评级等场景中实现了100%的协议有效性并持续提升任务性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体LLM系统中的提示词同时承担两种纠缠的角色：生成任务相关内容与指定执行关键协议。优化提示词以改进内容生成时，可能意外破坏协议（如路由、格式、终止信号），导致整个智能体流水线失败。现有方法未区分这两种角色，缺乏对协议稳定性的保障。

Method: 提出控制-数据流分离设计：将执行关键的控制信息表示为类型化、经过验证的程序对象（控制流），而将任务相关内容保留为可优化的自然语言（数据流）。优化器仅优化数据流部分，控制流完全不受提示编辑影响，从结构上消除协议漂移的风险。

Result: 在合成推理、协作审阅生成和保险评级三个工作流中，框架实现了100%的最终协议有效性，同时在任务性能上持续优于基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过将执行协议与可优化内容在表示层面分离，能够在保证系统协议稳定性的前提下安全地进行提示优化，为多智能体系统的鲁棒优化提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Prompt optimization can improve multi-agent LLM systems, but the prompts being optimized often serve two entangled roles: generating task-relevant content and specifying execution-critical protocols, such as message routing, output formatting, and termination signals, on which the underlying code relies. As a result, a prompt edit intended to improve content generation can inadvertently corrupt the protocol and cause the entire agent pipeline to fail. Our key observation is that these two roles have different representations: execution protocols are typically structured, while task-relevant content is usually expressed in unstructured language. Based on this, we propose control-data flow separation, where execution-critical control is represented as typed, validated program objects, while task-relevant language remains the optimizable data flow for agent communication. This design allows optimizers to improve multi-agent behavior without exposing the routing or formatting interface to prompt drift. Across synthetic reasoning, collaborative review generation, and insurance rating workflows, our framework empirically achieves 100% eventual protocol validity while consistently improving task performance.

</details>


### [355] [REVISE: Validity-Guided Recovery for Online Revisions in Agent Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00643)
*Ruoling Qi,Xuaner Wu,Penghang Liu,Jian Chen,Yirui Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Revise，一个面向结构化智能体工作流的有效性引导运行时系统，用于在代理修订（agent revisions）到来时实现细粒度的并发恢复。Revise通过将修订的增量与记录的数据和控制依赖相交，经过DAG传播影响范围，仅停止受影响的工作并重算受影响区域，同时保留有效进度，从而在正确性和效率间取得平衡。实验表明其在编码代理场景下显著降低模型调用并保证无陈旧输出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代理修订在并发执行中暴露了正确性-效率之间的根本性权衡：放弃正在执行的工作可保证最新版本的正确性但浪费可能仍然有效的进度；重用先前工作可保持效率但存在将陈旧状态传播到输出和工具效应的风险。现有恢复策略采用粗粒度策略，要么偏向效率允许可能过时的工作继续，要么偏向正确性重启整个工作流或从最早冲突处重算线性后缀，从而丢弃未受影响的进度。

Method: Revise包含三个核心步骤：(1) 当修订到达时，将其delta与记录的数据依赖和控制依赖相交，并通过部分执行的DAG传播影响以识别受影响的工作；(2) 停止无效工作，保留超出最早冲突的、由有效性确立的进度；(3) 仅重算受影响区域。不完整的溯源会保守地扩展恢复范围，复用的结果在提交前需重新验证。

Result: 在300个具有挑战性的修订/提交执行中，Revise与最新版本oracle匹配，无陈旧输出或效应。在未修改的LangGraph和LLMCompiler应用中（使用Qwen3-14B），相比完全重启减少40.6-56.0%的模型调用，相比后缀重算减少31.3-43.6%。在服务压力下，进一步减少13.26%的修订到正确完成的token，并将SLO有效吞吐量提升3.07-5.43%。

Conclusion: Revise通过细粒度的有效性引导恢复机制，证明在结构化智能体工作流中可以在保持最新版本正确性的同时最大化工作复用效率，从而弥合了正确性-效率权衡中粗粒度策略的固有不足。

Abstract: Agent revisions expose a fundamental correctness--efficiency trade-off during concurrent execution. Discarding ongoing work preserves latest-version correctness but wastes progress that may remain valid, whereas reusing prior work preserves efficiency but risks propagating stale state into outputs and tool effects. Existing recovery strategies resolve this trade-off in an imbalanced way with coarse-grained policies: they either favor efficiency by allowing potentially stale work to continue, or favor correctness by restarting the workflow or recomputing a linear suffix from the earliest conflict, thereby discarding unaffected progress. We present \textsc{Revise}, a validity-guided runtime for fine-grained recovery in structured agent workflows. When a revision arrives, \textsc{Revise} first intersects its delta with recorded data and control dependencies and propagates the resulting impact through the partially executed DAG to identify affected work. It then stops invalid work, preserves validity-established progress beyond the earliest conflict, and recomputes only the affected region. Incomplete provenance conservatively expands recovery, while reused results are revalidated before commit. Analysis of real coding-agent traces show online recovery opportunities: 118 sessions retain observable work before a queued later message is delivered; across 167 overlapping assistant responses, enqueue-to-completion overlap reaches 56.55~s at p95. Across 300 challenging revision/commit executions, \textsc{Revise} matches a latest-version oracle with no stale outputs or effects. On unmodified LangGraph and LLMCompiler applications using Qwen3-14B, it reduces model calls by 40.6--56.0\% relative to full restart and by 31.3--43.6\% relative to suffix recomputation. Under serving pressure, it further reduces revision-to-correct-completion tokens by 13.26\% and improves SLO goodput by 3.07--5.43\%.

</details>


### [356] [DramaChain Bench: An End-to-End Benchmark for Short-Drama Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00646)
*Haoyuan Shi,Mingtao Chen,Shuo Jiang,Ziyan Chen,Xuyi Sheng,Yiming Liu,Ying Zhang,Miao Wang,Jianxiang Lu,Fanyang Lu,Songyuanyi Lu,Xiele Wu,Zhichao Hu,Yuhong Liu,Richeng Xuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了DramaChain Bench，这是第一个覆盖短剧生产全链条（剧本、分镜、关键帧、镜头级视频、成片）的基准测试，包含5,785个条目、17,488个有效评分和255,925条可追溯归因记录，并配套了自动化评测代理（PLCC达0.918）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有短剧基准仅评估视频生成阶段，且使用预写输入而非真实上游流水线输出，无法回答两个关键问题：（1）各阶段是否忠于原始剧本意图；（2）不同镜头组装成多集成片后是否连贯。

Method: 构建DramaChain Bench基准，包含三个内部系统：DramaChain Dimensions（五个评估轴在每一阶段实例化，细分为63个叶维度）；DramaChain Agent（在工艺流程和成片质量上对照商业短剧平台校准）；DramaChain Labeling System（5,785条目由三位专业标注者独立评分，缺陷按预定义清单时空定位）。DramaChain Agentic Judge通过多轮收集证据并对照逐项检查清单自动评分。

Result: 人类标注证实上游缺陷会向下游级联传播，表明最终剧集质量并非仅由视频生成阶段决定。DramaChain Agentic Judge以0.918的平均PLCC复现模型排名，足以免标注成本接纳新模型。

Conclusion: 短剧质量评测需要覆盖完整生产链而非单一生成阶段，上游缺陷的级联效应证明了全链条评测的必要性，自动化代理评测可替代高成本的人工标注。

Abstract: Commercial short-drama production follows a multi-stage chain: script, storyboard, keyframe imagery, shot-level video, and the finished short drama. Most existing benchmarks evaluate solely the video-generation stage using pre-authored inputs instead of real upstream pipeline outputs. This leaves two critical questions unanswerable: whether each stage adheres to the original script intent (rather than only its immediate input prompt), and whether disparate shots remain coherent after assembly into multi-episode releases. We present DramaChain Bench, the first short-drama benchmark that evaluates every stage of the complete production chain. It is built upon three in-house systems sharing one dimension system, DramaChain Dimensions: five evaluation axes instantiated at every stage, resolving into 63 leaf dimensions. DramaChain Agent is calibrated against commercial short-drama platforms in both workflow and finished short-drama quality, enabling stage-wise fair comparison across models. DramaChain Labeling System has each of the 5,785 items scored independently by three professional annotators, with all defects spatio-temporally localised and selected from a predefined defect list. This process produces 17,488 valid scores and 255,925 traceable attribution records. The human annotations confirm that upstream defects cascade across the pipeline, demonstrating that final episode quality is not governed by video generation alone. DramaChain Agentic Judge then scores every leaf dimension automatically, gathering evidence over multiple agentic rounds before judging against a per-item checklist; it reproduces the model ranking at a mean PLCC of 0.918, enough to admit new models at no annotation cost.

</details>


### [357] [Self-Reports Are Not Verification: Environment-Grounded Auditing of LLM Operators in Evolutionary Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00652)
*Enrong Pan,Ryan Zhou,Ting Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种环境锚定的审计方法（environment-grounded audit），检验语言模型代理自我报告（自信度、推理、选择）的可靠性。在200次运行、5种配置、3个模型家族下，通过Contexto演化搜索环境对每个中间提议给予精确结果，收集12,249条自我报告。测试的三个假设（置信度校准、继承推理的影响、适者选择改善报告质量）全部失败：操作员高估top-100成功率4.8至9.3倍，校准与判别能力在不同模型家族间分离，真实推理的价值仅约250个排名，且基于适应度与随机选择均无可检测的选择差异或亲代-子代传递。结论：代理自我报告应被视为待环境验证的主张，而非可靠性证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型代理越来越多地提出行动、观察外部反馈并解释自身行为，其自信度与推理被视为便捷的监控信号。但"便捷"不等于"验证"——缺乏将自我报告与环境结果对照的系统性机制，现有监控信号可能系统性地误导。

Method: 构建一个环境锚定的审计框架：将语言模型置于演化式Contexto搜索任务中，每个有效猜测都获得精确排名（无需人工标注）。跨200次运行、5种配置、3个模型家族，收集12,249条自我报告。通过受控干预（754条继承推理）以及对比适者选择与随机选择，系统检验置信度校准、推理影响和选择机制三个假设。

Result: 三个假设全部失败：(1) 操作员高估top-100成功4.8至9.3倍，校准与判别在不同模型家族间分离；(2) 对754条继承推理的受控干预显示，真实推理的可测收益仅约250个排名；(3) 适者选择与随机选择均无可检测的选择差异或亲代-子代报告准确性传递，尽管搜索行为差异显著。

Conclusion: 代理自我报告不应被当作其自身可靠性的证据，而应被视为需要对照环境进行验证的主张。监控语言模型代理时，必须建立环境锚定的审计机制而非依赖代理内在的置信度与推理。

Abstract: Language model agents increasingly propose actions, observe external feedback, and explain their own behavior. Their confidence and rationales are convenient monitoring signals, but convenience is not verification. We introduce an environment-grounded audit in which every intermediate proposal receives an exact outcome. A language model operates an evolutionary Contexto search whose feedback function assigns every valid guess an exact rank without human annotation. Across 200 runs spanning five configurations and three model families, four reporting configurations produce 12,249 self-reports. We test three assumptions: stated confidence is calibrated, inherited rationales affect later proposals, and fitness-based selection improves report quality. All three fail. Operators overstate top-100 success by factors of 4.8 to 9.3, while calibration and discrimination dissociate across model families. Controlled interventions on 754 inherited rationales bound any measured benefit of the genuine rationale to roughly 250 ranks. Neither fitness-based nor random selection produces a detectable selection differential or parent-to-offspring transmission in report accuracy, despite sharply different search behavior. Agent self-reports should therefore be treated as claims to verify against the environment, not as evidence of their own reliability.

</details>


### [358] [SciTrue: Reliable Scientific Claim Validation with Frontier and Open Language Models at the NTCIR SciClaimEval Task](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00654)
*Qiming Bao,Neşet Özkan Tan,Siyuan Wang,Mark Gahegan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SciTrue团队参与NTCIR-19 SciClaimEval任务两个子任务，不是调优单一模型，而是在统一的逐样本诚实协议下基准测试11个前沿及开源多模态模型，并结合轻量透明的后处理。在官方盲测榜单上，SciTrue在四个证据类别/子任务组合中的三个中以明显优势排名第一，在第四个的主要指标上并列第一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机是验证论文中表格和图表中的科学主张，并探究是什么因素驱动了模型在该任务上的表现——是模型本身的能力、任务配对结构，还是数据层面的问题。

Method: 基准测试11个前沿和开源多模态模型，采用统一的逐样本诚实协议；使用无泄漏的配对先验（pair prior）从主张文本中恢复Supported/Refuted配对；结合轻量透明的后处理、受控微调、蒸馏和智能体一致性检查。

Result: 三项主要发现：(1) 强指令微调模型已具竞争力，GPT-5.5和Claude Fable 5在子任务2上达97.7；(2) 任务的配对结构是最大杠杆——无泄漏配对先验将子任务1配对准确率从72.2提升到93.5，远超任何模型替换或集成加权；(3) 大多数残余错误是视觉上无法检测的标签映射交换或数据集标签噪声，可建模改进空间很小。

Conclusion: 测量准确率低估了真实能力，可修复的建模提升空间有限。作者还记录了一种测量泄漏——标签信息通过数据打包的文件排序而非内容到达系统，有一次甚至误导了自身pipeline。

Abstract: We describe the SciTrue team's participation in both subtasks of the NTCIR-19 SciClaimEval task~\cite{sciclaimeval}, which asks systems to verify scientific claims against the tables and figures of a paper. Rather than tuning a single model, we benchmark eleven frontier and open multimodal models under one honest, per-sample protocol and combine them with light, transparent post-processing. On the official, blind test leaderboard (Section~\ref{sec:results}), SciTrue placed first by a clear margin in three of the four evidence-category/subtask combinations, and tied for first on the primary metric in the fourth. Three findings explain the result. First, strong instruction-tuned models are already competitive: Claude Opus~4.8 and Gemma-4-31B each exceed the strongest public baseline (o4-mini), and GPT-5.5 and Claude Fable~5 lead both subtasks (97.7 on Subtask~2). Second, the task's pairing structure is the largest lever: a \emph{leak-free pair prior} that recovers the Supported/Refuted pairing from the claim text alone (a visible field) and assigns Supported to the higher-confidence evidence raises Subtask-1 pair-accuracy from 72.2 to 93.5, far more than any model swap or ensemble weighting. Third, a case-by-case audit finds that most residual errors are visually-undetectable label-mapping swaps or dataset label noise, so measured accuracy understates the true ability and the fixable-by-modeling headroom is small. Controlled fine-tuning, distillation, and agentic consistency-checking support the same conclusions, and we document throughout a measurement leak---label information reaching a system through the packaging of the data rather than its content---in which the released file ordering encodes the label, including one instance that briefly misled our own pipeline.

</details>


### [359] [Drift-Aware LLM Routing with Sparse Contexts and Shared Budgets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00662)
*Cheung Hao Lee,Patrick Wong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为Drift-Aware Sparse Routing (DRS)的在线路由算法，用于多模型语言服务，在非平稳环境中同时满足计算、延迟、内存和成本等多重背包约束，并通过悲观奖励和乐观成本估计以及滚动更新实现次线性遗憾。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模型LLM服务需要在多个模型间路由请求并维护工作负载级预算（计算、延迟、内存、成本）。这个问题比静态模型选择更难，因为：1）提示表征是高维的，只有少数嵌入方向能预测模型的增量价值（稀疏结构）；2）请求分布和模型前沿会因发布、微调、量化变化和系统更新而漂移（非平稳性）。现有方法未同时处理稀疏上下文路由和非平稳动态约束。

Method: DRS策略包含以下关键组件：1）从滚动审计窗口估计奖励和资源使用；2）使用悲观的奖励估计和乐观的成本估计进行路由；3）在线更新资源影子价格；4）在提交前应用硬计量器。在审计流中仅对一小部分提示（比例ρ）在多个模型上评估。理论分析将控制与统计分离：策略遗憾由事件预测半径之和、容量缓冲项和O(√T)步进项界定。在稀疏线性模型和漂移界V_T下，采用滚动估计可获得明确的遗憾上界。

Result: 在稀疏线性模型下，遗憾界为Õ(T√(s/(ρW)) + W·V_T + √T)，其中s是稀疏度，ρ是审计率，W是窗口长度。优化窗口W后：静态场景（V_T=0）得到标准的O(√(sT/ρ))速率；存在漂移时得到O(T^(2/3)(s/ρ)^(1/3)V_T^(1/3))的自适应项，在非平稳性与估计方差之间取得最优权衡。

Conclusion: DRS首次将稀疏上下文路由、多重背包约束和非平稳漂移统一在一个可证明的在线学习框架中，通过分离控制与统计误差，实现了在静态和漂移环境下的最优遗憾速率，为多模型服务系统的智能请求路由提供了理论基础。

Abstract: A multi-model language service must route each request while preserving workload-level budgets for compute, latency, memory, or monetary cost. Two features make this problem materially harder than static model selection. Prompt representations are high dimensional, so only a small subset of embedding directions may predict the incremental value of a model, and both the request mix and the model frontier drift after launches, fine-tunes, quantization changes, and system updates. We formulate nonstationary sparse contextual routing with multiple knapsack constraints and an optional shadow-audit stream that evaluates a small fraction of prompts on several models.
  We propose Drift-Aware Sparse Routing (DRS). The policy estimates reward and resource use from a rolling audit window, routes using pessimistic reward and optimistic cost estimates, updates resource shadow prices online, and applies a hard meter before commitment. The analysis separates control from statistics. On any event with uniform prediction radii $\{β_t\}$, regret against a paced dynamic fluid benchmark is bounded by the sum of the radii, a capacity-buffer term, and an $O(\sqrt{T})$ pacing term. Under a sparse linear model and bounded drift $V_T$, rolling estimation gives \[ \widetilde O\left( T\sqrt{\frac{s}{ρW}}+WV_T+\sqrt{T} \right), \] where $s$ is sparsity, $ρ$ is the audit rate, and $W$ is the window length. Optimizing $W$ yields the usual stationary $O(\sqrt{sT/ρ})$ rate when $V_T=0$ and a $O(T^{2/3}(s/ρ)^{1/3}V_T^{1/3})$ adaptation term under drift.

</details>


### [360] [Triple-Bottom-Line Sustainability of Language Models for Edge AI: A Comparison Between SLMs and Quantized LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00665)
*Jainil Dharmil Shah*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对边缘AI模型选择常被单一指标（准确率、延迟、内存、能耗或安全性）驱动的问题，提出了一个可复现的Holistic Sustainability Score (HSS)评分体系，基于三重底线（经济、环境、社会）框架，系统比较了原生小语言模型（SLMs）与经后训练量化压缩的大语言模型（LLMs）在边缘部署中的可持续性权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有边缘AI模型选择往往只关注单一指标，但可部署的语言模型必须同时平衡准确率、延迟、内存、能耗和安全性五个维度。因此，需要回答一个关键问题：原生训练的SLM与通过后训练量化压缩的LLM，哪一个在边缘部署中提供更可持续的权衡。

Method: 提出了Holistic Sustainability Score (HSS)，围绕三重底线组织：经济支柱（能力与系统效率）、环境支柱（GPU运行能耗）、社会支柱（有害提示鲁棒性）。对比5个BF16 SLM和5个不同量化方案（BF16、INT8、NF4 4位、GPTQ 4位、GGUF Q4）下的LLM，共产生30个测量配置。能力评估基于5个零样本基准，效率涵盖延迟、吞吐量、峰值VRAM和能耗，安全性通过5个有害提示的攻击成功率近似衡量。

Result: Qwen3-30B-A3B/GGUF Q4在综合池中排名第一（93.38分），其次是Mistral-Small-24B/GGUF Q4（92.40分），而Phi-4-mini/BF16是SLM中排名最高的（89.49分）。结果显示，原生SLM必须是最可持续边缘选择的假设并未得到普遍支持——优化的量化LLM可以整体胜出，而SLM通过更低的资源需求保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 量化是一种系统级选择，而非单调的精度-效率权衡。同时，HSS的评估结果相对其比较池和代理定义而言是相对的，需要谨慎解读。

Abstract: Edge-AI model selection is commonly driven by one isolated metric - accuracy, latency, memory, energy, or safety, even though a deployable language model must balance all five. Our work focuses on answering the question whether na- tively trained small language models (SLMs) or large language models (LLMs) compressed through post-training quantization offer the more sustainable edge- deployment trade-off. We introduce a reproducible Holistic Sustainability Score (HSS) organized around the triple bottom line: an economic pillar for capability and systems efficiency, an environmental pillar for operational GPU energy and a social pillar for harmful-prompt robustness. Five BF16 SLMs and five LLMs under different quantization approaches - BF16, INT8, NF4 4-bit, GPTQ 4-bit, and GGUF Q4 produce 30 measured configurations. Capability is assessed on five zero-shot benchmarks; efficiency uses latency, throughput, peak VRAM and energy; and safety is approximated by attack success rate on five harmful prompts. Qwen3-30B-A3B/GGUF Q4 ranks first in the combined pool (93.38), followed by Mistral-Small-24B/GGUF Q4 (92.40), while Phi-4-mini/BF16 is the highest- ranked SLM in that pool (89.49). Thus, the hypothesis that native SLMs must be the most sustainable edge choice is not supported universally; optimized quantized LLMs can win overall, while SLMs remain competitive through lower resource demand. Quantization is a systems-level choice rather than a monotonic precision- efficiency trade-off and HSS remains relative to its comparison pool and proxy definitions.

</details>


### [361] [Value Over Language Model: Detecting Original Contribution in Writing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00700)
*Vibhhu Sharma,Thorsten Joachims,Sarah Dean*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个名为VOLM（Value Over Language Model）的框架，用来衡量人相对于语言模型在写作中贡献的真实价值。该方法不评判文本表层，而是通过在不同粒度下提取内容、用LLM重建文档并与仅基于任务描述生成的文档进行比较，来分离信息贡献与风格因素。实验在新闻文章、ICLR同行评审和议论文三个领域验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的LLM文本检测工具主要衡量文档表层文本中由LLM撰写的比例，而非衡量信息的真正来源。作者希望区分：哪些想法/内容来自LLM自身，哪些是用户提供的。这需要一种不受文体混淆影响的、衡量"人在LLM之上增加了多少价值"的方法。

Method: VOLM框架的核心步骤包括：(1) 在不同粒度级别上提取文档的内容表示；(2) 使用LLM从每个部分表示中重建文档；(3) 将重建结果与仅从任务描述直接生成的"替代级"文档进行比较。该方法无需训练或标注数据，也不直接评分文档表层文本，从而避免文体变异的干扰。

Result: 在新闻文章、ICLR同行评审和议论文三个领域的实验中，VOLM能够将人类撰写的文档与LLM从通用任务描述生成的文档区分开，同时对内容保持性变换（如LLM重建和往返翻译）表现出显著的鲁棒性。研究还发现，越受约束的内容提取器能减少LLM生成与人类加工文本之间的残余差异，说明解耦信息内容与风格变异的重要性。

Conclusion: VOLM为评估LLM辅助写作中的人类贡献提供了一个无需训练的新框架，揭示了现有检测工具的局限性，并为未来在该方向进行更专门的框架实例化研究铺平了道路。

Abstract: LLMs have been rapidly adopted across writing tasks, prompting the development of tools for detecting LLM-generated text. Yet, these tools largely measure how much of a document's surface text was written by an LLM and aren't fundamentally designed to measure how much of the information content or ideas originated from the LLM itself rather than being supplied by the user in the prompt. In this work, we design a framework that measures how much value a person adds on top of what a language model could have easily produced by itself. The method requires no training or labeled data and never scores the document's surface text, insulating it from stylistic confounders. Instead, it extracts the document's content at increasing levels of granularity, uses an LLM to reconstruct the document from each partial representation, and compares these reconstructions with those produced from the task description alone. We call this framework Value Over Language Model (VOLM), which measures a document's contribution relative to a replacement-level document that an LLM could produce from the task description alone. We evaluate VOLM with a specific instantiation of this framework across three domains: news articles, ICLR peer reviews, and argumentative essays. VOLM separates human-authored documents from matched LLM-generated documents produced from generic task descriptions, while remaining substantially invariant to content-preserving transformations, including LLM-based reconstruction and round-trip translation. We further find that increasingly constrained content extractors reduce residual differences between LLM-generated and humanized text, demonstrating the importance of disentangling informational content from stylistic variation. We hope these results encourage further work on specialized instantiations of the framework and on assessing human contributions in LLM-assisted writing more generally.

</details>


### [362] [ChatDev 2.0: A No-Code Multi-Agent Platform for Developing Everything](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00714)
*Yufan Dang,Shu Yao,Bowen Lai,Chenting Xu,Ruijie Shi,Wai-Shing Leung,Huatao Li,Chen Qian,Zhiyuan Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DevAll (ChatDev 2.0) 是一个无代码平台，用于构建、执行和检查异构多智能体系统，兼顾高表达力与易用性。它通过声明式可执行图抽象与循环感知执行引擎统一表示异构Agent及动态循环交互，并提供集成可视化界面支持无代码创作、运行、监控与人工参与，实验表明可在三个代表性任务上复现SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体系统开发面临两难：代码框架表达力强但工程繁重，无代码构建器易于使用但将Agent交互限制在作者定义的工作流中，无法兼顾表达力与易用性。

Method: DevAll采用声明式可执行图表征结合具备循环感知能力的执行引擎，可在单一框架内表示和执行异构Agent及动态循环交互；同时集成可视化界面，支持用户无需编写代码即可创作、运行、监控和检查多智能体系统（包括人在环步骤）。

Result: 实验证明DevAll能够在三个代表性任务上以有竞争力的性能复现当前最先进的多智能体系统，且无需任务特定的编排代码，凸显其作为通用平台的效力。

Conclusion: DevAll成功弥合了代码框架与无代码构建器之间的鸿沟，提供了一种既具高表达力又易于使用的通用LLM多智能体系统开发平台。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have shown strong potential for solving complex tasks, yet their development forces a tradeoff: code frameworks are expressive but engineering-intensive, while no-code builders simplify authoring but constrain agent interactions to author-defined workflows. We present ChatDev 2.0: DevAll (hereafter DevAll), a no-code platform for building, executing, and inspecting heterogeneous MAS that delivers both high expressiveness and ease of use. In terms of expressiveness, DevAll pairs a declarative executable graph abstraction with a cycle-aware execution engine, so that heterogeneous agents and dynamic and cyclic interactions can be represented and executed within a single framework. For ease of use, an integrated visual interface lets users author, run, monitor, and inspect MAS, including human-in-the-loop steps, entirely without writing code. Experiments demonstrate that DevAll reproduces state-of-the-art MAS across three representative tasks at competitive performance and without task-specific orchestration code, highlighting its effectiveness as a general-purpose platform for LLM-based MAS. DevAll is available at https://github.com/OpenBMB/ChatDev.

</details>


### [363] [A Closed-Loop Evaluation of Capability Loss and Recovery in Compressed Driving Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00718)
*Ahmad Alfan Alfian Irfan,Nur Ahmad Khatim,Mansur Arief*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种阶段式闭环评估方法，用于跟踪驾驶策略在压缩流水线（剪枝、蒸馏、量化）中的表现退化过程。在Gym-Duckietown中将驾驶任务建模为POMDP并用PPO训练信念状态策略，逐阶段压缩并在五个驾驶课程上评估。发现结构化剪枝首先导致驾驶能力丧失，蒸馏改善有限，整数量化会丢失需要停车再起步的课程，而对未剪枝策略执行同样的量化则保留所有课程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的压缩方法（剪枝、蒸馏、量化）常用聚合数值指标评估，但这些指标可能无法反映策略与其他道路使用者交互时的安全驾驶能力。需要一种能追踪压缩对驾驶能力影响的评估方法，以回答如何安全可靠地部署压缩驾驶策略的讨论。

Method: 将驾驶任务建模为POMDP，用PPO在Gym-Duckietown中训练信念状态策略；提取actor成分，逐步执行压缩流水线（结构化剪枝→蒸馏→整数量化）；在五个渐进式驾驶课程上对每个压缩阶段进行闭环评估。

Result: 结构化剪枝是最先导致驾驶能力丧失的阶段；蒸馏能改善被剪枝的actor，但改善受限于其排练数据；对蒸馏后actor进行整数量化会丢失需要停止后恢复行驶的课程；而对未剪枝actor执行相同量化步骤则能保留全部五个课程。

Conclusion: 提供经验分析表明压缩流水线中各阶段对驾驶能力的影响具有非均匀性和交互效应，压缩顺序与策略结构的选择至关重要，为自动驾驶功能安全可靠的压缩部署提供实证依据。

Abstract: Many automobile and mobility companies deploy learned driving policies on embedded computers with limited memory and power. Pruning, knowledge distillation, and quantization are the standard methods to reduce the size and the inference cost of these policies. However, these methods are commonly assessed by aggregate numerical scores, and such scores may not reflect the ability of the policy to drive safely when interacting with other road users. In this study, we propose a stage-wise closed-loop evaluation approach to follow a driving policy through a compression pipeline. We formulate the driving task as a partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP) and train a belief-state policy with proximal policy optimization (PPO) in Gym-Duckietown. We then extract the actor, compress it one stage at a time, and evaluate it on five driving curricula. We show that structured pruning is the stage at which the driving capability is first lost. Meanwhile, distillation improves the pruned actor, but the improvement is limited by its rehearsal data. Integer quantization of the improved actor loses some of the curricula that require the vehicle to stop and then resume. Interestingly, the same procedure on the unpruned actor preserves all five curricula. Our study thus provides an empirical analysis aiming to answer the currently active discussions on how to accept a compressed driving policy, so as to achieve a safe and statistically reliable deployment of automated driving functions.

</details>


### [364] [Escaping Redundant Reasoning: Structure-Aware Search for Inference-Time LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00738)
*Lu Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出BASIN，一种无需训练的、结构感知的推理时搜索选择方法。它通过将推理状态分组为"盆地"（basins）并惩罚重复访问同一策略，从而在固定计算预算下将搜索重新分配到真正不同的推理路径上，缓解大语言模型推理时的"推理盆地塌缩"问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在推理时搜索往往集中在少量结构或语义相似的轨迹上，忽略了大量替代方案。作者将这种失败模式称为"推理盆地塌缩"（reasoning basin collapse），亟需一种方法让搜索覆盖真正多样的推理路径。

Method: BASIN：一种无需训练的、结构感知的选择方法。将推理状态划分为盆地，对重复访问同一策略的行为施加惩罚，从而在固定计算预算下把搜索重新分配到不同策略的推理路径上。还提出质量感知变体QA-BASIN，通过保留高质量盆地来增强鲁棒性。作者提出冗余差距Δ用于解释盆地感知选择何时有效。

Result: 在相同推理预算下，BASIN相比Tree of Thoughts (ToT)在Game of 24上最高提升+22个百分点，在MuSR上最高提升+6.7个百分点。QA-BASIN进一步增强了鲁棒性。标准ToT通常在Δ≈0附近运行，而BASIN持续将Δ推向正值，说明其有效利用了推理结构的多样性。

Conclusion: 结构感知的选择是一种简单且通用的方法，可以改善大语言模型的推理时推理能力。代码已开源。

Abstract: Inference-time search with large language models (LLMs) often concentrates on a small set of structurally or semantically similar trajectories, leaving alternatives underexplored---a failure mode we call \textit{reasoning basin collapse}. We introduce BASIN, a training-free, structure-aware selection method that groups reasoning states into basins and penalizes repeated visits to the same strategy, thereby reallocating search across genuinely distinct reasoning paths under a fixed compute budget. Under matched inference budgets, BASIN improves over Tree of Thoughts (ToT) by up to $+22$pp on Game of 24 and $+6.7$pp on MuSR. A quality-aware variant, QA-BASIN, further improves robustness by preserving high-quality basins when unconditional diversification over-explores. To explain when basin-aware selection helps, we introduce the redundancy gap $Δ$, which measures how differently search concentrates for correct versus incorrect predictions: standard ToT often operates near $Δ\approx 0$, while BASIN consistently shifts $Δ$ positive. More broadly, BASIN suggests structure-aware selection as a simple and general approach to improving inference-time reasoning. Code can be found at https://github.com/GitHubLuCheng/basin.

</details>


### [365] [ContextPipe: Database-Inspired Context Assembly for Long-Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00749)
*Peng Xu,Zuyu Zhang,Yuze Sun,Feng Tian,Long Wang,Chen Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ContextPipe，一个将长程LLM代理的上下文组装问题形式化为类关系数据库查询执行的五阶段流水线框架，通过结构化数据源目录和确定性缓存感知优化器，实现可审计、可重放、故障隔离的上下文管理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程LLM代理需要运行时决定每个提示词中包含什么上下文、以什么顺序、以及何时压缩历史，但当前生产系统中的这种逻辑散落在提示词构造器、临时压缩例程、缓存破解方案和供应商适配器中，缺乏统一的理论框架和系统化设计。

Method: 提出ContextPipe，一个五阶段流水线（Plan Bind Optimize Execute Feedback），包括结构化数据源目录、确定性缓存感知优化器，以及EXPLAIN ANALYZE追踪机制。其核心洞察是将上下文组装视为与关系数据库查询执行结构同构的问题：两者都在硬预算下执行、利用分层缓存、并依赖统计信息。

Result: 在SWE-bench Pro Qutebrowser子集上的初步评估显示，与追加式上下文构建策略相比，ContextPipe将总token量减少31%、LLM调用次数减少23%、响应时间减少9%，代价是KV缓存命中率较低。

Conclusion: 将数据库查询执行的纪律性引入LLM代理的上下文组装是可行的，能够带来显著的效率提升和更好的可观测性，但需要在KV缓存命中率和token效率之间做权衡。

Abstract: Long-horizon large language model (LLM) agents require context assembly: the runtime must decide what to include in each prompt, in what order, and when to compact history under a hard context-window budget and a byte-sensitive prompt cache. In production agentic systems, this logic is scattered across prompt builders, ad hoc compaction routines, cache-break workarounds, and per-provider shims. We argue that context assembly is structurally isomorphic to query execution in a relational database: both execute under a hard budget, exploit a tiered cache, and leverage statistics. We adopt this discipline in ContextPipe: a five-phase pipeline (Plan Bind Optimize Execute Feedback) backed by a structured data-source catalog, a deterministic cache-aware optimizer, and an EXPLAIN ANALYZE trace. We show that context in ContextPipe is auditable, replayable, and failure-isolated. A preliminary evaluation using the SWE-bench Pro Qutebrowser subset shows that, compared with the append-only context construction policy, ContextPipe reduces total token volume by 31%, LLM calls by 23%, and response time by 9%, at the cost of a lower KV cache-hit ratio.

</details>


### [366] [S^3martCirc: Self-supervised Smart Circuit Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00755)
*Wendy Zheng,Yinhan He,Liang Wu,Jundong Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出S³martCirc框架，一种自监督的智能电路发现方法，能够同时进行电路发现和功能解释，将节点行为抽象为两种通用的计算角色，并用量化指标进行联合发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机械可解释性方法采用两阶段范式（先电路发现再功能解释），但组件的重要性和功能角色本质上是相互依赖的，分步处理会忽略这一关键洞见。此外，功能角色常绑定特定节点难以泛化，且依赖主观解释而非量化指标。

Method: 提出S³martCirc（自监督智能电路发现）统一框架，将节点行为抽象为两种可跨任务泛化的通用计算角色，并定义量化指标来分配角色，使重要性和功能角色能够联合发现而非顺序进行。

Result: 大量实验表明，该框架在电路发现任务上优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 通过联合建模重要性与功能角色的相互依赖关系，S³martCirc提供了一种更优的电路发现方案，并引入可量化的功能解释机制。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance across diverse tasks, from text summarization to question answering. Despite these capabilities, their black-box nature obscures internal decision-making processes. Mechanistic interpretability (MI) aims to address this by reverse-engineering neural networks into human-understandable algorithms. Current MI approaches for LLMs typically follow a two-stage paradigm: first identifying important components (circuit discovery), where components are typically individual nodes such as an attention head or feedforward neuron, and second determining the role they play in a certain task (functional interpretation). However, this sequential approach overlooks a fundamental insight: a component's importance and its functional role are inherently codependent. Unifying these stages presents two key challenges: (1) functional roles are often tied to specific nodes or components, limiting generalization, and (2) their identification relies on subjective interpretation rather than quantifiable metrics. To address these challenges, we propose S^3martCirc (Self-supervised Smart Circuit Discovery), a unified framework that simultaneously discovers circuits and interprets functionality. S^3martCirc abstracts node behavior into two general computational roles that generalize across tasks and defines a quantitative metric for assigning them, enabling importance and functional role to be discovered jointly rather than in sequence. Extensive experiments show that our framework outperforms existing methods in circuit discovery.

</details>


### [367] [Automated Tree Knowledge Graph Construction using Ontology Expansion and Retrieval from Vietnamese History Textbooks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00763)
*Ket Doan Nguyen,Minh N. H. Nguyen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个端到端的知识图谱构建与检索策略评估流程，针对越南语低资源场景。采用三阶段混合关系抽取管线（Union-Find批内去重、近似跨批搜索、带质心过滤的LLM抽取和五步双LLM验证器），构建双层架构（不可合并结构节点+可合并内容节点）。基于越南高中历史教科书（400页）构建750节点、4,341条语义边的树状知识图谱（本体从40增长到41类型）。评估三种图遍历策略（自顶向下、水平、自底向上）在1,210个越南语查询上的表现，其中自顶向下+结构策略在NDCG@10上比向量基线高4.7个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有层级知识图谱RAG方法缺乏：1）面向越南语等低资源语言的基于本体扩展的自动KG构建方法；2）利用层级结构的知识检索策略的系统性评估。这两个挑战阻碍了结构化知识对LLM的有效支持。

Method: 1) KG构建：采用三阶段混合关系抽取管线，包括Union-Find批内去重、近似跨批搜索和带质心过滤的LLM抽取，配合五步双LLM验证器防止本体膨胀；采用双层架构（不可合并结构节点与可合并内容节点）保留文档结构。2) 检索评估：评估Top-Down、Horizontal、Bottom-Up三种图遍历策略，在合成的1,210个越南语查询（从109个子图、五种查询方向）基准上进行测试。

Result: 从越南高中历史教科书（近400页）构建出750节点、4,341条语义边的树状知识图谱，本体类型从40控制在41（增长极小）。Top-Down策略+结构信息在NDCG@10上超越向量基线4.7个百分点。树结构信息在大多数场景优于平面余弦相似度，但当查询不需要结构上下文时会降低性能。

Conclusion: 树状结构信息能为RAG检索提供超越平面向量相似度的额外价值，但需根据查询是否依赖结构上下文来决定是否使用。本文验证了低资源语言下可控本体膨胀的KG自动构建可行性，并为层级结构检索策略提供了系统性评估基准。

Abstract: Hierarchical Knowledge graph (KG)-based retrieval augmented generation (RAG) has emerged as a powerful approach for supporting large language models with structured knowledge. However, there are primary challenges: (i) the lack of methods for automatic KG construction using ontology expansion for low-resource languages such as Vietnamese, (ii) the absence of systematic evaluation for knowledge retrieval strategies leveraging the hierarchical structures. In this paper, we propose an end-to-end pipeline for KG construction and retrieval strategies evaluation.
