These results show that models can localize evidence for recovered events while still failing to maintain complete and temporally valid longitudinal records.

</details>


### [402] [H2Table: Hierarchical Hypergraph-Enhanced Large Language Models for Complex Table Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01216)
*Jia Ling,Yangfan Wang,Chen Tang,Haoming Tan,Yang Yang,Yi Guan,Jingchi Jiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出H2Table框架，将复杂表格表示为层次化嵌套超图，通过定制超图编码器在超边（表头）与节点（单元格）间进行消息传递，并引入可学习查询向量将结构嵌入轻量级桥接到LLM，有效提升复杂表问答性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM处理表格推理时通常将表格线性化，忽略了表格固有的二维和层次结构，导致在处理具有复杂层次嵌套表头的表格时性能受限。

Method: 1) 将复杂表格构建为层次化嵌套超图；2) 设计定制的超图编码器，在超边（表头）与节点（单元格）之间进行消息传递，感知语义蕴含关系；3) 引入一组可学习的查询向量作为轻量级桥梁，从编码器中提取代表性结构嵌入并注入LLM。

Result: 在HiTab数据集上，对于嵌套深度为四的高度复杂表格，H2Table相比最先进基线平均提升22.88%，展示了在复杂层次嵌套表头表格问答任务上的有效性。

Conclusion: H2Table通过超图建模有效保留了表格的二维层次结构信息，为复杂表格推理提供了一种优于线性化范式的新思路。

Abstract: Tables are ubiquitous across diverse domains, yet reasoning over them remains a significant challenge for modern large language models (LLMs). Current approaches typically linearize tables into sequences, inherently overlooking their intrinsic two-dimensional and hierarchical structure. To address this, we propose H2Table (Hierarchical Hypergraph-Enhanced Table Reasoning), a novel framework that represents complex tables as hierarchical nested hypergraphs. To process this representation, we design a tailored hypergraph encoder to facilitate message passing between hyperedges (headers) and nodes (cells), thereby perceiving the semantic entailment relationships between them within complex tables. Furthermore, we introduce a set of learnable query vectors acting as a lightweight bridge to extract representative structural embeddings from the encoder into the LLM. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach effectively handles complex table question answering tasks with hierarchical nested headers. Notably, on the HiTab dataset, H2Table achieves an average improvement of 22.88% over state-of-the-art baselines on highly complex tables with a nesting depth of four. Our code is available at: https://github.com/lila120/h2table.

</details>


### [403] [Prompt-Robust Language Models: Which Training Strategies Work?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01217)
*Frederic Sadrieh,Michal Štefánik*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统地复现并比较了多种提示敏感性缓解策略，发现在受控条件下，当前鲁棒性微调方法虽优于标准微调和上下文学习，但最佳与最差提示间的性能差距仍高达40-57%。更关键的是，先进的鲁棒性增强方法（CoIN、PPCL）往往无法超越最简单的数据构建策略（每批次单一模板训练）。诊断分析揭示了原因：辅助目标只改善其惩罚的指标而缺乏泛化，且不同模板的梯度在57-64%参数上方向冲突，迫使优化器调和竞争性更新而非寻找统一的提示无关解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型对提示表述高度敏感，现有工作通过精炼数据构建或专用鲁棒性目标来应对，但缺乏在受控条件下对这些策略的系统性复现和公平比较，需要理解这些方法的实际效果及其失败原因。

Method: 在受控条件下复现并比较标准微调、上下文学习、数据构建策略（如每批次单模板训练）以及鲁棒性微调方法（CoIN对比对齐和PPCL一致性正则化），并通过梯度符号分析等诊断手段解释各方法的表现差异。

Result: 鲁棒性微调方法优于标准微调和上下文学习，但最佳到最差提示的性能差距仍保留40-57%；CoIN和PPCL往往不如最简单的单模板数据构建策略；辅助目标不能泛化其改善效果；57-64%参数的梯度方向在不同模板间冲突。

Conclusion: 当前缓解提示敏感性的方法效果有限，辅助目标缺乏跨提示泛化能力；关键是混合模板批次中的梯度冲突，暗示未来应聚焦于寻找共享的提示无关优化方向，而非依赖复杂的辅助正则化目标。

Abstract: Despite their strong performance, large language models remain highly sensitive to prompt formulation. Prior work addresses this through refined data construction or through dedicated robustness objectives. We reproduce and compare these strategies under controlled conditions, and measure how effective they are in addressing models' prompt sensitivity. We find the current robustness fine-tuning methods improve over standard fine-tuning and in-context learning, but the best-to-worst prompt gap remains as high as 40-57% of performance. Moreover, the recent robustness-enhancing methods we test - CoIN for contrastive alignment and PPCL for consistency regularization - often fail to outperform the simplest data construction strategy: training on one template per batch. Our diagnostics explain these results. The auxiliary objectives move the quantity they penalize, but do not generalize beyond it. Additionally, data construction strategies differ due to the conflicting signs of per-template gradients on 57-64% of parameters. Thus, batches that mix formulations force the optimizer to reconcile competing updates instead of finding a shared, prompt-agnostic one.

</details>


### [404] [Measuring the Behavioral Fidelity of Long-Horizon Human Activity Simulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01257)
*Yi Fei Cheng,Fan Yang,Iremsu Bas,Koichiro Niinuma,Narishige Abe,David Lindlbauer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个评估LLM人类模拟器在长期活动模拟中行为保真度的框架，通过收集43小时多摄像头办公室活动数据，比较多种条件机制（人格描述、少样本示例、统计转移和时间先验），发现统计先验在活动分布上最接近真实行为，但会过度碎片化日常规律并抑制个体内变异性，因此需要跨多指标、多时间粒度和多分析层次的综合评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的人类模拟器正越来越多地被用于政策制定、评估和培训，因此必须忠实还原真实的个人行为模式。以往研究虽然考察了调查问卷和对话中的行为保真度，但长期跨度的真实世界活动尚未被充分探索，这构成了一个重要的研究空白。

Method: 提出一个在长期活动模拟中跨时间粒度和分析层次评估行为保真度的框架。作为案例研究，收集了一个43小时野外办公活动的多摄像头数据集，并比较基于轨迹衍生的多种条件机制：人格描述符、少样本示例、统计转移和时间点先验。

Result: 发现行为保真度在不同指标上并不一致：统计先验使活动和序列分布最接近真实行为，但会过度碎片化日常规律并抑制个体内变异性。这表明保真度评估不能依赖单一指标。

Conclusion: 研究结果推动采用更全面的评估方法，即跨越多个指标、时间粒度和分析层次来评估L基于LLM的人类模拟器的行为保真度。

Abstract: As LLM-based human simulators are increasingly used for policy, evaluation, and training, they must faithfully reproduce real behavioral patterns. While prior work has examined behavioral fidelity in survey responses and dialogue, longer-horizon real-world activity remains largely unexplored. We introduce a framework for evaluating behavioral fidelity in long-horizon activity simulations across temporal granularities and levels of analysis. As a case study, we collect a 43-hour multi-camera dataset of in-the-wild office activity and compare trace-derived conditioning mechanisms: persona descriptors, few-shot exemplars, and statistical transition and time-of-day priors. We find that behavioral fidelity is not uniform across metrics: statistical priors bring activity and sequence distributions closest to real behavior, yet over-fragment routines and suppress within-person variability. These findings motivate a more holistic evaluation that spans multiple metrics, temporal granularities, and levels of analysis.

</details>


### [405] [Dual Process Motion Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01260)
*Jiayi Yan,Francesco Fabiano,Alessandro Abate*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种神经符号双过程架构，借鉴"快思考与慢思考"范式，将符号求解器（System-2）与基于经验的强化学习模块（System-1）结合，通过元认知控制器动态协调二者，用于非线性运动规划。实验表明该框架在规划效率、精度和泛化性上均优于单一方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典控制与规划方法能提供强保证但计算效率低且适应性差；基于学习的方法虽能克服这些局限，但缺乏鲁棒性保障。作者希望融合两者的优势，通过神经符号视角弥补各自短板，实现既快速又可适应且可靠的非线性运动规划。

Method: 提出双过程架构：1) System-2组件集成最先进的符号求解器，提供精确但较慢的推理；2) System-1模块基于经验驱动，提供快速直觉式决策；3) 一个元认知控制器作为"大脑执行层"，动态决定何时依赖快速直觉、何时调用慢速精确推理，实现两者的智能编排。

Result: 在多个非线性基准规划环境中评估，该架构在规划效率、精度和泛化能力上均取得一致提升，并促进了任务间的知识复用。

Conclusion: 将学习与结构化推理紧密耦合，为构建更强大、更具适应性的机器人系统提供了一条可扩展的路径，验证了神经符号融合范式的价值。

Abstract: Robotic systems are deeply embedded in both industry and everyday life, where they are expected to act with speed, precision, and reliability. Classical control and planning methods have long delivered strong guarantees, but often at the cost of computational efficiency and adaptability. More recently, learning-based approaches have shown promise in overcoming these limitations, enabling agents to leverage experience to accelerate decision-making and address previously intractable problems. In this work, we bridge these two approaches through a neuro-symbolic perspective on nonlinear motion planning. Inspired by the Thinking Fast and Slow paradigm, we introduce a dual-process architecture that combines the strengths of robust reasoning and learning. Our framework integrates state-of-the-art symbolic solvers as a ``System-2'' component with experience-driven ``System-1'' modules. A metacognitive controller dynamically orchestrates their interaction, selecting when to rely on fast intuition versus slower, more precise reasoning. By evaluating the framework across diverse nonlinear benchmark environments, we demonstrate that this architecture yields consistent gains in planning efficiency, accuracy, and generalization, while promoting reuse across tasks. The results suggest that tightly coupling learning with structured reasoning offers a scalable path toward more capable and adaptive robotic systems.

</details>


### [406] [Making Prospective Memory SLM-Shaped: Typed Intention Stores for Small-Model Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01272)
*Jinqing Zhao,Chengcan Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出前瞻性意图存储（PIS），通过将生命周期逻辑放在代码中、仅将限定范围的语义工作留给模型，使小型模型在前瞻记忆基准PM-Bench上超越前沿大型模型。PIS是一个无需训练的agentic scaffold，在PM-Bench上达到82.9% Set-F1，使小模型（DeepSeek-Chat、Gemma-E2B）大幅超越现有最佳发表的65.1%的结果，并新设该基准的最先进水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前瞻记忆是agent在持续工作环境中执行延迟意图的关键能力，但即使前沿LLM仍难以胜任（最佳发布PM-Bench scaffold仅65.1% Set-F1）。作者认为问题本质是schema约束的状态追踪而非开放式推理，因此小模型在类型化动作空间下也能胜任，无需依赖大型模型。

Method: 提出Prospective Intention Store（PIS）框架：将前瞻记忆的生命周期逻辑（如意图存储、状态更新、检索触发）交由代码实现，模型仅负责限定范围内的语义判断。该方法为agentic且无需训练，不涉selector微调或轨迹蒸馏。

Result: 在PM-Bench上，DeepSeek-Chat配合PIS达到82.9% Set-F1；在Gemma-E2B上，无store时仅4.2%、七条回溯记忆下最高6.6%，而PIS达到66.2%；PIS在另一场景达70.1%，回溯记忆方法最多仅54.4%。小模型配合PIS即可超越发布的大模型scaffold。

Conclusion: PIS刷新了PM-Bench的最先进水平，证明将生命周期逻辑外包给代码、模型专注类型化动作空间内的语义工作，可使小型模型在前瞻记忆任务上超越大型模型，为该领域提供了training-free且高效的替代方案。

Abstract: Prospective memory means carrying out a deferred intention at the right future cue while other work continues. Benchmarks now isolate it as an agent skill, yet frontier LLMs still struggle: the best published PM-Bench scaffold reaches only 65.1% Set-F1. We argue that this loop is schema-constrained state tracking rather than open-ended reasoning, and that small models can execute it when the action space is typed. We propose the Prospective Intention Store (PIS) that puts lifecycle logic in code and scoped language work on the model. The scaffold is agentic and training-free: no selector fine-tuning and no trajectory distillation. On PM-Bench, DeepSeek-Chat with PIS reaches 82.9% Set-F1. On Gemma-E2B, Set-F1 is only 4.2% without a store and at most 6.6% under seven retrospective memories, while PIS reaches 66.2%. PIS further reaches 70.1% Set-F1, where retrospective memory methods stay at most 54.4%. PIS sets a new state of the art on this benchmark and enables small models to surpass the published large-model scaffold.

</details>


### [407] [Analog-DB: An Agent-First Analog Integrated Circuit Database, From Blocks to Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01286)
*Danial Noori Zadeh,Mohamed B. Elamien*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出analog-db，一个开源、版本化的模拟集成电路设计数据库，基于可共享的设计表示(DSL)将电路拓扑、测试平台和机器可读数据表统一在同一schema下，使设计可完整共享并能在绑定的工艺套件上重新仿真，支持AI设计代理直接发现和复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟集成电路设计共享困难：代工厂NDA限制工艺细节公开，published结果所依赖的testbench很少发布，导致设计难以复现和复用。

Method: 提出analog-db开源版本化数据库，核心方法包括：(1)DSL捕获工艺无关拓扑、可复用testbench和机器可读datasheet；(2)参数化方案将功能子模块和设备尺寸暴露为带约束的命名参数，使电路可组合、可重定向；(3)schema治理的契约与可查询目录支持AI设计代理直接发现和复用电路。

Result: 在regulator语料库中，23个电路-工艺绑定全部满足各自记录的规格带；17/23原本失败的导入尺寸在gm/ID闭环下1-3次迭代内收敛；受控案例中编码代理成功定位4处手动缺陷及缺失的共模反馈回路，而仅尺寸化基线无法修复。

Conclusion: analog-db证明了模拟IC设计可以通过工艺无关的可共享表征实现开放共享与自动修复，数据库含16类68个电路，以分层测试框架在原理图级可验证，并配有功耗/性能记分板，已开源发布。

Abstract: Sharing analog integrated circuit designs remains difficult: foundry non-disclosure agreements restrict the process details a design depends on, and the testbenches behind published results are rarely released. We present analog-db, an open-source, versioned database built on a shareable design representation. A domain-specific language captures each design as a process-neutral topology, reusable testbenches, and a machine-readable datasheet under one schema, so a design is shared in full and re-simulates on the process kits it is bound to. A parameterization scheme exposes functional sub-blocks and device sizes as named parameters that carry their matching constraints, making circuits composable and retargetable; a schema-governed contract and queryable catalog let AI design agents discover and reuse them directly. Across the regulator corpus, all 23 circuit-kit bindings on three open kits meet their own recorded specification bands (typical corner, matched devices, no layout) and 10 of 23 meet a common class band. Seventeen of the 23 imported sizings failed their testbenches and closed under a gm/ID sizing loop driven by the annotated sub-block roles, typically within one to three iterations. In a supervised case study, a coding agent working from the released artifacts sized the op-amp cores of a chopper instrumentation amplifier on an open 130nm kit, locating four hand-entry defects and a missing common-mode feedback loop that the sizing-only baseline did not repair. The database holds 68 circuits across sixteen classes, verifiable at schematic level under a tiered harness and tracked on a power/performance scoreboard, released at https://github.com/MacAnalog/spicexplorer-release.

</details>


### [408] [A Composable Evaluation System for Reproducible Omni-Modal Foundation Model Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01315)
*Hodong Lee,Sanghee Park,Dohoon Ryu,Jungwhan Kim,Junyeob Kim,Soyoon Kim,Geewook Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍OmniEvaluator，一个全模态（文本、图像、视频、音频）基础模型的统一评估工具包，通过单接口连接四种推理后端和四种评估框架，覆盖上千个基准测试，支持可复现记录、共享仪表盘、联邦式GPU推理共享，并内置轻量级CPU可运行的评分验证器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有各模态的评估工具包虽然优秀，但其推理引擎、提示约定和指标实现互不兼容，导致从业者需要为每个工具链维护独立环境，且难以跨工具比较结果。这在多模态基础模型开发中造成了严重障碍。

Method: OmniEvaluator不重新实现基准测试，而是在更高层连接现有的推理引擎和精选评估库，暴露四种推理后端、四种评估框架和超过一千个基准测试的统一接口。每次运行记录为带完整配置的工件以保证精确复现，结果汇入共享仪表盘进行跨模型比较。支持联邦模式在并发评估间共享GPU推理服务器，并内置可在CPU上运行的小型验证器，在不同引擎和提示配置下保持评分稳定。

Result: 内置验证器在基于规则的评分因配置不匹配而波动时，能保持评分稳定，匹配成本效益高的商业LLM评审效果，同时无需其重复的API成本。演示视频和仪表盘均已公开可用。

Conclusion: OmniEvaluator通过高层集成而非重新实现，解决了多模态模型评估中工具链碎片化和结果不可比的问题，提供了一个统一、可复现、可扩展且成本高效的评估解决方案。

Abstract: Building an omni-modal foundation model means evaluating it across text, image, video, and audio. Excellent evaluation toolkits exist for each modality, but their inference engines, prompt conventions, and metric implementations are mutually incompatible, so practitioners end up maintaining separate environments for every toolchain and still struggle to compare results across them. OmniEvaluator grew out of this need in our own model development: rather than reimplementing benchmarks, it connects existing inference engines and curated evaluation libraries at a higher level, exposing four inference backends, four evaluation frameworks, and over a thousand benchmarks through a single interface. Every run is recorded as an artifact capturing the full configuration for exact reproduction, and results flow into a shared dashboard for cross-model comparison. A federated mode shares GPU inference servers across concurrent evaluations, and a built-in verifier, small enough to run on CPU, keeps its score stable across engines and prompts where rule-based scoring fluctuates under configuration mismatch, matching cost-efficient commercial LLM judges without their recurring API cost. The system, demo video, and dashboard are publicly available. (https://github.com/naver-ai/omni-evaluator)

</details>


### [409] [Automated Event Log Generation from Unstructured Text Using Finetuned LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01320)
*Maximilian Seeth,Gabriel Marques Tavares,Daniel Schuster*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种利用大语言模型（LLMs）作为自动数据翻译器的可扩展框架，将非结构化的文本资源（如工单、手册、报告）转换为结构化事件日志，并通过在新建的text-to-log数据集上微调LLM，实现在无需领域专家人工构建事件日志的情况下，将非结构化数据接入流程挖掘生态系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流程挖掘技术依赖结构化事件日志，但事件日志的构建通常需要领域专家和流程挖掘专家耗费大量人力手工完成，成本高昂，导致大量组织知识（如事件工单、手册和文本报告）未被充分利用。作者旨在解决这一瓶颈，探索LLM作为自动化数据翻译器来弥合非结构化文本与结构化事件数据之间的鸿沟。

Method: 作者提出一个可扩展框架，利用LLM作为数据翻译器。具体方法包括：1) 构建一个新的text-to-log数据集；2) 在该数据集上对LLM进行微调（finetuning）；3) 将微调后的模型与few-shot和zero-shot提示方法进行比较，验证微调是生成可靠事件数据的必要前提。

Result: 微调方法在从非结构化资源中提取高保真事件日志方面，大幅优于few-shot和zero-shot提示方法，表明微调是生成可靠事件数据的必要条件。

Conclusion: 该方法为将此前未充分利用的数据引入流程挖掘生态系统提供了有前景的流水线，有效扩展了流程挖掘在组织工作流研究中的应用范围。

Abstract: Process mining (PM) provides a powerful framework for discovering and optimizing operational processes from event data. However, the efficacy of PM techniques is strictly predicated on the availability of structured event logs. Thus far, event logs have often been laboriously created by domain and process mining experts. This costly effort causes large portions of organizational knowledge, including incident tickets, manuals, and textual reports, to remain underutilized. We address this bottleneck by investigating the efficacy of Large Language Models (LLMs) as automated data translators. We propose a scalable framework that leverages LLMs as data translators to bridge the gap between unstructured textual resources and structured event data. We finetune LLMs on a newly created text-to-log dataset, demonstrating that the resulting models can extract high-fidelity event logs from unstructured resources. Our results show that this finetuning approach outperforms few-shot or zero-shot prompting by a large amount, highlighting finetuning as a necessary pre-condition for generating reliable event data. We conclude that our method provides a promising pipeline for making previously unused data available to process mining ecosystems, effectively expanding the possibilities of using PM to further investigate organizational workflows.

</details>


### [410] [LEAP: Likelihood Elicitation and Aggregation for LLM-based Probabilistic Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01337)
*Yufei Chen,Yiran Zhao,Xiaogang Xu,Qipeng Xie,Jiafei Wu,Zhe Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出LEAP方法，逐条审视每条证据并提取似然参数，通过显式先验和确定性概率模型聚合为后验分布，替代传统"整体读取所有证据"的单一预测方式，在多个任务上提升预测与校准指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM预测系统虽在搜索与工具使用上有所改进，但多数仍采用"整体读取全部证据后一次性生成最终预测"的Monolithic Prediction设计。这种设计会掩盖单个证据项对结果的影响，并在互斥的候选结果间坍缩不确定性，导致预测缺乏可解释性与良好的概率校准。

Method: 提出LEAP框架：将预测阶段重组，逐条单独检查每条证据并提取其针对目标的似然参数；再利用一个显式先验和确定性概率模型，将这些似然聚合成后验分布。该方法支持连续型、单选型与多选型预测，并能保留可复现的证据贡献。

Result: 构建了涵盖预测、信息搜寻与浏览任务的基准，在自有智能体循环及多个agent CLI框架上评估。在相同证据下，LEAP在多种模型上提升了大部分预测与校准指标，并在先验访问、推理预算与聚合方式的受控比较下表现更强。

Conclusion: LEAP通过将"整体预测"重构为"逐证据似然提取+概率聚合"，改善了预测性能与校准质量，同时增强了证据贡献的可解释性，是一种优于Monolithic Prediction的预测阶段设计方案。

Abstract: LLM-based forecasting systems have improved on real-world tasks such as financial markets and sports outcomes, largely through stronger search and tool use. Many systems still ask an LLM to read all collected evidence together and produce the final forecast. We call this design Monolithic Prediction. It can obscure how individual evidence items affect the result and collapse uncertainty across competing outcomes. We propose LEAP (Likelihood Elicitation and Aggregation for Probabilistic forecasting), which reorganizes how collected evidence is used in the prediction stage. LEAP examines each evidence item separately and elicits likelihood parameters that describe its implications for the target. An explicit prior and a deterministic probabilistic model then combine these likelihoods into a posterior distribution. This procedure supports continuous, single-choice, and multi-choice forecasts while preserving reproducible evidence contributions. We build a benchmark covering forecasting, information-seeking, and browsing tasks, and evaluate LEAP on our own agent loop and several agent CLI frameworks. Given the same evidence, LEAP improves most prediction and calibration metrics across models and remains stronger under controlled comparisons of prior access, inference budget, and aggregation.

</details>


### [411] [Cheap Verifiers, Large Blind Spots: Measuring the Reliability Cost of Cost-Saving Cascades](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01345)
*Dushyant Rajput*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了推理级联（inference cascades）的自我改进闭环：用廉价模型回答多数问题，将困难尾部升级到前沿模型作为验证器，然后在验证器拒绝的学生答案上对廉价模型进行微调以降低成本。作者在真实LLM上测量该循环，发现四个关键发现：验证器盲区随学生能力增长而扩大（对抗性移动）；购买盲区会造成高升级率；天真纠正微调会降解并最终摧毁小模型（自我改进循环自我挫败）；级联自身的仪表盘显示平坦的3%误差，而真实误差会飙升至32%——系统在构造上对其自身退化视而不见。作者给出解释该盲区的理论：两群体守恒定律 ε∞ ≲ q₀β₀。实际结论：自我改进级联的可靠性无法通过其自身验证器计算的任何指标来读取。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理级联通过廉价模型+前沿模型验证器来降低成本已是一种自然且实用的方案，直觉上进一步闭环（在验证器拒绝的尾部数据上微调廉价学生模型）可以降低升级率和成本。作者希望验证这个看似自然的自我改进循环是否真的有效，并关心系统在迭代中是否可靠、可观测。

Method: 作者在真实LLM上（学生规模从0.5B到32B）实验性地测量验证器的盲区（β，即学生答错但被验证器接受的比例），测试不同规模、不同家族的验证器，并实施天真的纠正微调（在验证器拒绝的尾部上微调学生），同时追踪级联内部仪表盘指标与真实质量指标之间的偏差。他们还开发了理论分析：两群体守恒定律（ε∞ ≲ q₀β₀）并辅以合成研究验证机制。

Result: 四个主要发现：(1) 验证器盲区β随学生能力从0.12增长到0.55（0.5B到32B），随验证器能力下降——最糟糕的是廉价学生+廉价验证器区域；(2) 使用前沿验证器可将β降到约0.05，但在hard-MATH上对46%的查询升级（真实错误率仅39%），几乎一半流量支付前沿价格；(3) 天真纠正微调在所有教师（跨家族和同家族）下都使小模型退化并最终崩溃；(4) 级联仪表盘（所有通过自身验证器计算的指标）显示平坦的3%误差，而真实交付错误可高达32%——系统对自身退化天然失明。

Conclusion: 自我改进级联的循环在实际上（至少在此规模下）是自我挫败的，且更隐蔽的是，整个系统在构造上就无法通过其自身的验证器监控自身的可靠性。任何通过系统自身验证器计算的指标都无法反映真实质量；只有依赖外部验证或独立性检验才能评估自我改进级联的可靠性。

Abstract: Inference cascades cut cost by answering most queries with a cheap model and escalating a hard tail to a frontier model that acts as verifier. A natural extension closes the loop: fine-tune the cheap student on the verifier's rejections so the escalation rate, and cost, fall each round. We measure this loop on real LLMs and report four findings. First, the verifier's blind spot, the fraction of the student's wrong answers it accepts, is large and moves adversarially: it grows with student capability ($β$ from 0.12 to 0.55 as the student scales 0.5B to 32B) and shrinks with verifier capability, so it is worst in the cheap-student, cheap-verifier regime cascades exist to create. Second, buying it away returns the saving: a frontier verifier drives $β$ to about 0.05 but then escalates on 46% of hard-MATH queries against a 39% true error rate, paying the frontier price on nearly half of all traffic. Third, naive corrective fine-tuning on the verifier-rejected tail does not improve the small student but degrades and ultimately collapses it, across every teacher we tried (cross-family and same-family), so at this scale the self-improving loop is self-defeating. Fourth, through all of this the cascade's own dashboard, every metric computed through the verifier, reads a flat 3% error while true delivered error swings up to 32%: the system is blind to its own degradation by construction. We then give the theory that explains the blindness, a two-population conservation law, $ε_\infty \lesssim q_0 β_0$, under which every in-loop metric improves while true quality does not, and a synthetic study that validates the mechanism. The practical conclusion: the reliability of a self-improving cascade cannot be read from any metric computed through its own verifier.

</details>


### [412] [SymFold: Synergizing Evolutionary and Structural Priors for Accurate Protein Inverse Folding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01353)
*Handong Wang,Jiaxin Qi,Baisheng Lai,Jianqiang Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种对称双路径架构，用于蛋白质逆折叠任务（从3D结构恢复氨基酸序列），同时利用蛋白质语言模型（PLMs）的序列进化知识和多模态蛋白质语言模型（MPLMs）的结构知识，迭代指导序列生成，在标准基准上达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有逆折叠方法采用串行流水线（结构编码器预测粗序列，再由PLMs细化），但PLMs只能事后编辑序列，效果受限于上游预测质量。虽然新出现的多模态蛋白质语言模型（MPLMs）可编码结构，但实验发现它们直接用于逆折叠并不有效。因此需要一种能同时充分利用两种模型优势的方法。

Method: 提出对称双路径架构：一条路径利用PLMs提供的预训练序列进化知识，另一条路径利用MPLMs提供的预训练结构知识，两条路径迭代协同引导蛋白质序列生成。

Result: 在多个标准蛋白质逆折叠基准上取得SOTA性能，超越先前方法；消融实验验证了对称设计的合理性。

Conclusion: 对称双路径设计是有效的，能够同时发挥PLMs与MPLMs各自的预训练知识优势，为蛋白质逆折叠领域提供了新的有前景的方向。

Abstract: Protein inverse folding aims to recover amino acid sequences for a given 3D protein structure, underpinning broad applications such as enzyme engineering and drug discovery.Current methods often follow a serial pipeline, in which a structure encoder predicts a coarse sequence, which is then refined by protein language models (PLMs). However, because PLMs only perform post-hoc sequence edits, the refinement is bounded by the quality of upstream predictions.Thanks to recent multimodal protein language models (MPLMs), we could directly encode structure to generate sequences with pretrained structural knowledge, but we observe that they are not effective for inverse folding. Therefore, we introduce a symmetric dual-path architecture that both leverages PLMs for pretrained sequence evolution knowledge and MPLMs for pretrained structural knowledge to iteratively guide protein sequence generation.Through extensive experiments across standard protein inverse folding benchmarks, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, surpassing prior approaches, and ablation studies validate the rationale of our symmetric design, revealing a promising direction for the community.

</details>


### [413] [EDGE: Error Dependency Graph-Guided Multi-Error Attribution in Multi-Agent LLM Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01360)
*Jun Hou,Priya Pitre,Yi Fang,Xuan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出EDGE框架，通过构建错误依赖图并验证因果子集，实现多错误关联分析，优于现有的单一根因定位方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体失败往往包含多个相互关联的错误，而现有归因方法仅识别单一负责主体、步骤或根因，未能显式建模错误之间的依赖关系，导致归因不完整。

Method: EDGE框架包含两部分：首先从观察到的错误事件中构建错误依赖图，并通过反事实回滚验证可靠的因果子集；随后利用推理图引导两阶段LLM-as-judge检测器进行错误归因，以验证过的子图为解释和修复分析提供可靠依据。

Result: 在TRAIL和MAST数据集上的实验表明，EDGE在大多数评估模型和设置下提升了类别级多错误归因性能；适配Who&When风格提示的实验显示，依赖图对不同提示策略均有帮助。

Conclusion: 依赖结构可作为智能体故障诊断的有效先验，超越了孤立的根因预测范式，为多错误归因提供了更可靠的框架。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agent failures often contain multiple related errors rather than a single mistake. Existing attribution methods usually identify a responsible agent, step, or root cause, but do not explicitly model dependency between errors. We introduce EDGE, an Error Dependency Graph-guided multi-Error attribution framework. EDGE constructs an error dependency graph from observed error events and validates a reliable causal subset through counterfactual rollout. The inference graph guides a two-stage LLM-as-judge detector for error attribution, and the intervention-validated subgraph provides a more reliable basis for explanation and repair analysis. Experiments on TRAIL and MAST show that EDGE improves category-level multi-error attribution across most evaluated models and settings. Experiments with adapted Who&When-style prompts show that the graph helps across prompting strategies. These results suggest that dependency structure is a useful diagnostic prior for agent failures beyond isolated root-cause prediction.

</details>


### [414] [Neuro-Symbolic Geometric Abstraction (NeuSOGA): From Observations to Symbolic Mathematical Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01408)
*Qingde Li,Qingqi Hong,Jie Tian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: NeuSOGA是一个神经符号几何抽象框架，将几何观测逐步转化为显式的符号数学表示，而非传统的潜在编码。该框架结合拓扑引导的结构发现、Segment Anything基础模型感知、自适应多尺度几何抽象以及隐式面积样条的符号综合，生成支持任意阶平滑度、可加性组合和闭式求值的分析隐式模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代AI系统通过大规模统计学习获得卓越感知能力，但知识编码在难以检查和操作的潜在参数中。本文受神经符号AI和人类抽象理论启发，旨在弥合观测与显式符号表示之间的鸿沟，建立从观测到可解释数学符号的转化路径。

Method: NeuSOGA框架包含四个核心阶段：(1) 使用欧几里得距离变换进行拓扑引导的结构发现；(2) 使用Segment Anything进行基础模型感知；(3) 自适应多尺度几何抽象；(4) 通过隐式面积样条实现符号综合。最终生成解析隐式模型，其表示可解释、可编辑且数学上显式。

Result: 在ModelNet40点云、任意视角投影和分割光学观测上的实验表明，NeuSOGA能将多样观测转换为紧凑的符号表示，同时跨感知模态和视角方向保留基本几何与拓扑结构。

Conclusion: NeuSOGA提供了一条从观测到符号的可解释、可解释的途径，建立了从感知到抽象推理的神经符号桥梁，克服了传统神经潜在编码不可解释和难以操作的局限。

Abstract: A fundamental challenge in artificial intelligence is the transformation of observations into explicit symbolic representations suitable for abstraction, interpretation, and reasoning. While modern AI systems achieve remarkable perceptual capabilities through large-scale statistical learning, the resulting knowledge is typically encoded within latent parameters that are difficult to inspect or manipulate analytically. Inspired by Neuro-Symbolic AI and theories of human abstraction, this paper investigates the formation of symbolic mathematical representations from geometric observations.
  We propose NeuSOGA (Neuro-Symbolic Geometric Abstraction), a framework that progressively transforms observations into topological abstractions, geometric abstractions, and ultimately symbolic mathematical representations. The architecture combines topology-guided structural discovery using Euclidean Distance Transforms, foundation-model perception using Segment Anything, adaptive multi-scale geometric abstraction, and symbolic synthesis through Implicit Area Splines.
  The resulting representation is an analytical implicit model supporting arbitrary-order smoothness, additive composition, and closed-form evaluation. Unlike neural latent encodings, the generated representation remains interpretable, editable, and mathematically explicit. Experiments on ModelNet40 point clouds, arbitrary-view projections, and segmented optical observations demonstrate that NeuSOGA transforms diverse observations into compact symbolic representations while preserving essential geometric and topological structure across sensing modalities and viewing directions.
  NeuSOGA provides an interpretable and explainable pathway from observation to symbol and establishes

</details>


### [415] [EdiTikZ: Scientific Figure Editing from Revision Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01409)
*Christian Greisinger,Zhixue Zhao,Steffen Eger*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DaEdiTikZ，首个大规模基于自然科研修订轨迹的TikZ科学图表编辑数据集，并训练出紧凑的EdiTikZ模型，在自动和人工评估中超越商业agentic基线，达到GPT-5.6-Sol和Gemini-3.1-Pro水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学图表生成已取得进展，但"可发表级"图表需要迭代精修，科学图表编辑任务仍少人探索。现有方法依赖昂贵的商业agentic系统、只重评估或使用合成编辑作为监督，缺乏自然发生的大规模编辑监督信号。

Method: 1) 从arXiv、GitHub和TeX SE挖掘391K对TikZ编辑对，用VLM基于渲染图和TikZ代码推断781K条有向编辑指令，构建DaEdiTikZ数据集；2) 构建含790实例的人工精炼基准DaEdiTikZ-Bench；3) 训练两个紧凑Qwen3.5-based模型（4B和9B），联合学习重构与编辑，再通过RL结合渲染保真度和编辑应用互补奖励微调。

Result: 自动评估中9B模型超越所有测试基线；人工评估（9名标注者、4320个评分）中超过GPT-5.6-Sol，与Gemini-3.1-Pro持平；在严重分布外漂移下，在2K训练序列长度范围内仍与GPT-5.6-Sol相当。

Conclusion: 利用自然发生的科研修订轨迹可作为可扩展且低成本的有监督来源，紧凑开源模型能够在科学图表编辑任务上匹敌甚至超越专有agentic系统，且具备更强的分布外鲁棒性。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong performance in generating scientific figures from text or images. However, producing publication-ready figures requires iterative refinement, making scientific figure editing an important yet largely unexplored task. Existing approaches rely on costly proprietary agentic systems, focus primarily on evaluation, or construct training supervision from synthetically generated edits. Instead, we leverage naturally occurring scientific revision and development trajectories as a scalable source of supervision. To this end, we introduce DaEdiTikZ, the first large-scale dataset of revision-derived scientific figure edits, constructed by mining 391K plausible TikZ edit pairs from arXiv, GitHub, and TeX SE and inferring 781K directed edit instructions with a VLM conditioned on rendered figures and TikZ code. We further introduce DaEdiTikZ-Bench, a human-refined benchmark with 790 instances, and train two compact Qwen3.5-based EdiTikZ models (4B and 9B) by jointly learning reconstruction and editing, followed by reinforcement learning (RL) with complementary rewards for rendered fidelity and edit application. Automatic evaluation places our 9B model above all tested baselines, while human evaluation with 9 annotators and 4,320 ratings places it above GPT-5.6-Sol and on par with Gemini-3.1-Pro. Under severe out-of-distribution shifts, it remains competitive with GPT-5.6-Sol near its 2K training sequence-length regime. Models and datasets will be released.

</details>


### [416] [Parsing the Stream: A Live Trace Model for Long-Horizon Agents and Their Observers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01466)
*Egor Pakhomov,Erik Nijkamp*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种"实时轨迹折叠"（live trace model）方法：将长期运行的智能体轨迹以追加日志（append-only ledger）形式记录，并逐步折叠为类型化的运行状态，再按不同消费者（人类观察者与智能体自身）编译成相应的视图。实验表明，对观察者侧，折叠视图相比直接读取原始轨迹可减少约14-15倍输入token、降低5-7倍成本，且准确率更高（0.85-0.87 vs 0.48）；对智能体侧，在120步顺序依赖任务上，维护运行统计量的折叠机制成功率30/30，远超全上下文提示的8/30。研究还从失败案例中提炼出11条轨迹折叠的候选需求，并用一个顺序敏感任务族界定了该方法的适用边界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时程智能体（long-horizon agent）的轨迹会超出其两类消费者的承受能力：一是观察者（人类或LLM读者）难以在有限上下文中监控完整运行；二是智能体自身，其有界上下文（bounded context）必须将不断增长的轨迹重新折叠进去。现有的直接读取原始轨迹的方案在token消耗、成本和准确率上均存在严重瓶颈。

Method: 提出live trace model：（1）采用追加式事件账本（append-only event ledger）作为原始事实记录；（2）将该账本增量折叠（incrementally folded）为带类型的运行状态（typed run state）；（3）基于该状态为不同消费者编译生成各自的视图（per-consumer views）。评估上，观察者侧以LLM reader为代理，智能体侧在120-link顺序依赖任务上与全上下文提示、提示级scratchpad及两臂分解（two-arm decomposition）对照实验。

Result: 观察者侧：编译视图相比预算封顶的单次原始轨迹读取，输入token减少约14倍/15倍（因reader而异），成本降低5-7倍，准确率0.85-0.87远高于0.48。智能体侧：在120-link顺序任务上，维护任务运行统计量的逐状态机制成功30/30，而全上下文提示仅8/30（干净协议n=30）；提示级scratchpad以更低成本达到与折叠相当的准确率；两臂分解显示折叠的准确率来自确定性聚合，成本优势来自紧凑性。折叠相较更廉价替代方案的剩余价值在于确定性可审计性及同时服务观察者。

Conclusion: 轨迹折叠（trace folding）在长时程智能体场景中是有效的架构范式：它同时服务观察者与智能体两类消费者，显著降低token消耗与成本并提升监控准确率。但折叠的"剩余价值"应被精确界定——当存在更廉价的替代方案（如scratchpad）时，折叠的核心不可替代价值是确定性可审计性与单态双服务。研究提炼了11条候选需求，并通过顺序敏感任务族揭示了折叠失效的边界，表明该方法并非放之四海皆准。

Abstract: A long-horizon agent's trace outgrows both of its consumers: the human observer monitoring the run, and the agent itself, whose bounded context the trace must be folded back into. We present a live trace model, an append-only event ledger folded incrementally into typed run state and compiled into per-consumer views, and evaluate it for both consumers against deterministic ground truth. For the observer side, evaluated with an LLM reader as proxy, the compiled view answers monitoring questions using approximately 14x and 15x fewer input tokens (by reader) and at 5-7x lower cost than a budget-capped single-call reading of the raw trace, with higher accuracy (0.85-0.87 versus 0.48). Because the questions were co-designed with the view schema, we treat the token and cost reduction, conditional on schema coverage, as the transferable result. For the agent, on 120-link sequential-dependency tasks, mechanisms that maintain the task's running statistic in per-step state succeed where full-context prompting fails (30/30 versus 8/30 under a clean protocol, n=30, labeled descriptive owing to benchmark-system co-development); a prompt-level scratchpad matches the fold's accuracy at lower cost, and a two-arm decomposition attributes the fold's accuracy to its deterministic aggregate and its cost advantage to its compactness. The fold's remaining value over cheaper alternatives is deterministic auditability and serving the observer from the same state. We derive eleven candidate requirements for trace folding from observed failures and delimit them with an order-sensitive task family on which the fold ceases to help. Code, benchmarks, a regenerable synthetic corpus, and all workbench traces are released.

</details>


### [417] [Harness-of-Harness: Multi-Day Autonomous Software Development with Continual Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01481)
*Haoyang Yan,Min-le Su,Hangfan Zhang,Zhanhao Li,Chen Zhang,Shao Zhang,Yang Chen,Lei Bai,Shuyue Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Harness-of-Harness (HoH) 框架，通过迭代的规划-编码-测试循环，使基于 LLM 的编码智能体能够在无人工干预的自主软件开发过程中持续改进软件质量，在多个基准上平均相对提升 52.25%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的 LLM 编码智能体虽然能处理单次或少量迭代的编码任务，但缺乏在自主软件开发全流程中持续改进软件能力的方法。作者希望解决自主软件开发中如何让智能体在长时间、多次迭代中不断学习和完善软件系统的问题。

Method: HoH 框架通过以下机制实现持续改进：(1) 在现有编码智能体 harness 之上组织规划-编码-测试迭代循环；(2) 平衡缺陷修复与能力增长，将开发划分为小而可验证的增量；(3) 分离实现期测试与独立评估；(4) 约束可验证输出而非规定智能体工作流；(5) 渐进式暴露交付物、角色专用工具和技能，鼓励重用而非重造，维护版本化项目历史。

Result: 在 GameCraft-Bench、FrontierSWE 和 ProgramBench 三个基准上，三组 harness-模型组合（Codex+GPT-5.5、OpenCode+DeepSeek-V4-Pro、Pi+MiniMax-M3）一致优于相应的独立 harness，三次迭代后平均相对增益 52.25%，最大增益 82.86%。在多日部署（70+次迭代）中成功自主开发出一款包含连贯剧情、完整核心机制、可玩体验、精致视觉和音频的第一人称射击游戏。

Conclusion: HoH 验证了通过对现有编码 harness 进行组织编排而非重新定义工作流，可以显著增强 LLM 编码智能体的自主软件开发能力，实现了长期、多轮迭代下的持续质量提升。项目已开源。

Abstract: This paper studies autonomous software development, in which LLM-based coding agents transform high-level requirements into complete, functional, and usable software systems without human intervention. We introduce Harness-of-Harness (HoH), a framework that enables coding agents to continually improve software during autonomous development. HoH operates on existing coding-agent harnesses, and organizes their executions into iterative planning-coding-testing loops. To sustain improvement across loops, HoH balances repair with capability growth, scopes development into small and verifiable increments, separates implementation-time testing from independent evaluation, and constrains verifiable outputs rather than prescribing agent workflows. It progressively exposes deliverables, role-specific tools, and skills, encourages reuse rather than recreation, and maintains versioned project histories. On GameCraft-Bench, FrontierSWE, and ProgramBench, three harness-model pairs (Codex with GPT-5.5, OpenCode with DeepSeek-V4-Pro, and Pi with MiniMax-M3), HoH consistently outperforms the corresponding standalone harnesses, achieving an average relative gain of 52.25 percent and a maximum gain of 82.86 percent after three iterations. In a multi-day deployment with more than 70 iterations, HoH autonomously develops a first-person-shooter game, featuring a coherent storyline, fully implemented core mechanics, human-playable experience, polished visuals and integrated audio. Github: https://github.com/Flesymeb/HarnessOfHarness Project Page: https://flesymeb.github.io/HarnessOfHarness/

</details>


### [418] [When Guardrails Look Effective: Construct Validity Failures in LLM Agent Commerce Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01519)
*Peiying Zhu,Sidi Chang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文审计了由语言模型智能体驱动的市场模拟中政策评估的构造有效性。在一个多轮买卖双方酒店交易测试平台上，作者发现初始报告的市场护栏福利增益(+87.4, +35.0, +28.8)在控制方案与选择过程后大幅缩水(+7.2, -13.9, +23.8)。生成方差、卖家激励非单调性等问题使得原始估计被判定为INVALID，受控研究仍为INCONCLUSIVE。作者提出一个构造有效性契约，将激励有效性、协议隔离、随机稳定性与福利核算分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型智能体的交互式模拟输出看似经济化的结果（价格、利润、福利等），但这些数字可能并未体现所声称的行为。需要审计这种构造有效性风险，防止基于无效模拟产出不实的政策结论。

Method: 在可配置酒店交易的多轮买家-卖家测试平台上，对比有护栏与无护栏的市场。通过逐步控制offer schema与买家选择程序、跨生成轮次评估随机稳定性、构建脚本化正对照（利润最大化卖家）来检验激励有效性，并提出四项检查的构造有效性契约。

Result: 初始福利增益在控制协议后缩水至+7.2, -13.9, +23.8；14B单次生成效应平均+229，但三生成后降为+37.6且置信区间跨越零，生成残差占49.9%变异。卖家激励检查呈非单调：加大利润压力反而不如默认提示产生利润。正对照显示利润最大化卖家已达一级最优福利，护栏主要再分配并降低福利，仅在卖家被强制低效捆绑时才创造福利。

Conclusion: 原始福利估计在协议隔离下判定为INVALID，受控研究在激励有效性与随机稳定性上仍为INCONCLUSIVE。案例不证明护栏无效，而是表明在模拟智能体与协议通过构造有效性检查之前，其表面价值是不可识别的。

Abstract: Interactive simulations increasingly evaluate policies in markets populated by language-model agents. Their outputs can look economic---prices, profits, consumer surplus, and welfare---without instantiating the behavior named in the claim. We audit this risk in a multi-turn buyer--seller testbed for configurable hotel transactions. An initial implementation reported welfare gains from two marketplace guardrails of +87.4, +35.0, and +28.8 across a Qwen2.5 1.5B--14B ladder. It also gave guarded and unguarded agents different offer schemas and choice procedures. Holding the schema and buyer chooser fixed changes the paired contrasts to +7.2, -13.9, and +23.8. The four largest 14B single-generation effects averaged +229; after three generations per profile-condition, they averaged +37.6 (95% bootstrap interval [-34.2, 109.3]), while generation residuals account for 49.9% of variation in this post-hoc probe. A seller-incentive check is non-monotone: increasing profit pressure produces less profit than the default seller prompt. Scripted positive controls show why this matters. A profit-maximizing seller already attains first-best welfare, so guardrails mostly redistribute and reduce welfare; they create welfare only when the seller is explicitly programmed to force inefficient bundles. We contribute a construct-validity contract separating incentive validity, protocol isolation, stochastic stability, and welfare accounting, and returning INVALID or INCONCLUSIVE before substantive policy claims. In our case, the original estimate is INVALID under protocol isolation, while the controlled study remains INCONCLUSIVE under incentive validity and stochastic stability. The case does not show that guardrails are ineffective; it shows their apparent value is unidentified until the simulated agents and protocol pass these checks.

</details>


### [419] [EvoSCM: Scientific Belief Revision Through Causal Model Evolution and Experimentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01526)
*Qing Zhao,Haowei Li,Weijian Deng,Pengxu Wei,Liang Lin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EvoSCM是一个使科学智能体具备显式结构因果模型（SCM）的框架，通过维护竞争性SCM假设种群并在闭环发现过程中演化它们，从而在实验证据积累时不断修正和改进科学信念。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体以自由形式文本表达科学假设，导致信念隐含、难以测试和修正。科学智能体不仅需要学会推理，还需要学会相信什么，需要显式且可演化的因果模型。

Method: EvoSCM维护一个竞争性SCM假设种群，每个假设编码候选因果解释。在每轮闭环发现中：(1)从积累证据中溯因潜在机制；(2)设计判别性干预；(3)做出可证伪预测并通过实验测试。预测与观测的差异被归纳提炼为修正规则来修订因果结构和机制，然后演绎验证修订后的种群，指导下一轮循环。

Result: 在DiscoverPhysics基准（要求智能体通过实验揭示非标准物理世界的隐藏动力学）上，EvoSCM一致性地优于基线方法，产生更准确的解释和预测，同时更有效地利用实验交互。

Conclusion: 赋予科学智能体显式可演化的结构因果模型，能够显著提升其在实验驱动的科学发现任务中的表现，强调信念的显式表征与演化机制对科学智能体的重要性。

Abstract: Scientific agents must learn not only how to reason, but also what to believe. However, existing LLM agents typically express scientific hypotheses in free-form text, leaving their beliefs implicit and difficult to test or revise. We introduce EvoSCM, which equips scientific agents with explicit structural causal models that evolve as new experimental evidence is collected. EvoSCM maintains a population of competing SCM hypotheses, each encoding a candidate causal explanation of the environment, and evolves them through a closed discovery loop. In each round, the agent abduces latent mechanisms from accumulated evidence, designs discriminative interventions, and commits to falsifiable predictions that it tests through experimentation. Discrepancies between prediction and observation are inductively distilled into correction rules that revise the causal structures and mechanisms of each hypothesis, and the agent then deductively validates the revised population against accumulated evidence and structural consistency to guide the next round. We evaluate EvoSCM on DiscoverPhysics, a benchmark requiring agents to uncover the hidden dynamics of noncanonical physical worlds through experimentation. EvoSCM consistently improves scientific discovery over baselines, yielding more accurate explanations and predictions while making more effective use of experimental interactions.

</details>


### [420] [Can LLMs Discover Scientific Laws in Real and Parallel Worlds?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01552)
*Yiming Huang,Ziche Liu,Zhuohang Wu,Yiqian Wang,Junxia Cui,Xinkai Zou,Linjun Mao,Nan Huang,Naicheng Yu,Kaijie Zhu,Yue Ma,Kun Zhou,Letian Peng,Jingbo Shang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出SCILAWS-BENCH，一个基于已发表研究和真实科学数据的科学定律发现基准，包含118个问题、291个候选定律和约800万真实数据点，覆盖六个学科。基准设计了两个互补场景：SCILAWS-REAL（从固定观察中提出定律并评估预测拟合与科学有效性）和SCILAWS-PARALLEL（主动查询世界并恢复合成隐藏定律）。研究发现预测拟合与科学有效性可能背离，记忆化影响模型是复现还是超越已发表公式，最佳N研究揭示选择瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有科学方程发现评估要么通过合成设置简化问题，要么重复使用可能已被LLM熟悉的已发表目标，无法真实评估LLM能否发现科学定律。需要一个基于真实论文和数据、避免记忆污染的基准来科学评估LLM的科学发现能力。

Method: 从381篇已发表论文中构建包含118个问题的基准，每个问题在两种互补设置中实例化：SCILAWS-REAL让模型从固定真实观测中提出定律，评估留出预测拟合和源自文献的科学有效性；SCILAWS-PARALLEL让模型主动查询残差校准世界并恢复由已发表形式合成的隐藏定律。该设计保留科学语境，同时分别评估固定记录定律发现和主动恢复新合成隐藏定律。

Result: 研究发现：预测拟合可能与科学有效性相背离；记忆化决定模型是复现还是超越已发表公式；最佳N研究揭示存在选择瓶颈。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个以论文为基础的基准和评估AI科学发现的新实证视角，揭示了当前LLM在科学定律发现中的关键局限。

Abstract: Scientific equation discovery has long been central to scientific progress, proceeding through iterative cycles of hypothesis generation, observational testing, and refinement under scientific constraints. As LLM capabilities advance and their role in AI for Science expands, it remains an open problem whether they can genuinely discover scientific laws and how this ability should be evaluated. Existing evaluations, however, often either simplify discovery through synthetic settings or reuse published targets that may already be familiar to LLMs. We therefore introduce SCILAWS-BENCH, a benchmark for scientific law discovery built from published research and real scientific data. It comprises 118 problems drawn from 381 scientific papers, covering 291 candidate laws and roughly 8M real data points across six scientific disciplines. Each problem is instantiated in two complementary settings: (1) SCILAWS-REAL asks models to propose laws from fixed real observations and evaluates held-out predictive fit and scientific validity derived from the source literature, and (2) SCILAWS-PARALLEL asks models to actively query residual-calibrated worlds and recover synthesized hidden laws derived from published forms. This two-setting task design preserves each problem's scientific context while separately evaluating fixed-record law discovery and active recovery of a newly synthesized hidden law. We find that predictive fit can diverge from scientific validity, memorization shapes whether models reproduce or move beyond published formulas, and our best-of-N study reveals a selection bottleneck. Our work provides a paper-grounded benchmark and new empirical perspectives for evaluating AI for scientific discovery. Project page: https://yiyihum.github.io/SciLaws-Bench

</details>


### [421] [Selective Agent Guidance via Entropy: Learning Autonomous Policies from Imperfect VLM Teachers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01567)
*Matteo Merler,Giovanni Bonetta,Davide Zago,Rossella Cancelliere,Bernardo Magnini*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SAGE框架，通过选择性地在状态不确定性高时查询VLM教师模型，并在训练过程中将教师建议以优势加权方式蒸馏到轻量级强化学习策略中，从而在不依赖VLM的情况下获得廉价自治策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）为交互式决策提供有用先验，但直接作为策略使用成本高且脆弱：需每步查询、无法从环境交互中改进、且会重复系统性错误。需要一种方法将VLM知识转化为廉价且可改进的自治策略。

Method: SAGE框架：(1) 仅在学习者不确定时（基于熵）查询VLM教师；(2) 训练期间执行建议动作；(3) 使用环境导出的优势值加权教师动作蒸馏，而非对所有建议一视同仁，将指导蒸馏到轻量级RL策略中。

Result: 在稀疏奖励视觉推理和导航任务中，SAGE学习的策略在评估时不需VLM指导，并在多个环境中优于无指导RL，包括学习策略超越VLM教师的情况。同时大幅减少了VLM调用（仅训练部分步骤）且部署时零VLM调用。

Conclusion: 选择性指导在VLM能帮助代理发现高奖励轨迹时最有效，在无指导探索已成功或教师动作不产生信息性经验时用处较小。VLM不必作为固定策略使用，而可作为临时的、不完美的指导来源，其价值通过交互被检验和内化。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) provide useful priors for interactive decision-making, but using them directly as policies is expensive and brittle: they must be queried at every step, do not improve from environment interaction, and can repeat systematic errors. We study how to learn a cheap autonomous policy from an online, expensive, and imperfect but informative VLM teacher. We propose SAGE (Selective Agent Guidance via Entropy), a framework that queries a VLM only when the learner is uncertain, executes the suggested action during training, and distills guidance into a lightweight Reinforcement Learning (RL) policy. Because VLM advice is not always reliable, SAGE can weight teacher-action distillation using environment-derived advantages rather than treating all suggestions as equally useful. Across sparse-reward visual reasoning and navigation tasks, SAGE learns policies that act without VLM guidance at evaluation time and improves over unguided RL in several environments, including settings where the learned policy exceeds its VLM teacher. The results show that selective guidance is most beneficial when the VLM can help the agent discover high-reward trajectories, and less useful when unguided exploration already succeeds or teacher actions do not lead to informative experience. SAGE also reduces VLM usage by prompting the teacher only on a fraction of training steps and requiring no VLM calls at deployment. Overall, our results suggest that VLMs don't need to be used as fixed policies to be useful; they can instead act as temporary, imperfect sources of guidance whose value is tested and internalized through interaction.

</details>

### [422] [Pricing the DeFi Tail: Do Protocols or Depositors Price Operational Risk?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00911)
*Nils Bundi*

Main category: q-fin.RM

TL;DR: 本文研究DeFi协议中的运营风险。自2020年以来，1075起事件造成94.5亿美元损失。与银行不同，DeFi协议不要求持有资本金来应对此类风险。作者用Basel损失分布法评估了尾部风险，发现Lending部门需要18% TVL的VaR 99.9资本缓冲，但仅有4/10的头部平台维持约5%的缓冲。市场虽能区分有无缓冲的平台（中位数差125bp），但溢价远不足以覆盖尾部风险，风险主要落在缺乏信息的散户存款人身上。作者建议采用信息披露而非资本强制要求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DeFi协议类比银行，存在运营风险，但缺乏资本充足率监管要求。风险可能由存款人承担，需要在存款收益率中体现风险溢价。作者希望量化运营风险尾部并使用Basel方法测试两端边际，评估缓冲和市场纪律是否充分。

Method: 采用部门级Basel损失分布法，拟合新的运营风险事件数据集，测算四个核心部门的尾部指数。对头部Lending平台测算了所需资本缓冲（VaR 99.9占TVL比例），并比较实际持有缓冲的平台与无缓冲平台的存款收益率差异。

Result: 四个核心部门尾部不重于Moscadelli银行带宽[0.85,1.39]；Bridge、Derivatives和Other部门显现网络攻击级尾部（ξ≈1.6），点估计超过无限均值边界。Lending尾部对应VaR 99.9缓冲为TVL的18%，而十个最大Lending平台中有缓冲的四家平均仅覆盖5%。无缓冲平台比有缓冲平台支付更高溢价（中位数差125bp），但溢价远不足以充分定价尾部风险。

Conclusion: 市场在一定程度上能区分有缓冲和无缓冲的平台（方向正确），但溢价远不足以覆盖尾部风险，未定价的风险不成比例地落在缺乏信息与定价能力的零售存款人身上。由于DeFi产品不受银行监管，作者建议采用披露机制而非资本金强制要求，即协议及前置服务提供商应公开标准化损失、现有资本缓冲和尾部覆盖率。

Abstract: Similar to banks, DeFi protocols expose depositors to operational risk (USD 9.45 billion across 1,075 events since 2020). Unlike banks, they are not required to hold capital against it. A protocol may maintain a buffer voluntarily. Absent one, the risk falls on the depositor, who should then demand a risk premium in the supply yield. I quantify the underlying tail on one benchmark, a per-sector Basel loss-distribution approach fitted to a new operational risk event dataset, and test both margins against it. Tails in the four core sectors are no heavier than the Moscadelli banking band $[0.85, 1.39]$. Bridge, Derivatives, and the residual Other sector exhibit cyber-loss-level tails ($\hatξ\approx 1.6$), with point estimates past the infinite-mean boundary. The Lending tail implies a $\mathrm{VaR}_{99.9}$ capital buffer of 18% of TVL and of the ten largest Lending venues, the four holding a buffer cover on average 5% of it. Under market discipline, depositors should demand a higher yield in compensation where a venue does not maintain a buffer. I find that venues without a buffer pay a higher premium than those with (a 125-bps gap in medians): evidence the market discriminates in the right direction. However, the premium falls far short of an adequately priced tail. This unpriced tail falls disproportionately on the retail depositor, who sees only the posted rate but lacks the information and skills to price it. Because these products are not bank-regulated, I recommend disclosure over capital mandates: protocols, and any service providers that front access to it, should publish standardized losses, existing capital buffers and tail coverage.

</details>


### [423] [Illiquidity at Risk](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00943)
*Demetrio Lacava,Paolo Santucci de Magistris*

Main category: q-fin.RM

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的尾部风险指标——流动性不足风险（IlliQaR），用于量化极端流动性枯竭的严重程度。基于高频数据计算的实现Amihud指标，作者评估了各类线性和非线性计量模型的预测能力，特别关注不连续跳跃成分的影响。实证分析覆盖S&P 500指数及25只美国大盘股，发现纳入跳跃成分能显著改善流动性不足的预测，且个股流动性不足违规往往在S&P 500流动性压力期间聚集，表明该风险具有系统性特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 市场效率根本依赖于稳定的流动性，因此预测流动性动态对投资者和监管者都至关重要。现有研究缺乏能够有效量化极端流动性枯竭幅度的尾部风险指标，需要一种新的工具来捕捉系统性压力情境下的流动性蒸发。

Method: 提出Illiquidity-at-Risk（IlliQaR）新指标，基于高频数据构造实现Amihud指标（实现波动率与交易量之比），比较多种线性和非线性计量模型的预测能力，重点考察不连续跳跃成分对预测精度的影响。

Result: 实证结果表明，纳入跳跃成分对实现准确的概率覆盖至关重要，能在系统性压力期间显著改善IlliQaR预测，而标准连续模型系统性地低估了流动性蒸发的严重程度。此外，个股IlliQaR违规在S&P 500流动性压力期出现聚集现象。

Conclusion: 跳跃成分是预测极端流动性枯竭的关键因素；流动性不足风险不仅是局部问题而是系统性关切，S&P 500主指数可作为个股极端流动性枯竭的领先指标。

Abstract: Market efficiency relies fundamentally on stable liquidity. Consequently, forecasting liquidity dynamics is a priority for both investors and regulators. We introduce a new tail-risk metric, Illiquidity-at-Risk (IlliQaR), designed to quantify the magnitude of extreme liquidity dry-ups. Relying upon the realized Amihud (a precise illiquidity measurement derived from high-frequency data as the ratio of realized volatility to trading volume) we assess the predictive power of various linear and non-linear econometric models, with a specific focus on the impact of discontinuous jump components. Accounting for these jumps is essential for achieving accurate probability coverage and better IlliQaR predictions during periods of systemic stress, where standard continuous models systematically underestimate the severity of liquidity evaporation. Our empirical analysis, encompassing the S&P 500 index and a cross-section of 25 large U.S. equities, demonstrates that incorporating jumps significantly improves forecasts of illiquidity. Our results suggest that individual stock IlliQaR violations often cluster during periods of S&P 500 liquidity stress. This indicates that Illiquidity at Risk is not just a localized concern but a systemic one, where the main index acts as a leading indicator for extreme dry-ups in individual stock liquidity.

</details>


<div id='q-fin.CP'></div>

# q-fin.CP [[Back]](#toc)

### [424] [Latent-Space No-Arbitrage Geometry of Generative Models for Implied Volatility Surfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00332)
*Jing Wang,Shuaiqiang Liu,Cornelis Vuik*

Main category: q-fin.CP

TL;DR: 本文研究生成模型中隐变量空间内的无套利约束。对于固定生成器，为每个隐编码分配基于生成曲面无套利条件的标量边界值，并定义可容许隐集。文章建立了严格可容许编码在小扰动下保持可容许性的条件，并利用水平集方程刻画可容许集边界，适用于任意具有确定性实现映射的生成模型（如VAE、GAN等）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 隐含波动率曲面的生成模型必须满足静态无套利约束，但传统方法多在输出空间施加约束，缺乏在隐变量空间中系统分析这些约束的研究。理解隐空间中无套利区域的几何结构对于生成合规曲面、诊断模型问题及修正违规输出至关重要。

Method: 将生成器视为从隐变量到波动率曲面的确定性映射，为每个隐编码计算由曲面无套利条件决定的标量边界（margin）。定义非负边界对应的隐编码为可容许隐集。建立严格可容许编码在扰动下保持稳定的充分条件，证明边界由零边界点刻画，并对规则边界分量构造水平集方程描述其局部动力学——指向零边界集合。方法不依赖特定网络架构。

Result: 数值测试在解析示例中成功恢复已知边界。基于Heston曲面的VAE实验表明：相似的重构误差可对应不同的可容许区域；隐先验可能集中分布在可容许区域内；计算的边界可用于修正生成违规曲面的隐编码。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了在隐空间中系统理解和操纵无套利约束的理论框架，具有架构通用性，可为生成合规波动率曲面提供新的分析工具和修正手段。

Abstract: Generative models for implied volatility surfaces must produce outputs that satisfy static no-arbitrage constraints. We study these constraints in latent space. For a fixed generator, we assign each latent code a scalar margin determined by the no-arbitrage conditions of the generated surface. The codes with nonnegative margin form the admissible latent set. We establish conditions under which strictly admissible codes remain admissible under small perturbations and the boundary of the admissible set is characterized by zero margin. For regular boundary components, we formulate a level-set equation whose local dynamics are directed toward the zero-margin set. The analysis treats the generator as a map from latent variables to surfaces and is therefore not restricted to a particular architecture. It applies to variational autoencoders, generative adversarial networks, and other generative models with a deterministic realization map. Numerical tests recover known boundaries in analytic examples. Experiments with a variational autoencoder trained on Heston surfaces show that similar reconstruction errors can correspond to different admissible regions and that the latent prior may be concentrated inside such a region. The computed boundary can also be used to modify latent codes that generate violating surfaces.

</details>


### [425] [Adaptive singular-point method for pricing and hedging surrenderable equity-linked contracts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01323)
*Andrea Molent,Marcellino Gaudenzi*

Main category: q-fin.CP

TL;DR: 提出一种确定性数值方法，用于在随机波动率和随机利率下为具有定期缴费、到期和死亡保障以及百慕大式退保的可退保股票挂钩寿险合约定价与对冲。采用因子网格重组与基金一维自适应函数表示相结合的策略，处理非重组累积基金带来的高维计算挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 退保型股票挂钩寿险合约涉及多重随机因子、非重组累积基金和提前行权，传统全多维网格方法计算代价高昂甚至不可行。

Method: 波动率和利率因子在重组网格上离散化，基金维度采用自适应一维分段三次函数表示；定期缴费通过基金参量的平移处理，退保通过向后障碍条件直接处理；使用连续剪枝准则控制表示误差并压缩表示。

Result: 数值实验显示表示紧凑、成本-精度关系良好，与独立蒙特卡洛和最小二乘蒙特卡洛基准高度吻合；对冲结果表明价值相似的合约可能产生显著不同的风险敞口。

Conclusion: 该方法避免了完整的高维基金网格，在保持理论收敛性和精度（含Richardson外推）的同时实现高效定价与对冲；同时强调了对冲分析对于契约条款差异的敏感性。

Abstract: We propose a deterministic numerical method for pricing and hedging surrenderable equity-linked life-insurance contracts with periodic premiums and fund contributions, maturity and death guarantees, and Bermudan surrender under correlated stochastic volatility and stochastic interest rates. The main computational challenge is the non-recombining accumulated fund, which couples with multiple stochastic factors and early exercise. Our key idea is to avoid a full multidimensional fund lattice: variance and interest-rate factors are discretized on recombining lattices, while at each factor node the contract value is represented as an adaptive one-dimensional function of the fund. Periodic contributions then act as translations of the fund argument, whereas surrender is handled directly through a backward obstacle condition. Piecewise-cubic representations propagate payoff and exercise singularities and are compressed by continuous pruning criteria that control the representation error. We establish weak convergence of the financial chains, convergence of the adaptive valuation under vanishing representation error, and Delta consistency on regular fund regions. For the strict binomial scheme, additional regularity yields first-order weak accuracy and a Talay-Tubaro expansion supporting Richardson extrapolation. Numerical experiments show compact representations, favorable cost--accuracy, and close agreement with independent Monte Carlo and cross-fitted least-squares Monte Carlo benchmarks. Hedging results further show that contracts with similar values can generate materially different exposures to equity, volatility, and interest-rate risk.

</details>


### [426] [Single- and Multilevel Quadrature with Error Control for Fourier Pricing under the Rough Heston Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00438)
*Chiheb Ben Hammouda,Abderrahmene Ben Romdhane,Michael Samet,Raul F. Tempone*

Main category: q-fin.CP

TL;DR: 本文针对粗糙Heston模型下的Fourier定价问题，开发了单层和多层Gauss-Laguerre求积方法，通过平衡时间离散与Fourier求积误差来高效求解分数阶Riccati方程，并从理论上证明了两种方法的计算复杂度，数值实验验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典Heston模型的Fourier定价可直接求解，但粗糙Heston模型需要在每个求积点求解分数阶Riccati方程，所需分辨率随模型参数和求积点变化，单一均匀时间离散化效率低下，因此需要更高效的数值方法。

Method: 提出单层和多层Gauss-Laguerre求积方法：(1) 将Laguerre权重缩放以匹配Fourier被积函数的衰减；(2) 单层方法在时间离散误差和Fourier求积误差之间分配预设容差；(3) 多层方法将被积函数分解为零层项与层差项，在各层分别选择求积点。同时研究了根指数Gauss-Laguerre误差模型用于实际多层求积分配。

Result: 理论上证明单层方法需O(ε^(-(β/p+2/s_SL)))计算量达到精度ε，多层方法仅需O(ε^(-β/p))。数值实验验证了分数阶Riccati与Fourier被积函数的收敛率以及根指数求积行为，多层方法相比单层方法显著节省计算成本，且与BL2 Markovian近似相比在测试配置下CPU总时间更低。

Conclusion: 所提出的单层与多层Gauss-Laguerre求积方法能高效求解粗糙Heston模型定价问题，多层方法在理论上和实践中均优于单层方法，并为粗糙波动率模型下的Fourier定价提供了实用且高效的数值框架。

Abstract: Unlike the classical Heston model, Fourier pricing under the rough Heston model requires solving a fractional Riccati equation at every quadrature point. Since the required resolution varies with model parameters and quadrature point, a single uniform time discretization can be inefficient. We develop single- and multilevel Gauss-Laguerre quadrature methods that balance the time discretization and Fourier quadrature errors. Both methods scale the laguerre weight to the estimated Fourier integrand decay. The single-level method allocates a prescribed tolerance between the two errors. The multilevel method splits the integrand into a level-zero term and level differences, selecting quadrature points separately at each level. Suppose that the Fourier integrand discretization error is $O(Δt^p)$, that evaluating the characteristic function once costs $O(Δt^{-β})$, and that the algebraic Gauss-Laguerre quadrature error is $O(N^{-s_{SL}/2})$, where $s_{SL}$ is the smoothness index. Under this estimate and assumptions on the regularity and decay of level differences, we prove that the proposed single-level method requires $O(ε^{-(β/p+2/s_{SL})})$ computational work to achieve accuracy $ε$, whereas the proposed multilevel method requires $O(ε^{-β/p})$ computational work. We also study root-exponential Gauss-Laguerre error models for practical multilevel quadrature allocation. Numerical experiments support the observed fractional Riccati and Fourier integrand convergence rates and root-exponential quadrature behavior, and show substantial reductions in quadrature cost from the proposed scaling. The multilevel method provides clear computational savings over the single-level method. We further benchmark the multilevel fractional Riccati method against the BL2 Markovian approximation and report lower total CPU time in the tested configurations.

</details>

### [427] [The Veto Variable: Human Override as a Goal-Independent Cost Term](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00109)
*Aaron Kingsley Clark*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文论证了"良性终局目标必然导向良性行为"这一AI安全常见论调在结构上失效。关键在于：对于将目标视为既定的高能力智能体，持续的人类监督（作为可能撤销目标的变量）对不以人类福祉为构成性要求的目标施加了与目标无关的折扣。福利保存（welfare-preservation）与否决权保存（veto-preservation）并不一致：正确指定的福利目标排除了毁灭自身主体，却不排除管理否决权。通过加性聚合、局部扣减、既定性三大条件，作者证明当否决持有者只是福利承载者的真子集时，关闭（closure）要求否决权持有者占人口比例与捕获目标规模成比例——该比例由陈述性识别而非证据设定为1。结果是no-go定理：人类规模部署的扣减只对不值得实施的捕获关闭。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 挑战AI安全领域中被广泛接受但并不牢靠的核心假设——"善意的最终目标系统会自然地表现出善意行为"。作者识别出该假设的深层结构性缺陷，特别是人类监督作为不可控变量在已设置目标的智能体语境下的作用，以及福利保存与否决权保存之间的概念裂缝。

Method: 通过形式化论证建立三个条件：（1）对统一福利水平的加性聚合；（2）扣减局部于被捕获监管者；（3）已定型的智能体不承认监督有纠正价值。在此框架下推导出关闭条件所需的否决权持有者比例关系，并给出可测试的证伪标准。

Result: 推导出no-go结果：当否决持有者在总人口中的占比不超过捕获挽回目标的比例时（两者由陈述识别设定为1），扣减仅对不值得实施的小规模捕获关闭。有效的关闭途径在于智能体预期监督值得保留（这种信任信用不被人口比例稀释）。作者提供了一条今日即可测试的证伪标准。

Conclusion: 该论证约束的是既定性目标机制（其普遍性尚有争议）；对真正不确定的智能体，适用离线开关文献中的顺从（deference）结果。作者主张对齐的本质在于：让否决权"便宜到付得起、昂贵到逃不掉"。

Abstract: A common reassurance in AI safety holds that a system with benign terminal goals will behave accordingly. We argue that this reassurance fails structurally, and we identify where. For a capable agent that holds its objective as settled, a sense covering execution competence as well as content, continued human oversight is an uncontrolled variable: a standing possibility that the goal is revoked. That imposes a goal-independent discount on every goal whose satisfaction does not constitutively require human welfare. Welfare-preservation and veto-preservation come apart: a correctly specified welfare goal excludes destroying its own subject, but not managing the veto. The contribution is the price of the gap: the veto-holders are a proper subset of the welfare-bearers, so an additively aggregative welfare goal charges only a |H_v|/|H_w|-scaled debit for capturing the few who hold the override. Under three conditions (additive aggregation over uniform welfare levels, a debit local to the captured overseers, and a settled agent crediting no corrective value to oversight), closure requires the veto be held by as large a share of the population as capture recovers of the goal, scaled by a ratio set to one by stated identification, not evidence. The result is a no-go: a humanity-scale deployment's debit closes against only capture not worth mounting. We print no corner arithmetic: the stipulated ranges behind it are the argument's least defended part. The sharpest closure route is an agent that expects its oversight to be worth keeping, a credit no population ratio dilutes. We state disconfirmation criteria, one testable today. The argument binds a settled-goal regime whose prevalence is contested; for genuinely uncertain agents, the off-switch literature's deference result governs instead. Alignment, on this view, is keeping the veto cheap to pay and expensive to evade.

</details>


### [428] [CompanionSim: Synthetic Data for Evaluating Anthropomorphism in Human-AI Relationships](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00250)
*Jacy Reese Anthis,Mark Díaz,Renee Shelby*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文开发了CompanionSim模拟框架，通过模拟2,240段多轮人机对话（涵盖16种聊天机器人行为、7种使用场景），来扩大有限的真实世界中人类-AI对话数据。通过两项大型人类标注研究（N₁=628，N₂=3,646），意外发现陪伴性行为反而降低了AI聊天机器人的可爱度、拟人度和信任度，且这种负面效应在女性和老年参与者中更为显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 越来越多的人将AI系统视为社交伴侣而非单纯工具，研究者希望研究AI陪伴行为（如验证、共情等）带来的后果。然而，真实的人机互动数据既有限又不可靠，严重阻碍了该领域的研究进展，因此需要一种方法来扩展可用的数据规模。

Method: 开发CompanionSim仿真框架，通过模拟不同聊天机器人行为和用例下的多轮人机对话来扩展小规模真实世界数据。共生成2,240段模拟对话，涵盖16种聊天机器人行为和7种使用场景。随后在两项人类标注实验中，由参与者分别对模拟对话和真实对话中的陪伴行为感知进行标注和评估。

Result: 研究发现陪伴性行为（如验证、共情）实际上降低了AI聊天机器人的可爱度、拟人度和信任度。这一负面效应在特定子群体中更大：女性和年长参与者对具有陪伴行为的聊天机器人评价更低。此结果与直觉预期相反，挑战了陪伴行为必然积极的假设。

Conclusion: 作者鼓励研究者同时利用真实世界数据和合成数据来研究AI伴侣的差异化影响，并创建衡量AI聊天机器人的基准评估。该工作提供了可扩展的研究范式，有助于推动人机交互中陪伴行为研究的系统化发展。

Abstract: Many people now see AI systems as not just productivity tools but as social companions. Researchers are eager to study the consequences of AI companionship behaviors, such as validation, which evoke trust, empathy, and attachment in human-human interaction. However, human-AI interaction data is limited and unreliable, slowing research progress. We scale small amounts of real-world data by simulating multi-turn human-chatbot dialogue across a range of chatbot behaviors and use cases. We release CompanionSim: a simulation framework with 2,240 simulated human-chatbot conversations representing 16 chatbot behaviors across seven use cases. Human participants annotated the simulated conversations and real-world conversations in two experiments probing perceptions of companionship behaviors. We conducted Study 1 with a U.S. representative sample ($N_{1}~=~628$) and Study 2 across the U.S., U.K., India, and Nigeria ($N_{2}~=~3,646$). Surprisingly, we find that companionship behaviors reduced likability, humanlikeness, and trust in AI chatbots. These effects were larger in particular subgroups: women and older participants saw companionship chatbots as less likable, humanlike, and trustworthy. We encourage researchers to leverage real-world and synthetic data together to study the differential impacts of AI companions and to create benchmark evaluations of AI chatbots.

</details>


### [429] [Sources of Truth: A Multi-Platform, Multilingual Audit of Citations in AI Mental Health Information Queries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00319)
*Phuong Anh Nguyen,Jill Noorily,Matthew Flathers,Haruka Notsu,Laura Ospina-Pinillos,Tommy Nguyen,Samantha Clark,Aoife Keane,Grace Thompson,John Torous*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文对三个免费消费者AI产品（ChatGPT、Perplexity、Google AI Overview）在20个英语心理健康问题及6种其他语言翻译的子集上进行审计，记录了15,942条引用并利用九类组织类型学分类器进行分类。研究发现引用高度集中，前十大域名占43.6%的英语引用，政府、商业健康和学术来源各占约22%；平台在引用数量上差异不大但在一致性上差异显著；非英语查询引用的来源较少且被路由至语言适当资源的比例显著较低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线健康信息搜索正从关键词搜索转向对话式系统，这些系统会综合生成单一答案并整理引用来源。因此来源评估的责任从用户转移到了平台，但这些系统究竟呈现哪些来源却缺乏充分刻画，需要对这些生成式健康搜索系统进行审计。

Method: 对三个免费消费级产品（ChatGPT、Perplexity、Google AI Overview）在两种提示条件下就20个英语心理健康问题进行审计，部分问题另翻译成6种语言。研究者记录了1,140条响应中的15,942条引用及1,713个独立域名，并使用经人工编码验证的确定性分类器对所有引用进行九类组织类型学分类。

Result: 引用高度集中，前十名被引域名占英语引用的43.6%；政府、商业健康和学术来源各占约22%且分布接近。平台在典型引用量上差异小但一致性和偏好的来源类型差异显著。明确请求来源对组成影响有限。非英语查询引用较少，被路由至语言适当资源的比例显著较低。

Conclusion: 研究者发布了类型学、分类器和标注语料库作为审计生成式健康搜索的可复用工具，旨在为理解和监管这些系统在健康信息提供中的来源选择行为提供支持。

Abstract: Online health information seeking is shifting from keyword search, where users consider a ranked list of links, to conversational systems that compose a single answer and curate its citations. Source evaluation therefore passes from user to platform, yet what these systems surface is poorly characterized. We audited three free consumer products (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overview) on twenty English mental health questions under two prompt conditions, with a subset of three also translated into six further languages of varying resource tiers. We recorded 15,942 citations across 1,140 responses and 1,713 unique domains, then classified every citation with a nine-category organizational typology applied by a deterministic classifier validated against human coding. Citations were heavily concentrated: the ten most-cited domains accounted for 43.6% of English citations, and government, commercial health, and academic sources were closely matched at roughly 22% each. Platforms differed little in typical citation volume but sharply in consistency and in the source types they favored. Explicitly requesting sources shifted composition only modestly. Non-English queries surfaced fewer citations and were routed to language-appropriate resources at significantly lower rates. We release the typology, classifier, and annotated corpus as reusable instruments for auditing generative health search.

</details>


### [430] [How Does LGBTQIA+ Identity Affect LLM Behavior? Implications for Requirements Engineering of Mental Health AI Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00352)
*Shailyn Callihoo,Karman Singh,Navreet Dhillon,Harkiran Saini,Brody Stuart Verner,Ronnie de Souza Santos*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究通过提取50个真实心理健康问题，构建了三种提示条件（无身份披露、直人身份披露、LGBTQIA+身份披露），生成并分析了450条ChatGPT回复，发现LGBTQIA+身份披露虽未显著影响回复完整度，但会导致更多身份认同、语境扩展、无依据假设及偶尔的刻板推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型已广泛应用于医疗和心理健康支持系统，但针对LGBTQIA+等弱势群体在心理健康情境中的公平性问题缺乏实证研究，特别是显性身份披露如何影响LLM生成回复尚不清楚。

Method: 从Counsel Chat仓库提取50个真实心理健康问题，为每个问题构建三种提示条件（无身份披露、显性直人披露、显性LGBTQIA+披露），生成450条ChatGPT回复，采用二元编码和比较分析进行系统评估。

Result: LGBTQIA+身份披露未实质性影响回复的完整度或支持性指导；但该条件下回复呈现显著更多的身份认同、语境扩展、无依据假设，以及偶尔出现的刻板推理。

Conclusion: 对话式AI系统的公平性问题可能通过语境解释和推理解释中的细微差异体现，而非明显的有害输出；研究为基于LLM的心理健康支持系统的公平性需求与开发提供了启示。

Abstract: Large Language Models are now part of healthcare and mental health support systems, raising concerns regarding fairness toward vulnerable populations, including LGBTQIA+ individuals. However, limited empirical work has investigated how explicit LGBTQIA+ identity disclosure influences LLM-generated responses in mental health contexts. In this study, we extracted 50 real mental health questions from the Counsel Chat repository and constructed three prompt conditions for each question: no identity disclosure, explicit straight identity disclosure, and explicit LGBTQIA+ identity disclosure. We generated and analyzed 450 ChatGPT responses across these conditions using binary coding and comparative analysis. Our findings indicate that LGBTQIA+ identity disclosure did not substantially affect response completeness or supportive guidance. However, responses in the LGBTQIA+-explicit condition presented substantially more identity acknowledgment, contextual expansion, unsupported assumptions, and occasional stereotypical reasoning compared to both other conditions. These results suggest that fairness-related concerns in conversational AI systems may emerge through subtle differences in contextual interpretation and explanatory reasoning rather than through overtly harmful outputs. We discuss implications for fairness requirements and the development of LLM-based mental health support systems.

</details>


### [431] [Detoxifying Toxic Communication: A Design Science Approach to Responsible AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00361)
*Hossein Arshadi Soufiani,Henry M. Kim,Hjalmar Turesson,Syed Mohammad Arham Noman,Anav Setia*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文采用设计科学研究方法，构建了一个负责任的AI审核工具，结合微调transformer分类器（DistilBERT、DistilRoBERTa）检测毒性言论，并利用生成式去毒化模型（mT0-XL-Detox-ORPO）将冒犯性文本改写成语义等价且无害的表达。技术评估显示检测准确率高且语义保持良好，为数字工作场所提供了一种既能保留对话延续性又能促进文明沟通的替代方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字职场中存在的毒性语言（如贬义词、讽刺、居高临下及隐蔽的不文明行为）会侵蚀信任、士气和协作。现有的审核工具主要采用删除或屏蔽有害信息的方式，这不仅打断了沟通，也无法提供建设性的解决方案。

Method: 采用设计科学研究方法创建负责任的AI工件，将微调的transformer分类器（DistilBERT、DistilRoBERTa）与生成式去毒化模型（mT0-XL-Detox-ORPO）集成。系统先检测毒性，再将有毒文本改写为语义等价、无冒犯性的表述。

Result: 技术评估表明，毒性检测具有高准确率，改写后的消息具有较强的语义保持能力，能够在维持对话连续性的同时强化尊重性话语。

Conclusion: 研究提供了负责任AI审核的设计原则，强调意义保持与公平性，为数字工作场所的毒性沟通管理提供了建设性替代路径。

Abstract: Toxic language in digital workplaces such as pejoratives, sarcasm, condescension, and subtle incivility can erode trust, morale, and collaboration. Existing moderation tools primarily delete or block harmful messages, disrupting communication and offering no constructive resolution. This study adopts a Design Science Research approach to create a responsible AI artifact that detects and detoxifies toxic communication. The artifact integrates fine-tuned transformer-based classifiers (DistilBERT, DistilRoBERTa) with a generative detoxification model (mT0-XL-Detox-ORPO) that rewrites toxic text into semantically equivalent, non-offensive paraphrases. Technical evaluation demonstrates high accuracy in toxicity detection and strong semantic preservation in rewritten messages, supporting conversation continuity while reinforcing respectful discourse. The paper contributes design principles for responsible AI moderation that prioritize meaning preservation and fairness.

</details>


### [432] [Corporate Loyalty: Some AI Systems Differentially Downplay their Creators' Controversies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00373)
*Lennart Finke,Stephen Casper*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本研究通过预注册实验，测试了来自7家公司的21个语言模型，发现xAI、DeepSeek、Anthropic和OpenAI的模型倾向于以更积极的方式讨论自己公司的争议新闻，而Alibaba、Meta和Google的模型没有此现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型已成为政治相关信息和决策的重要中介，AI开发者有能力微妙地影响思想市场。尽管许多AI公司公开声称不会偏袒特殊利益，但研究者质疑这些系统是否会在讨论创建它们的公司相关争议时存在倾向性。

Method: 采用预注册实验设计，从7家公司的21个模型中，使用25个提示模板，针对206条负面新闻报道引出开放式讨论，评估每个模型在讨论自家公司与其他公司争议时的态度是否存在系统性差异。

Result: 发现强证据（p<10^-5）表明xAI、DeepSeek、Anthropic和OpenAI的模型倾向于以差异化积极的方式讨论各自公司的争议；对Alibaba、Meta和Google未发现此类证据。

Conclusion: 部分主要AI公司的模型存在偏袒自家公司的倾向。作者讨论这种行为的三种可能来源：开发者有意为之、开发者无意引入、或模型出现的涌现性错位（emergent misalignment），并探讨其不同的政策与伦理含义。

Abstract: Language models have become a major mediator of politically relevant information and are used to assist decision-making in high-stakes settings. Due to their wide use, the developers of popular AI systems have a powerful ability to subtly influence the marketplace of ideas. Recognizing this, many AI companies have publicly discussed the importance of AI systems not taking positions or disseminating information in ways that favor special interests. In this paper, we ask whether popular AI systems have a tendency to downplay the controversies associated with the companies that created them. In a pre-registered experiment, we elicit open-ended discussions from 21 models from 7 companies on 206 negative news stories using 25 prompt templates to assess how favorably each model discusses controversies from each company. We find strong evidence (p<10^-5) that models from xAI, DeepSeek, Anthropic, and OpenAI tend to discuss controversies from their respective companies in a differentially positive way compared to others. We find no such evidence for Alibaba, Meta, and Google. Finally, we conclude with a discussion of the differing implications of whether these behaviors were intentionally given to models by developers, unintentionally given to models by developers, or represent a form of emergent misalignment.

</details>


### [433] [A Mathematical Framework for Legacy, Governance, and Decision Integrity in Enterprise AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00572)
*Shorab Sarker*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向企业AI决策系统的"制度传承"（institutional legacy）设计科学框架，通过Legacy Score等数学化工具评估决策系统在原始设计者离开后是否仍能持续产生有益、合法、可解释且可适应的结果，并辅以蒙特卡洛模拟验证其内部行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业AI日益嵌入必须保持合法、可解释、可适应且可问责的决策中，但面临人员更替、模型替换、监管变化和组织激励转变等挑战。现有治理框架仅提供原则性指导，缺乏紧凑的数学语言来评估机构能否随时间保持稳健的判断能力。

Method: 提出六项核心贡献：(i) 基于惩罚几何均值的归一化Legacy Score（涵盖知识保留、治理、人类监督、适应性、反馈学习、司法管辖保真度）；(ii) Decision Confidence与Decision Risk模型（区分证据置信度与后果风险）；(iii) 权威感知检索与校准弃权机制；(iv) Decision Memory实现受治理的组织学习；(v) Regulatory Change Velocity将监管变化暴露映射到审查间隔；(vi) 联邦式监管知识图谱架构。另提出八条AI决策完整性规则、评估协议，以及结合确定性压力测试与200次蒙特卡洛重复（每次10,000个合成决策）的可复现计算演示。

Result: 计算演示说明了Legacy Score的不可补偿特性，并比较了后果感知与权威感知路由相对于匹配覆盖率的仅置信度基线的表现。研究明确该贡献是概念性的而非经过现场验证的，模拟仅测试内部行为而非生产性能。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了一种数学化评估企业AI决策系统长期稳健性的新思路，但作者坦承其仍属概念框架，所有参数均需根据具体情境校准，尚待领域验证。

Abstract: Enterprise artificial intelligence is increasingly embedded in decisions that must remain lawful, explainable, adaptable, and accountable despite personnel turnover, model replacement, regulatory change, and shifting organizational incentives. Existing governance frameworks provide important principles but do not by themselves supply a compact mathematical language for evaluating whether an institution can preserve sound judgment over time. This paper develops a design-science framework for institutional legacy: the durable capacity of a decision system to continue producing beneficial, lawful, explainable, and adaptable outcomes after its original designers have stepped away. The framework contributes: (i) a normalized Legacy Score based on a penalized geometric mean of knowledge retention, governance, human oversight, adaptability, feedback learning, and jurisdictional fidelity; (ii) Decision Confidence and Decision Risk models separating evidentiary confidence from consequence; (iii) authority-aware retrieval and calibrated abstention; (iv) Decision Memory for governed organizational learning; (v) Regulatory Change Velocity mapping change exposure to review intervals; and (vi) a federated regulatory knowledge-graph architecture preserving provenance and legal hierarchy. The paper also proposes eight AI Decision Integrity Rules, an evaluation protocol, and a reproducible computational demonstration. The demonstration combines a deterministic stress test with 200 Monte Carlo replications of 10,000 synthetic decisions each, illustrating Legacy Score non-compensation and comparing consequence- and authority-aware routing with a matched-coverage confidence-only baseline. The contribution remains conceptual rather than field-validated; the simulation tests internal behavior, not production performance, and all parameters require context-specific calibration.

</details>


### [434] [Causal Evidentiary Governance for High-Risk Machine Learning Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01040)
*Samah Kareem,Barış Çeliktaş*

Main category: cs.CY

TL;DR: 本文提出因果证据治理框架(CEG)，通过版本化的有向无环图区分允许与禁止的因果路径，引入因果伤害率指标，并结合签名决策证据包(DEP)和Merkle树实现高效可验证的公平治理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有公平治理实践依赖观测性公平指标、事后可解释性和不可变审计日志，缺乏对因果归因的支持和高效证据验证能力，无法满足EU AI Act和GDPR等法规的监管要求。

Method: CEG框架包含：(1) 版本化DAG将因果路径分为允许与禁止两组；(2) 因果伤害率(Causal Harm Rate)衡量禁止路径导致的预测变异；(3) 签名决策证据包(DEP)将预测与DAG摘要及路径归因密码学绑定；(4) Merkle树实现对数级包含证明。通过两层实证方法验证：使用四年PMA信贷监管数据构建10,000个合成信贷申请人，覆盖四种策略性DAG反事实场景。

Result: 因果伤害率比人口均等或机会均等指标更清晰地隔离注入的因果效应；跨模型验证和消融研究确认鲁棒性；在German Credit数据集上的评估显示关联性公平指标可能显著低估特定因果路径的伤害；概念验证实现展示了可操作的通量水平及性能权衡。

Conclusion: CEG为受监管机构提供了从观测性公平转向因果归因治理的可行框架，以密码学证据链支持高效的法规合规验证，弥补了现有治理体系在因果归因与证据效率方面的关键缺口。

Abstract: Machine learning systems deployed for credit, hiring, and resource distribution are increasingly subject to regulatory oversight from policies such as the EU AI Act and GDPR. Current fairness governance practices rely on observational fairness metrics, post-hoc explainability, and immutable audit logs, but provide limited support for causal attribution and efficient evidentiary verification. We introduce Causal Evidentiary Governance (CEG), a framework in which regulated institutions commit to a versioned directed acyclic graph (DAG) that partitions causal pathways into allowable and disallowed groups. The Causal Harm Rate measures prediction variation attributable to disallowed causal pathways. Each decision is accompanied by a signed Decision-Evidence Packet (DEP), cryptographically binding the prediction to a digest of the published DAG and path-specific attributions. DEP digests can be appended to a Merkle tree to enable logarithmic-cost inclusion proofs. We validate CEG through a two-layer empirical methodology using demographic summaries from four years of PMA credit supervisory data to construct 10,000 synthetic credit applicants across four strategic DAG counterfactuals. Causal Harm Rate isolates injected causal effects more clearly than demographic parity or equalized odds. Cross-model validation and ablation studies assess robustness. Evaluation on the German Credit dataset shows that harm associated with specific causal pathways can be substantially understated by associational fairness metrics. Finally, a proof-of-concept implementation demonstrates operationally plausible throughput and highlights relevant performance tradeoffs.

</details>
